Lawh-i-Sarraj (Tablet to Sarraj)

BH00006

Translated by GPT 6.1 Sol on 15 Qudrat 183

1

هو المجیب

Huwa al-Mujīb

He is the Answerer.

2

نامهٴ آن جناب بین یدی العرش حاضر و بر مقرّ انّه لا یعرف بما سواه واصل و ما فیه بلحاظ اللّه ملحوظ آمد سؤال شده بود از اینکه چگونه میشود که حرف علّیّین بسجّین تبدیل شود و یا اثبات بنفی راجع گردد و یا ثمرهٴ جنیّه از لطافت ممنوع شود و یا مرآت از اشراقات انوار آفتاب معانی محروم ماند فنعم ما سألت و کنت من السّائلین

Nāma-yi ān janāb bayna yaday al-ʿarsh ḥāḍir va bar maqarr-i innahu lā yuʿrafu bi-mā siwāhu vāṣil va mā fīhi bi-liḥāẓ-i Allāh malḥūẓ āmad. Suʾāl shuda būd az īnki chigūna mīshavad ki ḥarf-i ʿilliyyīn bi-sijjīn tabdīl shavad va yā ithbāt bi-nafy rājiʿ gardad va yā thamara-yi janiyya az liṭāfat mamnūʿ shavad va yā mirʾāt az ishrāqāt-i anvār-i āftāb-i maʿānī maḥrūm mānad. Fa-niʿma mā saʾalta va kunta mina al-sāʾilīn.

Your letter was presented before the Throne and reached the seat of “He is not known through anything other than Himself,” and its contents came under the gaze of God. You had asked how a letter of the highest heaven can be changed into one of the lowest abyss, or affirmation revert to negation, or a ripe fruit be deprived of its sweetness, or a mirror remain deprived of the radiance of the lights of the Sun of inner meanings. Excellent indeed is what you have asked, and you are among those who inquire.

3

بسیار سؤال شما مقبول افتاد چه که الیوم لازم است هر نفسی که از عرفان معضلات مسائل الهیّه عاجز شود از شریعهٴ علم ربّانیّه و فرات حکمت صمدانیّه سائل و آمل گردد که شاید برشحی از آن مشروب شود و بر بساط سکون و ایقان مستریح گردد و نسأل اللّه بأن یصعدک الی مقام تشهد جمال القدم ببصرک و تنقطع عن بصر العالمین و تسمع نغماته بأذنک و تنقطع عن اذن الخلایق اجمعین و تعرف نفسه بقلبک و تنقطع عن افئدة کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین و یطهّرک عن دنس الدّنیا و ما فیها بحیث لن تمرّ علی شیء الّا و قد تسمع منه بأنّه لا اله الّا هو و انّ طلعة الأعلی لبهائه فی الملإ الأعلی و ضیائه بین الأرض و السّمآء و کبریائه لمن فی ملکوت الأمر و الخلق و کذلک ینطق کلّ شیء ان انت من السّامعین

Bisyār suʾāl-i shumā maqbūl uftād chi ki al-yawm lāzim ast har nafsī ki az ʿirfān-i muʿḍalāt-i masāʾil-i ilāhiyya ʿājiz shavad az sharīʿa-yi ʿilm-i rabbāniyya va furāt-i ḥikmat-i ṣamadāniyya sāʾil va āmil gardad ki shāyad bi-rashḥī az ān mashrūb shavad va bar bisāṭ-i sukūn va īqān mustarīḥ gardad. Va nasʾalu Allāha bi-an yuṣʿidaka ilā maqāmin tashhadu jamāla al-qidami bi-baṣarika va tanqaṭiʿu ʿan baṣari al-ʿālamīn va tasmaʿu naghamātihi bi-udhunika va tanqaṭiʿu ʿan udhuni al-khalāʾiqi ajmaʿīn va taʿrifu nafsahu bi-qalbika va tanqaṭiʿu ʿan afʾidati kulli man fī al-samāwāti va al-araḍīn va yuṭahhiraka ʿan danasi al-dunyā va mā fīhā bi-ḥaythu lan tamurra ʿalā shayʾin illā va qad tasmaʿu minhu bi-annahu lā ilāha illā huwa va inna ṭalʿata al-Aʿlā la-bahāʾuhu fī al-malaʾi al-aʿlā va ḍiyāʾuhu bayna al-arḍi va al-samāʾ va kibriyāʾuhu li-man fī malakūti al-amri va al-khalq. Va kadhālika yanṭiqu kullu shayʾin in anta mina al-sāmiʿīn.

Your question was most welcome, for today every soul who is unable to comprehend the difficulties of divine questions must seek and hope to receive from the river of divine knowledge and the Euphrates of eternal wisdom, that perhaps they may drink a sprinkling of it and find repose upon the carpet of tranquillity and certitude. We ask God to raise you to a station where you behold the Ancient Beauty with your own eyes and detach yourself from the sight of the peoples of the world, hear His melodies with your own ears and detach yourself from the hearing of all created beings, and recognize His Self with your own heart and detach yourself from the hearts of all who are in the heavens and on earth; and to purify you from the defilement of the world and all that is in it, so that you will pass by nothing without hearing it declare, “There is no God but Him, and the countenance of the Most Exalted is indeed His glory in the Concourse on high, His radiance between earth and heaven, and His majesty to those in the kingdom of command and creation.” Thus does everything speak, if you are among those who listen.

4

چه که الیوم بر هر نفسی من عند اللّه فرض شده که بچشم و گوش و فؤاد خود در امر او ملاحظه نماید و تفکّر کند تا از بدایع مرحمت رحمن و فیوضات حضرت سبحان باشراقات شمس معانی مستنیر و فایز شود و علّتی که جمیع ناس را از لقآء اللّه محروم نموده و به ما سواه مشغول داشته اینست که بوهم صرف کفایت نموده‌اند و بآنچه از امثال خود شنیده قناعت کرده‌اند براههای مهلک تقلید مشی نموده‌اند و از مناهج تجرید محروم شده‌اند امر الهی لازال چون صبح نورانی ظاهر و لایح بوده اینکه بعضی از ادراک او محتجب مانده‌اند نظر بآن است که گوش و قلب را بآلایش کلمات ناس آلوده‌اند والّا اگر ناظر باصل میزان معرفت الهی باشند هرگز از سبیل هدایت محروم نگردند

Chi ki al-yawm bar har nafsī min ʿindi Allāh farḍ shuda ki bi-chashm va gūsh va fuʾād-i khud dar amr-i ū mulāḥaẓa namāyad va tafakkur kunad tā az badāyiʿ-i marḥamat-i Raḥmān va fuyūḍāt-i Ḥaḍrat-i Subḥān bi-ishrāqāt-i shams-i maʿānī mustanīr va fāʾiz shavad. Va ʿillatī ki jamīʿ-i nās rā az liqāʾ-i Allāh maḥrūm namūda va bi-mā siwāhu mashghūl dāshta īnast ki bi-vahm-i ṣirf kifāyat namūda-and va bi-ānchi az amthāl-i khud shanīda qanāʿat karda-and. Bi-rāhhā-yi muhlik-i taqlīd mashy namūda-and va az manāhij-i tajrīd maḥrūm shuda-and. Amr-i ilāhī lāzāl chūn ṣubḥ-i nūrānī ẓāhir va lāʾiḥ būda. Īnki baʿḍī az idrāk-i ū muḥtajib mānda-and naẓar bi-ān ast ki gūsh va qalb rā bi-ālāyish-i kalimāt-i nās ālūda-and va illā agar nāẓir bi-aṣl-i mīzān-i maʿrifat-i ilāhī bāshand hargiz az sabīl-i hidāyat maḥrūm nagardand.

For today God has enjoined upon every soul to examine and reflect upon His Cause with their own eyes, ears, and heart, so that, through the wondrous mercy of the All-Merciful and the outpourings of the All-Glorious, they may be illumined by the radiance of the Sun of inner meanings and attain its grace. The reason all people have been deprived of meeting God and occupied with anything other than Him is that they have contented themselves with mere fancy and been satisfied with what they have heard from others like themselves. They have walked the deadly paths of imitation and been deprived of the ways of detachment. The Cause of God has always been as manifest and radiant as the luminous dawn. That some have remained veiled from perceiving it is because they have defiled their ears and hearts with the pollution of people’s words. Otherwise, if they looked to the fundamental standard of the knowledge of God, they would never be deprived of the path of guidance.

5

حال خود آن جناب ملاحظه نماید امر از دو قسم بیرون نه یا آنکه اهل بیان مقرّند بقدرت الهیّه یا نه اگر معترف نیستند باین نفوس حرفی نداریم چه که از ملل قبل محسوبند که ید اللّه را مغلول دانسته‌اند چنانچه ربّ العزّة خبر داده بقوله تعالی ید اللّه مغلولة و اگر معترفند ببدایع قدرت ربّانی در این صورت اعتکاف باینگونه مسائل لغو بوده و باطل خواهد بود چه که عجز شأن خلق بوده و آن ذات قدم لازال بر عرش قدرت و اقتدار مستوی و اگر اراده فرماید بحرفی جمیع من علی الأرض را بسموات امر متصاعد فرماید و بحرف دیگر بادنی رتبهٴ خلق راجع نماید و لیس لأحد ان یقول لم و بم و من قال فقد کفر باللّه و اعرض عن قدرته و حارب بنفسه و نازع بسلطانه و کان من المشرکین فی الواح عزّ حفیظ

Ḥāl khud-i ān janāb mulāḥaẓa namāyad amr az du qism bīrūn na: yā ānki ahl-i Bayān muqirr-and bi-qudrat-i ilāhiyya yā na. Agar muʿtarif nīstand bi-īn nufūs ḥarfī nadārīm chi ki az milal-i qabl maḥsūb-and ki yad-i Allāh rā maghlūl dānista-and chunānchi Rabb al-ʿIzza khabar dāda bi-qawlihi taʿālā: Yadu Allāhi maghlūla. Va agar muʿtarif-and bi-badāyiʿ-i qudrat-i rabbānī dar īn ṣūrat iʿtikāf bi-īngūna masāʾil laghv būda va bāṭil khwāhad būd chi ki ʿajz shaʾn-i khalq būda va ān Dhāt-i Qidam lāzāl bar ʿarsh-i qudrat va iqtidār mustavī va agar irāda farmāyad bi-ḥarfī jamīʿ-i man ʿalā al-arḍ rā bi-samāvāt-i amr mutaṣāʿid farmāyad va bi-ḥarf-i dīgar bi-adnā rutba-yi khalq rājiʿ namāyad. Va laysa li-aḥadin an yaqūla lima va bima va man qāla fa-qad kafara bi-Allāhi va aʿraḍa ʿan qudratihi va ḥāraba bi-nafsihi va nāzaʿa bi-sulṭānihi va kāna mina al-mushrikīn fī alwāḥi ʿizzin ḥafīẓ.

Now consider for yourself: the matter admits of only two possibilities. Either the people of the Bayān acknowledge divine power, or they do not. If they do not acknowledge it, We have nothing to say to such souls, for they are reckoned among the religious communities of the past who considered God’s hand to be fettered, as the Lord of Glory has related in His exalted words: “God’s hand is fettered.” But if they acknowledge the wonders of divine power, then dwelling on questions of this kind is futile and will be of no avail. For powerlessness is a condition of creation, while that Eternal Essence has always been established upon the throne of power and might. If He so wills, with a word He can raise all who are on earth to the heavens of His Cause, and with another word return them to the lowest rank of creation. No one has the right to say “Why?” or “Whereby?” Whoever says this has disbelieved in God, turned away from His power, made war upon His Self, and contested His sovereignty, and is numbered among those who associate partners with God in the tablets of inviolable glory.

6

و هم‌چنین قادر است باینکه هر وقت اراده فرماید مظهر نفس خود را در بین بریّه مبعوث نماید و در حین ظهور باید از نفس ظهور او تعالی حجّت و دلیل خواست اگر بآن حجّتی که لازال مابین ناس بوده اتیان فرمود دیگر توقّف باطل است بلکه اگر کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض اقلّ من حین توقّف نمایند از اهل نار محسوب اگرچه جمیع ادّعای ولایت نمایند عزیز میکند هر که را اراده فرماید و ذلیل میفرماید هر که را بخواهد لا یسأل عمّا یفعل

Va hamchunīn qādir ast bi-īnki har vaqt irāda farmāyad maẓhar-i nafs-i khud rā dar bayn-i bariyya mabʿūth namāyad va dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr bāyad az nafs-i ẓuhūr-i ū taʿālā ḥujjat va dalīl khwāst. Agar bi-ān ḥujjatī ki lāzāl mābayn-i nās būda ityān farmūd dīgar tavaqquf bāṭil ast balki agar kull-i man fī al-samāvāt va al-arḍ aqall-i min ḥīn tavaqquf namāyand az ahl-i nār maḥsūb agarchi jamīʿ iddiʿā-yi vilāyat namāyand. ʿAzīz mīkunad har ki rā irāda farmāyad va dhalīl mīfarmāyad har ki rā bikhwāhad. Lā yusʾalu ʿammā yafʿal.

Likewise, He has the power to raise up the Manifestation of His own Self among creation whenever He wills. At the time of His appearance, proof and evidence must be sought from His exalted Manifestation Himself. If He produces that proof which has always existed among people, further hesitation is unwarranted. Indeed, if all who are in the heavens and on earth hesitate for less than an instant, they are reckoned among the people of the fire, even if they all claim sainthood. He exalts whomever He wills and abases whomever He wishes. He is not questioned about what He does.

7

حال آن جناب بانصاف ملاحظه نمایند اگر نفسی بجمیع شئونات قدرتیّهٴ الهیّه ظاهر شود و علاوه بر آن اتیان نماید بآن حجّتی که لازال بآن اثبات دین ناس شده و امر اللّه بین بریّهٴ او ثابت گشته و مع‌ذلک از چنین ظهور که نفس ظهور اللّه بوده نفسی اعراض نماید و باعراض هم کفایت ننموده بر قتلش قیام نماید آیا بر چنین نفسی چه حکم جاری قل حکمه عند اللّه یحکم ما یشآء کما حکم بالحقّ ولکنّ النّاس هم لا یشعرون آیا در هیچ عهدی و ملّتی چنین امری جایز بوده لا فونفسه الرّحمن الرّحیم

Ḥāl ān janāb bi-inṣāf mulāḥaẓa namāyand agar nafsī bi-jamīʿ-i shuʾūnāt-i qudratiyya-yi ilāhiyya ẓāhir shavad va ʿalāva bar ān ityān namāyad bi-ān ḥujjatī ki lāzāl bi-ān ithbāt-i dīn-i nās shuda va amr-i Allāh bayn-i bariyya-yi ū thābit gashta va maʿa dhālik az chunīn ẓuhūr ki nafs-i ẓuhūr-i Allāh būda nafsī iʿrāḍ namāyad va bi-iʿrāḍ ham kifāyat nanamūda bar qatl-ash qiyām namāyad āyā bar chunīn nafsī chi ḥukm jārī? Qul ḥukmuhu ʿinda Allāh yaḥkumu mā yashāʾ kamā ḥakama bi-al-ḥaqq va lākinna al-nāsa hum lā yashʿurūn. Āyā dar hīch ʿahdī va millatī chunīn amrī jāʾiz būda? Lā fa-wa-nafsihi al-Raḥmāni al-Raḥīm.

Now consider fairly: if a person appears invested with all the expressions of divine power and, moreover, produces that proof by which people’s religion has always been substantiated and the Cause of God established among His creatures, and yet someone turns away from such a manifestation, which is the very Manifestation of God, and, not content with turning away, rises up to kill Him, what judgment applies to such a person? Say: His judgment rests with God. He decrees whatever He wills, just as He has decreed in truth, but the people do not perceive. Has such a deed ever been permissible in any age or religious community? No, by His own Self, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate!

8

اگر بگویند این ظهور نباید ظاهر شود چنانچه مشرکین گفته‌اند در این صورت قدرت و ارادهٴ حقّ منوط و معلّق بارادهٴ خلق میشود فتعالی عن ذلک علوّاً کبیراً چنانچه در ظهور ستّین کلّ ناس از عالم و جاهل باین سخنهای مزخرف بی‌معنی از حقّ محروم شده‌اند و از علّیّین بقا بسجّین فنا راجع گشته‌اند و بگمان خود بر اعلی مقعد ایمان مستقرّند فبئس ما ظنّوا فی انفسهم و کانوا من المتوهّمین فی امّ الألواح مذکورا

Agar bigūyand īn ẓuhūr nabāyad ẓāhir shavad chunānchi mushrikīn gufta-and dar īn ṣūrat qudrat va irāda-yi Ḥaqq manūṭ va muʿallaq bi-irāda-yi khalq mīshavad. Fa-taʿālā ʿan dhālika ʿuluwwan kabīrā. Chunānchi dar ẓuhūr-i sittīn kull-i nās az ʿālim va jāhil bi-īn sukhanhā-yi muzakhraf-i bī-maʿnī az Ḥaqq maḥrūm shuda-and va az ʿilliyyīn-i baqā bi-sijjīn-i fanā rājiʿ gashta-and va bi-gumān-i khud bar aʿlā maqʿad-i īmān mustaqirr-and. Fa-biʾsa mā ẓannū fī anfusihim va kānū mina al-mutawahhimīn fī Umm al-Alwāḥ madhkūrā.

If they say that this Manifestation must not appear, as those who associate partners with God have said, then God’s power and will become dependent upon and subject to the will of His creatures. Exalted, immeasurably exalted, is He above that! Thus, at the Revelation of the year sixty, all people, learned and ignorant alike, were deprived of God through such meaningless, spurious words, and returned from the highest heaven of eternity to the lowest abyss of extinction, while imagining themselves established upon the loftiest seat of faith. How evil is what they have imagined concerning themselves! In the Mother of Tablets they are recorded among those who are deluded.

9

باری نظر را از ما سوی اللّه بردار و بحقّ ناظر شو و به ما یظهر من عنده چه که دون او لاشیء محض بوده و خواهد بود و اگر الیوم کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض حروفات بیانیّه شوند که بصدهزار رتبه از حروفات فرقانیّه اعظم و اکبرند و اقلّ من آن در این امر توقّف نمایند از معرضین عنداللّه محسوبند و از احرف نفی منسوب

Bārī naẓar rā az mā sivā-yi Allāh bardār va bi-Ḥaqq nāẓir shaw va bi-mā yaẓharu min ʿindihi chi ki dūn-i ū lā-shayʾ-i maḥḍ būda va khwāhad būd va agar al-yawm kull-i man fī al-samāvāt va al-arḍ ḥurūfāt-i bayāniyya shavand ki bi-ṣad hazār rutba az ḥurūfāt-i furqāniyya aʿẓam va akbar-and va aqall-i min ān dar īn amr tavaqquf namāyand az muʿriḍīn ʿinda Allāh maḥsūb-and va az aḥruf-i nafy mansūb.

In short, turn your gaze away from everything but God and look to Him and to whatever appears from Him, for all besides Him has been and will remain sheer nothingness. If today all who are in the heavens and on earth were to become letters of the Bayān, who are a hundred thousand degrees greater and mightier than the letters of the Qurʾān, and were to hesitate in this Cause for less than an instant, they would be reckoned before God among those who turn away and numbered among the letters of negation.

10

حقّ جلّ و عزّ را باحدی نسبت و ربط و مشابهت و مشاکلت نه و کلّ به نسبتهم الی عرفانه مفتخر و معزّز بوده و خواهند بود جمال سبحان بر عرش رحمن مستوی و پرتو انوار شمس فضلش بر کلّ اشیاء بالسّویّه اشراق و تجلّی فرموده و جمیع من فی الملک بین یدی الفضل در صقع واحد قائمند و ذرّه را بر ذرّه افتخار و زیادتی نه الّا بسبقتها الی عرفان اللّه و لقائه فطوبی لمن عرفه بنفسه و انقطع عمّا سواه

Ḥaqq jalla va ʿazza rā bi-aḥadī nisbat va rabṭ va mushābahat va mushākalat na va kull bi-nisbatihim ilā ʿirfānihi muftakhir va muʿazzaz būda va khwāhand būd. Jamāl-i Subḥān bar ʿarsh-i Raḥmān mustavī va partaw-i anvār-i shams-i faḍl-ash bar kull-i ashyāʾ bi-al-saviyya ishrāq va tajallī farmūda va jamīʿ-i man fī al-mulk bayna yaday al-faḍl dar ṣuqʿ-i vāḥid qāʾim-and va dharra rā bar dharra iftikhār va ziyādatī na illā bi-sabqatihā ilā ʿirfāni Allāhi va liqāʾihi. Fa-ṭūbā li-man ʿarafahu bi-nafsihi va inqaṭaʿa ʿammā siwāhu.

God, glorified and exalted is He, bears no relation, connection, resemblance, or likeness to anyone, and all have been and will be honored and exalted according to their relation to the recognition of Him. The All-Glorious Beauty is established upon the throne of the All-Merciful, and the rays of the light of the sun of His grace have shone and appeared equally upon all things. All who dwell in the realm of existence stand on a single plane before His grace, and no atom has any distinction or superiority over another except through its precedence in recognizing God and meeting Him. Blessed, then, is the one who has recognized Him through Himself and detached himself from everything but Him.

11

ای علیّ بشنو ندآء اللّه را و بمقرّی وارد شو که لازال مقدّس از اسماء بوده و خواهد بود تا بهیچ اسمی از جمال مسمّی و سلطانی که بارادهٴ قلمش ملکوت اسماء خلق شده محروم نگردی فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو که مقصود از این بیان آن است که شاید آن جناب و معدودی خرق حجاب نموده بسرادق قدس محبوب که مقدّس از ظنون و اوهام عباد بوده درآیند والّا انّه لمتعالی عن اقبال الخلق و اعراضهم و مقدّس عن العالمین

Ay ʿAlī bishnaw nidā-yi Allāh rā va bi-maqarrī vārid shaw ki lāzāl muqaddas az asmāʾ būda va khwāhad būd tā bi-hīch ismī az jamāl-i musammā va sulṭānī ki bi-irāda-yi qalam-ash malakūt-i asmāʾ khalq shuda maḥrūm nagardī. Fa-wa-Allāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa ki maqṣūd az īn bayān ān ast ki shāyad ān janāb va maʿdūdī kharq-i ḥijāb namūda bi-surādiq-i quds-i Maḥbūb ki muqaddas az ẓunūn va awhām-i ʿibād būda darāyand va illā innahu la-mutaʿālin ʿan iqbāli al-khalqi va iʿrāḍihim va muqaddasun ʿan al-ʿālamīn.

O ʿAlī, hear the call of God and enter a realm that has always been and will forever remain sanctified above names, so that no name may deprive you of the beauty of the One named, the Sovereign through the will of whose Pen the kingdom of names was created. By God, besides whom there is no other god, the purpose of these words is that perhaps you and a few others may rend the veil and enter the tabernacle of the Beloved’s holiness, which is sanctified above the suppositions and imaginings of His servants. Otherwise, He is indeed exalted above the turning of His creatures toward Him or away from Him, and sanctified above all the worlds.

12

آیا در حین اشراق شمس لایق است نفسی سؤال نماید که چگونه میشود نور انجم اخذ شود و حال آنکه ملاحظه مینماید که نور آفتاب روشنی او را معدوم نموده بلکه در این مقام نجوم طالب ظلمت لیلند و از نور نهار معرض چه که قدر و ضیاء نجوم در لیل مشهود است و از تجلّی نیّر یوم معدوم و مفقود میگردند فسبحانه عن المثل و الأمثال چه که لازال نیّر جمالش مستضیء بوده و احدی با او نبوده و کلّ ما سواه در امکنهٴ ترابیّه بمشیّت امکانیّه خلق شده‌اند و باو راجع خواهند شد و انّه جلّ و عزّ در مقعد امتناع و مقرّ ارتفاع خود لم‌یزل و لایزال مقدّس از کلّ بوده و خواهد بود بسیار عجیب است که از تغییر و تبدیل اسماء ناس تعجّب مینمایند و متحیّر شده‌اند با اینکه جمیع در کلّ حین تغییر و تبدیل مظاهر اسماء و مطالع آن را ببصر ظاهر مشاهده مینمایند و مع‌ذلک بحجبات وهمیّه و کلمات شرکیّه چنان محتجب مانده‌اند که از آنچه ببصر ملاحظه مینمایند غافل شده‌اند

Āyā dar ḥīn-i ishrāq-i shams lāyiq ast nafsī suʾāl namāyad ki chigūna mīshavad nūr-i anjum akhdh shavad va ḥāl ānki mulāḥaẓa mīnamāyad ki nūr-i āftāb rawshanī-yi ū rā maʿdūm namūda balki dar īn maqām nujūm ṭālib-i ẓulmat-i layl-and va az nūr-i nahār muʿriḍ chi ki qadr va ḍiyā-yi nujūm dar layl mashhūd ast va az tajallī-yi nayyir-i yawm maʿdūm va mafqūd mīgardand. Fa-subḥānahu ʿan al-mathali va al-amthāl chi ki lāzāl nayyir-i jamāl-ash mustaḍīʾ būda va aḥadī bā ū nabūda va kull-i mā sivāhu dar amkina-yi turābiyya bi-mashiyyat-i imkāniyya khalq shuda-and va bi-ū rājiʿ khwāhand shud va innahu jalla va ʿazza dar maqʿad-i imtināʿ va maqarr-i irtifāʿ-i khud lam-yazal va lā-yazāl muqaddas az kull būda va khwāhad būd. Bisyār ʿajīb ast ki az taghyīr va tabdīl-i asmāʾ-i nās taʿajjub mīnamāyand va mutaḥayyir shuda-and bā īnki jamīʿ dar kull-i ḥīn taghyīr va tabdīl-i maẓāhir-i asmāʾ va maṭāliʿ-i ān rā bi-baṣar-i ẓāhir mushāhada mīnamāyand va maʿa dhālik bi-ḥujubāt-i vahmiyya va kalimāt-i shirkiyya chunān muḥtajib mānda-and ki az ānchi bi-baṣar mulāḥaẓa mīnamāyand ghāfil shuda-and.

When the sun shines, is it fitting for anyone to ask how the light of the stars can be taken away, while observing that the sunlight has effaced their brightness? Indeed, in this condition the stars seek the darkness of night and turn away from the light of day, for the worth and radiance of the stars are seen at night, and through the shining of the orb of day they vanish and disappear. Glorified is He above comparison and likenesses! For the orb of His beauty has always been radiant, and no one has been with Him. All besides Him have been created in earthly abodes through the will pertaining to contingent existence, and to Him they will return. He, glorified and exalted is He, in His inaccessible seat and His lofty abode, has ever been and will forever remain sanctified above all. It is most strange that people are astonished and bewildered by the change and alteration of names, although at every moment they all observe with their outward eyes the change and alteration of the manifestations of names and their dawning-places. Yet they have remained so veiled by imaginary veils and words that associate partners with God that they have become heedless of what they see with their own eyes.

13

ای سائل اسماء و صفات الهی را موهوم مدان بدان که جمیع اشیاء از آنچه مابین ارض و سماء خلق شده مظاهر اسماء و مطالع صفات حقّ تعالی شأنه بوده و خواهد بود غایت این است که انسان نسبت بدون خود اعظم رتبةً و اکبر مقاماً خلق شده و اگر در سماء ما تری فی خلق الرّحمن من تفاوت ارتقا نمائی در خلق رحمانی و مطالع صنع سبحانی تفاوت و فطور نبینی فطوبی لمن طار فی هذا الهوآء الّذی ما طارت فیه اجنحة المریبین

Ay sāʾil asmāʾ va ṣifāt-i ilāhī rā mawhūm madān. Bidān ki jamīʿ-i ashyāʾ az ānchi mābayn-i arḍ va samāʾ khalq shuda maẓāhir-i asmāʾ va maṭāliʿ-i ṣifāt-i Ḥaqq taʿālā shaʾnuhu būda va khwāhad būd. Ghāyat īn ast ki insān nisbat bi-dūn-i khud aʿẓam rutbatan va akbar maqāman khalq shuda va agar dar samā-yi mā tarā fī khalqi al-Raḥmāni min tafāwut irtiqā namāʾī dar khalq-i raḥmānī va maṭāliʿ-i ṣunʿ-i subḥānī tafāvut va fuṭūr nabīnī. Fa-ṭūbā li-man ṭāra fī hādhā al-hawāʾ alladhī mā ṭārat fīhi ajniḥatu al-murībīn.

O questioner, do not regard the divine names and attributes as imaginary. Know that all things created between earth and heaven have been and will remain manifestations of the names and dawning-places of the attributes of God, exalted is His station. It is only that the human being has been created greater in rank and loftier in station than all else. If you ascend into the heaven of “You see no disparity in the creation of the All-Merciful,” you will see neither disparity nor flaw in the creation of the All-Merciful and the dawning-places of His glorious handiwork. Blessed, then, is the one who has soared in this atmosphere, where the wings of the doubters have never flown.

14

و حال ملاحظه نما در جمیع این مظاهر اسمیّهٴ الهیّه از اشجار و افنان و اغصان و اثمار و هم‌چنین در اوراد و ازهار و کلّما ینبت علی وجه الأرض که در اوّل بچه مقدار طراوت و لطافت و نضارت ظاهر میشوند و بعد از مدّتی کلّ از خلع لطیفه عاری شده بارض راجع شوند چه مقدار از ثمرات جنیّه که تغییر نماید بشأنی که از رایحهٴ او انسان اجتناب نماید باری کلّ در علوّ و دنوّ و تغییر و تبدیل مگر مظاهر کلّیّهٴ الهیّه که بنفسه لنفسه قائم و باقیند

Va ḥāl mulāḥaẓa namā dar jamīʿ-i īn maẓāhir-i ismiyya-yi ilāhiyya az ashjār va afnān va aghṣān va athmār va ham-chunīn dar avrād va azhār va kulli mā yanbutu ʿalā wajhi al-arḍ ki dar avval bi-chi miqdār ṭarāvat va laṭāfat va niḍārat ẓāhir mī-shavand va baʿd az muddatī kull az khilaʿ-i laṭīfa ʿārī shuda bi-arḍ rājiʿ shavand. Chi miqdār az thamarāt-i janiyya ki taghyīr namāyad bi-shaʾnī ki az rāʾiḥa-yi ū insān ijtināb namāyad. Bārī kull dar ʿuluvv va dunuvv va taghyīr va tabdīl magar maẓāhir-i kulliyya-yi ilāhiyya ki bi-nafsihi li-nafsihi qāʾim va bāqī-and.

Now consider all these manifestations of the divine names—trees, boughs, branches, and fruits, as well as roses, blossoms, and everything that grows upon the face of the earth—with what freshness, delicacy, and verdure they first appear, and how, after a time, they are all stripped of their delicate robes and return to the earth. How many ripe fruits undergo such a change that people recoil from their smell! In short, all undergo ascent and decline, change and transformation, except the universal Manifestations of God, who subsist and endure through themselves and for themselves.

15

قسم بآفتاب صبح معانی که لسان الهی بشأن و اندازهٴ ناس تکلّم میفرماید چه که اکثری از ناس ببلوغ نرسیده‌اند والّا بابی از علم بر وجه عباد مفتوح میفرمود که کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض بافاضهٴ قلمیّهٴ او از علم ماسوی خود را غنیّ مشاهده نموده بر اعراش سکون مستقرّ میشدند و نظر بعدم استعداد ناس جواهر علم ربّانی و اسرار حکمت صمدانی در سماء مشیّت الهی محفوظ و مستور مانده و تا حین حرفی از آن نازل نشده و بعد الأمر بیده یفعل ما یشآء و لا یسأل عمّا شآء و هو العلیم الخبیر

Qasam bi-āftāb-i ṣubḥ-i maʿānī ki lisān-i ilāhī bi-shaʾn va andāza-yi nās takallum mī-farmāyad, chi ki aktharī az nās bi-bulūgh na-rasīda-and, va illā bābī az ʿilm bar vajh-i ʿibād maftūḥ mī-farmūd ki kullu man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍ bi-ifāḍa-yi qalamiyya-yi ū az ʿilm-i mā-sivā khud rā ghanī mushāhada namūda bar aʿrāsh-i sukūn mustaqarr mī-shudand. Va naẓar bi-ʿadam-i istiʿdād-i nās javāhir-i ʿilm-i rabbānī va asrār-i ḥikmat-i ṣamadānī dar samā-yi mashiyyat-i ilāhī maḥfūẓ va mastūr mānda va tā ḥīn ḥarfī az ān nāzil na-shuda va baʿd al-amru bi-yadihi yafʿalu mā yashāʾu wa lā yusʾalu ʿammā shāʾa wa huwa al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr.

I swear by the Sun of the morning of inner meanings that the divine Tongue speaks in keeping with the condition and capacity of the people, for most people have not reached maturity. Otherwise, He would open a door of knowledge before His servants such that all who are in the heavens and on earth, through the outpouring of His Pen, would find themselves independent of the knowledge of all besides Him and would be established upon thrones of tranquility. In view of the people’s lack of readiness, the gems of divine knowledge and the mysteries of eternal wisdom have remained guarded and concealed in the heaven of God’s will, and until now not a word of them has been revealed. Hereafter, the matter rests in His hand: He does whatever He wills and is not questioned about what He has willed. He is the All-Knowing, the All-Aware.

16

و اگر از این عبد میشنوی پرهای تحدید و تقلید را بیفکن و بپرهای تجرید در این هوای قدس توحید پرواز کن تا از شبهات وهمیّه و اشارات ریبیّه خود را مقدّس یابی و بانوار یقین خود را منوّر بینی بگوش جان کلمات رحمانی را اصغا نما که شاید قلب از غبار مکدّرهٴ اوهام که در این ایّام کلّ من فی الملک را احاطه نموده مطهّر شده بمنظر اکبر راجع شود

Va agar az īn ʿabd mī-shinavī par-hā-yi taḥdīd va taqlīd rā biyafkan va bi-par-hā-yi tajrīd dar īn havā-yi quds-i tawḥīd parvāz kun tā az shubuhāt-i vahmiyya va ishārāt-i raybiyya khud rā muqaddas yābī va bi-anvār-i yaqīn khud rā munavvar bīnī. Bi-gūsh-i jān kalimāt-i raḥmānī rā iṣghā namā ki shāyad qalb az ghubār-i mukaddira-yi avhām ki dar īn ayyām kulla man fī al-mulk rā iḥāṭa namūda muṭahhar shuda bi-manẓar-i akbar rājiʿ shavad.

If you will listen to this servant, cast away the wings of limitation and imitation, and soar on the wings of detachment in this holy atmosphere of divine unity, so that you may find yourself sanctified from fanciful doubts and dubious allusions, and see yourself illumined by the lights of certitude. Listen with the ear of your soul to the words of the All-Merciful, that perhaps the heart may be cleansed of the obscuring dust of imaginings that has enveloped all who dwell in the world in these days, and may turn toward the Most Great Vision.

17

و چون باین مقام اقدس امنع اطهر فایز شوی ملاحظه مینمائی که مقصود ما فی البیان که از سماء مشیّت ظهور قبلم نازل شده این ظهور بوده و خواهد بود فوالّذی نفس حسین فی قبضة قدرته که اعظم از این امر در بیان نازل نشده

Va chūn bi-īn maqām-i aqdas-i amnaʿ-i aṭhar fāʾiz shavī mulāḥaẓa mī-namāʾī ki maqṣūd-i mā fī al-Bayān ki az samā-yi mashiyyat-i ẓuhūr-i qablam nāzil shuda īn ẓuhūr būda va khvāhad būd. Fa-wa-alladhī nafsu Ḥusaynin fī qabḍati qudratihi ki aʿẓam az īn amr dar Bayān nāzil na-shuda.

When you attain this most holy, most inaccessible, most pure station, you will perceive that the purpose of all that was revealed in the Bayān from the heaven of the will of My previous Manifestation has been and will remain this Revelation. By Him in the grasp of whose power is the soul of Ḥusayn, nothing greater than this Cause has been revealed in the Bayān.

18

ببصر منیر حدید در او ملاحظه نمائید تا بر مقصود کلمات قدس ربّانی مطّلع شوید و در جمیع اوراق و الواح و رقاع و صحف و زبر و کتب کلّ ناس را وصیّت فرموده و از جمیع اخذ عهد نموده که مباد در حین ظهور بشیئی از آنچه خلق شده متمسّک شوند و از نفس ظهور محتجب مانند چه که در آن یوم هیچ شیئی نفع نمی‌بخشد الّا بعد اذنه

Bi-baṣar-i munīr-i ḥadīd dar ū mulāḥaẓa namāʾīd tā bar maqṣūd-i kalimāt-i quds-i rabbānī muṭṭaliʿ shavīd va dar jamīʿ-i avrāq va alvāḥ va riqāʿ va ṣuḥuf va zubur va kutub kull-i nās rā vaṣiyyat farmūda va az jamīʿ akhdh-i ʿahd namūda ki mabād dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr bi-shayʾī az ānchi khalq shuda mutamassik shavand va az nafs-i ẓuhūr muḥtajib mānand, chi ki dar ān yawm hīch shayʾī nafʿ na-mī-bakhshad illā baʿda idhnihi.

Examine it with clear and penetrating vision, so that you may understand the intent of the holy words of the Lord. In all His pages, tablets, missives, scriptures, writings, and books, He has counseled all people and taken a covenant from them all, lest at the time of the Revelation they cling to anything that has been created and remain veiled from the Manifestation Himself. For on that Day nothing is of any avail except by His permission.

19

به وحید اکبر میفرمایند و انتظروا من یذکرکم اللّه وجهه فانّکم ما خلقتم الّا للقائه و هو الّذی علّق کلّ شیء بأمره ایّاک ایّاک ایّام ظهوره ان تحتجب بالواحد البیانیّة فانّ ذلک الواحد خلق عنده و ایّاک ایّاک ان تحتجب بکلمات ما نزّلت فی البیان فانّها کلمات نفسه فی هیکل ظهوره من قبل

Bi-Vaḥīd-i Akbar mī-farmāyand: wa-intaẓirū man yudhakkirukumu Allāhu wajhahu fa-innakum mā khuliqtum illā li-liqāʾihi wa huwa alladhī ʿallaqa kulla shayʾin bi-amrihi. Iyyāka iyyāka ayyāma ẓuhūrihi an taḥtajiba bi-al-wāḥidi al-bayāniyya fa-inna dhālika al-wāḥida khuliqa ʿindahu wa iyyāka iyyāka an taḥtajiba bi-kalimāti mā nuzzilat fī al-Bayān fa-innahā kalimātu nafsihi fī haykali ẓuhūrihi min qabl.

He says to Vaḥīd-i Akbar: “Await Him whose countenance God will call to your remembrance, for you were created only to meet Him. He is the One who has made all things dependent upon His command. Beware, beware lest in the days of His appearance you allow the Vāḥid of the Bayān to veil you, for that Vāḥid is a creation in His sight. Beware, beware lest you be veiled by the words revealed in the Bayān, for they are His own words in the temple of His previous Manifestation.”

20

حال در این کلمات سلطان اسماء و صفات تفکّر نمائید با این آیات محکمه و کلمات متقنه دیگر مجال اعراض برای نفسی باقی میماند لا فوالّذی انطق الرّوح فی صدری مگر آنکه بالمرّه از حقّ اعراض نماید و واحد بیان خلق اوّلیّه‌اند و ما دونهم خلقوا فی ظلّهم

Ḥāl dar īn kalimāt-i sulṭān-i asmā va ṣifāt tafakkur namāʾīd. Bā īn āyāt-i muḥkama va kalimāt-i mutqana dīgar majāl-i iʿrāḍ barā-yi nafsī bāqī mī-mānad? Lā fa-wa-alladhī anṭaqa al-Rūḥa fī ṣadrī, magar ānki bi-al-marra az Ḥaqq iʿrāḍ namāyad. Va Vāḥid-i Bayān khalq-i avvaliyya-and wa mā dūnahum khuliqū fī ẓillihim.

Now reflect on these words of the Sovereign of names and attributes. With these firm verses and conclusive words, does any room remain for anyone to turn away? No, by Him who has caused the Spirit to speak within My breast—unless one should turn away from God altogether. The Vāḥid of the Bayān are the first creation, and all besides them were created beneath their shadow.

21

و هم‌چنین به وحید اکبر میفرمایند و ربّما یأتیک من انت قد سألت عن علوّ ذکره و ارتفاع امره و انّ من فی البیان یقرؤون تلک الکلمات و هم لا یلتفتون بظهوره و لا یؤمنون باللّه الّذی خلقهم بظهور قبله و هم راقدون

Va ham-chunīn bi-Vaḥīd-i Akbar mī-farmāyand: wa rubbamā yaʾtīka man anta qad saʾalta ʿan ʿuluwwi dhikrihi wa irtifāʿi amrihi wa inna man fī al-Bayān yaqraʾūna tilka al-kalimāti wa hum lā yaltafitūna bi-ẓuhūrihi wa lā yuʾminūna bi-Allāhi alladhī khalaqahum bi-ẓuhūrin qablihi wa hum rāqidūn.

He likewise says to Vaḥīd-i Akbar: “Perhaps He will come to you about the loftiness of whose mention and the exaltation of whose Cause you have asked. Those who are in the Bayān read these words, yet they pay no heed to His appearance, nor do they believe in God, who created them through a Revelation before Him, and they lie asleep.”

22

چنانچه حال ملاحظه میشود که کلّ تلاوت کتاب اللّه مینمایند و در لیل و نهار مینویسند و مع‌ذلک بحرفی از کتاب مستشعر نشده‌اند بلکه مقصود از ترویج جز تحقّق ریاست و اثبات آن نبوده و نخواهد بود کذلک یشهد لسان اللّه الملک العزیز العلیم

Chunānchi ḥāl mulāḥaẓa mī-shavad ki kull tilāvat-i Kitāb Allāh mī-namāyand va dar layl va nahār mī-nivīsand va maʿa-dhālik bi-ḥarfī az Kitāb mustashʿir na-shuda-and balki maqṣūd az tarvīj juz taḥaqquq-i riyāsat va ithbāt-i ān na-būda va na-khvāhad būd. Kadhālika yashhadu lisānu Allāhi al-Maliki al-ʿAzīzi al-ʿAlīm.

Thus it is now seen that all recite the Book of God and write by night and day, yet they have not understood a single word of the Book. Rather, their purpose in promoting it has been and will remain nothing but to secure and establish their own leadership. Thus testifies the Tongue of God, the King, the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

23

و میفرمایند من اوّل ذلک الأمر الی قبل ان یکمل تسعة کینونات الخلق لم تظهر و انّ کلّما قد رأیت من النّطفة الی ما کسوناه لحماً ثمّ اصبر حتّی تشهد خلق الآخر قل فتبارک اللّه احسن الخالقین

Va mī-farmāyand: min awwali dhālika al-amri ilā qabli an yakmula tisʿatun kaynūnātu al-khalqi lam taẓhar wa inna kulla mā qad raʾayta min al-nuṭfati ilā mā kasawnāhu laḥman thumma iṣbir ḥattā tashhada khalqa al-ākhar. Qul fa-tabāraka Allāhu aḥsanu al-khāliqīn.

He also says: “From the beginning of that Cause until before nine is completed, the realities of creation have not appeared. All that you have seen is from the stage of the drop of seed to that which We clothed with flesh. Then be patient until you witness the other creation. Say: ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of creators!’”

24

و هم‌چنین به عظیم میفرمایند هذا ما وعدناک قبل الّذی اجبناک اصبر حتّی یقضی عن البیان تسعة فاذاً قل فتبارک اللّه احسن المبدعین

Va ham-chunīn bi-ʿAẓīm mī-farmāyand: hādhā mā waʿadnāka qabla alladhī ajabnāka iṣbir ḥattā yuqḍā ʿani al-Bayāni tisʿatun fa-idhan qul fa-tabāraka Allāhu aḥsanu al-mubdiʿīn.

He likewise says to ʿAẓīm: “This is what We promised you before We answered you. Be patient until nine has elapsed from the Bayān. Then say: ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of originators!’”

25

و میفرمایند فلتراقبنّ فرق القائم و القیّوم ثمّ فی سنة التّسع کلّ خیر تدرکون

Va mī-farmāyand: fa-la-turāqibanna farqa al-Qāʾimi wa-al-Qayyūmi thumma fī sanati al-tisʿi kulla khayrin tudrikūn.

He also says: “Be sure to observe the difference between the Qāʾim and the Qayyūm. Then, in the year nine, you will attain all good.”

26

حال قدری در این کلمات تفکّر فرمائید و هم‌چنین در فرق قائم و قیّوم تفکّر لازم چه که این عبد از احزان وارده قادر بر تفسیر کلمات اللّه نه فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو که تبلیغ امر اللّه این عبد را بر تحریر این لوح مضطرّ نموده که شاید مصباحی چند در مشکاة امکان مستضیء شوند و بقدرة اللّه بر نصر این مظلوم فرید قائم گردند

Ḥāl qadrī dar īn kalimāt tafakkur farmāʾīd va ham-chunīn dar farq-i Qāʾim va Qayyūm tafakkur lāzim, chi ki īn ʿabd az aḥzān-i vārida qādir bar tafsīr-i kalimāt Allāh na. Fa-wa-Allāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa ki tablīgh-i Amr Allāh īn ʿabd rā bar taḥrīr-i īn lawḥ muḍṭarr namūda ki shāyad miṣbāḥī chand dar mishkāt-i imkān mustaḍīʾ shavand va bi-qudrat Allāh bar naṣr-i īn maẓlūm-i farīd qāʾim gardand.

Now reflect a little on these words. Reflection on the difference between the Qāʾim and the Qayyūm is also necessary, for the sorrows that have befallen this servant leave Him unable to expound the words of God. By God, besides whom there is no other god, the proclamation of the Cause of God has compelled this servant to write this Tablet, that perhaps a few lamps may be kindled in the niche of contingent existence and may arise, through the power of God, to aid this wronged and solitary One.

27

اذاً کلّ شیء یبکی علی ضرّی و بما ورد علیّ من الّذین هم خلقوا بقولی و از همه گذشته امر بمقامی منجرّ شده که با آنکه ظهور آیات قدس ربّانی بمثابهٴ غیث هاطل از سماء مشیّت من غیر مکث و سکون نازل و من دونها آیات قدرتیّه و ظهورات الهیّه که عالم را احاطه نموده بشأنی که ملل قبل مذعن و معترف شده‌اند مع‌ذلک باید بادلّه استدلال نمایم و امری را که لایزال مقدّس از دلیل بوده بدلیل ثابت نمایم که لعلّ معدودی بسماء شهود صعود نمایند

Idhan kullu shayʾin yabkī ʿalā ḍurrī wa bi-mā warada ʿalayya mina alladhīna hum khuliqū bi-qawlī va az hama gudhashta amr bi-maqāmī munjarr shuda ki bā ānki ẓuhūr-i āyāt-i quds-i rabbānī bi-mathāba-yi ghayth-i hāṭil az samā-yi mashiyyat min ghayr-i makth va sukūn nāzil va min dūnihā āyāt-i qudratiyya va ẓuhūrāt-i ilāhiyya ki ʿālam rā iḥāṭa namūda bi-shaʾnī ki milal-i qabl mudhʿin va muʿtarif shuda-and maʿa-dhālik bāyad bi-adilla istidlāl namāyam va amrī rā ki lā-yazāl muqaddas az dalīl būda bi-dalīl thābit namāyam ki laʿalla maʿdūdī bi-samā-yi shuhūd ṣuʿūd namāyand.

Now all things weep over My suffering and over what has befallen Me at the hands of those who were created by My word. Beyond all this, matters have reached such a pass that, although the holy verses of the Lord pour down like a torrent of rain from the heaven of His will without pause or cessation, and besides these there are signs of power and divine manifestations that have encompassed the world to such a degree that the peoples of earlier religions have acknowledged and confessed them, I must nevertheless argue by proofs and establish by evidence a Cause that has always been sanctified above proof, so that perhaps a few may ascend to the heaven of direct witness.

28

ظلمی فوق این در علم الهی نه که جمال قدم بدون خود استدلال بر حقّیّت خود نماید بعد از آنکه چون شمس در قطب زوال سماء لایزال مشهود و لایح است فسیعلم الّذین ظلموا نفس اللّه ایّ مرجع یرجعون و بلایای محتومه و قضایای مثبته بشأنی وارد که جز حقّ احدی بر احصای آن قادر نه در کلّ حین رماح بغضا از شطر اعدا بر هیکل بقا وارد و لقد جآءنی مظاهر نفس اللّه فی ضحی من الیوم یبکون و ینوحون قالوا یا اسفا علی یوسف اللّه المهیمن القیّوم فقد اودعوه عبیده فی الجبّ ثمّ فی انفسهم یستصرخون

Ẓulmī fawq-i īn dar ʿilm-i ilāhī na ki Jamāl-i Qidam bi-dūn-i khud istidlāl bar ḥaqqiyyat-i khud namāyad baʿd az ānki chūn shams dar quṭb-i zavāl-i samā-yi lā-yazāl mashhūd va lāʾiḥ ast. Fa-sa-yaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū nafsa Allāhi ayya marjaʿin yarjiʿūn. Va balāyā-yi maḥtūma va qaḍāyā-yi muthbata bi-shaʾnī vārid ki juz Ḥaqq aḥadī bar iḥṣā-yi ān qādir na. Dar kull-i ḥīn rimāḥ-i baghḍā az shaṭr-i aʿdā bar haykal-i baqā vārid. Wa laqad jāʾanī maẓāhiru nafsi Allāhi fī ḍuḥan mina al-yawmi yabkūna wa yanūḥūna qālū yā asafā ʿalā Yūsufi Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūmi fa-qad awdaʿūhu ʿabīduhu fī al-jubbi thumma fī anfusihim yastaṣrikhūn.

In God’s knowledge there is no injustice greater than this: that the Ancient Beauty should prove His own truth by something other than Himself, when He is manifest and radiant as the sun at the zenith of the everlasting heaven. Those who have wronged the very Self of God will soon know to what place they will return. Inescapable afflictions and decreed ordeals have descended in such measure that no one but God can number them. At every moment, the spears of hatred strike the Temple of eternity from the direction of His enemies. The Manifestations of the Self of God came to Me in the forenoon, weeping and lamenting. They said: “Alas for the Joseph of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting! His servants have cast Him into the pit.” Then within themselves they cry out for help.

29

قل یا ملأ البیان أ تقتلون نقطة الأولی و تقرؤون آیاته فی کلّ عشیّ و بکور تاللّه قد فعلتم ما لا فعلت امم القبل و یشهد بذلک عباد مکرمون ان انتم تنکرون أ تقتلون اللّه بأسیاف النّفس و الهوی ثمّ علی مقاعدکم بذکره تشتغلون و بآیاته تستدلّون کذلک فعل کلّ امّة باللّه حین ظهوره بمظهر نفسه فی کلّ عصر و کذلک فعلوا و کانوا ان یفعلون قل الیوم لن یحرّک علی اسمآء هؤلآء قلم اللّه المهیمن العزیز القیّوم و لن یرتدّ الیهم طرف اللّه و لن یأخذهم نفحات قدس محبوب الیوم

Qul yā malaʾa al-Bayān a-taqtulūna Nuqṭata al-Ūlā wa taqraʾūna āyātihi fī kulli ʿashiyyin wa bukūr? Ta-Allāhi qad faʿaltum mā lā faʿalat umamu al-qabli wa yashhadu bi-dhālika ʿibādun mukramūn in antum tunkirūn. A-taqtulūna Allāha bi-asyāfi al-nafsi wa-al-hawā thumma ʿalā maqāʿidikum bi-dhikrihi tashtaghilūna wa bi-āyātihi tastadillūn? Kadhālika faʿala kullu ummatin bi-Allāhi ḥīna ẓuhūrihi bi-maẓhari nafsihi fī kulli ʿaṣrin wa kadhālika faʿalū wa kānū in yafʿalūn. Qul al-yawma lan yuḥarraka ʿalā asmāʾi hāʾulāʾi qalamu Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-ʿAzīzi al-Qayyūm wa lan yartadda ilayhim ṭarfu Allāhi wa lan yaʾkhudhahum nafaḥātu qudsi maḥbūbi al-yawm.

Say: O people of the Bayān! Do you slay the Primal Point while reading His verses every evening and morning? By God, you have done what the peoples of former times did not do, and honored servants bear witness to this, if you deny it. Do you slay God with the swords of self and desire, then sit in your seats occupying yourselves with His remembrance and citing His verses as proof? Thus has every community treated God when He appeared in the Manifestation of Himself in every age. Thus they acted, and such was their practice. Say: Today the Pen of God, the All-Protecting, the Almighty, the Self-Subsisting, will not move to record the names of these people. The gaze of God will not turn toward them, nor will the holy breezes of the Beloved of this day reach them.

30

اگر عباد از این آیات قدس الهیّه و ظهورات عزّ صمدانیّه اعراض نمایند بچه حجّت و دلیل اثبات دین خود مینمایند بگو ای اهل بیان ببصر حقّ بمنظر اکبر ناظر شوید چه که ببصر دون خود مشهود نگردد اینست که ظهور قبلم میفرماید ایّاکم فانظروا الیه بعینه فمن ینظر الیه بعین سواه لن یعرفه ابداً و بعد از وصایای لایحصی عباد خود را در این امر میفرماید فیا الهی انت تعلم بأنّی ما قصّرت فی نصحی ذلک الخلق و تدبیری لاقبالهم الی اللّه ربّهم و ایمانهم باللّه بارئهم الی آخر قوله روحی فداه

Agar ʿibād az īn āyāt-i quds-i ilāhiyya va ẓuhūrāt-i ʿizz-i ṣamadāniyya iʿrāḍ namāyand bi-chi ḥujjat va dalīl ithbāt-i dīn-i khud mī-namāyand? Bi-gū ay ahl-i Bayān bi-baṣar-i Ḥaqq bi-manẓar-i akbar nāẓir shavīd chi ki bi-baṣar-i dūn-i khud mashhūd na-gardad. Īn ast ki ẓuhūr-i qablam mī-farmāyad: iyyākum fa-unẓurū ilayhi bi-ʿaynihi fa-man yanẓuru ilayhi bi-ʿayni siwāhu lan yaʿrifahu abadan. Va baʿd az vaṣāyā-yi lā-yuḥṣā ʿibād-i khud rā dar īn amr mī-farmāyad: fa-yā ilāhī anta taʿlamu bi-annī mā qaṣṣartu fī nuṣḥī dhālika al-khalqa wa tadbīrī li-iqbālihim ilā Allāhi rabbihim wa īmānihim bi-Allāhi bāriʾihim, ilā ākhir-i qawlihi rūḥī fidāh.

If the servants turn away from these holy divine verses and these manifestations of eternal glory, by what testimony and proof will they establish their own religion? Say: O people of the Bayān! Look upon the Most Great Vision with God’s own sight, for He cannot be seen through any sight other than His own. Thus My previous Manifestation says: “Beware! Look upon Him with His own eye, for whoever looks upon Him through the eye of anyone besides Him will never know Him.” After giving His servants countless counsels concerning this Cause, He says: “O My God, You know that I have not fallen short in counseling these creatures or in making provision for them to turn toward God, their Lord, and to believe in God, their Maker”—to the end of His words, may my soul be sacrificed for Him.

31

قسم بجمال قدم که از این بیان که از قلم رحمن جاری شده قلب کلّ اشیاء محترق گشته و هر ذی بصری از این کلمات نوحه و حنین مظهر اسماء و صفات را ادراک مینماید ولکن لا یزید الظّالمین الّا غروراً و خساراً ای علیّ گوش جان بگشا و کلمات رحمن که در قیّوم اسماء نازل شده اصغا نما که میفرماید یا قرّة العین لا تجعل یدک مبسوطة علی الأمر لأنّ النّاس فی سکران من السّرّ و انّ لک الکرّة بعد هذه الدّورة بالحقّ الأکبر هنالک فأظهر من السّرّ سرّاً علی قدر سمّ الابرة فی الطّور الأکبر لیموتنّ الطّوریّون فی السّینا عند مطلع رشح من ذلک النّور المهیمن الحمرآء باذن اللّه الحکیم و هو اللّه قد کان علیک بالحقّ علی الحقّ حفیظا

Qasam bi-Jamāl-i Qidam ki az īn bayān ki az qalam-i Raḥmān jārī shuda qalb-i kull-i ashyā muḥtariq gashta va har dhī-baṣarī az īn kalimāt nawḥa va ḥanīn-i maẓhar-i asmā va ṣifāt rā idrāk mī-namāyad wa lākin lā yazīdu al-ẓālimīna illā ghurūran wa khasāran. Ay ʿAlī gūsh-i jān bi-gushā va kalimāt-i Raḥmān ki dar Qayyūm-i Asmā nāzil shuda iṣghā namā ki mī-farmāyad: yā Qurrata al-ʿAyn lā tajʿal yadaka mabsūṭatan ʿalā al-amri li-anna al-nāsa fī sukrānin mina al-sirri wa inna laka al-karrata baʿda hādhihi al-dawrati bi-al-ḥaqqi al-akbar. Hunālika fa-aẓhir mina al-sirri sirran ʿalā qadri sammi al-ibrati fī al-Ṭūri al-akbari li-yamūtanna al-ṭūriyyūna fī al-Sīnā ʿinda maṭlaʿi rashḥin min dhālika al-nūri al-muhaymini al-ḥamrāʾi bi-idhni Allāhi al-Ḥakīmi wa huwa Allāhu qad kāna ʿalayka bi-al-ḥaqqi ʿalā al-ḥaqqi ḥafīẓan.

I swear by the Ancient Beauty that this utterance, which has flowed from the Pen of the All-Merciful, has set the heart of all things ablaze. Everyone endowed with sight perceives in these words the lamentation and yearning of the Manifestation of the names and attributes. Yet it only increases the wrongdoers in delusion and loss. O ʿAlī, open the ear of your soul and listen to the words of the All-Merciful revealed in the Qayyūm-i Asmā, where He says: “O Qurrat al-ʿAyn! Do not stretch out Your hand over the Cause, for the people are intoxicated by the mystery. Yours will be the return after this cycle, through the Most Great Truth. Then disclose, upon the Most Great Mount, a mystery of the mystery to the measure of a needle’s eye, so that the dwellers of the Mount in Sinai will surely die at the dawning of a sprinkling of that all-protecting, crimson Light, by the permission of God, the All-Wise. He is God, who has indeed been Your Guardian in truth and according to truth.”

32

و حال کرّة ظاهر و طوریّون معدوم و مفقود چنانچه مشاهده میشود و با اینکه میفرماید طوریّون میّت و لاشیء و معدوم میشوند مع‌ذلک تعجّب مینمایند از اینکه ثمرهٴ طوبی حنظل شود چنانچه بعینه همین را سؤال کرده‌اند و یا صور علّیّین بسجّین تبدیل گردد لازال امر الهی محدود نبوده و نخواهد بود کلّ مرایاء موجودات اگر در حین بشمس سماء قدم مقابل شوند در کلّ انوار شمس ظاهر و لایح و منطبع و مرتسم و بمجرّد انحراف از کلّ اخذ میشود فانظر فی الشّمس ثمّ فی المرایا لکی تجد الی ما یلقیک الرّوح سبیلا

Va ḥāl karra ẓāher va ṭūriyyūn maʿdūm va mafqūd chonānche moshāhede mīshavad va bā īnke mīfarmāyad ṭūriyyūn mayyet va lā-shayʾ va maʿdūm mīshavand maʿa dhālek taʿajj ob mīnamāyand az īnke thamare-ye Ṭūbā ḥanẓal shavad chonānche be-ʿayneh hamīn rā soʾāl karde-and va yā ṣovar-e ʿilliyyīn be-sijjīn tabdīl gardad lāzāl amr-e elāhī maḥdūd nabūde va nakhvāhad būd koll-e marāyā-ye mawjūdāt agar dar ḥīn be-shams-e samā-ye qedam moqābel shavand dar koll anvār-e shams ẓāher va lāyeḥ va monṭabeʿ va mortasem va be-mojarrad-e enḥerāf az koll akhdh mīshavad fa-nẓur fī al-shams thumma fī al-marāyā li-kay tajida ilā mā yulqīka al-rūḥ sabīlan.

And now the return is manifest, while the dwellers of the Mount are nonexistent and lost, as can be seen. Although He says that the dwellers of the Mount become dead, nothing, and nonexistent, they nevertheless express surprise that the fruit of the Tree of Bliss should become colocynth—as indeed they have asked this very question—or that the forms of the highest heaven should be transformed into those of the nethermost prison. The Cause of God has never been, and will never be, confined by limits. If all the mirrors of existing things face the sun in the heaven of eternity for a moment, the sun’s lights appear, shine, are imprinted, and are reflected in them all; the instant they turn away, those lights are withdrawn from them all. Look, then, at the sun and then at the mirrors, so that you may find a way to what the Spirit imparts to you.

33

ابن نبیل مرفوع در اثبات امر اللّه بما القی اللّه علی فؤاده الواحی نوشته و در ابتدا باین آیه که از سماء مشیّت ظهور قبلم نازل شده استدلال نموده قوله عزّ ذکره قل اللّهمّ انّک انت الهان الالهین لتؤتینّ الألوهیّة من تشآء و لتنزعنّ الألوهیّة عمّن تشآء الی آخر و کذلک قل اللّهمّ انّک انت ربّاب السّموات و الأرض لتؤتینّ الرّبوبیّة من تشآء و لتنزعنّ الرّبوبیّة عمّن تشآء الی آخر با آنکه سلطان وجود باین صریحی فرموده که عطا میفرماید الوهیّت و ربوبیّت را بهر نفسی که اراده فرماید و اخذ میفرماید از هر که بخواهد خداوند قادری که مقام الوهیّت و ربوبیّت که اعلی مقامات است اخذ فرماید قادر نیست بر اینکه از هیکلی قمیص اسم خود را نزع نماید یا آنکه حلوی را بمرّ تبدیل فرماید سبحان اللّه عمّا یتوهّمون العباد فی قدرته فتعالی عمّا یصفون حال مشاهده نمائید که طیر قدرت و عظمت در چه هوا طیران مینماید و ناس در چه اماکن توقّف نموده‌اند آیا آیهٴ انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر را چه معنی نموده‌اند و از یفعل ما یشآء و لا یسأل عمّا شآء چه ادراک کرده‌اند

Ibn-e Nabīl-e marfūʿ dar ethbāt-e amr-e Allāh bi-mā alqā Allāh ʿalā fuʾādihi alvāḥī neveshte va dar ebt edā be-īn āye ke az samā-ye mashiyyat-e ẓohūr-e qablam nāzel shode estedlāl namūde qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu qul Allāhumma innaka anta ilāhān al-ilāhīn la-tuʾtiyanna al-ulūhiyya man tashāʾ wa-la-tanziʿanna al-ulūhiyya ʿamman tashāʾ ilā ākhir va kadhālika qul Allāhumma innaka anta rabbāb al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ la-tuʾtiyanna al-rubūbiyya man tashāʾ wa-la-tanziʿanna al-rubūbiyya ʿamman tashāʾ ilā ākhir bā ānke solṭān-e vojūd be-īn ṣarīḥī farmūde ke ʿaṭā mīfarmāyad olūhiyyat va robūbiyyat rā be-har nafsī ke erāde farmāyad va akhdh mīfarmāyad az har ke bekhvāhad Khodāvand-e qāderī ke maqām-e olūhiyyat va robūbiyyat ke aʿlā-ye maqāmāt ast akhdh farmāyad qāder nīst bar īnke az haykalī qamīṣ-e esm-e khod rā nazʿ namāyad yā ānke ḥolvī rā be-morr tabdīl farmāyad subḥāna Allāh ʿammā yatawahhamūna al-ʿibād fī qudratihi fa-taʿālā ʿammā yaṣifūn ḥāl moshāhede namāyīd ke ṭayr-e qodrat va ʿaẓamat dar che havā ṭayarān mīnamāyad va nās dar che amāken tavaqqof namūde-and āyā āye-ye innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr rā che maʿnī namūde-and va az yafʿalu mā yashāʾ wa-lā yusʾalu ʿammā shāʾ che edrāk karde-and.

The exalted Ibn-i Nabīl has written tablets in proof of the Cause of God through what God has inspired in his heart. At the outset he has adduced this verse, revealed from the heaven of the will of My previous Manifestation. His words—exalted be His remembrance—are: “Say: O God, You are indeed the God of gods. You will surely bestow divinity on whomever You will, and You will surely strip divinity from whomever You will”—and so forth. Likewise: “Say: O God, You are indeed the Lord of the heavens and the earth. You will surely bestow lordship on whomever You will, and You will surely strip lordship from whomever You will”—and so forth. Although the Sovereign of existence has stated so explicitly that He bestows divinity and lordship on any soul He wishes and takes them from whomever He wills, is the mighty God who takes away the station of divinity and lordship, the highest of stations, unable to strip the robe of His name from a person, or to turn something sweet into something bitter? Glory be to God, far above what His servants imagine concerning His power! Exalted is He above what they describe! Now observe in what atmosphere the bird of power and grandeur is soaring, and in what places the people have come to a halt. What meaning have they given to the verse, “He has power over all things”? And what have they understood from “He does whatever He wills” and “He is not questioned about what He has willed”?

34

ای عباد از اوهن بیوت برکن شدید متمسّک شوید و از ظلمات جهل و نادانی بفجر منیر علم ربّانی توجّه نمائید و کاش اهل بیان در آیهٴ مبارکه که ابن نبیل ذکر نموده تفکّر نمایند که شاید از سبل وهم بصراط یقین درآیند ای علیّ یک قدح از این ماء عذب حیوان که در ظلمات کلمات سلطان اسماء و صفات مستور شده بیاشام تا از کدورات ایّام و شبهات انام و اشارات غافلین و دلالات مغلّین پاک و مقدّس شوی و ابواب علوم نامتناهی ربّانی بر وجه قلبت مفتوح شود تا آنکه موقن شوی باینکه سلطان قدم قادر است بر آنکه در ساعتی جمیع اشیاء را بخلع اسماء حسنی مفتخر و معزّز فرماید و در ساعت اخری از جمیع اخذ نماید و انّی اشکو الی اللّه من هؤلآء العباد لأنّهم ینظرون الیّ بما عندهم لا بما عندی و یقاسون نفس اللّه بأنفسهم و کلماته بکلماتهم فوالّذی نفسی نفسه لو ینقطعنّ الیوم کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض و یقبلنّ الی اللّه لیعلّمهم من بدایع علمه ما یغنیهم عن العالمین

Ey ʿebād az awhan-e boyūt be-rokn-e shadīd motamassek shavīd va az ẓolomāt-e jahl va nādānī be-fajr-e monīr-e ʿelm-e rabbānī tavajjoh namāyīd va kāsh ahl-e Bayān dar āye-ye mobārake ke Ibn-e Nabīl dhekr namūde tafakkor namāyand ke shāyad az sobol-e vahm be-ṣerāṭ-e yaqīn dar-āyand ey ʿAlī yek qadaḥ az īn māʾ-e ʿadhb-e ḥayavān ke dar ẓolomāt-e kalemāt-e solṭān-e asmā va ṣefāt mastūr shode biyāshām tā az kodūrāt-e ayyām va shobohāt-e anām va eshārāt-e ghāfelīn va dalālāt-e moghellīn pāk va moqaddas shavī va abvāb-e ʿolūm-e nāmotanāhī-ye rabbānī bar vajh-e qalbat maftūḥ shavad tā ānke mūqen shavī be-īnke solṭān-e qedam qāder ast bar ānke dar sāʿatī jamīʿ-e ashyā rā be-khelaʿ-e asmā-ye ḥosnā moftakhar va moʿazzaz farmāyad va dar sāʿat-e okhrā az jamīʿ akhdh namāyad wa-innī ashkū ilā Allāh min hāʾulāʾ al-ʿibād li-annahum yanẓurūna ilayya bi-mā ʿindahum lā bi-mā ʿindī wa-yuqāsūna nafs Allāh bi-anfusihim wa-kalimātihi bi-kalimātihim fa-wa-alladhī nafsī nafsuhu law yanqaṭiʿanna al-yawm kullu man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ wa-yuqbilanna ilā Allāh la-yuʿallimahum min badāʾiʿ ʿilmihi mā yughnīhim ʿan al-ʿālamīn.

O servants! Turn from the frailest of houses and take hold of a strong support, and turn from the darkness of ignorance and unknowing toward the luminous dawn of divine knowledge. Would that the people of the Bayān would ponder the blessed verse cited by Ibn-i Nabīl, so that they might leave the paths of illusion and enter the path of certainty. O ʿAlī! Drink a cup of this sweet water of life concealed in the darkness of the words of the Sovereign of names and attributes, so that you may be purified and sanctified from the troubles of the days, the doubts of humanity, the allusions of the heedless, and the arguments of the malicious, and so that the gates of infinite divine knowledge may be opened before your heart. Then you may become certain that the Sovereign of eternity has the power, in one hour, to honor and exalt all things with the robes of the most beautiful names, and in another hour to take them from them all. I complain to God of these servants, for they look upon Me through what they possess, not through what I possess, and they measure God’s own Self against themselves and His words against their words. By Him whose Self is My own! If all who are in the heavens and on earth were today to detach themselves and turn toward God, He would assuredly teach them such wonders of His knowledge as would make them independent of all the worlds.

35

و در این سنهٴ شداد بعضی از عباد اینگونه مسائل سؤال نموده‌اند و عبد حاضر لدی العرش جوابهای محکمهٴ شافیهٴ کافیه نوشته ارسال داشته عجب است که شما ندیده‌اید و در این ارض هم بعضی از شبهات القا نموده‌اند که شاید نفوس قدسیّه را بحجبات کلمات قبلیّه محتجب دارند ولکن غافل از اینکه نفسی که در هوای بافضای قدس الهی طیران نمود و از خرمنهای علوم نامتناهی ربّانی القاط فرمود بشبهات وهمیّه ممنوع نشود و محروم نگردد قل من ورد علی بحر الأعظم لن یلتفت الی سراب بقیعة و لن یشرب من مآء الحمیم اگرچه لایق نه که قلم اعلی بذکر کلمات اولو البغضآء بیالاید و یا حرکت نماید ولکن نظر بتبلیغ رسالات ربّانی مفرّی نه که شاید جاهلی ببحر علم درآید و یا گم‌گشتهٴ وادی غفلت و نسیان بیمن رحمن خرامد و انّه لیهدی من یشآء الی صراط البهآء و انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر

Va dar īn sane-ye shedād baʿżī az ʿebād īngūne masāʾel soʾāl namūde-and va ʿabd-e ḥāżer laday al-ʿarsh javābhā-ye moḥkame-ye shāfiye-ye kāfiye neveshte ersāl dāshte ʿajab ast ke shomā nadīde-īd va dar īn arż ham baʿżī az shobohāt elqā namūde-and ke shāyad nofūs-e qodsiyye rā be-ḥojobāt-e kalemāt-e qabliyye moḥtajeb dārand va-lāken ghāfel az īnke nafsī ke dar havā-ye bā-faẓā-ye qods-e elāhī ṭayarān namūd va az kharmanhā-ye ʿolūm-e nāmotanāhī-ye rabbānī elqāṭ farmūd be-shobohāt-e vahmiyye mamnūʿ nashavad va maḥrūm nagardad qul man warada ʿalā baḥr al-aʿẓam lan yaltafita ilā sarābin bi-qīʿa wa-lan yashraba min māʾ al-ḥamīm agarche lāyeq na ke qalam-e aʿlā be-dhekr-e kalemāt-e ulū al-baghḍā biyālāyad va yā ḥarakat namāyad va-lāken naẓar be-tablīgh-e resālāt-e rabbānī mafarrī na ke shāyad jāhelī be-baḥr-e ʿelm dar-āyad va yā gom-gashte-ye vādī-ye ghaflat va nesyān be-yomn-e Raḥmān kherāmad wa-innahu la-yahdī man yashāʾ ilā ṣirāṭ al-Bahāʾ wa-innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

In this year of hardships, some of the servants have asked questions of this kind, and the servant present before the Throne has written and sent firm, healing, and sufficient answers. It is strange that you have not seen them. In this land, too, some have cast doubts, hoping to veil holy souls behind the veils of earlier words. Yet they are unaware that a soul who has soared in the spacious atmosphere of divine holiness and gleaned from the harvests of infinite divine knowledge will neither be held back nor deprived by fanciful doubts. Say: Whoever has reached the Most Great Ocean will never turn toward a mirage on a plain, nor drink of scalding water. Although it is not fitting that the Most Exalted Pen should be sullied by mentioning the words of those possessed of hatred, or move to write them, there is nevertheless no escape from doing so, in order to convey the divine messages, so that perhaps an ignorant person may enter the ocean of knowledge, or one lost in the valley of heedlessness and forgetfulness may, through the grace of the All-Merciful, advance. He indeed guides whomever He wills to the path of Bahā, and He has power over all things.

36

ولکن این ذکر و بیان برای نفوسی است که فی‌الحقیقه طالب سبیل هدایت باشند والّا علیل غلّ و بغضا را سلسبیل طاهر ننماید چنانچه الیوم اکثری اهل بیان جمیع ظهورات قدرتیّه و شئونات الهیّه و آیات منزله را بچشم خود دیده‌اند و بگوش خود شنیده‌اند مع‌ذلک ببغضی قیام نموده‌اند که ذکر آن ممکن نه الّا من فتح اللّه بصره و ایّده علی امره و اخرجه عن ظلمات الوهم و هداه الی صراطه العزیز الحمید و تمسّک باموری جسته‌اند که لم‌یزل عنداللّه مذکور نبوده و بشأنی غافلند که بحجر ساجد شده‌اند و از منظر اکبر و جمال اظهر انور معرض گشته‌اند وربّ معبود شعر من عابدیه خیر منه ان یا علیّ قل الیوم انتم و معبودکم عند اللّه فی حدّ سوآء فمن آمن منکم فقد امن من فزع الأکبر و من اعرض فقد خرج عن صراط اللّه و انّ هذا لهو الحقّ و ما بعد الحقّ الّا الضّلال

Va-lāken īn dhekr va bayān barā-ye nofūsī ast ke fī al-ḥaqīqe ṭāleb-e sabīl-e hedāyat bāshand va-ellā ʿalīl-e ghell va baghżā rā salsabīl ṭāher nanamāyad chonānche al-yawm aktharī-ye ahl-e Bayān jamīʿ-e ẓohūrāt-e qodratiyye va shoʾūnāt-e elāhiyye va āyāt-e monzale rā be-chashm-e khod dīde-and va be-gūsh-e khod shenīde-and maʿa dhālek be-boghżī qiyām namūde-and ke dhekr-e ān momken na illā man fataḥa Allāh baṣarahu wa-ayyadahu ʿalā amrihi wa-akhrajahu ʿan ẓulumāt al-wahm wa-hadāhu ilā ṣirāṭihi al-ʿazīz al-ḥamīd va tamassok be-omūrī joste-and ke lam-yazal ʿinda Allāh madhkūr nabūde va be-shaʾnī ghāfeland ke be-ḥajar sājed shode-and va az manẓar-e akbar va jamāl-e aẓhar-e anvar moʿreż gashte-and wa-rubba maʿbūdin shaʿrun min ʿābidīhi khayrun minhu an yā ʿAlī qul al-yawm antum wa-maʿbūdukum ʿinda Allāh fī ḥaddi sawāʾ fa-man āmana minkum fa-qad amina min fazaʿ al-akbar wa-man aʿraḍa fa-qad kharaja ʿan ṣirāṭ Allāh wa-inna hādhā la-huwa al-ḥaqq wa-mā baʿda al-ḥaqq illā al-ḍalāl.

But this discourse and exposition are for souls who truly seek the way of guidance; otherwise, even Salsabīl will not purify one afflicted with malice and hatred. Thus today most of the people of the Bayān have seen with their own eyes and heard with their own ears all the manifestations of power, the divine signs, and the revealed verses, yet they have arisen in such hatred that it cannot be described—except those whose eyes God has opened, whom He has strengthened in His Cause, brought out of the darkness of illusion, and guided to His mighty and praiseworthy path. They have clung to things that have never had any standing before God, and they are so heedless that they have bowed down before a stone and turned away from the Most Great Vision and the most manifest, most luminous Beauty. How many an object of worship is worth less than a hair of its worshipers! O ʿAlī! Say: Today you and the one you worship are on an equal footing before God. Whoever among you believes is safe from the Most Great Terror, and whoever turns away has departed from the path of God. This is indeed the truth, and beyond truth there is nothing but error.

37

ایّاکم ایّاکم یا ملأ البیان لا تکفروا باللّه و لا تحاربوا بمظهر نفسه و لا تجادلوا بالّذی جآءکم عن مشرق الأمر بسلطان مبین آیا گمان مینمائید که امر اللّه باعراض معرضین ممنوع شود و یا انوار شمس عزّ باقی باکمام انفس ظلمانی مستور ماند لا فوالّذی نطق فی صدری و بعثنی بالحقّ و ارسلنی علی العالمین

Iyyākum iyyākum yā malaʾ al-Bayān lā takfurū bi-Allāh wa-lā tuḥāribū bi-maẓhar nafsihi wa-lā tujādilū bi-alladhī jāʾakum ʿan mashriq al-amr bi-sulṭānin mubīn āyā gomān mīnamāyīd ke amr-e Allāh be-eʿrāż-e moʿreżīn mamnūʿ shavad va yā anvār-e shams-e ʿezz-e bāqī be-akmām-e anfos-e ẓolmānī mastūr mānad lā fa-wa-alladhī naṭaqa fī ṣadrī wa-baʿathanī bi-al-ḥaqq wa-arsalanī ʿalā al-ʿālamīn.

Beware, beware, O people of the Bayān! Do not disbelieve in God, do not wage war against the Manifestation of His own Self, and do not dispute with Him who has come to you from the Dayspring of the Cause with manifest authority. Do you imagine that the Cause of God can be obstructed by those who turn away, or that the light of the sun of everlasting glory can remain concealed within the coverings of darkened souls? No, by Him who has spoken within My breast, raised Me up in truth, and sent Me to all the worlds!

38

و بعضی از مشرکین از جمله شبهات که در این ارض القا نموده‌اند اینست که آیا میشود ذهب نحاس شود قل ای وربّی ولکن عندنا علمه نعلّم من نشآء بعلم من لدنّا و من کان فی ریب فلیسأل اللّه ربّه بأن یشهده و یکون من الموقنین و در رسیدن نحاس برتبهٴ ذهبیّت همان دلیلی است واضح بر عود ذهب بحالت اوّل لو هم یشعرون جمیع فلزّات بوزن و صورت و مادّه یکدیگر میرسند ولکن علمه عندنا فی کتاب مکنون

Va baʿżī az moshrekīn az jomle-ye shobohāt ke dar īn arż elqā namūde-and īnast ke āyā mīshavad dhahab noḥās shavad qul ī wa-rabbī wa-lākin ʿindanā ʿilmuhu nuʿallimu man nashāʾ bi-ʿilmin min ladunnā wa-man kāna fī raybin fa-l-yasʾal Allāh rabbahu bi-an yushhidahu wa-yakūna min al-mūqinīn va dar resīdan-e noḥās be-rotbe-ye dhahabiyyat hamān dalīlī ast vāżeḥ bar ʿawd-e dhahab be-ḥālat-e avval law hum yashʿurūn jamīʿ-e felezzāt be-vazn va ṣūrat va mādde-ye yekdīgar mīresand va-lākin ʿilmuhu ʿindanā fī kitābin maknūn.

Among the doubts that some of those who associate partners with God have raised in this land is this: Can gold become copper? Say: Yes, by My Lord! But the knowledge of it is with Us. We teach whomever We will through knowledge from Our presence. Whoever is in doubt should ask God, his Lord, to enable him to witness it and become one of those who are certain. The very fact that copper attains the rank of gold is a clear proof that gold can return to its former state, if only they understood. All metals attain the weight, form, and substance of one another, but the knowledge of this is with Us in a hidden Book.

39

میگوئیم علم معرضین باین مقام صعود ننموده که ادراک نمایند ذهب نحاس میشود آنقدر هم ادراک ننموده که تراب میشود این رتبه که مشهود هر ذی شعوری بوده که کلّ از تراب ظاهر و بتراب راجع و تراب در قدر و قیمت ارخص از نحاس است چه که او از اجسام محسوب و نحاس از اجساد و این بسی ظاهر و هویدا است و اگر ناس لایق و بالغ مشاهده میشدند هرآینه در این مقام ذکر بعضی از علوم مستورهٴ الهیّه میشد ولکن قضی ما قضی بر هر ذی بصری مشهود است که حقّ تعالی ذکره بر کلّ شیء قادر بوده و خواهد بود البتّه اگر بخواهد بمجرّد اراده ذهب را بنحاس تبدیل میفرماید و این عجز در موجودات موجود و مشهود و انّه لهو المقتدر العزیز القادر المحمود

Mīgūʾīm ʿelm-e moʿreżīn be-īn maqām ṣoʿūd nanamūde ke edrāk namāyand dhahab noḥās mīshavad ānqadr ham edrāk nanamūde ke torāb mīshavad īn rotbe ke mashhūd-e har dhī shoʿūrī būde ke koll az torāb ẓāher va be-torāb rājeʿ va torāb dar qadr va qīmat arkhaṣ az noḥās ast che ke ū az ajsām maḥsūb va noḥās az ajsād va īn basī ẓāher va hoveydā ast va agar nās lāyeq va bālegh moshāhede mīshodand har-āyene dar īn maqām dhekr-e baʿżī az ʿolūm-e mastūre-ye elāhiyye mīshod va-lāken quḍiya mā quḍiya bar har dhī baṣarī mashhūd ast ke Ḥaqq taʿālā dhikruhu bar koll-e shayʾ qāder būde va khvāhad būd albatte agar bekhvāhad be-mojarrad-e erāde dhahab rā be-noḥās tabdīl mīfarmāyad va īn ʿajz dar mawjūdāt mawjūd va mashhūd va-innahu la-huwa al-muqtadir al-ʿazīz al-qādir al-maḥmūd.

We say: The knowledge of those who turn away has not risen to the point of understanding that gold can become copper; they have not even understood that it becomes dust. Yet this much has been evident to everyone endowed with understanding: all things emerge from dust and return to dust. Dust is lower in worth and price than copper, for it is reckoned among bodies, while copper is reckoned among metallic bodies. This is plain and evident. If people had been found worthy and mature, some of the hidden divine sciences would certainly have been mentioned here. But what has been decreed has been decreed. It is evident to everyone endowed with sight that God—exalted be His remembrance—has always had, and will always have, power over all things. Certainly, if He wishes, He transforms gold into copper by the mere act of willing. It is in created things that this powerlessness exists and is seen. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent, the Praised.

40

نظر را مطهّر نموده بمنظر اکبر توجّه نمائید و از اشجار لایغنی و لایثمر منقطع شوید اینست از بدایع امر الهی فمن شآء فلیقبل و من شآء فلیعرض فمن اقبل فلنفسه و من اعرض فلها و انّه لهو المقدّس عن الخلایق اجمعین

Naẓar rā moṭahhar namūde be-manẓar-e akbar tavajjoh namāyīd va az ashjār-e lā-yoghnī va lā-yothmer monqaṭeʿ shavīd īnast az badāyeʿ-e amr-e elāhī fa-man shāʾ fa-l-yuqbil wa-man shāʾ fa-l-yuʿriḍ fa-man aqbala fa-li-nafsihi wa-man aʿraḍa fa-lahā wa-innahu la-huwa al-muqaddas ʿan al-khalāʾiq ajmaʿīn.

Purify your sight and turn toward the Most Great Vision, and detach yourselves from trees that neither profit nor bear fruit. This is among the wonders of the Cause of God. Whoever wishes, let him turn toward it, and whoever wishes, let him turn away. Whoever turns toward it does so for his own sake, and whoever turns away does so to his own detriment. He indeed is sanctified above all created things.

41

در شیطان تفکّر نما که معلّم ملکوت بوده در ملأ اعلی و در مداین اسماء بأسماء حسنی معروف و بعد باعراضی از اعلی رفیق اعلی بادنی ارض سفلی مقرّ گرفته کذلک یفعل ربّک ما یشآء ان انت من الموقنین از اینها گذشته بیت عتیق که کعبهٴ موجودات بوده و محلّ طواف مظاهر اسماء و صفات چرا از این فضل کبری محروم شد اذاً تفکّروا یا اولو الألباب کلّ شیء در قبضهٴ قدرت الهی اسیرند و در کلّ حین بآنچه اراده فرماید قادر و مقتدر است و نفاذ قدرت محیطه‌اش در هیچ اوان از مظاهر امکان و اکوان سلب نشده و نخواهد شد

Dar Shayṭān tafakkor namā ke moʿallem-e malakūt būde dar malaʾ-e aʿlā va dar madāyen-e asmā be-asmā-ye ḥosnā maʿrūf va baʿd be-eʿrāżī az aʿlā-ye rafīq-e aʿlā be-adnā-ye arż-e soflā maqarr gerefte kadhālika yafʿalu rabbuka mā yashāʾ in anta min al-mūqinīn az īnhā goẕashte bayt-e ʿatīq ke Kaʿbe-ye mawjūdāt būde va maḥall-e ṭavāf-e maẓāher-e asmā va ṣefāt cherā az īn fażl-e kobrā maḥrūm shod idhan tafakkarū yā ulū al-albāb koll-e shayʾ dar qabże-ye qodrat-e elāhī asīrand va dar koll-e ḥīn be-ānche erāde farmāyad qāder va moqtader ast va nafādh-e qodrat-e moḥīṭe-ash dar hīch avān az maẓāher-e emkān va akvān salb nashode va nakhvāhad shod.

Reflect on Satan, who was the teacher of the Kingdom in the Concourse on high and was known by the most beautiful names in the cities of names. Yet through one act of turning away, he went from the loftiest heights of the supreme companionship to make his abode in the lowest depths of the earth below. Thus does your Lord do whatever He wills, if you are one of those who are certain. Beyond these examples, why was the Ancient House, which had been the Kaaba of all beings and the place around which the manifestations of the names and attributes circled, deprived of this supreme grace? Reflect, then, O people of understanding! All things are held captive in the grasp of divine power, and at every moment He is able and powerful to do whatever He wills. The sway of His all-encompassing power over the manifestations of contingent existence and created things has never been, and will never be, withdrawn.

42

اسرار مکنونه‌اش را هر گوشی لایق استماع نه و حوریّات معانی مقصورهٴ علمیّه‌اش را هر چشمی قابل مشاهده نه چه مقدار از هیاکل ظلم که بقمیص عدل بین عباد معروف شده‌اند و چه مقدار از حقایق عدلیّه که در اثواب ظلم اشتهار یافته‌اند نظر در اصنام نما که حال نصف من علی الأرض باو عاکف شده‌اند و من دون اللّه معبود اخذ نموده‌اند و باین مرض مبتلا نشده‌اند مگر آنکه بوهم و تقلید اکتفا کرده‌اند و از سلطان توحید اعراض نموده‌اند باری الیوم مظاهر کلّ اسماء و صفات در صقع واحد و موقف واحد مشهودند الّا من صعد الی اللّه کذلک نلقی علیک لعلّ تطهّر نفسک و صدرک عن کلمات العالمین و تسمع ما غرّد الرّوح علی افنان هذه السّدرة الّتی احاطت کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Asrār-e maknūne-ash rā har gūshī lāyeq-e estemāʿ na va ḥūriyyāt-e maʿānī-ye maqṣūre-ye ʿelmiyye-ash rā har chashmī qābel-e moshāhede na che meqdār az hayākel-e ẓolm ke be-qamīṣ-e ʿadl bayn-e ʿebād maʿrūf shode-and va che meqdār az ḥaqāyeq-e ʿadliyye ke dar athvāb-e ẓolm eshtehār yāfte-and naẓar dar aṣnām namā ke ḥāl neṣf-e man ʿalā al-arż be-ū ʿākef shode-and va min dūn-e Allāh maʿbūd akhdh namūde-and va be-īn maraż mobtalā nashode-and magar ānke be-vahm va taqlīd ektefā karde-and va az solṭān-e tawḥīd eʿrāż namūde-and bārī al-yawm maẓāher-e koll-e asmā va ṣefāt dar ṣoqʿ-e vāḥed va mawqef-e vāḥed mashhūdand illā man ṣaʿida ilā Allāh kadhālika nulqī ʿalayka laʿalla tuṭahhiru nafsaka wa-ṣadraka ʿan kalimāt al-ʿālamīn wa-tasmaʿu mā gharrada al-rūḥ ʿalā afnān hādhihi al-sidra allatī aḥāṭat kulla man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-araḍīn.

Not every ear is worthy to hear His hidden mysteries, nor is every eye capable of beholding the maidens of meaning secluded within the chambers of His knowledge. How many embodiments of oppression have become known among the servants in the robe of justice, and how many realities of justice have become renowned in the garments of oppression! Consider the idols: half of those on earth now devote themselves to them and have taken them as objects of worship instead of God. They have been afflicted with this disease only because they have contented themselves with illusion and imitation and turned away from the Sovereign of divine unity. In short, today the manifestations of all names and attributes are seen on one plane and in one station, except those who have ascended to God. Thus do We impart to you, so that you may purify your soul and your breast of the words of the peoples of the world and hear what the Spirit has sung upon the branches of this Lote Tree, which encompasses all who are in the heavens and the earths.

43

قل یا ملأ البیان تاللّه الحقّ لم یکن هذا من تلقآء نفسی بل بما نطق اللّه فی صدری و ما ظهر من سلطانی و جری من قلمی برهانی ثمّ حجّتی ثمّ دلیلی ان انتم من المنصفین قل انتم بأیّ حجّة آمنتم بعلیّ من قبل حین الّذی ظهر بالحقّ و جآءکم بسلطان مبین و بأیّ برهان صدّقتم آیاته و اذعنتم برهانه و خضعتم عند ظهورات امره المهیمن المتعالی العزیز المنیر

Qul yā malaʾ al-Bayān ta-llāh al-Ḥaqq lam yakun hādhā min tilqāʾ nafsī bal bi-mā naṭaqa Allāh fī ṣadrī wa-mā ẓahara min sulṭānī wa-jarā min qalamī burhānī thumma ḥujjatī thumma dalīlī in antum min al-munṣifīn. Qul antum bi-ayyi ḥujja āmantum bi-ʿAlī min qabl ḥīna alladhī ẓahara bi-l-ḥaqq wa-jāʾakum bi-sulṭān mubīn wa-bi-ayyi burhān ṣaddaqtum āyātihi wa-adhʿantum burhānahu wa-khaḍaʿtum ʿinda ẓuhūrāt amrihi al-Muhaymin al-Mutaʿālī al-ʿAzīz al-Munīr.

Say: O people of the Bayān! By God, the Truth, this has not come from My own prompting, but through what God has spoken within My breast. Whatever has appeared through My sovereignty and flowed from My Pen is My proof, My testimony, and My evidence, if you are fair-minded. Say: By what testimony did you formerly believe in ʿAlī, when He appeared in truth and came to you with manifest authority? By what proof did you acknowledge His verses, assent to His demonstration, and bow before the revelations of His Cause, the All-Protecting, the Most Exalted, the Almighty, the Luminous?

44

و ان تقولوا انّا آمنّا به بنفسه و اکتفینا بحجّیّة نفسه عمّا سواه قل تاللّه هذا نفسه قد قام بین العباد و ظهر بسلطان اسمه المقتدر المهیمن العلیّ العظیم و ان تقولوا بأنّا آمنّا بما نزّل علیه من آیات اللّه العزیز الغالب القدیر فتلک آیاته ملأت شرق الأرض و غربها اذاً فاستمعوا لما یوحی عن شطر القدس الّذی یسمع من اریاحها ما سمع اذن الحبیب فی معراج القدس ثمّ اذن الرّوح فی سموات الأمر ثمّ اذن الکلیم علی طور العزّ عن شجرة اللّه النّاطق العزیز الحکیم و من دونهما قد ظهر هذا الغلام بسلطنة الّتی علت علی الممکنات و یشهد بذلک السن الکائنات ان انتم من السّامعین

Wa-in taqūlū innā āmannā bihi bi-nafsihi wa-ktafaynā bi-ḥujjiyyat nafsihi ʿammā siwāhu qul ta-llāh hādhā nafsuhu qad qāma bayna al-ʿibād wa-ẓahara bi-sulṭān ismihi al-Muqtadir al-Muhaymin al-ʿAlī al-ʿAẓīm. Wa-in taqūlū bi-annā āmannā bi-mā nuzzila ʿalayhi min āyāt Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Ghālib al-Qadīr fa-tilka āyātuhu malaʾat sharq al-arḍ wa-gharbahā. Idhan fa-stamiʿū li-mā yūḥā ʿan shaṭr al-quds alladhī yusmaʿ min aryāḥihā mā samiʿa udhun al-Ḥabīb fī miʿrāj al-quds thumma udhun al-Rūḥ fī samāwāt al-amr thumma udhun al-Kalīm ʿalā Ṭūr al-ʿizz ʿan shajarat Allāh al-Nāṭiq al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥakīm. Wa-min dūnihimā qad ẓahara hādhā al-ghulām bi-salṭanat allatī ʿalat ʿalā al-mumkināt wa-yashhad bi-dhālika alsun al-kāʾināt in antum min al-sāmiʿīn.

And if you say, “We believed in Him through His own Self and were content with the testimony of His Self, apart from all else,” say: By God, this is His very Self, who has arisen among His servants and appeared with the sovereignty of His name, the All-Powerful, the All-Protecting, the Most High, the Most Great. And if you say, “We believed through the verses of God, the Almighty, the All-Conquering, the All-Powerful, that were sent down to Him,” these are His verses, which have filled the east and the west of the earth. Listen, then, to what is revealed from the realm of holiness, upon whose breezes can be heard what the ear of the Beloved heard on His ascent to holiness, then the ear of the Spirit in the heavens of the Cause, then the ear of Moses upon the Mount of glory, from the Tree of God, the Speaker, the Almighty, the All-Wise. Apart from these two, this Youth has appeared with a sovereignty that transcends all contingent things. To this the tongues of all beings bear witness, if you are among those who listen.

45

ثمّ قل لرؤسآء البیان این کنتم حین الّذی اضطربت فیه انفس العباد و زلّت فیه الأقدام و غشی الرّعب قلوب الرّاسخین و قام علیّ کلّ العباد من مذاهب شتّی و ما استنصرت من احد الّا اللّه الّذی بعثنی و ارسلنی علی العالمین تاللّه هم کانوا مستوراً خلف قناع النّسآء فلمّا ظهر الأمر بسلطانه اطمأنّوا فی انفسهم و خرجوا عن الحجاب فأوّل ما فعلوا اعرضوا عن الّذی به ثبت ایمانهم کذلک کان الأمر و انّک کنت من الشّاهدین و انّک ان لن تصدّقنی بعد الّذی شهدت بعینک یصدّقنی کلّ الأشیآء و عن ورائها لسان اللّه الصّادق الأمین

Thumma qul li-ruʾasāʾ al-Bayān ayna kuntum ḥīna alladhī iḍṭarabat fīhi anfus al-ʿibād wa-zallat fīhi al-aqdām wa-ghashiya al-ruʿb qulūb al-rāsikhīn wa-qāma ʿalayya kull al-ʿibād min madhāhib shattā wa-mā istanṣartu min aḥad illā Allāh alladhī baʿathanī wa-arsalanī ʿalā al-ʿālamīn. Ta-llāh hum kānū mastūran khalfa qināʿ al-nisāʾ fa-lammā ẓahara al-amr bi-sulṭānihi iṭmaʾannū fī anfusihim wa-kharajū ʿan al-ḥijāb fa-awwal mā faʿalū aʿraḍū ʿan alladhī bihi thabata īmānuhum. Kadhālika kāna al-amr wa-innaka kunta min al-shāhidīn. Wa-innaka in lan tuṣaddiqanī baʿda alladhī shahidta bi-ʿaynika yuṣaddiqunī kull al-ashyāʾ wa-ʿan warāʾihā lisān Allāh al-Ṣādiq al-Amīn.

Then say to the leaders of the Bayān: Where were you when the souls of the servants were shaken, when feet slipped and terror overwhelmed the hearts of the steadfast, and all the servants, of diverse creeds, rose against Me? I sought help from no one but God, who raised Me up and sent Me to the peoples of the world. By God, they were concealed behind the veil of women! Then, when the Cause appeared in its sovereignty, they felt secure within themselves and emerged from behind the veil. The first thing they did was to turn away from Him through whom their faith had been established. Such was the matter, and you were among its witnesses. And if you will not acknowledge My truth after what you have witnessed with your own eyes, all things will acknowledge My truth, and beyond them, the tongue of God, the Truthful, the Trustworthy.

46

ان یا جمال الکبریآء بین الأرض و السّمآء غیّر اللّحن لأهل الانشآء ثمّ غنّ علی افنان البقآء علی لحن عجمیّ منیع لیکشف اسرار الأمر فیما رقم من هذا القلم المحکم المتین چه که جمیع ناس بلغات عربیّه مطّلع نه و ادراک کلمات پارسیّه اسهل است نزد اهل لسان ای سائل آنچه از اسامی در کتاب الهی از ذکر طوبی و سدرهٴ منتهی و شجرهٴ قصوی و ورقه و ثمره و امثال آن مشاهده مینمائی موهوم مدان مقصود از جمیع این اسامی عنداللّه مؤمن باللّه بوده و خواهد بود و مؤمن تا در ظلّ سدرهٴ الهیّه ساکن از سدرهٴ طوبی و علّیّین عنداللّه محسوب و بعد از اعراض از سدرهٴ نار و سجّین مذکور و در حین ایمان افنان و اغصان و اوراق و اثمار او جمیع از اثبات مشهود و بعد از اعراض جمیع از نفی محسوب میشود و بسا نفسی که در اصیل از ابهی سدرهٴ بقا است و در بکور از ادنی شجرهٴ فنا و کذلک بالعکس لو انت من العارفین

An yā Jamāl al-Kibriyāʾ bayna al-arḍ wa-l-samāʾ ghayyir al-laḥn li-ahl al-inshāʾ thumma ghanni ʿalā afnān al-baqāʾ ʿalā laḥn ʿajamī manīʿ li-yukshafa asrār al-amr fīmā ruqima min hādhā al-qalam al-muḥkam al-matīn. Che ke jamīʿ-e nās be-loghāt-e ʿarabiyye moṭṭaleʿ na va edrāk-e kalemāt-e pārsiyye ashal ast nazd-e ahl-e lesān. Ey sāʾel ānche az asāmī dar ketāb-e elāhī az dhekr-e Ṭūbā va Sedre-ye Montahā va Shajare-ye Qoṣvā va varaqe va thamare va amthāl-e ān moshāhede mīnamāʾī mowhūm madān. Maqṣūd az jamīʿ-e īn asāmī ʿinda Allāh moʾmen be-Allāh būde va khāhad būd va moʾmen tā dar ẓell-e Sedre-ye Elāhiyye sāken az Sedre-ye Ṭūbā va ʿIlliyyīn ʿinda Allāh maḥsūb va baʿd az eʿrāḍ az Sedre-ye Nār va Sijjīn madhkūr va dar ḥīn-e īmān afnān va aghṣān va owrāq va athmār-e ū jamīʿ az ethbāt mashhūd va baʿd az eʿrāḍ jamīʿ az nafy maḥsūb mīshavad va basā nafsī ke dar aṣīl az abhā Sedre-ye Baqā ast va dar bokūr az adnā Shajare-ye Fanā wa-kadhālika bi-l-ʿaks law anta min al-ʿārifīn.

O Beauty of majesty between earth and heaven! Change the melody for the people of creation, then sing upon the branches of eternity in an exalted Persian melody, so that the mysteries of the Cause may be disclosed in what is inscribed by this firm and steadfast Pen. For not everyone is acquainted with the Arabic tongue, and understanding Persian words is easier for those who speak that language. O questioner! Do not regard as imaginary the names you encounter in the Book of God, such as Ṭūbā, the Lote Tree of the Utmost Limit, the Farthest Tree, leaf, fruit, and the like. In the sight of God, what is meant by all these names has been and will be the believer in God. As long as a believer dwells beneath the shade of the divine Lote Tree, that believer is reckoned in God’s sight as belonging to the Lote Tree of Ṭūbā and to ʿIlliyyīn; after turning away, that believer is described as belonging to the Tree of Fire and to Sijjīn.
