While in a state of faith, that believer’s boughs, branches, leaves, and fruits are all seen as belonging to affirmation; after turning away, they are all reckoned as belonging to negation. How many a soul belongs in the evening to the most glorious Lote Tree of eternity, and in the morning to the lowliest Tree of extinction! And likewise the reverse, if you are among those who understand.

47

مؤمن را در حین اقبال او الی اللّه جنّتی مشاهده کن با کمال تزیین بشأنی که جمیع آنچه در جنّت شنیده‌ئی در او مشاهده نما از افنان علمیّه و اثمار معارف الهیّه و انهار بیانیّه و ازهار حکمتیّه و فوق ذلک الی ان یشآء اللّه در او موجود و همین نفس بعینه بعد از اعراض نفس هاویه میشود مع آنچه متعلّق باو بوده کذلک یبدّل اللّه النّور بالظّلمة و الظّلمة بالنّور لو انتم تفقهون آیا نشنیده‌ئی که ظهور قبلم در ارض همین حکم جاری فرموده چنانچه میفرماید بر هر ارضی که مؤمن مستقرّ شود از ارض جنّت عنداللّه مذکور است و اگر مشرک بهمان ارض مستقرّ شود از ارض جحیم محسوب چنانچه الیوم مقرّ عرش ارضی واقع شده که ابداً معروف نبوده ولکن الیوم مبغضین جمال ربّ العالمین خود را از علّیّین محروم ساخته‌اند و در قعر سجّین مقرّ گرفته‌اند و بزعم خود در اعلی مقعد جنّت ساکنند چنانچه ملل قبل هم بهمین اوهام مشغولند اذاً یبشّرهم قلم الأمر بعذاب یوم عقیم

Moʾmen rā dar ḥīn-e eqbāl-e ū ilā Allāh jannatī moshāhede kon bā kamāl-e tazyīn be-shaʾnī ke jamīʿ-e ānche dar jannat shenīdeʾī dar ū moshāhede namā az afnān-e ʿelmiyye va athmār-e maʿāref-e elāhiyye va anhār-e bayāniyye va azhār-e ḥekmatiyye va fowq-e dhālek ilā an yashāʾa Allāh dar ū mowjūd va hamīn nafs be-ʿayneh baʿd az eʿrāḍ nafs-e Hāviye mīshavad maʿ-e ānche motaʿalleq be-ū būde. Kadhālika yubaddilu Allāh al-nūr bi-l-ẓulma wa-l-ẓulma bi-l-nūr law antum tafqahūn. Āyā nashenīdeʾī ke ẓohūr-e qablam dar arḍ hamīn ḥokm jārī farmūde chenānche mīfarmāyad bar har arḍī ke moʾmen mostaqarr shavad az arḍ-e jannat ʿinda Allāh madhkūr ast va agar moshrek be-hamān arḍ mostaqarr shavad az arḍ-e jaḥīm maḥsūb chenānche al-yowm maqarr-e ʿarsh arḍī vāqeʿ shode ke abadan maʿrūf nabūde va-lāken al-yowm mobgheḍīn-e Jamāl-e Rabb al-ʿĀlamīn khod rā az ʿIlliyyīn maḥrūm sākhte-and va dar qaʿr-e Sijjīn maqarr gerefte-and va be-zaʿm-e khod dar aʿlā maqʿad-e jannat sākenand chenānche melal-e qabl ham be-hamīn owhām mashghūland. Idhan yubashshiruhum Qalam al-Amr bi-ʿadhāb yawm ʿaqīm.

When a believer turns toward God, behold that believer as a paradise adorned to perfection, and see within that soul everything you have heard of paradise: branches of knowledge, fruits of divine understanding, rivers of utterance, and flowers of wisdom. All these, and more beyond them, as God wills, are present within that soul. Yet this very same soul, after turning away, becomes hell itself, together with everything that belonged to it. Thus does God exchange light for darkness and darkness for light, if you understand. Have you not heard that My former Manifestation on earth pronounced this very judgment, saying: “Whatever land a believer settles in is accounted in God’s sight as the land of paradise; and if an idolater settles in that same land, it is reckoned as the land of hell”? Thus today the seat of the Throne has come to be in a land that was never renowned. Yet today those who hate the Beauty of the Lord of the worlds have deprived themselves of ʿIlliyyīn and made their abode in the depths of Sijjīn, while imagining that they dwell in the loftiest seat of paradise, just as the peoples of the past are occupied with these same delusions. The Pen of the Cause therefore gives them tidings of the punishment of a barren day.

48

این قوم را لایق آنکه عجلی من دون اللّه اخذ نمایند و باو ساجد و عاکف شوند چنانچه شده‌اند کجا لایقند بهوای قدس صمدانی طیران نمایند و یا بسماء عزّ الهی راجع شوند چنانچه مشاهده میشود آنکه طبعش گل میل نموده ابداً بگل ملتفت نه کذلک یضرب اللّه مثلاً لعلّ النّاس هم یشعرون آیا نشنیده‌اید که میفرماید بسا شجرهٴ اثبات که در ظهور بعد از شجرهٴ نفی میشود باری الیوم هر نفسی که از کلّ آنچه مابین عباد مشهود و مذکور است منقطع نشود و جمیع را چون کفّ طین مشاهده ننماید ابداً قادر نه که باین هوا طیران نماید و یا بمقرّ سلطان عزّ تقدیس درآید

Īn qowm rā lāyeq ānke ʿejlī min dūni Allāh akhdh namāyand va be-ū sājed va ʿākef shavand chenānche shode-and. Kojā lāyeqand be-havā-ye qods-e ṣamadānī ṭayarān namāyand va yā be-samā-ye ʿezz-e elāhī rājeʿ shavand. Chenānche moshāhede mīshavad ānke ṭabʿash gel meyl namūde abadan be-gol moltafet na. Kadhālika yaḍribu Allāh mathalan laʿalla al-nās hum yashʿurūn. Āyā nashenīde-īd ke mīfarmāyad basā Shajare-ye Ethbāt ke dar ẓohūr-e baʿd az Shajare-ye Nafy mīshavad. Bārī al-yowm har nafsī ke az koll-e ānche mābeyn-e ʿebād mashhūd va madhkūr ast monqaṭeʿ nashavad va jamīʿ rā chon kaff-e ṭīn moshāhede nanamāyad abadan qāder na ke be-īn havā ṭayarān namāyad va yā be-maqarr-e Solṭān-e ʿEzz-e Taqdīs darāyad.

It befits these people to take a calf instead of God, bow before it, and devote themselves to it, as indeed they have done. How could they be worthy to soar in the atmosphere of divine holiness or ascend to the heaven of divine glory? As can be seen, one whose nature inclines toward clay pays no attention to the rose. Thus does God offer a parable, so that people may understand. Have you not heard that He says: “Many a Tree of Affirmation becomes a Tree of Negation in the next Manifestation”? In short, today any soul who does not become detached from everything seen and mentioned among the servants, and does not regard it all as a handful of clay, will never be able to soar in this atmosphere or enter the dwelling of the Sovereign of sanctified glory.

49

لازال مؤمن اقلّ از کبریت احمر بوده و خواهد بود و علاوه بر این شموس معانی که از مشرق اصبع رحمانی اشراق نمود این بسی مبرهن و واضح است که ثمره بنفسه لنفسه موجود نه بلکه باعانت الهیّه از امکنهٴ ترابیّه صعود نموده تا باین رتبه ظاهر شده که مقام ثمری باشد و آن مقتدری که او را باین مقام فایز نمود بهمان قدرت قادر است که او و صدهزار امثال و اشباح را در اقلّ من آن از اعلی مقرّ بقا بادنی مقعد فنا راجع فرماید و هم‌چنین بالعکس و این از سنن او بوده و خواهد بود چه که قدرت محیطه و قضایای محتومهٴ آن سلطان احدیّه لازال بر کلّ شیء نافذ بوده و اقلّ من آن از ظهورات قدرت خود ممنوع نبوده فسبحان اللّه عمّا یظنّون المتوهّمون

Lāzāl moʾmen aqall az kebrīt-e aḥmar būde va khāhad būd va ʿelāve bar īn shomūs-e maʿānī ke az mashreq-e eṣbaʿ-e raḥmānī eshrāq namūd īn basī mobarhan va vāḍeḥ ast ke thamare be-nafseh le-nafseh mowjūd na balke be-eʿānat-e elāhiyye az amkene-ye torābiyye ṣoʿūd namūde tā be-īn rotbe ẓāher shode ke maqām-e thamarī bāshad va ān moqtaderī ke ū rā be-īn maqām fāʾez namūd be-hamān qodrat qāder ast ke ū va ṣad-hezār amthāl va ashbāḥ rā dar aqall-e men ān az aʿlā maqarr-e baqā be-adnā maqʿad-e fanā rājeʿ farmāyad va ham-chenīn be-l-ʿaks va īn az sonan-e ū būde va khāhad būd che ke qodrat-e moḥīṭe va qaḍāyā-ye maḥtūme-ye ān Solṭān-e Aḥadiyye lāzāl bar koll-e shayʾ nāfedh būde va aqall-e men ān az ẓohūrāt-e qodrat-e khod mamnūʿ nabūde. Fa-subḥān Allāh ʿammā yaẓunnūn al-mutawahhimūn.

A believer has always been, and will always be, rarer than red sulfur. Beyond these suns of meaning that have shone from the dawning-place of the finger of the All-Merciful, it is abundantly evident and clear that a fruit does not exist by itself and for itself. Rather, through divine assistance, it has risen from earthly places until it has appeared at this rank, the station of bearing fruit. The Mighty One who enabled it to attain this station is able, through that same power, to return it and a hundred thousand others like it, in less than an instant, from the loftiest abode of eternity to the lowliest seat of extinction—and likewise the reverse. This has been and will be among His ways, for the all-encompassing power and irrevocable decrees of that Sovereign of oneness have always held sway over all things, and never for less than an instant has He been prevented from manifesting His power. Exalted, then, is God above what the deluded imagine!

50

بسا لآلی اسرار که در اصداف بحار اسم ربّک السّتّار مستور بوده و خواهد بود که اظهار آن سبب اعثار اقدام غیر مستقیمه شود باری الیوم فضلی ظاهر شده که اگر اراده فرماید از کفی از طین کلّ حروفات اوّلیّه و آخریّه را مبعوث فرماید قادر است مع‌ذلک بسیار حیف است انسان در این ایّام که جمال رحمن بتمام فضل ظاهر شده خود را بغیر او مشغول نماید دع کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض لأهلها ثمّ ادخل فی غمرات هذا البحر الّذی لن یوجد فیه الّا لآلئ ذکر اسم ربّک العلیّ المقتدر العظیم

Basā laʾālī-ye asrār ke dar aṣdāf-e beḥār-e esm-e rabbika al-Sattār mastūr būde va khāhad būd ke eẓhār-e ān sabab-e eʿthār-e aqdām-e gheyr-e mostaqīme shavad. Bārī al-yowm faḍlī ẓāher shode ke agar erāde farmāyad az kaffī az ṭīn koll-e ḥorūfāt-e avvaliyye va ākheriyye rā mabʿūth farmāyad qāder ast. Maʿa-dhālek besyār ḥeyf ast ensān dar īn ayyām ke Jamāl-e Raḥmān be-tamām-e faḍl ẓāher shode khod rā be-gheyr-e ū mashghūl namāyad. Daʿ kulla man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ li-ahlihā thumma udkhul fī ghamarāt hādhā al-baḥr alladhī lan yūjada fīhi illā laʾāliʾ dhikr ism rabbika al-ʿAlī al-Muqtadir al-ʿAẓīm.

Many pearls of mysteries have been and will remain concealed within the shells of the seas of the name of your Lord, the All-Concealing, whose disclosure would cause unsteady feet to stumble. In short, today a grace has appeared such that, should He wish to raise up all the first and last Letters from a handful of clay, He has the power to do so. Nevertheless, it is a great pity for anyone, in these days when the Beauty of the All-Merciful has appeared in the fullness of His grace, to be occupied with anything other than Him. Leave all who are in the heavens and the earth to their own people, then plunge into the depths of this Ocean, in which nothing will be found but the pearls of the remembrance of the name of your Lord, the Most High, the All-Powerful, the Most Great.

51

اینست بدایع ظهورات شمس امر رحمن که از افق اصبع ملیک امکان اشراق فرموده فطوبی للعاملین و من دون ذلک انّ ربّک لغنیّ عن العالمین ای بسا نفوسی که الیوم در ابحر نار مستغرقند و مستشعر نیستند بلکه خود را از اهل جنّت میدانند چنانچه امم قبل هم باین ظنون مسرورند قسم بآفتاب عزّ قدس تجرید که این ظهور اعظم از آن است که بدلیل محتاج باشد و یا ببرهان منوط گردد قل انّ دلیله ظهوره و حجّته نفسه و وجوده اثباته و برهانه قیامه بین السّموات و الأرض فی ایّام الّتی فیها اضطربت کلّ من فی ملکوت الأمر و الخلق اجمعین و ان لن تقدرنّ ان تعرفنّه بما فصّلنا لکم فاعرفوه بما نزّل من عنده و کذلک قدّر لکم فضلاً من عنده و انّه لهو الفضّال القدیم

Īnast badāyeʿ-e ẓohūrāt-e Shams-e Amr-e Raḥmān ke az ofoq-e eṣbaʿ-e Malīk-e Emkān eshrāq farmūde fa-ṭūbā li-l-ʿāmilīn wa-min dūni dhālika inna rabbaka la-ghaniyy ʿan al-ʿālamīn. Ey basā nofūsī ke al-yowm dar abḥor-e nār mostaghraqand va mostashʿer nīstand balke khod rā az ahl-e jannat mīdānand chenānche omam-e qabl ham be-īn ẓonūn masrūrand. Qasam be-Āftāb-e ʿEzz-e Qods-e Tajrīd ke īn ẓohūr aʿẓam az ān ast ke be-dalīl moḥtāj bāshad va yā be-borhān manūṭ gardad. Qul inna dalīlahu ẓuhūruhu wa-ḥujjatahu nafsuhu wa-wujūduhu ithbātuhu wa-burhānahu qiyāmuhu bayna al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ fī ayyām allatī fīhā iḍṭarabat kull man fī malakūt al-amr wa-l-khalq ajmaʿīn. Wa-in lan taqdirunna an taʿrifunnahu bi-mā faṣṣalnā lakum fa-ʿrifūhu bi-mā nuzzila min ʿindihi wa-kadhālika quddira lakum faḍlan min ʿindihi wa-innahu la-huwa al-Faḍḍāl al-Qadīm.

These are the wondrous revelations of the Sun of the Cause of the All-Merciful, which has shone from the horizon of the finger of the Sovereign of contingent existence. Blessed are those who act; otherwise, your Lord is indeed independent of all the worlds. How many souls today are submerged in seas of fire and are unaware of it! Rather, they consider themselves among the people of paradise, just as the peoples of the past rejoice in these same suppositions. I swear by the Sun of the glory of holy detachment that this Revelation is too great to need evidence or depend upon proof. Say: Its evidence is its appearance, its testimony is its own Self, its existence is its confirmation, and its proof is its arising between the heavens and the earth in days when all who are in the kingdoms of revelation and creation were shaken. And if you cannot recognize Him through what We have explained to you, recognize Him through what has been sent down from Him. Thus has it been ordained for you as a grace from Him. He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the Ancient.

52

قلم اعلی میفرماید ای علیّ یکبار بطور تقدیس قدم گذار و بقلب فارغ و لسان طاهر ربّ ارنی گو تا لازال از مکمن قدس بی‌زوال انظر ترانی بشنوی و بلقاء جمال بیمثال حضرت ذو الجلال فایز گردی یعنی لقای مظهر نفس او که بیک تجلّی از تجلّیات انوار فضلش یتغنّی اشجار الوجود من الغیب و الشّهود بما نطقت سدرة الطّور این چنین احاطه فرموده فضل سلطان یفعل ما یشآء ولکنّ النّاس هم فی وهم عظیم و حجاب غلیظ و غفلة مبین اینست شأن این ناس که لایزال بقول حقّ افتخار مینمایند و از نفس او معرض مثلاً حجر را طواف میکنند و از اماکن بعیده طیّ سبلهای صعبه مینمایند و از جان و مال میگذرند تا بزیارتش فایز شوند ولکن از سلطان مقتدری که بقول او صدهزار امثال این حجر خلق میشود غافل بلکه معرضند

Qalam-e Aʿlā mīfarmāyad ey ʿAlī yek bār be-Ṭūr-e Taqdīs qadam godhār va be-qalb-e fāregh va lesān-e ṭāher rabbi arinī gū tā lāzāl az makman-e qods-e bī-zavāl unẓur tarānī beshnavī va be-leqā-ye Jamāl-e Bī-methāl-e Ḥaḍrat-e Dhu-l-Jalāl fāʾez gardī yaʿnī leqā-ye Maẓhar-e Nafs-e ū ke be-yek tajallī az tajalliyāt-e anvār-e faḍlash yataghannā ashjār al-wujūd min al-ghayb wa-l-shuhūd bi-mā naṭaqat Sidrat al-Ṭūr. Īn chenīn eḥāṭe farmūde faḍl-e Solṭān-e yafʿalu mā yashāʾ wa-lākinna al-nās hum fī wahm ʿaẓīm wa-ḥijāb ghalīẓ wa-ghafla mubīn. Īnast shaʾn-e īn nās ke lāyazāl be-qowl-e Ḥaqq eftekhār mīnamāyand va az nafs-e ū moʿreḍ mathalan ḥajar rā ṭavāf mīkonand va az amāken-e baʿīde ṭayy-e sobolhā-ye ṣaʿbe mīnamāyand va az jān va māl mīgodharand tā be-zeyāratash fāʾez shavand va-lāken az Solṭān-e Moqtaderī ke be-qowl-e ū ṣad-hezār amthāl-e īn ḥajar khalq mīshavad ghāfel balke moʿreḍand.

The Most Exalted Pen says: O ʿAlī! For once, set foot upon the Mount of sanctity and, with an unburdened heart and a pure tongue, say, “My Lord, show me,” so that you may continually hear from the imperishable sanctuary of holiness, “Look, and you will see Me,” and attain the presence of the peerless Beauty of the Lord of majesty—that is, the presence of the Manifestation of His own Self. Through a single effulgence of the lights of His grace, the trees of existence, unseen and seen, sing what the Lote Tree of the Mount has spoken. Such is the all-encompassing grace of the Sovereign who does whatever He wills. Yet the people are in great delusion, behind a thick veil, and in manifest heedlessness. Such is the condition of these people: they continually take pride in the word of the True One, yet turn away from His own Self. For example, they circle around the stone, traverse difficult paths from distant places, and sacrifice their lives and possessions to attain the privilege of visiting it. Yet they are heedless of—indeed, turn away from—the mighty Sovereign through whose word a hundred thousand stones like this are created.

53

چنانچه ملاحظه شد در سنهٴ ستّین و هم‌چنین در این ایّام بصر منیر را بصدهزار حجبات وهمیّه و سبحات نفسیّه مستور مینمایند و بعد فریاد برآرند که آفتاب جهانتاب عزّ صمدانی طالع نشده و اگر هم ادراک نمایند سؤال نموده که فلان نجم چگونه میشود نورش محو گردد و یا زایل شود دیگر غافل از اینکه بوجود شمس یمحو نوره چنانچه مشاهده میشود که در ایّام انوار نجوم محو و لایظهرند باری عنقریب ید قدرت محیطهٴ الهیّه نفوسی چند خلق فرماید که جمیع احجاب را خرق نمایند و بی ستر و حجاب بمکمن ربّ الأرباب درآیند و در سبیل محبوب از هیچ آبی مخمود نشوند و از هیچ ناری جزع ننمایند غیر معبود را مفقود شمرند و ماسوای مقصود را معدوم مشاهده نمایند و در کلّ اوان اهل امکان را بسلاسل بیان برضوان قدس رحمن کشند قسم بآفتاب معانی که انوار این نفوس اهل ملأ اعلی را مستنیر نماید چنانچه شمس اهل ارض را

Chunānchih mulāḥiẓih shud dar sanih-yi sittīn va ham-chunīn dar īn ayyām baṣar-i munīr rā bi-ṣad-hizār ḥujubāt-i vahmiyyih va subuḥāt-i nafsiyyih mastūr mīnamāyand va baʿd faryād bar-ārand kih āftāb-i jahān-tāb-i ʿizz-i ṣamadānī ṭāliʿ nashudih va agar ham idrāk namāyand suʾāl namūdih kih fulān najm chigūnih mīshavad nūrash maḥv gardad va yā zāʾil shavad dīgar ghāfil az īnkih bi-vujūd-i shams yamḥū nūrahu chunānchih mushāhidih mīshavad kih dar ayyām anvār-i nujūm maḥv va lā-yaẓhar-and bārī ʿan-qarīb yad-i qudrat-i muḥīṭih-yi ilāhiyyih nufūsī chand khalq farmāyad kih jamīʿ-i aḥjāb rā kharq namāyand va bī sitr va ḥijāb bi-makman-i Rabb al-Arbāb dar-āyand va dar sabīl-i Maḥbūb az hīch ābī makhmūd nashavand va az hīch nārī jazaʿ nanamāyand ghayr-i Maʿbūd rā mafqūd shumurand va mā-sivā-yi Maqṣūd rā maʿdūm mushāhidih namāyand va dar kull-i avān ahl-i imkān rā bi-salāsil-i bayān bi-Riḍvān-i quds-i Raḥmān kashand qasam bi-āftāb-i maʿānī kih anvār-i īn nufūs ahl-i malaʾ-i aʿlā rā mustanīr namāyad chunānchih shams ahl-i arḍ rā

As was observed in the year sixty, and likewise in these days, they veil their radiant vision with a hundred thousand veils of vain imagining and coverings of self, and then cry out that the world-illumining Sun of everlasting glory has not risen. Even if they perceive it, they ask how the light of a particular star could be effaced or disappear, heedless that the presence of the sun effaces its light, just as one observes that in the daytime the lights of the stars are effaced and do not appear. Soon, however, the hand of God’s all-encompassing power will create souls who will rend every veil and enter, without covering or veil, the sanctuary of the Lord of lords. In the path of the Beloved, no water will quench them and no fire will cause them to fear. They will reckon all but the One they worship as absent, and regard all besides the Object of their desire as nonexistent. At all times they will draw the people of the world of existence, with the chains of utterance, into the paradise of the holiness of the All-Merciful. I swear by the Sun of inner meanings that the lights of these souls will illumine the dwellers of the heavenly assembly, just as the sun illumines the people of the earth.

54

ان یا علیّ دع ما عندک و خذ ما یأمرک به اللّه و انّ هذا لیغنیک عن العالمین و من دونه لایسمن و لایغنی بوده و خواهد بود تمسّک بالعروة الوثقی و دع ما یأمرک به الهوی تاللّه الحقّ انّ هذا لحبل المحکم الّذی ظهر بین الأرض و السّمآء فمن تمسّک به فقد نجا و من اعرض فقد هلک

In yā ʿAlī daʿ mā ʿindaka wa-khudh mā yaʾmuruka bihi Allāh wa-inna hādhā la-yughnīka ʿan al-ʿālamīn va min dūnihi lā yusminu wa-lā yughnī būdih va khvāhad būd tamassak bi-l-ʿurwati al-wuthqā wa-daʿ mā yaʾmuruka bihi al-hawā ta-Allāhi al-Ḥaqq inna hādhā la-ḥablu al-muḥkam alladhī ẓahara bayna al-arḍi wa-l-samāʾ fa-man tamassaka bihi fa-qad najā wa-man aʿraḍa fa-qad halak

O ʿAlī! Leave what you possess and take what God commands you. This will indeed make you independent of all the worlds, while anything besides it has never nourished or satisfied, nor ever will. Hold fast to the surest handle and abandon what desire commands you. By God, the Truth! This is indeed the firm cord that has appeared between earth and heaven. Whoever holds fast to it has been saved, and whoever turns away has perished.

55

باری الیوم هر نفسی حقّ منیع را بدون او تعالی بخواهد عارف شود و یا ادراک نماید مثل آن است که از اکمه طلب ارائهٴ سبیل نماید و هذا لم یمکن ابداً دلیله آیاته و سلطانه اثباته

Bārī al-yawm har nafsī Ḥaqq-i manīʿ rā bidūn-i Ū taʿālā bikhvāhad ʿārif shavad va yā idrāk namāyad mithl-i ān ast kih az akmah ṭalab-i irāʾih-yi sabīl namāyad wa-hādhā lam yumkin abadan dalīluhu āyātuhu wa-sulṭānuhu ithbātuhu

In short, whoever today wishes to recognize or comprehend the exalted True One without Him—exalted is He—is like someone asking a person blind from birth to show the way. This has never been possible. His proof is His verses, and His sovereignty is His confirmation.

56

ای علیّ بلسان بدیع پارسی کلمات ربّانی را اصغا نما و اگر تو نشنوی البتّه قدرت محیطهٴ الهیّه انفسی بدعاً خلق فرماید که بشنوند ندای او را و بر نصر امرش قیام نمایند لیس هذا علی اللّه بعزیز

Ay ʿAlī bi-lisān-i badīʿ-i pārsī kalimāt-i rabbānī rā iṣghā namā va agar tū nashnavī al-battih qudrat-i muḥīṭih-yi ilāhiyyih anfusī badʿan khalq farmāyad kih bishnavand nidā-yi Ū rā va bar naṣr-i amrash qiyām namāyand laysa hādhā ʿalā Allāhi bi-ʿazīz

O ʿAlī! Listen to the divine words in the wondrous Persian tongue. If you do not listen, God’s all-encompassing power will assuredly create souls anew who will hear His call and arise to aid His Cause. This is not difficult for God.

57

و اگر از شمال وهم بیمین یقین راجع شدی و از کوثر عرفان جمال رحمن که در رضوان معانی جاری شده مرزوق گشتی بگو ای اهل بیان بکدام دین متدیّنید و بر کدام صراط قائم اگر بگویند بنقطهٴ بیان روح ما سواه فداه بگو بچه حجّت و دلیل بآن سلطان سبیل موقن شده‌اید و معترف گشته‌اید اگر بگویند او را بنفسه شناخته‌ایم بگو هذا کذب صراح چه که الی حین بنفس خود عارف نشده‌اید تا چه رسد بنفس اللّه القائمة علی کلّ شیء و اگر هم این قول از این نفوس مسموع آید چرا بنفس اللّه الظّاهرة که چون شمس مشرق است مذعن نشده‌اند و اگر بگویند بآیات منزله مؤمن شده‌ایم چرا باین آیات که بمثابۀ غیث هاطل از سماء غیب در کلّ حین نازل است کافر شده‌اند قل أ تؤمنون ببعض الکتاب و تکفرون ببعض فویل لکم یا معشر الظّالمین

Va agar az shimāl-i vahm bi-yamīn-i yaqīn rājiʿ shudī va az kawthar-i ʿirfān-i Jamāl-i Raḥmān kih dar Riḍvān-i maʿānī jārī shudih marzūq gashtī bigū ay ahl-i Bayān bi-kudām dīn mutadayyinīd va bar kudām ṣirāṭ qāʾim agar bigūyand bi-Nuqṭih-yi Bayān rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu bigū bi-chih ḥujjat va dalīl bi-ān sulṭān-i sabīl mūqin shudih-īd va muʿtarif gashtih-īd agar bigūyand ū rā bi-nafsih shinākhtih-īm bigū hādhā kadhibun ṣurāḥ chih kih ilā ḥīn bi-nafs-i khvud ʿārif nashudih-īd tā chih rasad bi-nafsi Allāhi al-qāʾimati ʿalā kulli shayʾ va agar ham īn qawl az īn nufūs masmūʿ āyad chirā bi-nafsi Allāhi al-ẓāhirah kih chūn shams mushriq ast mudhʿin nashudih-and va agar bigūyand bi-āyāt-i munzalih muʾmin shudih-īm chirā bi-īn āyāt kih bi-mathābih-yi ghayth-i hāṭil az samāʾ-i ghayb dar kull-i ḥīn nāzil ast kāfir shudih-and qul a-tuʾminūna bi-baʿḍi al-kitābi wa-takfurūna bi-baʿḍ fa-waylun lakum yā maʿshara al-ẓālimīn

If you have turned from the left hand of vain imagining to the right hand of certitude, and have received your portion of the river of the recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful that flows in the paradise of inner meanings, say: O people of the Bayān! What religion do you profess, and on what path do you stand? If they say, “We believe in the Point of the Bayān—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him,” say: By what proof and evidence have you become certain of that Sovereign of the path and acknowledged Him? If they say, “We have recognized Him through His own Self,” say: This is a blatant lie, for you have not yet recognized your own selves, much less the Self of God who sustains all things. Moreover, if such a claim is heard from these souls, why have they not acknowledged the manifest Self of God, who shines like the sun? And if they say, “We have believed through the revealed verses,” why have they disbelieved in these verses, which descend at every moment from the heaven of the unseen like pouring rain? Say: Do you believe in part of the Book and disbelieve in part? Woe to you, O company of wrongdoers!

58

و من‌دون این دو مقام ظهورات قدرتیّه و شئونات الوهیّه که عالم را احاطه نموده بشأنی که برای نفسی مجال اعراض نمانده الّا بأن یکون معرضاً بکلّه عن اللّه و انبیائه و اصفیائه و اودّائه قریب بیست سنه میشود که این عبد آنی بر بستر راحت نیاسوده و در کلّ حین در ارتفاع امر اللّه بنفسه کوشیده قسم بسلطان لایعرف که از اوّل ابداع تا حال چنین قدرتی ظاهر نشده که نفسی وحده اعلام قدرت بر [اقنان] عظمت مرتفع نماید و مع‌ذلک این مشرکین بر جمال مبین ربّ العالمین وارد آورده‌اند آنچه را که الآن روح الأمین و هیاکل علّیّین نوحه و ندبه مینمایند

Va min-dūn-i īn du maqām ẓuhūrāt-i qudratiyyih va shuʾūnāt-i ulūhiyyih kih ʿālam rā iḥāṭih namūdih bi-shaʾnī kih barā-yi nafsī majāl-i iʿrāḍ namāndih illā bi-an yakūna muʿriḍan bi-kullihi ʿan Allāhi wa-anbiyāʾihi wa-aṣfiyāʾihi wa-awiddāʾihi qarīb-i bīst sanih mīshavad kih īn ʿabd ānī bar bistar-i rāḥat nayāsūdih va dar kull-i ḥīn dar irtifāʿ-i Amr Allāh bi-nafsih kūshīdih qasam bi-Sulṭān-i lā-yuʿraf kih az avval-i ibdāʿ tā ḥāl chunīn qudratī ẓāhir nashudih kih nafsī vaḥdahu aʿlām-i qudrat bar [aqnān]-i ʿaẓamat murtafiʿ namāyad va maʿa-dhālik īn mushrikīn bar Jamāl-i mubīn-i Rabb al-ʿālamīn vārid āvardih-and ānchih rā kih al-ān Rūḥ al-Amīn va hayākil-i ʿilliyyīn nawḥih va nudbih mīnamāyand

Besides these two stations, there are manifestations of power and signs of divinity that have encompassed the world in such a way that no soul has any scope to turn away, unless it turns wholly away from God, His Prophets, His chosen ones, and His loved ones. For nearly twenty years this servant has not rested for a moment upon a bed of ease, and has at all times striven in person to exalt the Cause of God. I swear by the unknowable Sovereign that, from the beginning of creation until now, no such power has appeared: a single soul, alone, raising the banners of power upon the summits of grandeur. Yet these idolaters have inflicted upon the manifest Beauty of the Lord of the worlds what causes the Faithful Spirit and the embodiments of the highest heaven to lament and mourn even now.

59

و اگر میگویند این آیات بدیعه از فطرت الهیّه نازل نشده چنانچه مشرکین قبل در احیان ظهورات شموس حقیقت این سخن را گفته‌اند بگو الواح منزله که از سحاب عزّ ربّ العالمین در سنهٴ ستّین نازل شده موجود و این آیات بدیعه که از سماء قدس ابهی نازل شده حاضر و مشهود هر دو را نزد عدّه‌ئی از اهل قلوب صافیه و ابصار حدیده و انفس زکیّه و آذان واعیه تلاوت مینمائیم تا نغمات اللّه و روایح قدسش از قمیص کلمات بدیعش استشمام شود تاللّه الحقّ برایحة کلمة من تلک الکلمات لتهبّ رایحة اللّه المهیمن القیّوم ولکن کلّ ناس بزکام مبتلا گشته‌اند و هم لا یجدون ابداً الّا من شآء ربّک العزیز المحبوب اگرچه اعراض معرضین و افترای مفترین بمقامی رسیده که قلم و بیان هر دو از ذکر بازمانده و مع‌ذلک انّا نطعم العباد من مائدة العلمیّة الطّریّة الأبدیّة القدمیّة الالهیّة لوجه اللّه و ما نرید منهم جزآء و لا شکورا

Va agar mīgūyand īn āyāt-i badīʿih az fiṭrat-i ilāhiyyih nāzil nashudih chunānchih mushrikīn-i qabl dar aḥyān-i ẓuhūrāt-i shumūs-i ḥaqīqat īn sukhan rā guftih-and bigū alvāḥ-i munzalih kih az saḥāb-i ʿizz-i Rabb al-ʿālamīn dar sanih-yi sittīn nāzil shudih mawjūd va īn āyāt-i badīʿih kih az samāʾ-i quds-i Abhā nāzil shudih ḥāḍir va mashhūd har du rā nazd-i ʿiddih-ī az ahl-i qulūb-i ṣāfiyih va abṣār-i ḥadīdih va anfus-i zakiyyih va ādhān-i vāʿiyih tilāvat mīnamāyīm tā naghamāt Allāh va ravāyiḥ-i qudsash az qamīṣ-i kalimāt-i badīʿash istishmām shavad ta-Allāhi al-Ḥaqq bi-rāʾiḥati kalimatin min tilka al-kalimāt la-tahubbu rāʾiḥatu Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm valīkin kull-i nās bi-zukām mubtalā gashtih-and wa-hum lā yajidūna abadan illā man shāʾa rabbuka al-ʿAzīzu al-Maḥbūb agarchih iʿrāḍ-i muʿriḍīn va iftirā-yi muftarīn bi-maqāmī rasīdih kih qalam va bayān har du az dhikr bāz-māndih va maʿa-dhālik innā nuṭʿimu al-ʿibāda min māʾidati al-ʿilmiyyati al-ṭariyyati al-abadiyyati al-qidamiyyati al-ilāhiyyati li-wajhi Allāhi wa-mā nurīdu minhum jazāʾan wa-lā shukūrā

If they say that these wondrous verses have not descended from the divine nature, just as the idolaters of the past said when the Suns of Truth appeared, say: The revealed Tablets that descended from the cloud of the glory of the Lord of the worlds in the year sixty are available, and these wondrous verses that have descended from the heaven of the holiness of the Most Glorious are present and visible. We will recite both before a number of people with pure hearts, keen sight, stainless souls, and attentive ears, so that the melodies of God and His holy fragrances may be perceived from the garment of His wondrous words. By God, the Truth! With the fragrance of a single one of those words, the fragrance of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, will assuredly waft. Yet all the people have been afflicted with a cold, and they will never perceive it, except those whom your Lord, the Almighty, the Beloved, wills. Although the rejection of those who turn away and the slander of the slanderers have reached such a point that pen and utterance alike are unable to recount them, nevertheless We feed the servants, for the sake of God, from the fresh, eternal, ancient, divine table of knowledge, and We desire from them neither reward nor thanks.

60

فوالّذی نطق فی صدری که هیچ یک از ملل قبل بحجبات اهل بیان مشاهده نمیشوند چه که در جمیع کتب قبل ذکر ظهورات احدیّه بتلویح ذکر شده مثلاً در توریة در بعضی از مواضع ذکر شده که اگر نفسی بیاید و دعوی نبوّت کند کاذب است چه که الهی جز اله موسی نبوده و رسولی جز من مبعوث نخواهد شد و احکام الهی جز ما نزّل فی التّوریة نخواهد آمد و در یک موضع بتلویح اشاره بظهور بعد فرموده و بشأنی بحجب و استار ذکر شده که اکثری از عباد از عرفانش عاجزند حال در این صورت اگر امّت او از مشارق احدیّه و مظاهر الهیّه محتجب مانند فی‌الجمله عذری در دست دارند که بآن متعذّر شوند که معضلات کلمات الهی را ادراک ننمودیم لذا از منبع کوثر عرفان جمال رحمن محروم ماندیم

Fa-wa-lladhī naṭaqa fī ṣadrī kih hīch yak az milal-i qabl bi-ḥujubāt-i ahl-i Bayān mushāhidih namīshavand chih kih dar jamīʿ-i kutub-i qabl dhikr-i ẓuhūrāt-i aḥadiyyih bi-talvīḥ dhikr shudih mathalan dar Tawrāt dar baʿḍī az mavāḍiʿ dhikr shudih kih agar nafsī biyāyad va daʿvā-yi nubuwwat kunad kādhib ast chih kih ilāhī juz Ilāh-i Mūsā nabūdih va rasūlī juz man mabʿūth nakhvāhad shud va aḥkām-i ilāhī juz mā nuzzila fī al-Tawrāt nakhvāhad āmad va dar yak mawḍiʿ bi-talvīḥ ishārih bi-ẓuhūr-i baʿd farmūdih va bi-shaʾnī bi-ḥujub va astār dhikr shudih kih aktharī az ʿibād az ʿirfānash ʿājizand ḥāl dar īn ṣūrat agar ummat-i ū az mashāriq-i aḥadiyyih va maẓāhir-i ilāhiyyih muḥtajib mānand fī-l-jumlih ʿudhrī dar dast dārand kih bi-ān mutaʿadhdhir shavand kih muʿḍalāt-i kalimāt-i ilāhī rā idrāk nanamūdīm lidhā az manbaʿ-i kawthar-i ʿirfān-i Jamāl-i Raḥmān maḥrūm māndīm

By Him who has spoken within My breast! None of the peoples of the past are seen to be veiled as the people of the Bayān are. For in all the former Books the manifestations of divine unity were mentioned by allusion. For example, in certain passages of the Torah it is stated that if anyone comes and claims prophethood, he is a liar, for there has been no God but the God of Moses, no messenger but Me will be raised up, and no divine ordinances will come other than what has been sent down in the Torah. In one passage, He alludes indirectly to the subsequent Revelation, but it is mentioned beneath such veils and coverings that most people are unable to recognize it. In these circumstances, if His people remain veiled from the Daysprings of divine unity and the Manifestations of God, they have some measure of excuse to offer: “We did not comprehend the difficulties in the divine words, and thus remained deprived of the source of the river of the recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful.”

61

و هم‌چنین در انجیل روح القدس بنغماتی در علایم ظهور تغنّی و تکلّم فرموده که ادراک آن هر نفسی را ممکن نه الّا المنقطعین چه که برموزات خفیّه و اشارات دقیقه بیان شده چنانچه همان عبارات از قلم عزّ باقیه در رسایل فارسیّه مسطور گشت فانظروا الیها لعلّ تجدون در این صورت این طایفه هم اگر متعذّر شوند بآنکه عقول و ادراک ما قاصر بود از عرفان این کلمات مرموزهٴ معضله شاید که بعضی از عباد بپذیرند

Va ham-chunīn dar Injīl Rūḥ al-Qudus bi-naghamātī dar ʿalāʾim-i ẓuhūr taghannī va takallum farmūdih kih idrāk-i ān har nafsī rā mumkin nah illā al-munqaṭiʿīn chih kih bi-rumūzāt-i khafiyyih va ishārāt-i daqīqih bayān shudih chunānchih hamān ʿibārāt az qalam-i ʿizz-i bāqiyih dar rasāʾil-i fārsiyyih masṭūr gasht fa-nẓurū ilayhā laʿallakum tajidūn dar īn ṣūrat īn ṭāʾifih ham agar mutaʿadhdhir shavand bi-ānkih ʿuqūl va idrāk-i mā qāṣir būd az ʿirfān-i īn kalimāt-i marmūzih-yi muʿḍalih shāyad kih baʿḍī az ʿibād bipadhīrand

Likewise, in the Gospel the Holy Spirit has sung and spoken of the signs of the Revelation in melodies that no soul can comprehend except those who are detached, for they were expressed in hidden symbols and subtle allusions. Those very passages have been recorded by the Pen of everlasting glory in Persian treatises. Look at them, that perhaps you may discover. In these circumstances, if this community too were to offer the excuse, “Our minds and understanding were incapable of recognizing these difficult, cryptic words,” some people might accept it.

62

و هم‌چنین در فرقان که همهٴ شما دیده‌اید که در علایم ظهور بعد بچه شأن و بیان از سماء سبحان نازل شده مثلاً از جملۀ هل ینظرون الّا ان یأتیهم اللّه فی ظلل من الغمام و هم‌چنین یوم تأتی السّمآء بدخان مبین و هم‌چنین انفطار سماء و انشقاق ارض و اندکاک جبال و انسجار بحار و اقامهٴ اموات از قبور و دمیدن در صور و اشراق شمس عن جهة الغرب و ارتفاع صیحة بین السّموات و الأرض و امثال این کلمات که در کتاب اللّه مذکور است

Va ham-chunīn dar Furqān kih hamih-yi shumā dīdih-īd kih dar ʿalāʾim-i ẓuhūr-i baʿd bi-chih shaʾn va bayān az samāʾ-i Subḥān nāzil shudih mathalan az jumlih hal yanẓurūna illā an yaʾtiyahumu Allāhu fī ẓulalin min al-ghamām va ham-chunīn yawma taʾtī al-samāʾu bi-dukhānin mubīn va ham-chunīn infiṭār-i samāʾ va inshiqāq-i arḍ va indikāk-i jibāl va insijār-i biḥār va iqāmih-yi amvāt az qubūr va damīdan dar ṣūr va ishrāq-i shams ʿan jihati al-gharb va irtifāʿ-i ṣayḥih bayna al-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ va amthāl-i īn kalimāt kih dar Kitāb Allāh madhkūr ast

Likewise, in the Qurʾān, all of you have seen in what manner and language the signs of the subsequent Revelation have been sent down from the heaven of the All-Glorious. Among them, for example, are: “Do they await anything but that God should come to them in canopies of cloud?” and likewise, “The day when heaven brings forth manifest smoke”; and likewise the rending of heaven, the splitting of the earth, the crushing of the mountains, the kindling of the seas, the raising of the dead from their graves, the blowing of the trumpet, the rising of the sun from the west, the sounding of a cry between the heavens and the earth, and similar expressions recorded in the Book of God.

63

و هم‌چنین از ذکر خاتم النّبیّین [ص] که اصرح کلمات فرقانیّه است با این عبارات صعبهٴ مستصعبه و اشارات دقیقهٴ خفیّه اگر عباد از شریعهٴ ربّ الایجاد و عرفان نفس او فی المعاد محروم مانند میتوان گفت که ادراک بیانات الهیّه ننموده‌اند و از معانی کلمات ربّانیّه غافل شده‌اند چه که بفهم عباد نزدیک نبوده اگرچه جمیع این معاذیر در حین ظهور غیر مقبول بوده و خواهد بود چه که در هر ظهور بنفس ظهور و بما یظهر من عنده حجّت بر کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض بالغ میشود

Va ham-chunīn az dhikr-i Khātam al-Nabiyyīn [ṣ] kih aṣraḥ-i kalimāt-i furqāniyyih ast bā īn ʿibārāt-i ṣaʿbih-yi mustaṣʿabih va ishārāt-i daqīqih-yi khafiyyih agar ʿibād az sharīʿih-yi Rabb al-Ījād va ʿirfān-i nafs-i ū fī al-maʿād maḥrūm mānand mītavān guft kih idrāk-i bayānāt-i ilāhiyyih nanamūdih-and va az maʿānī-yi kalimāt-i rabbāniyyih ghāfil shudih-and chih kih bi-fahm-i ʿibād nazdīk nabūdih agarchih jamīʿ-i īn maʿādhīr dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr ghayr-i maqbūl būdih va khvāhad būd chih kih dar har ẓuhūr bi-nafs-i ẓuhūr va bi-mā yaẓharu min ʿindihi ḥujjat bar kulli man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ bāligh mīshavad

Likewise, there is the mention of the Seal of the Prophets [God bless him], which is among the most explicit expressions of the Qurʾān. With these exceedingly difficult passages and subtle, hidden allusions, if people remain deprived of the life-giving waters of the Lord of creation and of recognizing His own Self at the Return, it can be said that they have not comprehended the divine utterances and have remained unaware of the meanings of the words of the Lord, for these were not readily accessible to human understanding. Nevertheless, all such excuses have always been, and will always be, unacceptable at the time of Revelation, for in every Revelation the proof is made conclusive for all who are in the heavens and on earth through the Revelation itself and through what appears from Him.

64

و بر هر نفسی لازم است که مرآت قلب را از کلّ آنچه در دست ناس بوده طاهر نماید و بعد از تطهیر و اقبال البتّه انوار شمس مجلّی بر قلبش تجلّی فرماید و اگر حجّت الهی در احیان ظهور بالغ نباشد تکلیف از کلّ ساقط میگردد مثلاً در اهل فرقان ملاحظه نما که هر نفسی که قلب را از اشارات کلماتیّه مطهّر ننمود بعرفان نقطهٴ بیان فایز نشد چه که ذکر ختمیّت که در کتاب مذکور است از کلمات محکمهٴ فرقان بوده با اثبات این کلمه و تحقّق معنی ظاهر آن در قلب هرگز اقرار ننماید باینکه نبیّ از اوّل لا اوّل بوده و الی آخر لا آخر خواهد آمد چنانچه در بیان مذکور است طهّروا قلوبکم عمّا شهدتم لتشهدوا ما لا شهد احد من العالمین

Va bar har nafsī lāzim ast kih mirʾāt-i qalb rā az kull-i ānchih dar dast-i nās būdih ṭāhir namāyad va baʿd az taṭhīr va iqbāl al-battih anvār-i shams-i mujallī bar qalbash tajallī farmāyad va agar ḥujjat-i ilāhī dar aḥyān-i ẓuhūr bāligh nabāshad taklīf az kull sāqiṭ mīgardad mathalan dar ahl-i Furqān mulāḥiẓih namā kih har nafsī kih qalb rā az ishārāt-i kalimātiyyih muṭahhar nanamūd bi-ʿirfān-i Nuqṭih-yi Bayān fāʾiz nashud chih kih dhikr-i khatmiyyat kih dar kitāb madhkūr ast az kalimāt-i muḥkamih-yi Furqān būdih bā ithbāt-i īn kalimih va taḥaqquq-i maʿnī-yi ẓāhir-i ān dar qalb hargiz iqrār nanamāyad bi-īnkih nabī az avval-i lā avval būdih va ilā ākhir-i lā ākhir khvāhad āmad chunānchih dar Bayān madhkūr ast ṭahhirū qulūbakum ʿammā shahidtum li-tashhadū mā lā shahida aḥadun min al-ʿālamīn

Every soul must purify the mirror of the heart of all that people possess. After this purification and turning toward Him, the rays of the effulgent Sun will assuredly shine upon that heart. If God’s proof were not conclusive at the times of Revelation, all would be absolved of obligation. Consider, for example, the people of the Qurʾān: whoever did not purify the heart of verbal allusions failed to attain recognition of the Point of the Bayān. For the mention of finality recorded in the Book was among the unequivocal statements of the Qurʾān. With this statement affirmed and its outward meaning established in the heart, a person will never acknowledge that Prophets have existed from the beginning that has no beginning and will continue to come until the end that has no end. Thus it is stated in the Bayān: “Purify your hearts of all that you have witnessed, so that you may witness what no one in all the worlds has witnessed.”

65

در حین ظهور باید چشم از کلّ برداشت و بطرف اللّه ناظر شد که من دون ذلک لن یفوز احد باللّه العلیّ العظیم ای بندگان هوی بشنوید نغمات قدس بقا را و بمقرّ اعرفوا اللّه باللّه بشتابید و از دونش منقطع شوید این بیانات انبیا که در علامات ظهور فرموده‌اند

Dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr bāyad chashm az kull bardāsht va bi-ṭaraf Allāh nāẓir shud kih min dūni dhālika lan yafūza aḥadun bi-Allāhi al-ʿAliyyi al-ʿAẓīm ay bandigān-i havā bishnavīd naghamāt-i quds-i baqā rā va bi-maqarr-i iʿrifū Allāha bi-Allāh bishtābīd va az dūnash munqaṭiʿ shavīd īn bayānāt-i anbiyā kih dar ʿalāmāt-i ẓuhūr farmūdih-and

At the time of Revelation, one must turn one’s eyes away from everything and look toward God, for otherwise no one will attain God, the Most High, the Most Great. O servants of desire! Hear the melodies of everlasting holiness, hasten to the abode of “Recognize God through God,” and detach yourselves from all besides Him. These utterances of the Prophets concerning the signs of the Revelation

66

و امّا نقطهٴ بیان روح من فی لجج الأسمآء فداه جمیع این بیانات را مرتفع فرموده و حجبات را بالمرّه خرق نموده و جمیع این کلمات معضله را بنفس ظهور و ما یظهر من عنده تمام نموده‌اند و معنی فرموده‌اند و بشأنی ذکر این ظهور عزّ احدیّه را فرموده که برای احدی مجال توقّف نمانده تا چه رسد باعراض و جمیع بیان و ما نزّل فیه را منوط بعرفان آن شمس عزّ باقیه فرموده و میفرمایند که مباد در حین ظهور به بیان از منزل آن محتجب مانند و بکلمات آن تمسّک جسته از سلطان احدیّه محروم مانید و مخصوص میفرمایند ای حروفات و مرایا شما بقول من حجّت شده‌اید مبادا در حین ظهور بر جمال مختار استکبار نمائید

Va ammā Noqṭe-ye Bayān, rūḥu man fī lujaji al-asmāʾ fidāhu, jamīʿ-e īn bayānāt rā mortafeʿ farmūde va ḥojobāt rā bel-marre kharq namūde va jamīʿ-e īn kalemāt-e moʿḍele rā be-nafs-e ẓohūr va mā yaẓharu min ʿindihi tamām namūde-and va maʿnī farmūde-and va be-shaʾnī dhekr-e īn ẓohūr-e ʿezz-e aḥadiyye rā farmūde ke barā-ye aḥadī majāl-e tavaqqof namānde tā che resad be-eʿrāḍ, va jamīʿ-e Bayān va mā nuzzila fīhi rā manūṭ be-ʿerfān-e ān shams-e ʿezz-e bāqiye farmūde va mīfarmāyand ke mabād dar ḥīn-e ẓohūr be-Bayān az monzel-e ān moḥtajeb mānand va be-kalemāt-e ān tamassok joste az solṭān-e aḥadiyye maḥrūm mānīd va makhṣūṣ mīfarmāyand: Ey ḥorūfāt va marāyā, shomā be-qawl-e man ḥojjat shode-īd, mabādā dar ḥīn-e ẓohūr bar jamāl-e mokhtār estekbār namāyīd.

As for the Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all who dwell in the surging seas of names be sacrificed for Him—He has set aside all these statements, utterly torn through the veils, and brought all these difficult expressions to their fulfillment and explained their meaning through the Manifestation Himself and whatever proceeds from Him. He has spoken of this Revelation of the glory of divine unity in such a way that no one has any room to hesitate, much less to turn away. He has made the whole Bayān and all that was revealed in it dependent upon recognition of that Sun of everlasting glory. He says that, at the time of the Revelation, they must not let the Bayān veil them from its Revealer, and that you must not cling to its words and remain deprived of the Sovereign of oneness. He specifically says: “O Letters and Mirrors! You have become proofs through My word. Beware lest, at the time of the Revelation, you act arrogantly toward the sovereign Beauty.”

67

و با آنکه در مستغاث اشراق شمس حقیقت را باسم من یظهر عزّ اسمه وعده فرموده‌اند مع‌ذلک میفرمایند که اگر در ساعت دیگر ظاهر شود احدی را نمیرسد که لم او بم بگوید چه که آن سلطان امکان لم‌یزل مختار بوده و خواهد بود و اگر احدی بغیر آنچه ذکر شده قائل شود حقّ جلّ ذکره را مختار ندانسته پناه میبریم بحقّ از چنین توهّمات باطله و جمیع حدود و حجب و اشاره را از این مقام برداشته‌اند و آن جمال قدم ازلاً و ابداً مقدّس از حدود و اشارهٴ دون خود بوده و احدی بر کیفیّت ظهور اطّلاع نداشته و ندارد لن یحیط بعلمه احد و انّه بکلّ شیء علیم

Va bā ānke dar Mostaghāth eshrāq-e shams-e ḥaqīqat rā be-esm-e Man Yaẓhar, ʿazza ismuhu, vaʿde farmūde-and, maʿa-dhālek mīfarmāyand ke agar dar sāʿat-e dīgar ẓāher shavad aḥadī rā nemīrasad ke lima aw bima begūyad, che ke ān solṭān-e emkān lam-yazal mokhtār būde va khvāhad būd va agar aḥadī be-gheyr-e ānche dhekr shode qāʾel shavad Ḥaqq, jalla dhikruhu, rā mokhtār nadāneste. Panāh mībarīm be-Ḥaqq az chonīn tavahhomāt-e bāṭele. Va jamīʿ-e ḥodūd va ḥojob va eshāre rā az īn maqām bardāshte-and va ān Jamāl-e Qedam azalan va abadan moqaddas az ḥodūd va eshāre-ye dūn-e khod būde va aḥadī bar keyfiyyat-e ẓohūr eṭṭelāʿ nadāshte va nadārad. Lan yuḥīṭa bi-ʿilmihi aḥadun wa-innahu bi-kulli shayʾin ʿalīm.

Although He has promised that the Sun of Truth will shine forth in Mustaghāth under the name of Him Who Will Appear—exalted be His name—He nevertheless says that, should He appear in the next hour, no one has the right to ask “Why?” or “By what means?” For that Sovereign of existence has always been, and will always be, free to choose. Anyone who maintains anything other than what has been stated has not acknowledged the freedom of God—exalted be His mention—to choose. We seek refuge in God from such vain imaginings. He has removed all limitations, veils, and allusions from this station. That Ancient Beauty has, from eternity and forever, been sanctified above the limitations and allusions of anyone other than Himself. No one has ever known, or now knows, the manner of His manifestation. No one will encompass His knowledge, and He knows all things.

68

و میفرمایند من اوّل ما یطلع شمس البهآء الی ان یغرب خیر فی کتاب اللّه عن کلّ اللّیل ان انتم تدرکون ما خلق اللّه من شیء الّا لیومئذ اذ کلّ للقآء اللّه ثمّ رضائه یعملون و در این مقام میفرمایند و لقد قرب الزّوال و انّکم انتم ذلک الیوم لا تعرفون و من یکن لقائه ذات لقائی لا ترضوا له ما لا یرضی نفس لنفس الی آخر قوله عزّ و جلّ ای سمع امکان صاحب سمعی مشهود نه تو بشنو کلمات بالغهٴ ربّانیّه را که تصریحاً من غیر تأویل اخبار فرموده در آن ایّام که شمس طالع است و نزدیک است در وسط زوال اشراق فرماید ولکن شما ای ملأ بیان آن یوم عارف بآن جمال سبحان نخواهید شد و تصریح باین اسم هم فرموده‌اند بقوله عزّ و جلّ من اوّل ما تطلع شمس البهآء الی ان یغرب خیر فی کتاب اللّه الی آخر بیانه جلّ و عزّ که احدی شبهه ننماید و بدون ما قضی اللّه تفسیر ننماید مع‌ذلک کلّ بحجبات نفس و هوی از ادراک شمس بها محتجب مانده‌اند و به ما امرهم الشّیطان متمسّک و کاش باحتجاب کفایت مینمودند بلکه بعضی بتحریف این کلمات مظهر اسماء و صفات مشغول شده‌اند و این ظلمی است که در ابداع فوق آن ظاهر نشده فویل للظّالمین من عذاب یوم عظیم

Va mīfarmāyand: Min awwali mā yaṭluʿu shamsu al-Bahāʾ ilā an yaghruba khayrun fī kitābi Allāh ʿan kulli al-layl in antum tudrikūn. Mā khalaqa Allāhu min shayʾin illā li-yawmiʾidh idh kullun li-liqāʾi Allāh thumma riḍāʾihi yaʿmalūn. Va dar īn maqām mīfarmāyand: Wa-laqad qaruba al-zawāl wa-innakum antum dhālika al-yawma lā taʿrifūn. Wa-man yakun liqāʾuhu dhāta liqāʾī lā tarḍaw lahu mā lā yarḍā nafsun li-nafs. Ilā ākhiri qawlihi ʿazza wa-jalla. Ey samʿ-e emkān, ṣāḥeb-e samʿī mashhūd na, to beshnow kalemāt-e bāleghe-ye rabbāniyye rā ke taṣrīḥan min ghayri taʾwīl ekhbār farmūde dar ān ayyām ke shams ṭāleʿ ast va nazdīk ast dar vasaṭ-e zavāl eshrāq farmāyad va-lāken shomā ey malaʾ-e Bayān ān yowm ʿāref be-ān jamāl-e sobḥān nakhvāhīd shod va taṣrīḥ be-īn esm ham farmūde-and bi-qawlihi ʿazza wa-jalla: Min awwali mā taṭluʿu shamsu al-Bahāʾ ilā an yaghruba khayrun fī kitābi Allāh. Ilā ākhiri bayānihi jalla wa-ʿazza. Ke aḥadī shobhe nanamāyad va be-dūn-e mā qaḍā Allāh tafsīr nanamāyad. Maʿa-dhālek koll be-ḥojobāt-e nafs va havā az edrāk-e Shams-e Bahā moḥtajeb mānde-and va be-mā amarahumu al-shayṭān motamassek va kāsh be-eḥtejāb kefāyat mīnamūdand balke baʿḍī be-taḥrīf-e īn kalemāt-e maẓhar-e asmāʾ va ṣefāt mashghūl shode-and va īn ẓolmī ast ke dar ebdāʿ fowq-e ān ẓāher nashode. Fa-waylun li-l-ẓālimīn min ʿadhābi yawmin ʿaẓīm.

He also says: “From the moment the Sun of Bahāʾ rises until it sets is better, in the Book of God, than all the night, if you understand. God has created nothing except for that Day, for all labor to attain the presence of God and then His good pleasure.” In this connection He says: “Noon has indeed drawn near, yet you do not recognize that Day. As for Him whose presence is My very presence, do not wish for Him what no soul wishes for itself”—to the end of His words, exalted and glorious is He. O ear of existence! No one possessed of hearing is to be seen; you, then, hear these conclusive divine words. In those days He explicitly announced, without recourse to interpretation, that the Sun had risen and was about to shine at the height of noon, yet that you, O people of the Bayān, would not recognize that all-glorious Beauty on that Day. He also explicitly stated this name in His words, exalted and glorious is He: “From the moment the Sun of Bahāʾ rises until it sets is better, in the Book of God”—to the end of His utterance, glorious and exalted is He—so that no one should entertain any doubt or interpret it otherwise than God has decreed. Nevertheless, all have remained veiled by self and desire from recognizing the Sun of Bahāʾ and have clung to what Satan has commanded them. If only they had been content to remain veiled! Rather, some have occupied themselves with distorting these words of the Manifestation of the names and attributes. This is an injustice greater than any that has appeared in creation. Woe, then, to the wrongdoers, because of the punishment of a tremendous Day!

69

و بعد از ظهور این شمس عزّ صمدانی بعضی از مرایا توهّم نموده‌اند و رتبهٴ شمسی ادّعا نموده‌اند ولکن غافل از اینکه در بیان فارسی نصّ فرموده‌اند که اگر مرآت ادّعای شمسی نماید نزد شمس ظاهر است که شبح او است که او میگوید و هم‌چنین میفرماید مرایا بنفسها شیئیّت ندارند و در مقام دیگر میفرماید قل ان یا شموس المرایا انتم الی شمس الحقیقة تنظرون و انّ قیامکم بها لو انتم تتبصّرون کلّکم کحیتان بالمآء فی البحر تتحرّکون و تحتجبون عن المآء و تسألون عمّا انتم به قائمون حال ملاحظه نمائید که بشموس مرایا که مرایای اوّلیّه‌اند میفرماید که شما بشمس حقیقت ناظر باشید چه که وجود و ظهور شما بعنایت او بوده و خواهد بود و میفرمایند شموس مرایا مثل حیتان در آبند که در بحر حرکت میکنند ولکن از بحر و ماء محتجبند چنانچه الیوم ملاحظه میشود که مرآت قوم در بحر آیات حرکت مینماید چنانچه بآیات عزّ صمدانی که از ظهور قبلم نازل شده اثبات خود مینماید و حرکت و اظهار شأن او از آیات اللّه بوده و مع‌ذلک از جوهر آیات و منزل آن در این ایّام بالمرّه محتجب مانده در بحر حرکت مینماید و از سلطان بحر غافل و این بیان در رتبهٴ شموس مرایا از ملکوت بقا نازل تا چه رسد بمرایائی که در تحت این شموس واقعند

Va baʿd az ẓohūr-e īn shams-e ʿezz-e ṣamadānī baʿḍī az marāyā tavahhom namūde-and va rotbe-ye shamsī eddeʿā namūde-and va-lāken ghāfel az īnke dar Bayān-e Fārsī naṣṣ farmūde-and ke agar merʾāt eddeʿā-ye shamsī namāyad nazd-e shams ẓāher ast ke shabaḥ-e ū ast ke ū mīgūyad va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad marāyā be-nafsehā shayʾiyyat nadārand va dar maqām-e dīgar mīfarmāyad: Qul in yā shumūsa al-marāyā antum ilā shamsi al-ḥaqīqa tanẓurūn wa-inna qiyāmakum bihā law antum tatabaṣṣarūn. Kullukum ka-ḥītānin bi-l-māʾi fī al-baḥri tataḥarrakūn wa-taḥtajibūna ʿani al-māʾi wa-tasʾalūna ʿammā antum bihi qāʾimūn. Ḥāl molāḥeẓe namāyīd ke be-shomūs-e marāyā ke marāyā-ye avvaliyye-and mīfarmāyad ke shomā be-shams-e ḥaqīqat nāẓer bāshīd che ke vojūd va ẓohūr-e shomā be-ʿenāyat-e ū būde va khvāhad būd va mīfarmāyand shomūs-e marāyā mesl-e ḥītān dar āband ke dar baḥr ḥarekat mīkonand va-lāken az baḥr va māʾ moḥtajeband chenānche al-yowm molāḥeẓe mīshavad ke merʾāt-e qowm dar baḥr-e āyāt ḥarekat mīnamāyad chenānche be-āyāt-e ʿezz-e ṣamadānī ke az ẓohūr-e qablam nāzel shode ethbāt-e khod mīnamāyad va ḥarekat va eẓhār-e shaʾn-e ū az āyāt-e Allāh būde va maʿa-dhālek az jowhar-e āyāt va monzel-e ān dar īn ayyām bel-marre moḥtajeb mānde dar baḥr ḥarekat mīnamāyad va az solṭān-e baḥr ghāfel va īn bayān dar rotbe-ye shomūs-e marāyā az malakūt-e baqā nāzel tā che resad be-marāyāʾī ke dar taḥt-e īn shomūs vāqeʿand.

After the appearance of this Sun of eternal glory, some of the Mirrors have indulged in vain imaginings and claimed the rank of a sun. Yet they are heedless that He has explicitly stated in the Persian Bayān that, if a mirror claims to be a sun, it is clear to the sun that it is its own reflected image that is speaking. He likewise says that mirrors have no existence in themselves. Elsewhere He says: “Say: O suns of the mirrors! You look toward the Sun of Truth, and your existence depends upon it, if only you perceive. You are all like fish moving through the water in the sea, yet you are veiled from the water and ask about that through which you subsist.” Now consider how He tells the suns of the mirrors, who are the foremost Mirrors, to look toward the Sun of Truth, for their existence and manifestation have depended, and will depend, upon His favor. He says that the suns of the mirrors are like fish in the water that move through the sea but are veiled from the sea and its water. Today, likewise, it can be seen that the Mirror of the people moves in the ocean of verses, for he establishes his own claim through the verses of eternal glory revealed by My previous Manifestation. His movement and the display of his station have derived from the verses of God. Nevertheless, in these days he has remained utterly veiled from the Essence of the verses and their Revealer. He moves in the sea but is heedless of the Sovereign of the sea. This utterance concerning the rank of the suns of the mirrors has descended from the Kingdom of eternity; how much more does it apply to the mirrors that stand beneath these suns!

70

و هم‌چنین میفرماید فانّ یوم ظهوره اعلی الخلق مثل ادناه و انّ اقربکم من یؤمن به و لا انساب بینکم و لا افتخار الّا بایمانکم به اینست که الیوم مشاهده میشود که اعلای خلق از ادنی بین یدی اللّه مذکور چه ‌قدر از مظاهر علّیّین که بسجّین راجع شده‌اند و چه مقدار از مطالع لا که بمقرّ مطهّر الّا وارد شده و هم‌چنین بجناب آقا سیّد جواد میفرماید لأشکونّ الیک ان یا مرآة جودی عن کلّ المرایا کلّ بألوانهم الیّ لینظرون ملاحظه نمائید که از مرایا کلّها شکایت میفرمایند ولکن هذا الجمال یشکو حینئذ عن الّذی اشتهر بالمرآة لأنّه ینظر الیّ بما عنده لا بما عندی

Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad: Fa-inna yawma ẓuhūrihi aʿlā al-khalqi mithlu adnāhu wa-inna aqrabakum man yuʾminu bihi wa-lā ansāba baynakum wa-lā iftikhāra illā bi-īmānikum bihi. Īnast ke al-yowm moshāhede mīshavad ke aʿlā-ye khalq az adnā bayna yaday Allāh madhkūr. Che qadr az maẓāher-e ʿelliyyīn ke be-sejjīn rājeʿ shode-and va che meqdār az maṭāleʿ-e lā ke be-maqarr-e moṭahhar-e illā vāred shode va hamchenīn be-janāb-e Āqā Seyyed Javād mīfarmāyad: La-ashkuwanna ilayka in yā mirʾāta jūdī ʿan kulli al-marāyā, kullun bi-alwānihim ilayya la-yanẓurūn. Molāḥeẓe namāyīd ke az marāyā kollahā shekāyat mīfarmāyand va-lāken hādhā al-jamālu yashkū ḥīnaʾidhin ʿani alladhī ishtahara bi-l-mirʾāti li-annahu yanẓuru ilayya bi-mā ʿindahu lā bi-mā ʿindī.

He likewise says: “On the day of His appearance, the highest of creation is like the lowest, and the nearest among you is whoever believes in Him. There are no ties of kinship among you, nor any cause for pride except your faith in Him.” Thus today it is seen that the highest of creation is accounted among the lowest before God. How many manifestations of the highest heaven have returned to the lowest depths, and how many dawning-places of negation have entered the sanctified abode of affirmation! He likewise says to Āqā Siyyid Javād: “I will surely complain to you, O mirror of My bounty, of all the mirrors: they all look toward Me through their own colors.” Consider how He complains of all the mirrors. This Beauty, however, now complains of the one who has become known as the Mirror, for he looks toward Me through what he possesses, not through what I possess.

71

باری الیوم اگر جمیع مرایا باسم الوهیّت و ربوبیّت و فوق آن بنفس اللّه و ظهور اللّه و یا ذات اللّه در بیان موسوم باشند کفایت نمینماید مادام که باین ظهور قدس ربّانی و بطون غیب صمدانی موقن نشوند جمیع معدوم صرف و مفقود بحت عنداللّه محسوبند چنانچه در ابتدای این الواح من قلم اللّه ثبت شده که فرموده ایّاک ایّاک یوم ظهوره ان تحتجب بالواحد البیانیّة فانّ ذلک الواحد خلق عنده و ایّاک ایّاک ان تحتجب بکلمات ما نزّلت فی البیان فانّها کلمات نفسه فی هیکل ظهوره من قبل تحذیر میفرماید که در حین ظهور مباد بواحد بیان از مظهر امر محتجب مانی و این واحد نفوسی بوده‌اند که بعد از نقطهٴ بیان احدی بر آن نفوس مقدّم نبوده مع‌ذلک میفرماید که باین نفوس از حقّ محتجب نمانید و از این بیان مفهوم میشود که در ظهور بعد بعضی از این حروفات باید موجود باشند و میفرماید که بآنچه در بیان نازل شده از حقّ محتجب نمانید

Bārī al-yowm agar jamīʿ-e marāyā be-esm-e olūhiyyat va robūbiyyat va fowq-e ān be-Nafs-e Allāh va Ẓohūr-e Allāh va yā Dhāt-e Allāh dar Bayān mowsūm bāshand kefāyat nemīnamāyad mādām ke be-īn ẓohūr-e qods-e rabbānī va boṭūn-e ghayb-e ṣamadānī mūqen nashavand jamīʿ maʿdūm-e ṣerf va mafqūd-e baḥt ʿinda Allāh maḥsūband chenānche dar ebtedā-ye īn alvāḥ min qalami Allāh thabt shode ke farmūde: Iyyāka iyyāka yawma ẓuhūrihi an taḥtajiba bi-l-wāḥidi al-bayāniyya fa-inna dhālika al-wāḥida khalqun ʿindahu wa-iyyāka iyyāka an taḥtajiba bi-kalimāti mā nuzzilat fī al-Bayān fa-innahā kalimātu nafsihi fī haykali ẓuhūrihi min qabl. Taḥdhīr mīfarmāyad ke dar ḥīn-e ẓohūr mabād be-Vāḥed-e Bayān az maẓhar-e amr moḥtajeb mānī va īn Vāḥed nofūsī būde-and ke baʿd az Noqṭe-ye Bayān aḥadī bar ān nofūs moqaddam nabūde maʿa-dhālek mīfarmāyad ke be-īn nofūs az Ḥaqq moḥtajeb namānīd va az īn bayān mafhūm mīshavad ke dar ẓohūr-e baʿd baʿḍī az īn ḥorūfāt bāyad mowjūd bāshand va mīfarmāyad ke be-ānche dar Bayān nāzel shode az Ḥaqq moḥtajeb namānīd.

In short, even if all the Mirrors are designated in the Bayān by the names of divinity and lordship, and beyond these as the Self of God, the Manifestation of God, or the Essence of God, this does not suffice today. Until they attain certainty in this Revelation of divine holiness and this inward concealment of the eternal Unseen, they are all accounted as sheer nothingness and utter nonexistence before God. Thus, at the beginning of these Tablets, it has been recorded from the Pen of God that He said: “Beware, beware lest, on the day of His appearance, you be veiled by the Vāḥid of the Bayān, for that Vāḥid is but a creature in His sight. Beware, beware lest you be veiled by the words revealed in the Bayān, for they are His own words in the temple of His previous Manifestation.” He warns you not to let the Vāḥid of the Bayān veil you from the Manifestation of the Cause at the time of His appearance. This Vāḥid consisted of souls whom no one preceded in rank after the Point of the Bayān. Nevertheless, He says that you must not let these souls veil you from God. From this utterance it is understood that some of these Letters must be present in the subsequent Revelation. He also says that you must not let what has been revealed in the Bayān veil you from God.

72

حال انصاف دهید ای اهل بیان با این بیان اصرح اتمّ کسی میتواند الیوم معارضه نماید با نفس ظهور که فلان در بیان باسم اللّه مذکور است چگونه میشود الیوم از مقام خود سلب شود لا فوالّذی ایّد الرّوح بنفسی چه که این اسامی و اذکار و توصیف بر فرض تسلیم کلّ کلماتی است که در بیان مسطور است و از جمله وصایای سلطان لایزالی اینست که بآنچه در بیان نازل شده از ظهور اللّه محتجب نشوید

Ḥāl enṣāf dehīd ey ahl-e Bayān bā īn bayān-e aṣraḥ-e atamm kasī mītavānad al-yowm moʿāreḍe namāyad bā nafs-e ẓohūr ke folān dar Bayān be-esm-e Allāh madhkūr ast chegūne mīshavad al-yowm az maqām-e khod salb shavad? Lā fa-wa-alladhī ayy ada al-Rūḥa bi-nafsī. Che ke īn asāmī va adhkār va towṣīf bar farḍ-e taslīm koll kalemātī ast ke dar Bayān masṭūr ast va az jomle vaṣāyā-ye solṭān-e lā-yazālī īnast ke be-ānche dar Bayān nāzel shode az Ẓohūr-e Allāh moḥtajeb nashavīd.

Now judge fairly, O people of the Bayān: in the face of this most explicit and complete statement, can anyone today oppose the Manifestation Himself, saying, “So-and-so is mentioned in the Bayān by the name of God; how can he now be stripped of his station?” No, by Him who strengthened the Spirit through My Self! For these names, mentions, and descriptions, even if all are conceded, are words inscribed in the Bayān. Among the counsels of the everlasting Sovereign is this: do not let what has been revealed in the Bayān veil you from the Manifestation of God.

73

و علاوه بر این قَسَم بشمس عزّ صمدانی که الیوم از افق قدس ربّانی اشراق فرموده که ذکر آن سلطان قدم خلق بیان را باسم ربوبیّت و یا عبودیّت هر دو در آن ساحت یکسان است و در سنگ که جماد است و حروف ثلاثهٴ آن سه اسم اعظم الهی را ذکر فرموده‌اند و متنبّه نموده عباد را که در ملاحظهٴ آن باین اسماء ناظر باشند تا در مصنوع آیات صانع مشاهده شود و مقتدری که این مراتب را بحجر عنایت فرموده اگر اخذ نماید لایق است نفسی را که اعتراض نماید تاللّه لن یعترض احد علی امر اللّه الّا کلّ معتد اثیم اگر ناس از بعث اسماء مطّلع میبودند هرگز بسلطان یفعل ما یشآء در هیچ امری اعتراض نمینمودند

Va ʿalāve bar īn qasam be-shams-e ʿezz-e ṣamadānī ke al-yowm az ofoq-e qods-e rabbānī eshrāq farmūde ke dhekr-e ān solṭān-e qedam khalq-e Bayān rā be-esm-e robūbiyyat va yā ʿobūdiyyat har do dar ān sāḥat yeksān ast va dar sang ke jamād ast va ḥorūf-e thalāthe-ye ān se esm-e aʿẓam-e elāhī rā dhekr farmūde-and va motanabbeh namūde ʿebād rā ke dar molāḥeẓe-ye ān be-īn asmāʾ nāẓer bāshand tā dar maṣnūʿ āyāt-e ṣāneʿ moshāhede shavad va moqtaderī ke īn marāteb rā be-ḥajar ʿenāyat farmūde agar akhdh namāyad lāyeq ast nafsī rā ke eʿterāḍ namāyad? Ta-Allāh lan yaʿtariḍa aḥadun ʿalā amri Allāh illā kullu muʿtadin athīm. Agar nās az baʿth-e asmāʾ moṭṭaleʿ mībūdand harg ez be-solṭān-e yafʿalu mā yashāʾ dar hīch amrī eʿterāḍ nemīnamūdand.

Moreover, I swear by the Sun of eternal glory that has today shone from the horizon of divine holiness: whether that Ancient Sovereign refers to the creatures of the Bayān by the name of lordship or of servitude, both are alike in that court. In the stone, which is inanimate, and in the three letters of its name, He has mentioned three supreme divine names. He has instructed His servants to look to these names when contemplating it, so that the signs of the Maker may be seen in what is made. If the Almighty who has bestowed these ranks upon a stone should take them away, is it fitting for any soul to object? By God, none will object to the Cause of God except a sinful transgressor. Had people known of the raising up of names, they would never have objected in any matter to the Sovereign who does whatever He wills.

74

اینست که بعضی از ناس اسماً مبعوث میشوند و در ملکوت اسماء معروف ولکن کینونتشان ابداً از سجّین نفس و هوی عروج ننموده لحکمة لا یعلمها الّا اللّه و ربّ شهرة لا اصل لها و بعضی بکینونت مبعوث شده من‌دون اسم چنانچه حکایت خضر را استماع نموده که احدی در آن زمان بر علوّ مقام او مطّلع نه الّا اللّه چنانچه امرش از موسی مع علوّ مقامه و سموّ قدره مستور بوده و بعد از حضور در خدمتش بخطاب انّک لن تستطع معی صبراً مخاطب شده و اگرچه در کتاب باسم خضر مذکور شده ولکن ما عرفه احد الّا اللّه و عندنا علمه فی کتاب مبین و بعضی بکینونت و ذات و نفس و روح و اسم مبعوث میشوند اذاً فاشهد و قل سبحان اللّه احسن المبدعین و اگر مراتب بعث بتمامه ذکر شود ملاحظه میشد که این مفتخرین باسماء در چه مقام و رتبه مذکورند ولکن امسکنا القلم الی ان یشآء اللّه و انّه مبیّن کلّ امر فی کتاب مبین

Īnast ke baʿḍī az nās esman mabʿūth mīshavand va dar malakūt-e asmāʾ maʿrūf va-lāken kaynūnatashān abadan az sejjīn-e nafs va havā ʿorūj nanamūde li-ḥikmatin lā yaʿlamuhā illā Allāh wa-rubba shuhratin lā aṣla lahā va baʿḍī be-kaynūnat mabʿūth shode min dūni ism chenānche ḥekāyat-e Kheḍr rā estemāʿ namūde ke aḥadī dar ān zamān bar ʿolovv-e maqām-e ū moṭṭaleʿ na illā Allāh chenānche amrash az Mūsā maʿa ʿuluwwi maqāmihi wa-sumūwi qadrihi mastūr būde va baʿd az ḥoḍūr dar khedmatash be-kheṭāb-e innaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿiya ṣabran mokhāṭab shode va agarche dar ketāb be-esm-e Kheḍr madhkūr shode va-lāken mā ʿarafahu aḥadun illā Allāh wa-ʿindanā ʿilmuhu fī kitābin mubīn va baʿḍī be-kaynūnat va dhāt va nafs va rūḥ va esm mabʿūth mīshavand idhan fa-shhad wa-qul subḥāna Allāhi aḥsani al-mubdiʿīn va agar marāteb-e baʿth be-tamāme dhekr shavad molāḥeẓe mīshod ke īn moftakherīn be-asmāʾ dar che maqām va rotbe madhkūrand va-lāken amsaknā al-qalama ilā an yashāʾa Allāh wa-innahu mubayyinu kulli amrin fī kitābin mubīn.

Thus some people are raised up in name and are renowned in the kingdom of names, yet their being has never ascended from the prison of self and desire, for a wisdom known to God alone. Many a reputation has no foundation. Others are raised up in their being, without a name, as you have heard in the account of Khiḍr: no one at that time knew the loftiness of his station except God. His reality was hidden even from Moses, despite His lofty station and exalted rank; and after Moses entered his presence, He was addressed with the words, “You will not be able to bear patiently with me.” Although he is mentioned in the Book by the name of Khiḍr, no one has known him except God, and with Us is the knowledge of him in a clear Book. Others are raised up in being, essence, self, spirit, and name. Bear witness, then, and say: “Glory be to God, the best of originators!” Were the degrees of this raising up to be set forth in full, it would be seen what station and rank are assigned to those who pride themselves on names. But We have stayed the Pen until God wills, and He makes every matter clear in a lucid Book.

75

و دیگر آنکه کلّ اشیاء مکمن اسماء الهیّه و مخزن اسرار صنعیّه بوده و هستند و در هر کوری از هر شیء ظاهر میفرماید آنچه را اراده فرماید و اخذ میکند آنچه را بخواهد العجب کلّ العجب الیوم که جمال قدم و شمس اسم اعظم در قطب زوال مشرق و مستضیء شده مع‌ذلک ناس باسمی از اسماء از انوار جمال و عرفان طلعت بی‌مثال ذو الجلال محروم گشته‌اند قل تاللّه الحقّ بارادة من قلمه خلقت بحور الأسمآء و ملکوتها ان انتم من العارفین و لو یأخذ الیوم کفّاً من التّراب و یبعث منه اسم ما کان و ما یکون لیقدر و انّه لهو السّلطان الملک المقتدر العزیز القدیر

Va dīgar ānke koll-e ashyāʾ makman-e asmāʾ-e elāhiyye va makhzan-e asrār-e ṣonʿiyye būde va hastand va dar har kawrī az har shayʾ ẓāher mīfarmāyad ānche rā erāde farmāyad va akhdh mīkonad ānche rā bekhāhad. Al-ʿajab koll al-ʿajab, emrūz ke Jamāl-e Qedam va Shams-e Esm-e Aʿẓam dar qoṭb-e zavāl moshreq va mostaḍīʾ shode maʿa-dhālek nās be-esmī az asmāʾ az anvār-e jamāl va ʿerfān-e ṭalʿat-e bī-methāl-e Dhu’l-Jalāl maḥrūm gashte-and. Qul ta’llāhi al-Ḥaqq bi-irādatin min qalamihi khuliqat biḥāru al-asmāʾ wa malakūtuhā in antum min al-ʿārifīn. Wa law yaʾkhudh al-yawm kaffan min al-turāb wa yabʿath minhu isma mā kāna wa mā yakūn la-yaqdir wa innahu la-huwa al-Sulṭān al-Malik al-Muqtadir al-ʿAzīz al-Qadīr.

Moreover, all things have been and remain the repositories of the divine names and the treasuries of the mysteries of creation. In every dispensation He manifests from each thing whatever He wills and takes away whatever He wishes. How utterly astonishing that today, when the Ancient Beauty and the Sun of the Most Great Name have risen and shine at the zenith, people have nevertheless, because of one of the names, deprived themselves of the light of His beauty and of recognizing the peerless Countenance of the Lord of Glory. Say: By God, the True One! Through an act of will from His Pen, the seas of names and their kingdom were created, if you are among those who recognize the truth. Were He today to take a handful of dust and raise from it the name of all that has been and all that will be, He would indeed have the power. He is indeed the Sovereign, the King, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent.

76

تاللّه اذاً یبکی لنفسی و بما ورد علیّ عیون النّبیّین و المرسلین فی الرّفیق الأعلی و ینوحنّ فی انفسهم و یصحنّ فی کینوناتهم ولکنّ النّاس هم فی غفلة و وهم عظیم و بشأنی اهل بیان تنزّل نموده‌اند که لسان رحمن بذکر امثال این کلمات مشغول شده و مع‌ذلک از او نمی‌پذیرند اینست شأن این قوم و الیوم هر نفسی که از ملکوت اسماء ارتقا نجوید ابداً باین فیض اعظم فایز نشود اینست که نقطهٴ بیان میفرماید که نطفهٴ ظهور بعد اقوی از جمیع اهل بیان بوده و خواهد بود اذاً تفکّروا فی ذلک یا اولی الألباب فوالّذی قام بنفسه که اگر عباد در همین کلمه تأمّل نمایند خود را مستغنی از دون اللّه مشاهده نمایند و در اثبات این امر بدیع بجواب و سؤال محتاج نخواهند بود و اللّه یقول الحقّ ولکنّ النّاس لا یسمعون و

Ta’llāhi idhan yabkī li-nafsī wa bi-mā warada ʿalayya ʿuyūnu al-nabiyyīn wa al-mursalīn fī al-rafīq al-aʿlā wa yanūḥanna fī anfusihim wa yaṣiḥanna fī kaynūnātihim wa lākinna al-nāsa hum fī ghaflatin wa wahmin ʿaẓīm. Va be-shaʾnī ahl-e Bayān tanazzol namūde-and ke lesān-e Raḥmān be-dhekr-e amthāl-e īn kalemāt mashghūl shode va maʿa-dhālek az ū nemīpadhīrand. Īnast shaʾn-e īn qawm va emrūz har nafsī ke az malakūt-e asmāʾ erteqā najūyad abadan be-īn fayḍ-e aʿẓam fāʾez nashavad. Īnast ke Noqṭe-ye Bayān mīfarmāyad ke noṭfe-ye ẓohūr-e baʿd aqvā az jamīʿ-e ahl-e Bayān būde va khāhad būd. Idhan tafakkarū fī dhālika yā ulī al-albāb. Fa-wa’lladhī qāma bi-nafsihi ke agar ʿebād dar hamīn kaleme taʾammol namāyand khod rā mostaghnī az dūn-e Allāh moshāhede namāyand va dar ethbāt-e īn amr-e badīʿ be-javāb va soʾāl moḥtāj nakhāhand būd. Wa Allāhu yaqūlu al-ḥaqq wa lākinna al-nāsa lā yasmaʿūn va

By God! The eyes of the Prophets and Messengers in the exalted company weep for Me and for what has befallen Me; they lament within themselves and cry out in their inmost beings. Yet the people are sunk in heedlessness and grievous delusion. The people of the Bayān have fallen so low that the Tongue of the All-Merciful has occupied itself with such words as these, and still they will not accept them from Him. Such is the state of this people. Today, whoever does not ascend beyond the kingdom of names will never attain this most great outpouring of grace. Thus the Point of the Bayān states that the embryo of the next Manifestation has been and will remain mightier than all the people of the Bayān. Reflect on this, then, you who possess understanding. By Him who stands through His own Self! If the servants were to ponder this one utterance, they would find themselves independent of all but God and would have no need of questions and answers to establish this wondrous Cause. God speaks the truth, but the people do not listen, and

77

هم‌چنین میفرماید قوله عزّ ذکره فانّ مثله جلّ ذکره کمثل الشّمس لو یقابلنّه الی ما لا نهایة مرایا کلّهنّ لیستعکسنّ عن تجلّی الشّمس فی حدّهم و ان لن یقابلها من احد فیطلع الشّمس و یغرب و الحجاب للمرایا حال ملاحظه نمائید که از این بیان قدس ربّانی مستفاد میشود که ممکن است شمس طالع شود و غروب نماید و مرایا در حجاب باشند مع‌ذلک میتوان گفت بعد از اشراق شمس الشّموس الّتی یطوفنّ فی حولها شموس لا یعلم عدّتهنّ احد الّا نفس اللّه العالم العلیم که مرآت چگونه میشود از انوار شمس و تجلّی آن ممنوع و محروم شود و حال آنکه مسلّم است که وجود مرایا بنفسه لنفسه نبوده بلکه بوجود شمس قایم و منیرند چنانچه الیوم اگر تمام مرایای ممکنات بشمس عزّ صمدانی مقابل شوند در جمیع انوار شمس ظاهر و مشهود و بمجرّد انحراف جمیع معدوم و مفقود بوده و خواهند بود مشاهده در مرآت ظاهره نمائید تا در مقابل شمس قائم است آثار تجلّی در او ظاهر و بعد از انحراف آن آثار محو بوده و خواهد بود چنانچه مشهود است

Hamchenīn mīfarmāyad, qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu: Fa-inna mathalahu jalla dhikruhu ka-mathali al-shams law yuqābilannahu ilā mā lā nihāyata marāyā kulluhunna la-yastaʿkisanna ʿan tajallī al-shams fī ḥaddihim wa in lan yuqābilhā min aḥadin fa-yaṭluʿu al-shams wa yaghrub wa al-ḥijābu li’l-marāyā. Ḥāl molāḥeẓe namāʾīd ke az īn bayān-e qods-e rabbānī mostafād mīshavad ke momken ast shams ṭāleʿ shavad va ghorūb namāyad va marāyā dar ḥejāb bāshand. Maʿa-dhālek mītavān goft baʿd az eshrāq-e Shams al-shumūs allatī yaṭufna fī ḥawlihā shumūsun lā yaʿlamu ʿiddatahunna aḥadun illā nafsu Allāh al-ʿĀlim al-ʿAlīm ke merʾāt chegūne mīshavad az anvār-e shams va tajallī-ye ān mamnūʿ va maḥrūm shavad va ḥāl ānke mosallam ast ke vojūd-e marāyā be-nafsihi li-nafsihi nabūde balke be-vojūd-e shams qāʾem va monīrand. Chenānche emrūz agar tamām-e marāyā-ye momkenāt be-shams-e ʿezz-e ṣamadānī moqābel shavand dar jamīʿ anvār-e shams ẓāher va mashhūd va be-mojarrad-e enḥerāf jamīʿ maʿdūm va mafqūd būde va khāhand būd. Moshāhede dar merʾāt-e ẓāhere namāʾīd tā dar moqābel-e shams qāʾem ast āthār-e tajallī dar ū ẓāher va baʿd az enḥerāf ān āthār maḥv būde va khāhad būd chenānche mashhūd ast.

He also states—exalted be His mention: “His likeness—glorified be His mention—is that of the sun. Were mirrors without end to face it, they would all reflect the sun’s radiance according to their own limits. If none should face it, the sun would still rise and set, and it is the mirrors that would be veiled.” Now consider how this holy, divine utterance conveys that the sun may rise and set while the mirrors remain veiled. Nevertheless, one may ask: after the dawning of the Sun of suns, around which revolve suns whose number no one knows except God Himself, the Knowing, the All-Knowing, how can a mirror be kept from the sun’s light and deprived of its radiance? Yet it is certain that the mirrors do not exist of themselves and for themselves; rather, they subsist and shine through the existence of the sun. Thus today, if all the mirrors of contingent existence turn toward the Sun of eternal glory, the sun’s light will be manifest and visible in them all; and the moment they turn aside, all have been and will be nonexistent and lost. Look at an outward mirror: so long as it faces the sun, the traces of its radiance appear within it; after it turns aside, those traces have vanished and will vanish, as is plainly seen.

78

و هم‌چنین میفرماید او است آن سلطان مقتدری که اگر بحرکت بیاید لسان قدسش خلق میفرماید بقولی آنچه بخواهد و اراده فرماید از نبیّ و ولیّ و صدّیق حال لایق است از مقتدری که بقول او نبیّ و ولیّ خلق میشوند اعراض نمایند و باسمی از اسماء و یا بذکری از اذکار و یا بمرآتی از مرایا تمسّک جویند ان هذا الّا لظلم عظیم تاللّه الحقّ امری را مرتکب شده‌اند که احدی ارتکاب ننموده چه که بعد از ظهور شمس در قطب زوال مجال توقّف برای نفسی نه بلی اگر بنفس او عارف نباشند و از عرفان آن جمال قدم بنفسه لنفسه خود را عاجز مشاهده نمایند حجّت و دلیل طلب نمایند همان حجّت و دلیلی که ایمان کلّ عباد باو محقّق و ثابت بوده و اگر از بحور جود و فضل خود ظاهر فرمود دیگر که قادر است که توقّف نماید مگر آنکه بالمرّه از حقّ اعراض نماید و در سجّین قهر و هاویهٴ نفی و جحیم اعراض مقرّ یابد چنانچه اکثر از نفوسی که الیوم خود را بر رفرف ایمان و عرش ایقان متّکی و مستوی میدانند بالمرّة از حقّ اعراض نموده و در بحر کفر مستغرق و در کلّ حین بعذاب بدیع معذّبند ولکن من غیر شعور

Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad ū ast ān solṭān-e moqtaderī ke agar be-ḥarakat bīyāyad lesān-e qodsash khalq mīfarmāyad be-qawlī ānche bekhāhad va erāde farmāyad az nabī va valī va ṣeddīq. Ḥāl lāyeq ast az moqtaderī ke be-qawl-e ū nabī va valī khalq mīshavand eʿrāḍ namāyand va be-esmī az asmāʾ va yā be-dhekrī az adhkār va yā be-merʾātī az marāyā tamassok jūyand? In hādhā illā la-ẓulmun ʿaẓīm. Ta’llāhi al-Ḥaqq amrī rā mortakeb shode-and ke aḥadī ertekāb nanamūde che ke baʿd az ẓohūr-e shams dar qoṭb-e zavāl majāl-e tavaqqof barā-ye nafsī na. Balī agar be-nafs-e ū ʿāref nabāshand va az ʿerfān-e ān Jamāl-e Qedam bi-nafsihi li-nafsihi khod rā ʿājez moshāhede namāyand ḥojjat va dalīl ṭalab namāyand hamān ḥojjat va dalīlī ke īmān-e koll-e ʿebād be-ū moḥaqqaq va thābet būde va agar az boḥūr-e jūd va faḍl-e khod ẓāher farmūd dīgar ke qāder ast ke tavaqqof namāyad magar ānke bi’l-marre az Ḥaqq eʿrāḍ namāyad va dar sijjīn-e qahr va hāviye-ye nafy va jaḥīm-e eʿrāḍ maqarr yābad. Chenānche akthar az nofūsī ke emrūz khod rā bar rafraf-e īmān va ʿarsh-e īqān mottakī va mostavī mīdānand bi’l-marre az Ḥaqq eʿrāḍ namūde va dar baḥr-e kofr mostaghraq va dar koll-e ḥīn be-ʿadhāb-e badīʿ moʿadhdhaband va lākin min ghayri shuʿūr.

He also states: “He is that mighty Sovereign whose holy tongue, if it moves, creates with a word whatever He wishes and wills, whether prophet, holy one, or righteous one.” Is it fitting, then, to turn away from the All-Powerful, by whose word prophets and holy ones are created, and cling to one of the names, or one of the designations, or one of the mirrors? This is indeed nothing but a grievous wrong. By God, the True One! They have committed what no one has ever committed, for after the sun has appeared at the zenith, no soul has any grounds for hesitation. Yes, if they do not recognize Him through His own Self and find themselves unable to recognize that Ancient Beauty by Himself and for Himself, let them ask for proof and evidence—the very proof and evidence through which the faith of all the servants has been established and confirmed. And if He brings it forth from the seas of His bounty and grace, who can then hesitate, unless he turns away entirely from the Truth and takes his abode in the dungeon of wrath, the abyss of negation, and the hell of rejection? Thus most of those who today consider themselves reclining upon the lofty seat of faith and established upon the throne of certitude have turned away entirely from the Truth, are submerged in the sea of unbelief, and at every moment suffer an unprecedented torment, yet remain unaware.

79

و ایکاش باعراض و انکار کفایت مینمودند لا فوالّذی انطقنی بثنآء نفسه که ابداً کفایت نخواهند نمود چنانچه نفس الّتی ربّیناه فی مذ الأیّام و علّمناه فی کلّ الأحیان کلمات الرّحمن کما یعلّمون اهل الهند طیورهم قام علیّ و حارب بنفسی و اعرض عن جمالی و جادل بآیات اللّه المهیمن القیّوم و باین کفایت ننموده بر قطع سدرهٴ الوهیّة ایستاد فلمّا دمّره اللّه و ظهر ما فی قلبه اذاً قام علی المکر بشأن لن یقدر احد ان یحصیه الّا اللّه الملک العزیز القدیر و مفتریاتی جعل نموده و انتشار داده که قلم عاجز است از ذکرش و شقاوتی که از اوّل دنیا الی حین ظاهر شده بنفس اللّه القائمة علی کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض نسبت داده و مع‌ذلک در مقرّ خود ساکن و مستریح است چه که از حمقای ناس مطمئن است که کلّ در سبیل وهم سالکند و در بحر تقلید سابح فوالّذی نفسی بیده که اگر اقلّ من ان یحصی ناس را بابصر مشاهده مینمود باین مزخرفات ارتکاب نمینمود ولکن غافل از اینکه عنقریب از خلف استار عصمت الهی هیاکلی ظاهر شوند که ببصر الهی حقّ را از باطل و شمس را از ظلّ فرق گذارند و بهیچ بندی از صراط مستقیم ممنوع نشوند و بهیچ سدّی از نبأ عظیم محروم نگردند فیا لیت من ذی بصر لینظر الی کلماتهم الّتی یحکی عن انفسهم و ذواتهم لیعرفهم و یکون من العارفین قسم بسلطان اعظم که اگر نفسی در کلمات معرضین ببصر حدید ملاحظه نماید شأن و رتبه و مقام این انفس وهمیّه را ادراک مینماید

Va ey kāsh be-eʿrāḍ va enkār kefāyat mīnamūdand. Lā fa-wa’lladhī anṭaqanī bi-thanāʾi nafsihi ke abadan kefāyat nakhāhand namūd. Chenānche nafs allatī rabbaynāhu fī mudhdh al-ayyām wa ʿallamnāhu fī kull al-aḥyān kalimāt al-Raḥmān kamā yuʿallimūna ahl al-Hind ṭuyūrahum qāma ʿalayya wa ḥāraba bi-nafsī wa aʿraḍa ʿan jamālī wa jādala bi-āyāti Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm va be-īn kefāyat nanamūde bar qaṭʿ-e Sedre-ye Olūhiyyat īstād. Fa-lammā dammarahu Allāh wa ẓahara mā fī qalbihi idhan qāma ʿalā al-makr bi-shaʾnin lan yaqdir aḥadun an yuḥṣiyahu illā Allāh al-Malik al-ʿAzīz al-Qadīr va moftarayātī jaʿl namūde va enteshār dāde ke qalam ʿājez ast az dhekrash va shaqāvatī ke az avval-e donyā ilā ḥīn ẓāher shode be-nafs Allāh al-qāʾima ʿalā kulli man fī al-samāwāt wa al-arḍ nesbat dāde va maʿa-dhālek dar maqarr-e khod sāken va mostarīḥ ast che ke az ḥomaqā-ye nās moṭmaʾenn ast ke koll dar sabīl-e vahm sālekand va dar baḥr-e taqlīd sābeḥ. Fa-wa’lladhī nafsī bi-yadihi ke agar aqall min an yuḥṣā nās rā bā-baṣar moshāhede mīnamūd be-īn mozakhrafāt ertekāb nemīnamūd va lāken ghāfel az īnke ʿan-qarīb az khalf-e astār-e ʿeṣmat-e elāhī hayākelī ẓāher shavand ke be-baṣar-e elāhī Ḥaqq rā az bāṭel va shams rā az ẓell farq godhārand va be-hīch bandī az ṣerāṭ-e mostaqīm mamnūʿ nashavand va be-hīch saddī az nabaʾ-e ʿaẓīm maḥrūm nagardand. Fa-yā layta min dhī baṣarin li-yanẓura ilā kalimātihim allatī yaḥkī ʿan anfusihim wa dhawātihim li-yaʿrifahum wa yakūna min al-ʿārifīn. Qasam be-Solṭān-e Aʿẓam ke agar nafsī dar kalemāt-e moʿreḍīn be-baṣar-e ḥadīd molāḥeẓe namāyad shaʾn va rotbe va maqām-e īn anfos-e vahmiyye rā edrāk mīnamāyad.

Would that they had contented themselves with rejection and denial! No, by Him who has caused Me to speak in praise of His own Self, they will never be content with that. Thus the soul whom We nurtured over the days and taught at all times the words of the All-Merciful, as the people of India teach their birds, rose against Me, waged war upon My own Self, turned away from My beauty, and disputed the verses of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Not content with this, he arose to cut down the Tree of Divinity. When God brought him to ruin and what was in his heart became manifest, he then resorted to such plotting as no one can reckon except God, the King, the Almighty, the Omnipotent. He has fabricated and circulated slanders that the pen is powerless to recount, and has ascribed every wickedness manifested from the beginning of the world until now to the Self of God, who sustains all who are in the heavens and on earth. Yet he remains settled and at ease in his own abode, for he is confident of the fools among the people, who all tread the path of delusion and swim in the sea of imitation. By Him in whose hand is My soul! Had he perceived discernment in even an uncountably small number of people, he would not have committed these absurdities. But he is heedless that before long, from behind the veils of divine protection, figures will appear who, with divine sight, will distinguish truth from falsehood and the sun from the shadow. No bond will keep them from the straight path, and no barrier will deprive them of the momentous news. Would that someone possessed sight, to examine their words, which disclose their own selves and essences, so that he might recognize them and be among those who understand. I swear by the Most Great Sovereign that if anyone examines the words of those who turn away with penetrating sight, he will perceive the condition, rank, and station of these deluded souls.

80
