و الیوم رؤسای بیان بهمان ادلّه که پست‌ترین اهل فرقان بر حقّیّت خود استدلال مینموده‌اند بهمان دلایل استدلال نموده و مینمایند من حیث لا یشعرون مثلاً حکم وصایت را که ظهور قبلم بالمرّه از کتاب محو نموده چنانچه جمیع مطّلعند که جز حروفات و مرایا در بیان از قلم رحمن نازل نشده و مرایا را هم محدود نفرموده‌اند چنانچه در دعوات میفرمایند الهی در کلّ حین بفرست مرایای ممتنعه و بلّوریّات صافیه لیحکینّ عنک و یدلّنّ منک و در جمیع الواح من قبل اللّه این کلمات نازل من یشآء فلینظر الیها و یکون من العارفین حال بمثل امّت فرقان که خاتم النّبیّین درست نموده و از مرسل و مبعث آن محتجب مانده‌اند این اصحاب هم اراده نموده خاتم الولیّین برای نفس خود ثابت نمایند چنانچه مشهود شد و نفسی را که بقول او صدهزار ولیّ خلق شده و میشود در بئر بغضا انداخته‌اند و در کلّ حین احجار ظنون از کلّ جهات بر وجود مبارکش میاندازند و در نفس خود صیحه میزنند و دعوی مظلومیّت نموده که شاید غلّ اللّه در انفس ضعیفه القا نمایند اینست شأن مرایا که ظاهر شده قل الیوم لو یحکم اللّه لاسم الّذی یکون ابغض الأسمآء عند النّاس بأنّه ربّ لکم او بالعکس لیس لأحد ان یقول لم او بم لأنّه جلّ و عزّ یحکم ما یرید و لا یسأل عمّا اراد و انّه لهو المقتدر القدیر

Va emrūz roʾasā-ye Bayān be-hamān adelle ke past-tarīn-e ahl-e Forqān bar ḥaqqiyyat-e khod estedlāl mīnamūde-and be-hamān dalāyel estedlāl namūde va mīnamāyand min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūn. Mathalan ḥokm-e veṣāyat rā ke ẓohūr-e qablam bi’l-marre az ketāb maḥv namūde chenānche jamīʿ moṭṭaleʿand ke joz ḥorūfāt va marāyā dar Bayān az qalam-e Raḥmān nāzel nashode va marāyā rā ham maḥdūd nafarmūde-and chenānche dar daʿavāt mīfarmāyand Elāhī dar koll-e ḥīn beferest marāyā-ye momtaneʿe va bellūriyyāt-e ṣāfiye li-yaḥkīna ʿanka wa yadululna minka va dar jamīʿ-e alvāḥ min qibal Allāh īn kalemāt nāzel man yashāʾ fa’l-yanẓur ilayhā wa yakūn min al-ʿārifīn. Ḥāl be-methl-e ommat-e Forqān ke khātam al-nabiyyīn dorost namūde va az morsel va mobʿeth-e ān moḥtajeb mānde-and īn aṣḥāb ham erāde namūde khātam al-valiyyīn barā-ye nafs-e khod thābet namāyand chenānche mashhūd shod va nafsī rā ke be-qawl-e ū ṣad-hezār valī khalq shode va mīshavad dar beʾr-e baghḍā andākhte-and va dar koll-e ḥīn aḥjār-e ẓonūn az koll-e jehāt bar vojūd-e mobārakash mīandāzand va dar nafs-e khod ṣayḥe mīzanand va daʿvā-ye maẓlūmiyyat namūde ke shāyad ghell-e Allāh dar anfos-e ḍaʿīfe elqā namāyand. Īnast shaʾn-e marāyā ke ẓāher shode. Qul al-yawm law yaḥkum Allāh li-ism alladhī yakūnu abghaḍ al-asmāʾ ʿinda al-nās bi-annahu rabbun lakum aw bi’l-ʿaks laysa li-aḥadin an yaqūla lima aw bi-ma li-annahu jalla wa ʿazza yaḥkumu mā yurīd wa lā yusʾalu ʿammā arāda wa innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr.

Today the leaders of the Bayān have advanced and continue to advance, without realizing it, the very arguments by which the lowliest of the people of the Qurʾān argued for the truth of their own claims. One example is the ordinance of appointed succession, which My previous Manifestation entirely effaced from the Book. As everyone knows, nothing concerning this was sent down in the Bayān from the Pen of the All-Merciful apart from letters and mirrors, nor did He set any limit on the mirrors. Thus He says in His prayers: “My God, send forth at every moment inviolable mirrors and pure crystals, that they may reflect You and point to You.” These words have been sent down in all the Tablets from God. Whoever wishes, let him examine them and be among those who understand. Now, just as the community of the Qurʾān fashioned a “Seal of the Prophets” and remained veiled from Him who sent and raised him up, these companions too have sought to establish a “Seal of the Holy Ones” for themselves, as has been witnessed. They have cast into the well of hatred the One by whose word a hundred thousand holy ones have been and are created. At every moment they hurl the stones of their suspicions from every direction at His blessed Being, while they themselves cry out and claim to be wronged, hoping thereby to instill hatred of God in weak souls. Such is the condition of the mirrors that have appeared. Say: If today God should decree that the name most hateful to the people is your Lord, or the reverse, no one has the right to say “Why?” or “On what grounds?” For He, glorified and exalted, decrees whatever He wills and is not questioned about what He has willed. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

81

و در این ایّام رسائلی در ردّ حقّ بانامل شرکیّه نوشته و ارسال داشته‌اند قسم بآفتاب معانی که مثل اطفال بکلمات مزخرفهٴ بی‌معنی تکلّم نموده‌اند بل احقر لو انتم تعرفون حال کتب و رسائل این فئه را با آنچه از خدّام این بیت ظاهر شده میزان نمائید و خود انصاف دهید که شاید الیوم از فیض بحر معانی که جمیع ممکنات را احاطه نموده محروم نمانید

Va dar īn ayyām rasāʾelī dar radd-e Ḥaqq be-anāmel-e sherkiyye neveshte va ersāl dāshte-and. Qasam be-Āftāb-e Maʿānī ke methl-e aṭfāl be-kalemāt-e mozakhrafe-ye bī-maʿnī takallom namūde-and bal aḥqar law antum taʿrifūn. Ḥāl kotob va rasāʾel-e īn feʾe rā bā ānche az khoddām-e īn bayt ẓāher shode mīzān namāʾīd va khod enṣāf dahīd ke shāyad emrūz az fayḍ-e baḥr-e maʿānī ke jamīʿ-e momkenāt rā eḥāṭe namūde maḥrūm namānīd.

In these days they have written and dispatched treatises refuting the Truth, penned by fingers of idolatry. I swear by the Sun of inner meanings that, like children, they have uttered meaningless absurdities—indeed, they are even more contemptible, if you only knew. Now weigh the books and treatises of this faction against what has come forth from the servants of this House, and judge fairly for yourselves, so that today you may not remain deprived of the outpouring of the ocean of meanings that has encompassed all contingent things.

82

و حال حقّ بشأنی تنزّل نموده که از اطراف متتابعاً از مسائل فرقانیّه سؤال مینمایند و باید جواب مرقوم دارد مثلاً نفسی مرآت را یاقوت فرض گرفته و بعد سؤال نموده که یاقوت قبل از بلوغ رتبهٴ او باین مقام میشود تغییر نماید و بعد از بلوغ چگونه تغییر مینماید یعنی مرآت قبل از وصول باین مقام مرآتیّت ممکن بوده تبدیل شود و یا تغییر نماید ولکن بعد از بلوغ باین مقام چگونه تنزّل مینماید

Va ḥāl Ḥaqq be-shaʾnī tanazzol namūde ke az aṭrāf motatābeʿan az masāʾel-e Forqāniyye soʾāl mīnamāyand va bāyad javāb marqūm dārad. Mathalan nafsī merʾāt rā yāqūt farḍ gerefte va baʿd soʾāl namūde ke yāqūt qabl az bolūgh-e rotbe-ye ū be-īn maqām mīshavad taghyīr namāyad va baʿd az bolūgh chegūne taghyīr mīnamāyad yaʿnī merʾāt qabl az voṣūl be-īn maqām-e merʾātiyyat momken būde tabdīl shavad va yā taghyīr namāyad va lāken baʿd az bolūgh be-īn maqām chegūne tanazzol mīnamāyad.

Now the Truth has so far condescended that questions concerning matters of the Qurʾān are continually asked from every quarter, and He must write replies. For example, someone has likened a mirror to a ruby and then asked: a ruby may change before attaining this rank, but how can it change after attaining it? That is, before a mirror reached this station of mirrorhood, it could have been transformed or changed; but after attaining this station, how can it decline?

83

چنانچه اکثری باین مطالب بدیهیّه الیوم از سلطان احدیّه محروم مانده‌اند اوّلاً بگو ای سائل نسأل اللّه بأن یوفّقک و یؤیّدک بشأن تعرف کلّ شیء فی مقامه و تنقطع عن کلّ الاشارات و لن تشهد فی الملک الّا تجلّی انوار الّتی احاطت العالمین و یمحو عن قلبک کلّ الأذکار و تقوم علی ثنآء ربّک العزیز المختار

Chenānche aktharī be-īn maṭāleb-e badīhiyye emrūz az Solṭān-e Aḥadiyye maḥrūm mānde-and. Avvalan begū ey sāʾel nasʾalu Allāh bi-an yuwaffiqaka wa yuʾayyidaka bi-shaʾnin taʿrifu kulla shayʾin fī maqāmihi wa tanqaṭiʿu ʿan kull al-ishārāt wa lan tashhada fī al-mulk illā tajallī anwār allatī aḥāṭat al-ʿālamīn wa yamḥū ʿan qalbika kulla al-adhkār wa taqūmu ʿalā thanāʾi rabbika al-ʿAzīz al-Mukhtār.

Thus many have today remained deprived of the Sovereign of Oneness because of these self-evident matters. First say: O questioner, we ask God to grant you success and strengthen you, so that you may recognize everything in its own station, detach yourself from all allusions, and behold in the realm of existence nothing but the radiance of the lights that have encompassed all worlds; that He may efface every mention from your heart, and that you may arise to praise your Lord, the Almighty, the Unconstrained.

84

لأنّ فی مثل ذلک الیوم لا ینبغی لأحد ان یلتفت الی شیء عمّا خلق بین السّموات و الأرضین هل ینبغی لنفس بعد اشراق الشّمس فی قطب الزّوال ان یشتغل بذکر النّجوم او یسأل عن السّراج ولو یکون سراجاً منیرا لا فوجمالی المشرق المقدّس العزیز المنیر دع کلّ الأذکار عن ورائک ثمّ تمسّک بهذا الذّکر الّذی ظهر بالحقّ و ینطق فی کلّ شیء بأنّه لا اله الّا انا العزیز العلیم

Li-anna fī mithli dhālika al-yawm lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin an yaltafita ilā shayʾin ʿammā khuliqa bayna al-samāwāt wa-al-araḍīn. Hal yanbaghī li-nafsin baʿda ishrāqi al-shams fī quṭbi al-zawāl an yashtaghila bi-dhikri al-nujūm aw yasʾala ʿan al-sirāj wa-law yakūnu sirājan munīran? Lā fa-wa-jamālī al-mushriq al-muqaddas al-ʿazīz al-munīr. Daʿ kulla al-adhkār ʿan warāʾika thumma tamassak bi-hādhā al-dhikr alladhī ẓahara bi-al-ḥaqq wa-yanṭiqu fī kulli shayʾin bi-annahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿazīz al-ʿalīm.

For on such a day no one should turn toward anything created between the heavens and the earths. After the sun has shone at its zenith, should anyone occupy himself with mentioning the stars or inquire about a lamp, even if it is a shining lamp? No, by My radiant, sanctified, mighty, luminous Beauty! Leave every remembrance behind you, then hold fast to this Remembrance, who has appeared in truth and proclaims within all things: “There is no God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Knowing.”

85

و اگر موفّق بآنچه در این آیات منزله از سماء احدیّه نازل شده نشدی و بجواب مسئلهٴ خود ناظر باشی بشنو نداء ابهی را از افق عزّ اعلی و اوّلاً بدان که کلّ شیء بکلّ شیء تبدیل شده و میشود و علم ذلک فی کتاب ربّک الّذی لا یضلّ و لا ینسی

Va agar muwaffaq be-ānchih dar īn āyāt-e munazzaleh az samā-ye aḥadiyyeh nāzil shudeh nashudī va be-javāb-e masʾaleh-ye khud nāẓir bāshī, bishnav nidā-ye Abhā rā az ufuq-e ʿizz-e aʿlā va avvalan bidān keh kull-e shayʾ be-kull-e shayʾ tabdīl shudeh va mīshavad va ʿilmu dhālika fī kitābi rabbika alladhī lā yaḍillu wa-lā yansā.

And if you have not succeeded in attaining what has been sent down in these verses revealed from the heaven of oneness, and still seek an answer to your question, hear the call of the All-Glorious from the horizon of supreme glory. Know first that everything has been and is being transformed into everything else, and knowledge of this is in the Book of your Lord, who neither errs nor forgets.

86

و ثانیاً اگر از تو سؤال شود که حقّ قادر است بر تبدیل یاقوت یا نه جواب چه خواهی گفت باری عجز لازال شأن خلق بوده و حقّ منیع در قطب اقتدار قائم بحرفی قادر است که جمیع من فی الأرض را قطعه‌ئی از یاقوت رطبهٴ حمرا فرماید و بحرفی کلّ را بحجر راجع نماید فتعالی عمّا انتم ظننتم فی قدرته و تظنّون

Va thāniyan agar az tu suʾāl shavad keh Ḥaqq qādir ast bar tabdīl-e yāqūt yā nah, javāb chih khāhī guft? Bārī ʿajz lā-zāl shaʾn-e khalq būdeh va Ḥaqq-e manīʿ dar quṭb-e iqtidār qāʾim. Be-ḥarfī qādir ast keh jamīʿ-e man fī al-arḍ rā qiṭʿeh-ī az yāqūt-e raṭbeh-ye ḥamrā farmāyad va be-ḥarfī kull rā be-ḥajar rājiʿ namāyad. Fa-taʿālā ʿammā antum ẓanantum fī qudratihi wa-taẓunnūn.

And second, if you are asked whether God has the power to transform a ruby or not, what answer will you give? Powerlessness has always been the condition of creation, while God, the Inaccessible, stands at the center of power. With a single word He can turn all who are on earth into a piece of moist crimson ruby, and with a single word return them all to stone. Exalted is He above what you have imagined and still imagine concerning His power.

87

و از این مقام گذشته یاقوت را در نار بگذار و بعد ملاحظه کن که چه میشود تا بر تبدیل کلّ شیء الّا اللّه موقن شوی و هم‌چنین یاقوت قلب که در نار نفس و هوی مبتلا شد البتّه از لطافت و لون و صفای خود محروم ماند و الیوم بسی از قطعات یاقوت که بحجر راجع شده و خود شاعر نیستند و کذلک بالعکس لو انتم من العارفین

Va az īn maqām gudhashteh yāqūt rā dar nār bigudhār va baʿd mulāḥiẓeh kun keh chih mīshavad tā bar tabdīl-e kull-e shayʾ illā Allāh mūqin shavī. Va ham-chunīn yāqūt-e qalb keh dar nār-e nafs va havā mubtalā shud al-batteh az liṭāfat va lawn va ṣafā-ye khud maḥrūm mānad va al-yawm basī az qiṭaʿāt-e yāqūt keh be-ḥajar rājiʿ shudeh va khud shāʿir nīstand va-kadhālika bi-al-ʿaks law antum min al-ʿārifīn.

And beyond this, place a ruby in the fire and then observe what happens, so that you may become certain of the transformation of everything except God. Likewise, when the ruby of the heart is afflicted by the fire of self and desire, it is inevitably deprived of its delicacy, color, and purity. Today many pieces of ruby have reverted to stone and are themselves unaware of it; and the reverse is also true, if you are among those who understand.

88

در یاقوت انواع متعدّده و الوان مختلفه مشهود و جمیع الوان آن در نار تغییر مینماید مگر دو قسم که به بهرمانی و رمّانی مشهورند و این دو هم اگرچه بنار شدیده در ایّام عدیده تغییر مینماید ولکن از ورای حجاب اگر در نار متوسّطه بمانند ضرّی مشهود نه و بعضی بر آنند که نار بر لون این دو قسم بیفزاید و امّا اگر نار الهی که در علم مکتوم ربّانی بکبریت احمر معروفست بر یاقوت القا گردد فی‌الحین تکلیس شود چون سایر اجساد

Dar yāqūt anvāʿ-e mutaʿaddideh va alvān-e mukhtalifeh mashhūd va jamīʿ-e alvān-e ān dar nār taghyīr mīnamāyad magar du qism keh be-bahramānī va rummānī mashhūrand va īn du ham agarchih be-nār-e shadīdeh dar ayyām-e ʿadīdeh taghyīr mīnamāyad va-lākin az varā-ye ḥijāb agar dar nār-e mutavassiṭeh bimānand ḍararī mashhūd nah va baʿḍī bar ānand keh nār bar lawn-e īn du qism biyafzāyad. Va ammā agar nār-e ilāhī keh dar ʿilm-e maktūm-e rabbānī be-kibrīt-e aḥmar maʿrūf ast bar yāqūt ilqā gardad fī al-ḥīn taklīs shavad chūn sāʾir-e ajsād.

Rubies are found in numerous varieties and different colors, and all their colors change in fire except for two varieties known as saffron-colored and pomegranate-colored. Although these two also change under intense fire over many days, albeit from behind a veil, no damage is observed if they remain in a moderate fire. Some hold that fire deepens the color of these two varieties. But if the divine fire known in the hidden divine science as the crimson sulfur is applied to a ruby, it is immediately calcined like other bodies.

89

انّما النّار یصلح کلّ مفسد و یفسد کلّ مصلح تزید الصّالح صلاحاً و الفاسد فساداً هر نفسی که از علم الهی مطّلع شده آنچه ذکر شد ادراک مینماید و من دونه لیس لأحد نصیب الّا بأمر من لدن مقتدر قدیر

Innamā al-nār yuṣliḥu kulla mufsid wa-yufsidu kulla muṣliḥ, tazīdu al-ṣāliḥa ṣalāḥan wa-al-fāsida fasādan. Har nafsī keh az ʿilm-e ilāhī muṭṭaliʿ shudeh ānchih dhikr shud idrāk mīnamāyad va min dūnihi laysa li-aḥadin naṣīb illā bi-amrin min ladun muqtadirin qadīr.

Fire indeed sets right all that corrupts and corrupts all that sets right; it increases the sound in soundness and the corrupt in corruption. Whoever has become acquainted with divine knowledge understands what has been stated. Without it, no one has any share except through a command from One who is All-Powerful, Almighty.

90

باری ای سائل در جمیع ما سوی اللّه و نفس ظهور تغییر و تبدیل مشهود است خلقنا الأشیآء من التّراب و نعیدنّها الیه و نبعث منه حیّاً ذلک وعد من لدنّا فسوف نوفی بما وعدناکم به و انا خیر الموفین

Bārī ey sāʾil dar jamīʿ-e mā sivā Allāh va nafs-e ẓuhūr taghyīr va tabdīl mashhūd ast. Khalaqnā al-ashyāʾa min al-turāb wa-nuʿīdannahā ilayhi wa-nabʿathu minhu ḥayyan. Dhālika waʿdun min ladunnā fa-sawfa nūfī bi-mā waʿadnākum bihi wa-anā khayru al-mūfīn.

In short, O questioner, change and transformation are evident in all that is other than God and in the Manifestation Himself. We created all things from dust, and We will surely return them to it and raise them from it alive. This is a promise from Us, and We will fulfill what We have promised you. I am the best of those who fulfill their promises.

91

ای قوم ندای طیر بقا را از رضوان اعلی بشنوید و رحیق الطف ارقّ اصفی از انامل قدس بها بنوشید و از کلّ ما سوی اللّه غنیّ و بی‌نیاز شوید تا بحور علم و حکمت ربّانی از قلب و لسان جاری شود و از امثال این مسائل فارغ و مقدّس گردید زینهار قلب را که ودیعهٴ جمال مختار است بآلایش کلمات فجّار و شبهات اشرار میالائید چه که الیوم بکلّ حیل و مکر ظاهر شده‌اند و بهر نحو که ممکن شود القای شبهه در قلوب مینمایند

Ey qawm nidā-ye ṭayr-e baqā rā az Riḍvān-e aʿlā bishnavīd va raḥīq-e alṭaf-e araqq-e aṣfā az anāmil-e quds-e Bahā binūshīd va az kull-e mā sivā Allāh ghanī va bī-niyāz shavīd tā buḥūr-e ʿilm va ḥikmat-e rabbānī az qalb va lisān jārī shavad va az amthāl-e īn masāʾil fārigh va muqaddas gardīd. Zīnhār qalb rā keh vadīʿeh-ye Jamāl-e Mukhtār ast be-ālāyish-e kalimāt-e fujjār va shubuhāt-e ashrār mayālāyīd chih keh al-yawm be-kull-e ḥiyal va makr ẓāhir shudeh-and va be-har naḥv keh mumkin shavad ilqā-ye shubheh dar qulūb mīnamāyand.

O people, hear the call of the Bird of Eternity from the highest Paradise, drink the most exquisite, delicate, and pure wine from the holy fingers of Bahá, and become independent of all but God, needing nothing from them, so that oceans of divine knowledge and wisdom may flow from your hearts and tongues and you may be freed and sanctified from such questions. Take care not to defile the heart, which is entrusted to you by the sovereign Beauty, with the pollution of the words of the wicked and the doubts raised by evildoers. For today they have come forth with every trick and deception, instilling doubts in hearts by every possible means.

92

و از همهٴ این بیانات گذشته اگر در عالم شیئی یافت شود که تبدیل نشود و تغییر نیابد این چه دخلی بمطلب این قوم دارد مثلاً یاقوت بزعم این قوم اگر تغییر نیابد چه مناسبت دارد بآنکه مقبل نمیشود که معرض شود و یا موحّد مشرک و مؤمن کافر در بعضی اشیاء ملیک اسماء امکان تغییر گذاشته و در بعضی نگذاشته مثلاً نحاس امکان دارد ذهب شود ولکن تراب بالفعل امکان ذهبیّت در او موجود نه و این مطلب را چون اهل علم از قبل ذکر نموده‌اند این عبد دوست نداشته که مفصّل ذکر نماید

Va az hameh-ye īn bayānāt gudhashteh agar dar ʿālam shayʾī yāft shavad keh tabdīl nashavad va taghyīr nayābad īn chih dakhlī be-maṭlab-e īn qawm dārad? Mathalan yāqūt be-zaʿm-e īn qawm agar taghyīr nayābad chih munāsibat dārad be-ānkeh muqbil namīshavad keh muʿriḍ shavad va yā muvaḥḥid mushrik va muʾmin kāfir? Dar baʿḍī ashyāʾ Malīk-e Asmāʾ imkān-e taghyīr gudhāshteh va dar baʿḍī nagudhāshteh. Mathalan nuḥās imkān dārad dhahab shavad va-lākin turāb bi-al-fiʿl imkān-e dhahabiyyat dar ū mawjūd nah va īn maṭlab rā chūn ahl-e ʿilm az qabl dhikr namūdeh-and īn ʿabd dūst nadāshteh keh mufaṣṣal dhikr namāyad.

And beyond all these explanations, if something were found in the world that did not undergo transformation or change, what bearing would this have on the argument of these people? For example, if, as these people suppose, a ruby does not change, what connection does this have with the claim that one who has turned toward God cannot turn away, or that a believer in His oneness cannot become an idolater, or a believer an unbeliever? The King of Names has placed the possibility of change in some things and not in others. For example, copper can become gold, but the possibility of becoming gold is not actually present in earth. Since people of learning have discussed this matter before, this Servant has not wished to discuss it in detail.

93

ولکن در انسان امکان علم و جهل و اقبال و اعراض و ایمان و کفر موجود و مشهود است و اگر مقصود سائل از ذکر ذهب و یاقوت در رتبهٴ جماد بوده این از مقصود او بغایت دور است چه اگر هم بالفرض ذهب نحاس نشود و یاقوت رماد از این نمیتوان در سایر مصنوعات صانع قیاس نمود و این نزد اهل بصر که بمنظر اکبر ناظرند واضح و لایح است

Va-lākin dar insān imkān-e ʿilm va jahl va iqbāl va iʿrāḍ va īmān va kufr mawjūd va mashhūd ast va agar maqṣūd-e sāʾil az dhikr-e dhahab va yāqūt dar rutbeh-ye jamād būdeh īn az maqṣūd-e ū be-ghāyat dūr ast chih agar ham bi-al-farḍ dhahab nuḥās nashavad va yāqūt ramād az īn namītavān dar sāʾir-e maṣnūʿāt-e Ṣāniʿ qiyās namūd va īn nazd-e ahl-e baṣar keh be-Manẓar-e Akbar nāẓirand vāḍiḥ va lāyiḥ ast.

In the human being, however, the possibilities of knowledge and ignorance, turning toward and turning away, faith and unbelief are present and evident. If the questioner, in mentioning gold and ruby, meant them at the mineral level, this is very far from establishing his point. For even supposing that gold does not become copper and ruby does not become ash, one cannot draw an analogy from this concerning the other handiworks of the Maker. This is clear and evident to those endowed with sight who look toward the Most Great Vision.

94

و اگر مقصود در رتبهٴ انسان است معلوم بوده که ذهب و یاقوت در رتبهٴ مؤمن ایمانه باللّه و عرفانه نفسه بوده و خواهد بود و این بسی واضح است که تبدیل میشود چنانچه بسا از عباد که در اوّل ظهور جمال رحمن بایمان فایز شده‌اند و بعد معرض و اگر از عالم وهم متصاعد شوی و قلب را از اشارهٴ قولیّه مقدّس نمائی تبدیل کلّ شیء را در کلّ حین بکلّ شیء مشاهده نمائی و من فتح له هذا البصر انّه من اولی الأبصار لدی اللّه المقتدر المختار

Va agar maqṣūd dar rutbeh-ye insān ast maʿlūm būdeh keh dhahab va yāqūt dar rutbeh-ye muʾmin īmānuhu bi-Allāh va ʿirfānuhu nafsahu būdeh va khāhad būd va īn basī vāḍiḥ ast keh tabdīl mīshavad chunānchih basā az ʿibād keh dar avval-e ẓuhūr-e Jamāl-e Raḥmān be-īmān fāʾiz shudeh-and va baʿd muʿriḍ. Va agar az ʿālam-e vahm mutaṣāʿid shavī va qalb rā az ishāreh-ye qawliyyih muqaddas namāʾī tabdīl-e kull-e shayʾ rā dar kull-e ḥīn be-kull-e shayʾ mushāhideh namāʾī va man futiḥa lahu hādhā al-baṣar innahu min ulī al-abṣār ladā Allāh al-muqtadir al-mukhtār.

And if what is intended concerns the human level, it is known that gold and ruby, at the level of the believer, have been and will remain his faith in God and his recognition of Him. It is abundantly clear that this can change, for many servants attained faith at the beginning of the revelation of the Beauty of the All-Merciful and afterward turned away. If you rise above the realm of illusion and sanctify your heart from verbal allusions, you will observe the transformation of everything into everything else at every moment. Whoever has this vision opened to him is indeed reckoned among those endowed with insight before God, the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.

95

جوهر بیان طلعت رحمن آنکه امر اللّه لازال مقدّس از ذکر و وصف و تحدید بوده و خواهد بود و هر نفسی باین حجبات اراده نماید ملیک من فی لجج اللّانهایات را ادراک نماید ابداً موقن نخواهد شد بقوّت سلطان بقا حجبات اسماء و دون آن و فوق آن را خرق نمائید و بمدینهٴ اعزّ ارفع امنع اقدس ابهی وارد شوید که الیوم جز ظلّش نار و جز حبّش مردود بوده و خواهد بود

Jawhar-e bayān-e Ṭalʿat-e Raḥmān ānkeh Amr Allāh lā-zāl muqaddas az dhikr va vaṣf va taḥdīd būdeh va khāhad būd va har nafsī be-īn ḥujubāt irādeh namāyad Malīk-e man fī lujaj-e lā-nihāyāt rā idrāk namāyad abadan mūqin nakhāhad shud. Be-quvvat-e Sulṭān-e Baqā ḥujubāt-e asmāʾ va dūn-e ān va fawq-e ān rā kharq namāʾīd va be-madīneh-ye aʿazz-e arfaʿ-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e abhā vārid shavīd keh al-yawm juz ẓillash nār va juz ḥubbash mardūd būdeh va khāhad būd.

The essence of the utterance of the Countenance of the All-Merciful is this: the Cause of God has always been and will always remain sanctified above mention, description, and limitation. Whoever seeks through these veils to comprehend the King of all who dwell in the billowing oceans of infinity will never attain certainty. Through the power of the Sovereign of Eternity, tear through the veils of names and all that is below and above them, and enter the most mighty, most exalted, most inaccessible, most holy, most glorious City. For today all but its shade is fire, and all but love of it has been and will remain rejected.

96

و هم‌چنین نفسی از عدد آیهٴ منزلهٴ اقتربت السّاعة و انشقّ القمر سؤال نموده بگو ان یا ایّها النّاظر الی الکلمات عدد را بگذار و بخود آیه ملاحظه نما و اگر الیوم کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض باین آیهٴ مبارکه ناظر شوند و در معانی مستورهٴ آن تفکّر نمایند جمیع را کفایت نماید چه که امروز شمس باطن از افق ظاهر آیه اشراق فرموده و سیفی است قاطع در ردّ نفوسی که غیر اللّه را ولیّ اخذ نموده‌اند و معنی این آیه تا این ظهور منیع ظاهر نشده چه که در حین ظهور نقطهٴ اولی ولیّی علی زعم ناس نبوده تا منشقّ شود بلکه علما بوده‌اند و تعبیر از علما بنجوم شده و از ولیّ بقمر و از نبیّ بشمس اینست که در این ظهور شمس از افق اللّه مشرق و قمر وهم منشقّ شده اذاً قل فتبارک اللّه اقدر الأقدرین

Va ham-chunīn nafsī az ʿadad-e āyeh-ye munazzaleh-ye iqtarabati al-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa al-qamar suʾāl namūdeh. Bigū an yā ayyuhā al-nāẓir ilā al-kalimāt ʿadad rā bigudhār va be-khud-e āyeh mulāḥiẓeh namā va agar al-yawm kull-e man fī al-samāwāt va al-arḍ be-īn āyeh-ye mubārakeh nāẓir shavand va dar maʿānī-ye mastūreh-ye ān tafakkur namāyand jamīʿ rā kifāyat namāyad chih keh imrūz shams-e bāṭin az ufuq-e ẓāhir-e āyeh ishrāq farmūdeh va sayfī ast qāṭiʿ dar radd-e nufūsī keh ghayr Allāh rā valī akhdh namūdeh-and va maʿnī-ye īn āyeh tā īn ẓuhūr-e manīʿ ẓāhir nashudeh chih keh dar ḥīn-e ẓuhūr-e Nuqṭeh-ye Ūlā valī-ī ʿalā zaʿm-e nās nabūdeh tā munshaqq shavad balkih ʿulamā būdeh-and va taʿbīr az ʿulamā be-nujūm shudeh va az valī be-qamar va az nabī be-shams. Īn ast keh dar īn ẓuhūr shams az ufuq Allāh mushriq va qamar-e vahm munshaqq shudeh. Idhan qul fa-tabāraka Allāh aqdar al-aqdarīn.

Someone has also asked about the numerical value of the revealed verse, “The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.” Say: O you who look at the words, set aside the numerical value and consider the verse itself. If today all who are in the heavens and on earth were to turn to this blessed verse and reflect on its hidden meanings, it would suffice them all. For today the sun of its inner meaning has shone from the horizon of the verse’s outward form, and it is a sharp sword refuting those who have taken anyone other than God as their guardian. The meaning of this verse had not become manifest until this inaccessible Revelation, for at the time of the appearance of the Primal Point there was no guardian, as people conceive it, to be split apart. Rather, there were religious scholars: scholars have been referred to as stars, the guardian as the moon, and the prophet as the sun. Thus, in this Revelation the sun has risen from the horizon of God, and the moon of illusion has split apart. Then say: Blessed be God, the most powerful of all who wield power!

97

حال در این آیهٴ منزله تفکّر نمائید و انصاف دهید و لا تکونوا من الّذینهم یعرفون نعمة اللّه ثمّ ینکرون و ایکاش این ناس باین ولیّ و مرآت که برای خود من دون اللّه اخذ نموده‌اند مطّلع میشدند قسم بآفتاب عزّ صمدانی که اصل امر که در بارهٴ مرآت شنیده‌اند بآن نحو نبوده و هر نفسی ادّعای علم نماید کذب بربّ البقآء و آنچه نظر بحکمة اللّه این عبد مذکور داشته بین النّاس اشتهار یافته و مقصود از کلمات نقطهٴ اولی جلّ جلاله را احدی ادراک ننموده و این عبد اصل امر را از کلّ مستور داشته لحکمة لا یعلمها الّا نفسی العلیم الحکیم فواللّه فعل بموجده الّذی خلقه بنفخة من عنده ما لا فعل احد فی العالمین و اگر خلق لوحی از الواح بدیعه که از سماء عزّ احدیّه در این ایّام نازل شده ببصر اللّه ملاحظه نمایند از حقّ محتجب نمیمانند و ماسوایش را معدوم مشاهده میکنند و موقن میشوند که مادونش غیر مذکور بوده و خواهد بود تا چه رسد بمعرضین

Ḥāl dar īn āyeh-ye munazzaleh tafakkur namāʾīd va inṣāf dihīd va lā takūnū min alladhīna hum yaʿrifūna niʿmata Allāh thumma yunkirūn. Va ey kāsh īn nās be-īn valī va mirʾāt keh barā-ye khud min dūn Allāh akhdh namūdeh-and muṭṭaliʿ mīshudand. Qasam be-āftāb-e ʿizz-e ṣamadānī keh aṣl-e amr keh dar bāreh-ye mirʾāt shinīdeh-and be-ān naḥv nabūdeh va har nafsī iddiʿā-ye ʿilm namāyad kadhaba bi-rabbi al-baqāʾ va ānchih naẓar be-ḥikmat Allāh īn ʿabd madhkūr dāshteh bayn al-nās ishtihār yāfteh va maqṣūd az kalimāt-e Nuqṭeh-ye Ūlā jalla jalāluhu rā aḥadī idrāk nanamūdeh va īn ʿabd aṣl-e amr rā az kull mastūr dāshteh li-ḥikmatin lā yaʿlamuhā illā nafsī al-ʿalīm al-ḥakīm. Fa-wa-Allāh faʿala bi-mūjidihi alladhī khalaqahu bi-nafkhatin min ʿindihi mā lā faʿala aḥadun fī al-ʿālamīn va agar khalq lawḥī az alvāḥ-e badīʿeh keh az samā-ye ʿizz-e aḥadiyyeh dar īn ayyām nāzil shudeh be-baṣar Allāh mulāḥiẓeh namāyand az Ḥaqq muḥtajib namīmānand va mā-sivāyash rā maʿdūm mushāhideh mīkunand va mūqin mīshavand keh mā-dūnash ghayr-e madhkūr būdeh va khāhad būd tā chih rasad be-muʿriḍīn.

Now reflect on this revealed verse and judge fairly, and do not be among those who recognize God’s favor and then deny it. If only these people knew about this guardian and mirror whom they have taken for themselves apart from God! I swear by the Sun of everlasting glory that the true circumstances concerning the mirror were not as they have heard. Whoever claims to know has lied, by the Lord of Eternity! What this Servant has stated in accordance with God’s wisdom has become widely known among the people, but no one has understood the intent of the words of the Primal Point—exalted be His glory. This Servant has kept the truth of the matter concealed from everyone, for a wisdom that none knows but My own Self, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. By God, he has done to his Creator, who created him through a breath from Himself, what no one in all the worlds has done. If people were to look with the eye of God at a single one of the wondrous Tablets that have descended in these days from the heaven of the glory of oneness, they would not remain veiled from God. They would see all besides Him as nonexistent and become certain that whatever is other than Him has been and will remain unworthy of mention, much less those who turn away.

98

و بعضی الیوم بعصمت بعضی من دون اللّه قائل شده‌اند چنانچه اهل فرقان من غیر شعور تکلّم مینمودند و مقصود از عصمت را ابداً ادراک ننموده‌اند حکم عصمت الیوم محقّق میشود هر نفسی که بعد از استماع کلمة اللّه و ندائه بکلمهٴ بلی موقن شد از اهل عصمت بوده و من‌دون آن از عصمت خارج چنانچه نقطهٴ بیان روح ما سواه فداه میفرمایند مخاطباً للعظیم فانّ الأمر قد رقت عن الحدودات انت تصفی عباداً حین ما تجلّی اللّه لهم بهم قد عرفوا اللّه بارئهم و ما صبروا فیه و ما شکوا حتّی اجعلنّهم مثل ما جعلت من قبل من الأنبیآء و الأوصیآء و الشّهدآء و المقرّبین و لعمری لو تحضرنّ بعدد کلّ شیء لأجعلنّه و لا ینقص عن ملک اللّه قدر شیء و لا یزید قدر شیء ولکن تری ینبغی لتلک الدّرجة العصمة الکبری و لم یکن العصمة بما تری عند النّاس من احتیاطاتهم فی دینهم لأنّهم حین ما سمعوا ندآء أ لست بربّکم ما قالوا بلی قد خرجوا و انّما العصمة للّذینهم حین ما قال اللّه أ لست بربّکم قالوا بلی و انّ اللّه لم یقل لأحد الّا بمظهر نفسه فی کلّ ظهور انتهی

Va baʿżī al-yawm bi-ʿiṣmat-i baʿżī min dūni Allāh qāʾil shudih-and, chunānchih ahl-i Furqān min ghayri shuʿūr takallum mīnamūdand va maqṣūd az ʿiṣmat rā abadan idrāk nanamūdih-and. Ḥukm-i ʿiṣmat al-yawm muḥaqqaq mīshavad: har nafsī kih baʿd az istimāʿ-i Kalimatuʾllāh va nidāʾih bi-kalimiy-i balā mūqin shud az ahl-i ʿiṣmat būdih va min dūn-i ān az ʿiṣmat khārij. Chunānchih Nuqṭiy-i Bayān, rūḥ-i mā sivāh fidāh, mīfarmāyand mukhāṭiban li-l-ʿAẓīm: fa-inna al-amra qad raqqat ʿan al-ḥudūdāt, anta tuṣaffī ʿibādan ḥīna mā tajallā Allāhu lahum bihim qad ʿarafū Allāha bāriʾahum wa-mā ṣabarū fīhi wa-mā shakkū ḥattā ajʿalannahum mithla mā jaʿalta min qablu min al-anbiyāʾ wa-l-awṣiyāʾ wa-l-shuhadāʾ wa-l-muqarrabīn. Wa-la-ʿamrī law tuḥḍiranna bi-ʿadadi kulli shayʾ la-ajʿalannahu wa-lā yanquṣu ʿan mulki Allāhi qadru shayʾ wa-lā yazīdu qadru shayʾ, wa-lākin tarā yanbaghī li-tilka al-darajati al-ʿiṣmatu al-kubrā. Wa-lam yakun al-ʿiṣmatu bi-mā tarā ʿinda al-nāsi min iḥtiyāṭātihim fī dīnihim li-annahum ḥīna mā samiʿū nidāʾa a-lastu bi-rabbikum mā qālū balā qad kharajū. Wa-innamā al-ʿiṣmatu li-lladhīnahum ḥīna mā qāla Allāhu a-lastu bi-rabbikum qālū balā. Wa-inna Allāha lam yaqul li-aḥadin illā bi-maẓhari nafsihi fī kulli ẓuhūr. Intahā.

Some today have attributed infallibility to certain people apart from God, just as the people of the Qur’an used to speak without understanding; they have never understood what is meant by infallibility. Today the criterion of infallibility is established: whoever, after hearing the Word of God and His call, has become assured of the word “Yes” belongs to the people of infallibility, and anyone else is outside it. Thus the Point of the Bayán—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—says, addressing ʿAẓím: “The Cause has indeed risen beyond limitations. You are to select servants who, when God revealed Himself to them, recognized through them God, their Maker, and did not hesitate concerning Him or entertain doubt, that I may make them like those whom You previously made prophets, successors, martyrs, and those brought near. By My life, were you to bring forward as many as the number of all things, I would surely do so, and nothing whatsoever would diminish from God’s dominion or increase it. But you see that supreme infallibility befits that station. Infallibility is not what you see among people in their precautions concerning their religion, for when they heard the call ‘Am I not your Lord?’ and did not say ‘Yes,’ they departed from it. Infallibility belongs only to those who, when God said ‘Am I not your Lord?’ said ‘Yes.’ God has never spoken to anyone except through the Manifestation of His own Self in every Revelation.” End of quotation.

99

و بعد از این بیان که اصرح کلّ کلمات من قلم اللّه نازل شده دیگر که میتواند برای خود عصمت ثابت نماید الّا بعد از تصدیق این امر اعظم افخم الیوم کلّ ناس فی ایّ رتبة کان از عصمت خارجند مگر آن نفوسی که باین ظهور قدس صمدانی موقن شده‌اند ای عباد بشنوید ندآء اللّه را و آذان فطرت را از استماع کلمات اهل فرقان طاهر نموده تا بیان ابدع لسان رحمن را ادراک نمائید آخر تفکّر نمائید این فئه در کدام قول صادق بوده‌اند هزار و دویست و شصت سنه بختم ظهورات قائل بوده و هم‌چنین بکون قائم علی هیکل مخصوص در ارض معیّنه و هم‌چنین در علائم ظهور که بهزار روایات تمسّک جسته بشأنی که منکرین این اقوال را کافر میدانستند و بعد معلوم شد در ظهور نقطهٴ بیان جلّ ذکره که جمیع مخطی بوده و مظاهر عزّ احدیّه لم‌یزل طالع و لایزال مشرق خواهند بود و هم‌چنین در سایر اقوال این هیاکل اضلال ملاحظه کن که کلّ توهّم بوده و خواهد بود معبودهم هواهم و مسجودهم اوهامهم ان انتم تعرفون

Va baʿd az īn bayān kih aṣraḥ-i kull-i kalimāt min Qalamiʾllāh nāzil shudih, dīgar kih mītavānad barāy-i khud ʿiṣmat thābit namāyad illā baʿd az taṣdīq-i īn Amr-i aʿẓam-i afkham? Al-yawm kull-i nās fī ayyi rutbatin kān az ʿiṣmat khārijand magar ān nufūsī kih bi-īn ẓuhūr-i quds-i ṣamadānī mūqin shudih-and. Ay ʿibād, bishnavīd nidā-yi Allāh rā va ādhān-i fiṭrat rā az istimāʿ-i kalimāt-i ahl-i Furqān ṭāhir namūdih tā bayān-i abdaʿ-i Lisān-i Raḥmān rā idrāk namāyīd. Ākhir tafakkur namāyīd, īn fiʾih dar kudām qawl ṣādiq būdih-and? Hizār va duvīst va shaṣt sanih bi-khatm-i ẓuhūrāt qāʾil būdih va hamchunīn bi-kawn-i Qāʾim ʿalā haykal-i makhṣūṣ dar arḍ-i muʿayyanih va hamchunīn dar ʿalāʾim-i ẓuhūr kih bi-hizār rivāyāt tamassuk justih bi-shaʾnī kih munkirīn-i īn aqvāl rā kāfir mīdānistand. Va baʿd maʿlūm shud dar ẓuhūr-i Nuqṭiy-i Bayān, jalla dhikruhu, kih jamīʿ mukhṭī būdih va maẓāhir-i ʿizz-i aḥadiyyih lam-yazal ṭāliʿ va lā-yazāl mushriq khvāhand būd. Va hamchunīn dar sāʾir-i aqvāl-i īn hayākil-i iḍlāl mulāḥiẓih kun kih kull tavahhum būdih va khvāhad būd. Maʿbūduhum hawāhum wa-masjūduhum awhāmuhum in antum taʿrifūn.

After this statement, the most explicit of all utterances, has descended from the Pen of God, who can any longer claim infallibility for himself except after acknowledging this greatest, most exalted Cause? Today all people, whatever their rank, are outside infallibility except those souls who have become assured of this holy, eternal Revelation. O servants, hear the call of God and cleanse the ears of your innate nature from listening to the words of the people of the Qur’an, so that you may comprehend the wondrous utterance of the Tongue of the All-Merciful. Reflect, after all: in which of their statements have these people been truthful? For one thousand two hundred and sixty years they maintained that Revelations had ended, and likewise that the Qáʾim existed in a particular bodily form in a specified land. Likewise, concerning the signs of His appearance, they clung to a thousand traditions, to such an extent that they considered those who denied these assertions unbelievers. Then, in the Revelation of the Point of the Bayán—exalted be His mention—it became clear that all had been mistaken, and that the Manifestations of the glory of oneness have always risen and will forever continue to shine. Consider likewise the other statements of these embodiments of error: all have been and will remain mere illusion. Their god is their own desire, and the object of their worship their own imaginings, if you understand.

100

مع آنکه جمیع اهل بیان مشاهده نموده‌اند که آنچه در دست این فئه بود غیر حقّ بوده مع‌ذلک متّصلاً بکلمات اهل فرقان استدلال مینمایند و متکلّمند چنانچه تازه این فئه بذکر وصایت قبل میخواهند ناس را از فرات قدس الهی و شریعهٴ عزّ صمدانی ممنوع نمایند قسم بجمال اللّه العلیّ الأبهی که اگر هزار مظهر ظهور در ظهور نقطهٴ بیان موجود بود و در اقرار بر امر ملیک مختار اقلّ من حین اصطبار مینمود از اهل نار عنداللّه محسوب میشد

Maʿa ānkih jamīʿ-i ahl-i Bayān mushāhidih namūdih-and kih ānchih dar dast-i īn fiʾih būd ghayr-i ḥaqq būdih, maʿa-dhālik muttaṣilan bi-kalimāt-i ahl-i Furqān istidlāl mīnamāyand va mutakallimand. Chunānchih tāzih īn fiʾih bi-dhikr-i viṣāyat-i qabl mīkhvāhand nās rā az Furāt-i quds-i ilāhī va sharīʿiy-i ʿizz-i ṣamadānī mamnūʿ namāyand. Qasam bi-Jamāl-i Allāh al-ʿAliyy al-Abhā kih agar hizār maẓhar-i ẓuhūr dar ẓuhūr-i Nuqṭiy-i Bayān mawjūd būd va dar iqrār bar Amr-i Malīk-i Mukhtār aqall-i min ḥīn iṣṭibār mīnamūd az ahl-i nār ʿinda Allāh maḥsūb mīshud.

Although all the people of the Bayán have seen that what these people possessed was untrue, they nevertheless continually base their arguments and their discourse on the words of the people of the Qur’an. Thus these people now seek, by invoking the earlier appointment of a successor, to bar people from the Euphrates of divine holiness and the waterway of eternal glory. I swear by the Beauty of God, the Most High, the All-Glorious, that if a thousand manifestations of revelation had existed in the Revelation of the Point of the Bayán, and one had delayed for less than an instant in acknowledging the Cause of the sovereign King who chooses freely, he would have been reckoned among the people of the fire in God’s sight.

101

خرق کنید حجبات وهم را و بسماء عزّ ابهی عروج نمائید و اگر میخواهید حقّ بر جمیع معلوم شود چند نفر از منصفین حاضر شوند در این مدینه و آثار اللّه و کلماتش را ملاحظه نمایند و هم‌چنین مدّعیان هم در این ارض حاضرند درست استفسار نمایند تا آثار حقّ از دونش مبرهن گردد و بر جمیع محقّق شود که دونه فقرآء لدی بابه و عجزآء عند حضرته و فقدآء لدی ظهورات انواره

Kharq kunīd ḥujubāt-i vahm rā va bi-samā-yi ʿizz-i Abhā ʿurūj namāyīd. Va agar mīkhvāhīd Ḥaqq bar jamīʿ maʿlūm shavad chand nafar az munṣifīn ḥāḍir shavand dar īn madīnih va āthāruʾllāh va kalimātash rā mulāḥiẓih namāyand va hamchunīn muddaʿiyān ham dar īn arḍ ḥāḍirand. Durust istifsār namāyand tā āthār-i Ḥaqq az dūnash mubarhan gardad va bar jamīʿ muḥaqqaq shavad kih dūnahu fuqarāʾ ladā bābihi wa-ʿujazāʾ ʿinda ḥaḍratihi wa-fuqadāʾ ladā ẓuhūrāti anwārihi.

Tear through the veils of illusion and ascend to the heaven of all-glorious might. If you wish the Truth to become known to everyone, let a few fair-minded people come to this city and examine the writings of God and His words; the claimants are also present in this land. Let them inquire thoroughly, so that the writings of the True One may be clearly distinguished from those of others, and everyone may be certain that all besides Him are paupers at His gate, powerless in His presence, and destitute before the revelations of His light.

102

در بیان فارسی لسان الهی فرموده قوله تعالی منتهی جدّ و جهد خود را نموده که در یوم ظهور حقّ از کلمات او بر او احتجاج نگردد که کلّ بیان کلام ظهور قبل او است و او است عالم‌تر از آنچه نازل فرموده از کلّ خلق زیرا که روح کلّ در قبضهٴ او است و در نزد کلّ نیست الّا شبحی اگر بر حقّ مستقرّ باشند والّا که لایق ذکر نیست انتهی

Dar Bayān-i Fārsī Lisān-i Ilāhī farmūdih, qawluhu taʿālā: muntahā-yi jidd va jahd-i khud rā namūdih kih dar yawm-i ẓuhūr-i Ḥaqq az kalimāt-i ū bar ū iḥtijāj nagardad kih kull-i Bayān kalām-i ẓuhūr-i qabl-i ū ast va ū ast ʿālimtar az ānchih nāzil farmūdih az kull-i khalq zīrā kih rūḥ-i kull dar qabḍiy-i ū ast va dar nazd-i kull nīst illā shabaḥī agar bar Ḥaqq mustaqarr bāshand va-illā kih lāyiq-i dhikr nīst. Intahā.

In the Persian Bayán the Divine Tongue has spoken—exalted are His words: “Make your utmost effort and exertion so that, on the day of the Revelation of the True One, His words may not be used to argue against Him. For the whole Bayán is the utterance of His previous Revelation, and He knows what He has revealed better than all creation, for the spirit of all is in His grasp. All others possess only a semblance, if they remain steadfast in the Truth; otherwise, it is not worthy of mention.” End of quotation.

103

این بیان جمال رحمن حال ملاحظه نمائید با اینکه کل را منع فرموده‌اند از احتجاج بآن جوهر وجود و ساذج معبود و صریح فرموده‌اند بکلمات بیان بمنزل آن در ظهور بعد احتجاج ننمائید مع‌ذلک الیوم مشاهده میشود که کلّ باحتجاج برخاسته‌اند و میگویند فلان را در بیان باسماء حسنی موسوم نموده‌اند مع‌ذلک چگونه میشود از این مقام تنزّل نماید

Īnast bayān-i Jamāl-i Raḥmān. Ḥāl mulāḥiẓih namāyīd bā īnkih kull rā manʿ farmūdih-and az iḥtijāj bi-ān Jawhar-i Vujūd va Sādhaj-i Maʿbūd va ṣarīḥ farmūdih-and bi-kalimāt-i Bayān bi-Munzil-i ān dar ẓuhūr-i baʿd iḥtijāj nanamāyīd, maʿa-dhālik al-yawm mushāhidih mīshavad kih kull bi-iḥtijāj barkhāstih-and va mīgūyand fulān rā dar Bayān bi-asmā-yi ḥusnā mawsūm namūdih-and, maʿa-dhālik chigūnih mīshavad az īn maqām tanazzul namāyad?

Such is the utterance of the Beauty of the All-Merciful. Now consider: although He has forbidden everyone to argue with that Essence of being, that pure Being who is worshipped, and has explicitly said, “Do not use the words of the Bayán to argue with its Revealer in the next Revelation,” nevertheless today everyone can be seen rising to argue, saying, “Such a person has been designated in the Bayán by the most beautiful names; how, then, can he fall from this station?”

104

و هم‌چنین میفرماید عزّ ذکره او را شناخته بآیات او و احتیاط در عرفان او نکرده که بقدر همان در نار خواهی بود انتهی و نظر باین کلمات محکمه الیوم کلّ محتاطین در این امر امنع اقدس در نارند لا شکّ فی ذلک

Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad, ʿazza dhikruhu: ū rā shinākhtih bi-āyāt-i ū va iḥtiyāṭ dar ʿirfān-i ū nakardih kih bi-qadr-i hamān dar nār khvāhī būd. Intahā. Va naẓar bi-īn kalimāt-i muḥkamih al-yawm kull-i muḥtāṭīn dar īn Amr-i amnaʿ-i aqdas dar nārand, lā shakka fī dhālik.

He likewise says—exalted be His mention: “Recognize Him through His verses, and exercise no caution in recognizing Him, for to that same extent you will be in the fire.” End of quotation. In view of these decisive words, all who exercise caution today concerning this most unassailable, most holy Cause are in the fire. There is no doubt of this.

105

و قوله عزّ ذکره و اگر در مابین خود و خدا توجّه میکنید مثال او است که در افئدهٴ شما است باو از او محتجب نگردید و بشناسید کسی را که از برای عرفان او خلق شده‌اید و قوله تعالی در نزد هر ظهوری از ظهور شجرهٴ حقیقت مؤمنین باو و کتاب او از قبل بظهور او و کتاب او از بعد محتجب میشوند بحیثیّتی که نمیماند الّا مؤمن خالص و او اعزّ از کبریت احمر است انتهی

Va qawluhu, ʿazza dhikruhu: va agar dar mābayn-i khud va Khudā tavajjuh mīkunīd mithāl-i ū ast kih dar afʾidiy-i shumā ast, bi-ū az ū muḥtajib nagardīd va bishināsīd kasī rā kih az barāy-i ʿirfān-i ū khalq shudih-īd. Va qawluhu taʿālā: dar nazd-i har ẓuhūrī az ẓuhūr-i Shajariy-i Ḥaqīqat muʾminīn bi-ū va kitāb-i ū az qabl bi-ẓuhūr-i ū va kitāb-i ū az baʿd muḥtajib mīshavand bi-ḥaythiyyatī kih nimīmānad illā muʾmin-i khāliṣ va ū aʿazz az kibrīt-i aḥmar ast. Intahā.

And His words—exalted be His mention: “If, in private between yourselves and God, you turn toward Him, it is His image that is in your hearts. Do not let it veil you from Him, and recognize the One for whose recognition you have been created.” And His words—exalted is He: “At every appearance of the Tree of Truth, those who believed in Him and His Book before become veiled from His subsequent Revelation and His Book, to such an extent that none remains but the pure believer, who is rarer than red sulfur.” End of quotation.

106

چنانچه الیوم کلّ ممتحن شده‌اند و اکثری از بریّه از سلطان احدیّه اعراض نموده‌اند و میگویند فلان در بیان باسم اللّه نامیده شده و هم‌چنین بامثال این کلمات از سلطان عزّ لایزال محروم مانده و ملتفت نشده آنچه را عامل شده‌اند و بر فرض تسلیم غافلند از اینکه کلّ اسماء در آن ساحت اقدس در صقع واحدند عطا میفرماید کیف یشآء و اخذ میفرماید کیف یرید

Chunānchih al-yawm kull mumtaḥan shudih-and va aktharī az bariyyih az Sulṭān-i Aḥadiyyih iʿrāḍ namūdih-and va mīgūyand fulān dar Bayān bi-ism-i Allāh nāmīdih shudih va hamchunīn bi-amthāl-i īn kalimāt az Sulṭān-i ʿizz-i lā-yazāl maḥrūm māndih va multafit nashudih ānchih rā ʿāmil shudih-and. Va bar farḍ-i taslīm ghāfiland az īnkih kull-i asmā dar ān sāḥat-i aqdas dar ṣuqʿ-i vāḥidand. ʿAṭā mīfarmāyad kayfa yashāʾ va akhdh mīfarmāyad kayfa yurīd.

Thus today all have been tested, and most of humanity have turned away from the Sovereign of oneness, saying, “Such a person has been called by the name of God in the Bayán.” Through such words they have remained deprived of the Sovereign of everlasting glory, unaware of what they have done. Even granting their assertion, they are heedless that all names stand on a single plane in that most holy court. He bestows as He wills and takes away as He desires.

107

قوله تعالی چه که کسی عالم بظهور نیست غیر اللّه هر وقت شود باید کلّ تصدیق بنقطهٴ حقیقت نمایند و شکر الهی بجا آورند انتهی مع‌ذلک بعضی معارضه در قرب ظهور نموده چنانچه ملل قبل کلّ باین معارضات مشغولند قل ویل لکم چه زود تبدیل نموده‌اید نعمت الهی را و بسبل وهم و خطا سالک شده‌اید با آنکه هنوز از ظهور چیزی نگذشته که کلّ بقدم اوّل راجع شده

Qawluhu taʿālā: chih kih kasī ʿālim bi-ẓuhūr nīst ghayr-i Allāh, har vaqt shavad bāyad kull taṣdīq bi-Nuqṭiy-i Ḥaqīqat namāyand va shukr-i ilāhī bi-jā āvarand. Intahā. Maʿa-dhālik baʿżī muʿāriḍih dar qurb-i ẓuhūr namūdih chunānchih milal-i qabl kull bi-īn muʿāriḍāt mashghūland. Qul waylun lakum, chih zūd tabdīl namūdih-īd niʿmat-i ilāhī rā va bi-subul-i vahm va khaṭā sālik shudih-īd, bā ānkih hanūz az ẓuhūr chīzī nagudhashtih kih kull bi-qadam-i avval rājiʿ shudih.

His words—exalted is He: “For no one knows of the Revelation except God. Whenever it occurs, all must acknowledge the Point of Truth and offer thanks to God.” End of quotation. Nevertheless, some have objected to the nearness of the Revelation, just as the peoples of earlier religions are all occupied with such objections. Say: Woe to you! How quickly you have exchanged God’s blessing and taken the paths of illusion and error! Although scarcely any time has passed since the Revelation, all have returned to their starting point.

108

باری حقّ لم‌یزل مختار بوده و لایزال مختار خواهد بود بهر نحو بخواهد ظاهر میشود و انّه لهو المختار و ما سواه مقبوض فی قبضة قدرته المهیمن القیّوم فوالّذی نفسی بیده لم یکن الیوم ظلم اعظم من انّ الّذی ینطق فی کلّ شیء بأنّی انا اللّه لا اله الّا هو اراد ان یثبت لعباده بأنّه یکون مقتدراً بأن یبدّل اسماً من اسمائه بعد الّذی یکون ملکوت الأسمآء خاضعة لسلطنته و جبروت الصّفات مشفقة من خشیته و لاهوت العمآء منقادة لحضرته و منجعلة بارادته و بدعت بأمره و یرجع الیه

Bārī Ḥaqq lam-yazal mukhtār būdih va lā-yazāl mukhtār khvāhad būd, bi-har naḥv bikhvāhad ẓāhir mīshavad. Wa-innahu la-huwa al-Mukhtār wa-mā siwāhu maqbūḍun fī qabḍati qudratihi al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Fa-wa-lladhī nafsī bi-yadihi lam yakun al-yawma ẓulmun aʿẓamu min anna alladhī yanṭiqu fī kulli shayʾ bi-annī anā Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa arāda an yuthbita li-ʿibādihi bi-annahu yakūnu muqtadiran bi-an yubaddila isman min asmāʾihi baʿda alladhī yakūnu malakūtu al-asmāʾ khāḍiʿatan li-salṭanatihi wa-jabarūtu al-ṣifāt mushfiqatan min khashyatihi wa-lāhūtu al-ʿamāʾ munqādatan li-ḥaḍratihi wa-munjaʿilatan bi-irādatihi wa-budiʿat bi-amrihi wa-yarjiʿu ilayhi.

In short, the True One has always been free to choose and will forever remain so. He appears in whatever manner He wishes. He is indeed the One who chooses freely, and all besides Him is held in the grasp of His power, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. By Him in whose hand is My soul! No injustice today is greater than this: that He who proclaims in all things, “I am God; there is no god but Him,” should have to establish for His servants that He has the power to change one of His names, when the kingdom of names is subject to His sovereignty, the dominion of attributes trembles in awe of Him, and the divine realm of the cloud submits to His presence, is fashioned by His will, was brought into being by His command, and returns to Him.

109

اینست شأن این خلق نابالغ ناقابل مقتدری که کلّ اسماء خلق شده بارادهٴ او و کلّ صفات ظاهر شده بسلطان مشیّت او و اهل ملأ اعلی طائفند حول او باید استدلال نماید بر اینکه قادر است از نفسی قمیص اسمی از اسماء را انتزاع فرماید مع آنکه اطّلاع بر آن اسم نداشته و ندارند و مریبین در قدرت سلطان یفعل ما یشآء و این ظهور ابدع امنع اعلی ید اللّه را مغلول دانسته‌اند ولو بلسان اقرار ننمایند بذلک یشهد لهم لسان المختار ولو هم ینکرون قوله جلّ ثنائه

Īnast shaʾn-i īn khalq-i nābāligh-i nāqābil. Muqtadirī kih kull-i asmā khalq shudih bi-irādiy-i ū va kull-i ṣifāt ẓāhir shudih bi-sulṭān-i mashiyyat-i ū va ahl-i Malaʾ-i Aʿlā ṭāʾifand ḥawl-i ū bāyad istidlāl namāyad bar īnkih qādir ast az nafsī qamīṣ-i ismī az asmā rā intizāʿ farmāyad, maʿa ānkih iṭṭilāʿ bar ān ism nadāshtih va nadārand. Va murībīn dar qudrat-i Sulṭān-i yafʿalu mā yashāʾ va īn ẓuhūr-i abdaʿ-i amnaʿ-i aʿlā Yaduʾllāh rā maghlūl dānistih-and va-law bi-lisān iqrār nanamāyand. Bi-dhālika yashhadu lahum Lisānu al-Mukhtār wa-law hum yunkirūn. Qawluhu jalla thanāʾuhu.

Such is the condition of these immature, unworthy people. The All-Powerful One, by whose will all names have been created, through whose sovereign purpose all attributes have appeared, and around whom the Concourse on high circles, must offer proof that He is able to strip a soul of the robe of one of the names—even though they have never had, and still have no, knowledge of that name. Those who doubt the power of the Sovereign who does whatever He wills and this most wondrous, most unassailable, most exalted Revelation have regarded the hand of God as shackled, even if they do not acknowledge it with their tongues. To this the Tongue of the One who chooses freely bears witness concerning them, though they deny it. His words—glorious be His praise:

110

اذ عند الخلق لم یکن الّا کلماتاً ما اطّلعوا بمرادک فیها و لذا قد احتجبوا یوم ظهورک انتهی اینست که الیوم کلّ بکلمات بیان از منزل آن محتجب مانده‌اند مع آنکه بمراد اللّه مطّلع نبوده و نخواهند بود

Idh ʿinda al-khalqi lam yakun illā kalimātan mā iṭṭalaʿū bi-murādika fīhā wa-li-dhā qad iḥtajabū yawma ẓuhūrika. Intahā. Īnast kih al-yawm kull bi-kalimāt-i Bayān az Munzil-i ān muḥtajib māndih-and maʿa ānkih bi-murādiʾllāh muṭṭaliʿ nabūdih va nakhvāhand būd.

“For people possessed nothing but words whose intended meaning they did not understand, and therefore they became veiled on the day of Your Revelation.” End of quotation. Thus today all have remained veiled by the words of the Bayán from its Revealer, although they have not known, and will not know, what God intended.

111

چنانچه آن جمال قدم برؤسای بیان مرقوم فرموده‌اند که مراد اللّه را در کلمات او از حرف حیّ که تلقاء وجه بوده سؤال نمائید چه که شما عارف بمراد اللّه نیستید و حرف حیّ مذکور جناب آقا سیّد حسین بوده و هو استشهد فی سبیل مولاه و فایز نشد نفسی بلقای او تا از معانی کلمات صمدانیّه استفسار نماید و مقصود از این بیان که لسان رحمن فرموده آنکه رؤسا بدانند که عارف بر معنی کلمات الهیّه نبوده و نیستند

Chunānchih ān Jamāl-i Qidam bi-ruʾasā-yi Bayān marqūm farmūdih-and kih murādiʾllāh rā dar kalimāt-i ū az Ḥarf-i Ḥayy kih tilqāʾ-i vajh būdih suʾāl namāyīd, chih kih shumā ʿārif bi-murādiʾllāh nīstīd. Va Ḥarf-i Ḥayy-i madhkūr Jināb-i Āqā Siyyid Ḥusayn būdih, wa-huwa istushhida fī sabīli mawlāhu, va fāʾiz nashud nafsī bi-liqā-yi ū tā az maʿānī-yi kalimāt-i ṣamadāniyyih istifsār namāyad. Va maqṣūd az īn bayān kih Lisān-i Raḥmān farmūdih ānkih ruʾasā bidānand kih ʿārif bar maʿnī-yi kalimāt-i ilāhiyyih nabūdih va nīstand.

Thus that Ancient Beauty wrote to the leaders of the Bayán: “Ask the Letter of the Living who has been in My presence about God’s intention in His words, for you do not know what God intends.” The Letter of the Living mentioned was Áqá Siyyid Ḥusayn, who was martyred in the path of his Lord, and no one attained his presence to inquire into the meanings of the eternal words. The purpose of this statement spoken by the Tongue of the All-Merciful was that the leaders should know that they have never understood, and do not understand, the meaning of the divine words.

112

و چون ظهور مبین قریب بود لذا سیّد مذکور بمقرّ اعلی ارتقا جست تفکّروا فی ذلک یا اولی الأفکار

Va chūn ẓuhūr-i mubīn qarīb būd li-dhā Siyyid-i madhkūr bi-maqarr-i aʿlā irtiqā just. Tafakkarū fī dhālika yā ulī al-afkār.

And because the manifest Revelation was near, the aforementioned Siyyid ascended to the highest abode. Reflect on this, O people of understanding.

113

و قوله جلّ ثنائه و انّ کلّما ذکرت لک فی مقام الاستدلال رشح من طمطام الظّاهر و ان اردت سرّ الفؤاد بحکم طلعة الباطن لا تشیر الیها الاشارة و لا یواریها الحجبات اللّانهایة و لا یحتاج احد بذکر دلیلها لأنّها هو نفس الظّهور و تمام البطون فسبحان اللّه عمّا یصفون انتهی جمالی را که میفرماید

Va qawluhu jalla thanāʾuhu: «Wa inna kullamā dhakartu laka fī maqām al-istidlāl rashḥun min ṭamṭām al-Ẓāhir, wa in aradta sirr al-fuʾād bi-ḥukm ṭalʿat al-Bāṭin lā tushīru ilayhā al-ishāra wa lā yuwārīhā al-ḥujubāt al-lānihāya wa lā yaḥtāju aḥad bi-dhikr dalīlihā li-annahā huwa nafs al-ẓuhūr wa tamām al-buṭūn fa-subḥān Allāh ʿammā yaṣifūn.» Intahā. Jamālī rā ke mīfarmāyad

And His words—exalted be His praise: “Everything I have mentioned to you by way of demonstration is a spray from the ocean of the Manifest. And if you seek the secret of the heart, by virtue of the countenance of the Hidden, no allusion can point to it, nor can endless veils conceal it, nor does anyone need to mention a proof of it, for it is manifestation itself and the fullness of concealment. Glorified be God above what they describe.” Thus ends the quotation. That Beauty of whom He says

114

اشاره را بآن ساحت عزّ احدیّه سبیل نه اعزازاً لحضرته و اخباراً لصفآء کینونته و لطافة رتبته مع‌ذلک بعد از آنکه بکلّ ظهورات الهیّه و تمام شئونات احدیّه شمس جمال خود را از افق قضا ظاهر فرمود از کلّ جهات سهام کین بر جمال مبین ربّ العالمین انداخته و اوّل من رمانی هو الّذی حفظته تحت جناحین فضلی و ربّیناه تحت عبّی و علّمناه فی ایّامی و هو الّذی قتلنی بسیف الاعراض و سفک دمی و ضیّع حرمة اللّه فی نفسی و انکر آیاتی بعد الّذی کان خاضعاً لحرف منها و خلق بنفحة عنها و جاحد حقّ اللّه فی حقّی و حارب بنفس اللّه فی نفسی و افتی علی قتلی فی الظّاهر و لمّا امنعه اللّه بسلطانه و اظهر خفیّات قلبه علی الّذینهم هاجروا فی سبیل اللّه اذاً قام علی الافترآء و رجع فعله و ظلمه الی نفسی المظلوم اطمیناناً من الّذینهم اتّبعوه

Ishāra rā bi ān sāḥat-i ʿizz-i aḥadiyya sabīl na, iʿzāzan li-ḥaḍratihi wa ikhbāran li-ṣafāʾ kaynūnatihi wa laṭāfat rutbatihi, maʿa dhālik baʿd az ānke bi kull-i ẓuhūrāt-i ilāhiyya va tamām-i shuʾūnāt-i aḥadiyya shams-i jamāl-i khud rā az ufuq-i qaḍā ẓāhir farmūd az kull-i jihāt sihām-i kīn bar jamāl-i mubīn-i Rabb al-ʿālamīn andākhta. Wa awwalu man ramānī huwa alladhī ḥafiẓtuhu taḥta janāḥayn faḍlī wa rabbaynāhu taḥta ʿibbī wa ʿallamnāhu fī ayyāmī wa huwa alladhī qatalanī bi-sayf al-iʿrāḍ wa safaka damī wa ḍayyaʿa ḥurmat Allāh fī nafsī wa ankara āyātī baʿda alladhī kāna khāḍiʿan li-ḥarfin minhā wa khuliqa bi-nafḥatin ʿanhā wa jāḥada ḥaqq Allāh fī ḥaqqī wa ḥāraba bi-nafs Allāh fī nafsī wa aftā ʿalā qatlī fī al-ẓāhir wa lammā amnaʿahu Allāh bi-sulṭānihi wa aẓhara khafiyyāt qalbihi ʿalā alladhīna hum hājarū fī sabīl Allāh idhan qāma ʿalā al-iftirāʾ wa rajaʿa fiʿluhu wa ẓulmuhu ilā nafsī al-Maẓlūm iṭmiʾnānan min alladhīna hum ittabaʿūhu.

that no allusion has access to that court of the glory of oneness, in honor of His presence and to declare the purity of His being and the subtlety of His rank—nevertheless, after He revealed the Sun of His beauty from the horizon of decree with all divine manifestations and every expression of oneness, they shot the arrows of malice from every direction at the manifest Beauty of the Lord of the worlds. The first to shoot at Me was the one whom I sheltered beneath the wings of My grace, whom We nurtured in My embrace and taught in My days. He is the one who killed Me with the sword of rejection, shed My blood, violated the sanctity of God in My person, and denied My verses after having bowed before a single letter of them and been created by a breath from them. He repudiated God’s right in My right, waged war against God’s own Self in My person, and openly decreed My death. When God restrained him through His sovereignty and exposed the secrets of his heart to those who had emigrated in the path of God, he resorted to slander, and his deeds and oppression were attributed to My wronged Self, to reassure those who followed him.

115

تاللّه انفطرت سموات الأمر من فعله و شقّت اراضی القدس من ظلمه و قدّت ستر حجاب الملکوت من اقواله و بکت سکّان مداین البقآء من اثمه و هو یضحک فی نفسه کأنّه ما ارتکب فی الملک شیئاً تاللّه اذاً یبکی کلّ شیء ولکن انّه لا یکوننّ من الشّاعرین فسوف یعلم حین الّذی یأتیه الموت و یدور عینتاه من سطوة القهر و یقول هل لی من رجوع لأستغفر عمّا فعلت اذاً یضرب علی فمه طین الهاویة و کذلک قدّر للمستکبرین علی اللّه المهیمن العزیز القدیر قوله عزّ ثنائه فسبحانک اللّهمّ یا الهی ان تقل قد عفوت عن البیان و من فیه فاذاً کلّ فی غفرانک و رضائک و ان تقل لا فانّنی انا الآخذ بأذیال جودک و المستشفع الیک بنفسک انتهی

Ta-llāh infaṭarat samāwāt al-amr min fiʿlihi wa shuqqat arāḍī al-quds min ẓulmihi wa quddat sitr ḥijāb al-malakūt min aqwālihi wa bakat sukkān madāʾin al-baqāʾ min ithmihi wa huwa yaḍḥaku fī nafsihi ka-annahu mā irtakaba fī al-mulk shayʾan. Ta-llāh idhan yabkī kull shayʾ wa lākin innahu lā yakūnanna min al-shāʿirīn. Fa-sawfa yaʿlamu ḥīna alladhī yaʾtīhi al-mawt wa yadūru ʿaynatāhu min saṭwat al-qahr wa yaqūlu hal lī min rujūʿ li-astaghfira ʿammā faʿaltu idhan yuḍrabu ʿalā famihi ṭīn al-hāwiya wa kadhālika quddira li-l-mustakbirīn ʿalā Allāh al-Muhaymin al-ʿAzīz al-Qadīr. Qawluhu ʿazza thanāʾuhu: «Fa-subḥānaka Allāhumma yā ilāhī in taqul qad ʿafawtu ʿan al-Bayān wa man fīhi fa-idhan kullun fī ghufrānika wa riḍāʾika wa in taqul lā fa-innanī anā al-ākhidh bi-adhyāl jūdika wa al-mustashfiʿ ilayka bi-nafsika.» Intahā.

By God! The heavens of the Cause have been torn apart by his deeds, the lands of holiness split asunder by his oppression, the covering of the Kingdom’s veil rent by his words, and the inhabitants of the cities of eternity moved to tears by his sin, while he laughs to himself as though he had done nothing in this world. By God! Everything weeps, yet he is not among those who perceive. Soon he will know, when death comes to him and his eyes roll beneath the assault of overpowering wrath, and he says, “Is there any return for me, that I may ask forgiveness for what I have done?” Then the clay of the abyss will be struck against his mouth. Thus has it been ordained for those who arrogantly oppose God, the All-Protecting, the Almighty, the All-Powerful. His words—exalted be His praise: “Glory be to You, O God, my God! If You say, ‘I have pardoned the Bayán and those within it,’ then all are embraced by Your forgiveness and Your good pleasure. And if You say, ‘No,’ then I am the one who clings to the hem of Your generosity and seeks Your own Self as an intercessor with You.” Thus ends the quotation.

116

و شکّی نبوده که ذات قدم تکلّم نمینماید مگر بلسان مظهر نفس خود و مشاهده نمائید که در این بیانات چه مقدار خضوع از محبوب امکان ظاهر شده که جمیع بیان و ما فیه را بنعم و لای سلطان بقا در ظهور اخری منوط فرموده‌اند و حال ملیک غیب و شهود بر جمیع مشهود و بشأنی ضرّ بر وجود مبارکش وارد شده که اگر جمیع بحور غیب و شهود مداد شوند و کلّ من فی الملک اقلام و جمیع من فی السّموات و الأرض راقم البتّه از ذکرش عاجز شوند و ایکاش که از اهل ایمانش میشمردند فلعنة اللّه علی الظّالمین و المشرکین و مع‌ذلک بیان میخوانند و استکتاب مینمایند فربّ تالی بیان و البیان یلعنه و ربّ عامل فیه و العمل یبرأ منه و ربّ ذاکر و الذّکر یفرّ منه اعاذنا اللّه و ایّاکم یا ملأ الموحّدین من هؤلآء و شرّهم و مکرهم و خدعهم

Va shakkī nabūda ke Dhāt-i Qidam takallum namīnamāyad magar bi lisān-i maẓhar-i nafs-i khud va mushāhada namāyīd ke dar īn bayānāt chi miqdār khuḍūʿ az Maḥbūb-i imkān ẓāhir shuda ke jamīʿ-i Bayān va mā fīhi rā bi naʿam va lā-yi Sulṭān-i Baqā dar ẓuhūr-i ukhrā manūṭ farmūda-and va ḥāl Malīk-i ghayb va shuhūd bar jamīʿ mashhūd va bi shaʾnī ḍurr bar vujūd-i mubārakash vārid shuda ke agar jamīʿ-i buḥūr-i ghayb va shuhūd midād shavand va kull-i man fī al-mulk aqlām va jamīʿ-i man fī al-samāwāt wa al-arḍ rāqim albatta az dhikrash ʿājiz shavand va ay kāsh ke az ahl-i īmānash mīshumurdand. Fa-laʿnat Allāh ʿalā al-ẓālimīn wa al-mushrikīn. Va maʿa dhālik Bayān mīkհwānand va istiktāb mīnamāyand. Fa-rubba tālī Bayān wa al-Bayān yalʿanuhu wa rubba ʿāmil fīhi wa al-ʿamal yabraʾu minhu wa rubba dhākir wa al-dhikr yaf irru minhu. Aʿādhanā Allāh wa iyyākum yā malaʾ al-muwaḥḥidīn min hāʾulāʾ wa sharrihim wa makrihim wa khidaʿihim.

There has never been any doubt that the Ancient Essence speaks only through the tongue of the Manifestation of His own Self. Observe how much humility the Beloved of all existence has shown in these utterances: He has made the entire Bayán and all it contains dependent on the “Yes” or “No” of the Sovereign of eternity in the next Revelation. Now the King of the unseen and the seen is manifest to all, yet such suffering has befallen His blessed person that, were all the seas of the unseen and the seen to become ink, everyone in the world pens, and all who are in the heavens and on earth scribes, they would assuredly be powerless to describe it. If only they had counted Him among His own believers! May God’s curse be upon the oppressors and those who associate partners with Him. Nevertheless, they read the Bayán and have copies made of it. How many a reader of the Bayán is cursed by the Bayán itself! How many a person acts according to it, yet the very deed disowns him! How many a person makes mention, yet the Remembrance flees from him! May God protect us and you, O company of those who affirm His oneness, from these people, their evil, their scheming, and their deceits.

117

و هم‌چنین در مناجات با ملیک اسماء و صفات ذکر مینمایند فأسألک اللّهمّ بغنائک عن کلّ شیء ان تقبلنّ البیان و من فیه فانّی قد سمّیت کلّما قد ظهر منّی علی ذلک الاسم و جعلت کلّ ذلک کتاباً ورقاً من اوراق الحدایق الیک ان تقبلنّه یا محبوبی فانّ ذلک من ظهور فضلک و رحمتک و ان تردّنّه یا محبوبی فانّ ذلک من ظهور عدلک و غنآء ربوبیّتک انتهی

Va hamchunīn dar munājāt bā Malīk-i asmāʾ va ṣifāt dhikr mīnamāyand: «Fa-asʾaluka Allāhumma bi-ghināʾika ʿan kull shayʾ an taqbalanna al-Bayān wa man fīhi fa-innī qad sammaytu kullamā qad ẓahara minnī ʿalā dhālika al-ism wa jaʿaltu kulla dhālika kitāban waraqan min awrāq al-ḥadāʾiq ilayka an taqbalannahu yā maḥbūbī fa-inna dhālika min ẓuhūr faḍlika wa raḥmatika wa in taruddannahu yā maḥbūbī fa-inna dhālika min ẓuhūr ʿadlika wa ghināʾ rubūbiyyatika.» Intahā.

Likewise, in a prayer to the King of names and attributes, He says: “I ask You, O God, by Your independence of all things, to accept the Bayán and those within it, for I have called everything that has appeared from Me by that name and made all of it a book, a leaf among the leaves of the gardens offered to You. If You accept it, O my Beloved, that is a manifestation of Your grace and mercy; and if You reject it, O my Beloved, that is a manifestation of Your justice and the self-sufficiency of Your lordship.” Thus ends the quotation.

118

مع آنکه جمیع بیان بقول آن کینونت سبحان و طلعت رحمن منوط بوده حال به پست‌ترین خلق او مشغول و از جمالش محروم مانده‌اند فویل لهؤلآء ثمّ ویل لهؤلآء تاللّه ما یمرّنّ هؤلآء علی شیء الّا و انّه یستعیذ باللّه منه و یبرأ عنه و بلسان سرّه یقول یا ایّها المشرک الغافل بأیّ حجّة آمنت بظهور علیّ قبل نبیل و بأیّ برهان کفرت بحسین قبل علیّ لا یا ملعون تاللّه ما آمنت من قبل بأحد من رسل اللّه و لو آمنت فی عهد ذلک الایمان ما کان ایماناً حقیقیّاً بل کان شبحاً و لو کان علی التّحقیق ما کفرت بالّذی به حقّق رسالة کلّ رسول و بعث کلّ نبیّ و ایمان من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Maʿa ānke jamīʿ-i Bayān bi qawl-i ān Kaynūnat-i Subḥān va Ṭalʿat-i Raḥmān manūṭ būda ḥāl bi past-tarīn-i khalq-i ū mashghūl va az jamālash maḥrūm mānda-and. Fa-waylun li-hāʾulāʾ thumma waylun li-hāʾulāʾ. Ta-llāh mā yamurranna hāʾulāʾ ʿalā shayʾ illā wa innahu yastaʿīdhu bi-Allāh minhu wa yabraʾu ʿanhu wa bi-lisān sirrihi yaqūlu yā ayyuhā al-mushrik al-ghāfil bi-ayyi ḥujjatin āmanta bi-ẓuhūr ʿAlī qabla Nabīl wa bi-ayyi burhānin kafarta bi-Ḥusayn qabla ʿAlī. Lā yā malʿūn ta-llāh mā āmanta min qablu bi-aḥadin min rusul Allāh wa law āmanta fī ʿahdin dhālika al-īmān mā kāna īmānan ḥaqīqiyyan bal kāna shabaḥan wa law kāna ʿalā al-taḥqīq mā kafarta bi-alladhī bihi ḥuqqiqa risālat kull rasūl wa baʿth kull nabī wa īmān man fī al-samāwāt wa al-araḍīn.

Although the entire Bayán was made dependent on the word of that glorified Being and all-merciful Countenance, they are now occupied with the lowliest of His creatures and remain deprived of His beauty. Woe to these people, and again woe to them! By God! They pass by nothing that does not seek refuge in God from them and disown them, saying in its secret tongue, “O heedless one who associates partners with God! By what proof did you believe in the Revelation of ‘Alí before Nabíl, and by what demonstration did you disbelieve in Ḥusayn before ‘Alí? No, accursed one! By God! You never before believed in any of God’s Messengers. Even if you believed at some time, that faith was not true faith but a mere semblance. Had it been genuine, you would not have disbelieved in Him through whom the mission of every Messenger, the raising up of every Prophet, and the faith of all who are in the heavens and the earth have been established.”

119

ترجمهٴ این کلمات امنع صمدانی بلسان ابدع فارسی خالصاً لوجه اللّه ذکر میشود که شاید نفوسی از آلایش نفس و هوی پاک شده بسماء عزّ بقا که مقام عرفان نفس رحمن است عروج نمایند و له الأمر یهدی من یشآء الی جماله المقدّس المنیر

Tarjuma-yi īn kalimāt-i amnaʿ-i ṣamadānī bi lisān-i abdaʿ-i fārsī khāliṣan li-wajh Allāh dhikr mīshavad ke shāyad nufūsī az ālāyish-i nafs va havā pāk shuda bi samā-yi ʿizz-i baqā ke maqām-i ʿirfān-i Nafs-i Raḥmān ast ʿurūj namāyand. Wa lahu al-amr yahdī man yashāʾ ilā jamālihi al-muqaddas al-munīr.

A translation of these supremely exalted, eternal words into the wondrous Persian tongue is set forth solely for the sake of God, so that perhaps some souls may be cleansed of the defilement of self and desire and ascend to the heaven of everlasting glory, the station of recognizing the Self of the All-Merciful. His is the command; He guides whom He wills to His holy, radiant Beauty.

120

الیوم هر نفسی که از وجه معبود حقیقی اعراض نماید مرور نمینماید بر هیچ شیئی مگر آنکه بلسان سرّ میگوید ای مشرک باللّه بکدام حجّت و برهان بجمال رحمن در ظهور قبل ایمان آورده و بکدام دلیل از ملیک سبیل در این ظهور کافر شده قسم بآفتاب عزّ تقدیس که لم‌یزل کافر و مشرک بوده و اگر در عهدی اظهار ایمان نموده از روی حقیقت نبوده بلکه شبحی بوده در تو و در این ظهور اخذ شد دام الایمان فی الایمان و رجع الشّیطان الی مقرّه فی اسفل الجحیم و اگر ایمانت علی التّحقیق بود کافر نمیشدی بنفسی که باو محقّق شد رسالت کلّ رسل و بعث کلّ انبیا و ایمان جمیع آنچه در آسمانها و زمینها است

Al-yawm har nafsī ke az Vajh-i Maʿbūd-i Ḥaqīqī iʿrāḍ namāyad murūr namīnamāyad bar hīch shayʾī magar ānke bi lisān-i sirr mīgūyad ay mushrik bi-Allāh bi kudām ḥujjat va burhān bi Jamāl-i Raḥmān dar ẓuhūr-i qabl īmān āvarda va bi kudām dalīl az Malīk-i sabīl dar īn ẓuhūr kāfir shuda qasam bi āftāb-i ʿizz-i taqdīs ke lam-yazal kāfir va mushrik būda va agar dar ʿahdī iẓhār-i īmān namūda az rū-yi ḥaqīqat nabūda balke shabaḥī būda dar tu va dar īn ẓuhūr akhdh shud. Dāma al-īmān fī al-īmān wa rajaʿa al-shayṭān ilā maqarrihi fī asfal al-jaḥīm. Va agar īmānat ʿalā al-taḥqīq būd kāfir namīshudī bi nafsī ke bi ū muḥaqqaq shud risālat-i kull-i rusul va baʿth-i kull-i anbiyā va īmān-i jamīʿ-i ānchi dar āsimānhā va zamīnhā ast.

Today, any soul who turns away from the countenance of the true Object of worship passes by nothing that does not say in its secret tongue, “O you who associate partners with God! By what proof and demonstration did you believe in the Beauty of the All-Merciful in the previous Revelation, and on what grounds have you disbelieved in the King of the path in this Revelation? I swear by the Sun of the glory of holiness that you have always been an unbeliever and one who associates partners with God. If at any time you professed faith, it was not genuine; rather, it was a semblance within you, and in this Revelation it was taken away. Faith has remained in faith, and Satan has returned to his abode in the lowest depths of hell. Had your faith been genuine, you would not have disbelieved in the One through whom the mission of all Messengers, the raising up of all Prophets, and the faith of everything in the heavens and the earth have been established.”

121

ای عباد قدری بقلب طاهر و نظر انصاف در امر اللّه ملاحظه نمائید که شاید از حرم ربّانی محروم نشوید و از کعبهٴ قدس صمدانی ممنوع نگردید

Ay ʿibād qadrī bi qalb-i ṭāhir va naẓar-i inṣāf dar amr Allāh mulāḥaẓa namāyīd ke shāyad az ḥaram-i rabbānī maḥrūm nashavīd va az Kaʿba-yi quds-i ṣamadānī mamnūʿ nagardīd.

O servants! Consider the Cause of God for a while with a pure heart and an impartial eye, so that perhaps you may not be deprived of the divine sanctuary or barred from the Kaaba of eternal holiness.

122

ای علیّ اگرچه تو سائلی و جواب باسم تو مرقوم میشود ولکن بسیار مشکل بنظر میآید که الیوم مذعن بحقّ شوی و از کلّ ما ذکر فی اللّوح متذکّر گردی چه که قلبت بحجبات غلیظه محتجب شده و بصرت بسبحات لانهایه مستور ولکن نظر اللّه و لحظاته سرّاً بقلوب دیگر در این کلمات متوجّه است و عنقریب بقدرتی ظاهر شوند که جمیع ما سوی اللّه را در ظلّ خود مشاهده نمایند ولکن نظر بسبقت رحمت رحمانی و احاطهٴ فضل سبحانی باسم تو نازل شده لعلّ یأخذک نفحات ایّام اللّه و ینقطعک عن العالمین

Ay ʿAlī agarchi tu sāʾilī va javāb bi ism-i tu marqūm mīshavad va lākin bisyār mushkil bi naẓar mīāyad ke al-yawm mudhʿin bi Ḥaqq shavī va az kull-i mā dhukira fī al-lawḥ mutadhakkir gardī chi ke qalbat bi ḥujubāt-i ghalīẓa muḥtajib shuda va baṣarat bi subuḥāt-i lānihāya mastūr va lākin naẓar Allāh va laḥaẓātash sirran bi qulūb-i dīgar dar īn kalimāt mutavajjih ast va ʿan-qarīb bi qudratī ẓāhir shavand ke jamīʿ-i mā sivā Allāh rā dar ẓill-i khud mushāhada namāyand va lākin naẓar bi sabqat-i raḥmat-i raḥmānī va iḥāṭa-yi faḍl-i subḥānī bi ism-i tu nāzil shuda laʿalla yaʾkhudhuka nafaḥāt ayyām Allāh wa yanqaṭiʿuka ʿan al-ʿālamīn.

O ‘Alí! Although you are the questioner and the answer is written in your name, it seems most unlikely that today you will acknowledge the Truth and take heed of all that has been mentioned in the Tablet, for your heart is concealed by thick veils and your sight obscured by endless veils of glory. Yet in these words God’s gaze and glances are secretly directed toward other hearts. Before long they will arise with such power that they will behold everything other than God beneath their shadow. Nevertheless, because His all-merciful compassion precedes all things and His divine grace embraces all things, this has been revealed in your name, so that perhaps the breezes of the days of God may seize you and detach you from all the worlds.

123

بیانه جلّ احسانه لم یزل لتضربنّ المثل بالشّمس و ما دونها بالمرایا کلّ مرآة علی قدر ما تجلّت لها بها من نفسها الیها فاذاً یستدلّ علیها کلّ بها قائمون و لو یرفع عنها آیة الّتی قد تجلّت لها بها فیها فاذاً لم یکن فی المرآة من شیء یدلّ علی اللّه کذلک اذاً یرفع اللّه ما یرفع لن یحکمنّ من بعده بآیات افئدة النّاس ولو انّ کلّهم یقولون انّا باللّه و بآیاته موقنون ما شهد اللّه علیهم بما هم فیه ینطقون

Bayānuhu jalla iḥsānuhu: «Lam yazal la-taḍribanna al-mathal bi-l-shams wa mā dūnahā bi-l-marāyā kull mirʾāt ʿalā qadr mā tajallat lahā bihā min nafsihā ilayhā fa-idhan yustadallu ʿalayhā kullun bihā qāʾimūn wa law yurfaʿu ʿanhā āyat allatī qad tajallat lahā bihā fīhā fa-idhan lam yakun fī al-mirʾāt min shayʾ yadullu ʿalā Allāh kadhālika idhan yarfaʿu Allāh mā yarfaʿu lan yuḥkamanna min baʿdihi bi-āyāt afʾidat al-nās wa law anna kullahum yaqūlūna innā bi-Allāh wa bi-āyātihi mūqinūn mā shahida Allāh ʿalayhim bi-mā hum fīhi yanṭiqūn.»

His utterance—exalted be His beneficence: “You will always draw the comparison with the sun, and with mirrors for all that is other than it. Each mirror, according to the measure in which the sun has shone upon it through it, from itself toward it, then serves as evidence of the sun: all subsist through it. Were the sign through which it has shone upon the mirror, through it and within it, to be removed from it, there would then be nothing in the mirror that points to God. Likewise, when God removes what He removes, no judgment thereafter shall be based on the signs in people’s hearts. Even if they all say, ‘We are certain of God and His signs,’ God has not borne witness to them concerning what they utter.”

124

ای مدهوشان خمر اوهام بشنوید ندای ربّ علیّ اعلی را که در این کلمات بالغه و آیات محکمهٴ متقنه مرتفع شده که شاید بر خود و انفس عباد رحم نموده بر سدرهٴ امریّهٴ الهیّه احجار ظنّیّهٴ بغضیّه میندازید و اگر هم خود مهتدی نشوید عباد را از شریعهٴ ربّ الایجاد در این ایّام شداد محروم نسازید میفرمایند کلّ مرآتند و حاکیند از شمس باندازه و مقام خود علی قدر تجلّی شمس در آن مرآت بنفس مرآت در این وقت استدلال میشود باینکه کلّ بشمس قائم و موجودند و اگر اخذ شود آیهٴ تجلّی شمس که در مرآت بنفس مرآت تجلّی فرموده باقی نمیماند در مرآت شیئی تا دلالت کند بر مجلّی و خالق خود

Ay madhūshān-i khamr-i awhām bishnavīd nidā-yi Rabb-i ʿAliyy-i Aʿlā rā ke dar īn kalimāt-i bāligha va āyāt-i muḥkama-yi mutqana murtafiʿ shuda ke shāyad bar khud va anfus-i ʿibād raḥm namūda bar Sidra-yi amriyya-yi ilāhiyya aḥjār-i ẓanniyya-yi baghḍiyya mayandāzīd va agar ham khud muhtadī nashavīd ʿibād rā az sharīʿa-yi Rabb al-ījād dar īn ayyām-i shidād maḥrūm nasāzīd. Mīfarmāyand kull mirʾātand va ḥākī-and az shams bi andāza va maqām-i khud ʿalā qadr-i tajallī-yi shams dar ān mirʾāt bi nafs-i mirʾāt dar īn vaqt istidlāl mīshavad bi īnke kull bi shams qāʾim va mawjūdand va agar akhdh shavad āya-yi tajallī-yi shams ke dar mirʾāt bi nafs-i mirʾāt tajallī farmūda bāqī namīmānad dar mirʾāt shayʾī tā dalālat kunad bar mujallī va khāliq-i khud.

O you who are stupefied by the wine of delusions! Hear the call of the Lord, the Exalted, the Most High, raised in these compelling words and these firm, unassailable verses, so that perhaps you may have mercy on yourselves and on the souls of His servants and cease casting stones of conjecture and hatred at the divine Lote-Tree of the Cause. Even if you yourselves are not guided, do not deprive His servants of the water’s edge of the Lord of creation in these grievous days. He says that all are mirrors and reflect the sun according to their own measure and station. In proportion to the sun’s shining in that mirror, the mirror itself then serves as evidence that all subsist and exist through the sun. If the sign of the sun’s radiance, which has shone in the mirror through the mirror itself, is taken away, nothing remains in the mirror to point to the One who illumines and creates it.

125

و با این کلمات محکمهٴ غیر متشابههٴ بالغه اهل بیان شبهه نموده‌اند که چگونه میشود مرآت از تجلّی انوار شمس محروم ماند و در این رتبه بشأنی توقّف نموده‌اند که ذکر آن ممکن نه و بر نفسی که از یک تجلّی از انوار اسم انورش صدهزار مرایا مستضیء و مستنور میشوند و از یک تجلّی اسم آخذش کلّ بحدود نفس خود مردود اعتراض مینمایند و از جمالش اعراض و بعد از اشراق شمس جمال در قطب زوال میگویند انوار و دلیلش چیست

Va bā īn kalimāt-i muḥkama-yi ghayr-i mutashābiha-yi bāligha ahl-i Bayān shubha namūda-and ke chigūna mīshavad mirʾāt az tajallī-yi anvār-i shams maḥrūm mānad va dar īn rutba bi shaʾnī tavaqquf namūda-and ke dhikr-i ān mumkin na va bar nafsī ke az yak tajallī az anvār-i ism-i anvarash ṣad-hazār marāyā mustaḍīʾ va mustanīr mīshavand va az yak tajallī-yi ism-i Ākhidhash kull bi ḥudūd-i nafs-i khud mardūd iʿtirāḍ mīnamāyand va az jamālash iʿrāḍ va baʿd az ishrāq-i shams-i jamāl dar quṭb-i zavāl mīgūyand anvār va dalīlash chīst.

Despite these firm, unambiguous, compelling words, the people of the Bayán have raised the objection: how can a mirror be deprived of the radiance of the sun’s light? They have become so arrested at this point that it is impossible to describe. They object to the One through a single radiance of whose most luminous name a hundred thousand mirrors are illumined and made radiant, and through a single radiance of whose name, the Withholder, all are cast back within the limits of their own selves. They turn away from His beauty, and after the Sun of beauty has risen, they remain at the point of its setting and ask, “Where are its rays, and what is its proof?”

126

ای بی‌خبران سر از نوم غفلت بردارید و انوارش که عالم را احاطه نموده مشاهده کنید بعضی میگویند زود اشراق نموده ای بی‌بصران یا قریب و یا بعید حال اشراق فرموده شما ملاحظه نمائید فی‌الحقیقه این اشراق محقّق است یا نه دیگر قرب و بعد آن در دست شما و این غلام نبوده و نخواهد بود حکمت الهیّه که از انظر بریّه مستور است اقتضا نموده یا قوم فارضوا بما رضی اللّه لکم و قضی علیکم

Ey bī-khabarān, sar az nowm-e ghaflat bardārīd va anvārash ke ʿālam rā eḥāṭe namūde moshāhede konīd. Baʿżī mīgūyand zūd eshrāq namūde. Ey bī-baṣarān, yā qarīb va yā baʿīd, ḥāl eshrāq farmūde; shomā molāḥeẓe namāyīd fī al-ḥaqīqe īn eshrāq moḥaqqaq ast yā na. Dīgar qorb va boʿd-e ān dar dast-e shomā va īn gholām nabūde va nakhāhad būd. Ḥekmat-e elāhiyye ke az [corrupted text] bariyye mastūr ast eqteżā namūde. Yā qawm, fa-rḍaw bi-mā raḍiya Allāhu lakum wa-qaḍā ʿalaykum.

O heedless ones! Raise your heads from the sleep of negligence and behold His lights, which have encompassed the world. Some say, “He has shone forth too soon.” O you who lack sight! Whether sooner or later, He has now shone forth. Consider whether this radiance is indeed real or not. Its being sooner or later has never been, and will never be, in your hands or those of this Youth. Divine wisdom, which is hidden from the [corrupted original text] of humankind, has required it. O people, be content with what God has willed for you and decreed for you.

127

فواللّه لو کان الأمر بیدی ما اظهرت نفسی ابداً

Fa-wa-Allāhi law kāna al-amru bi-yadī mā aẓhartu nafsī abadan.

By God, had the matter been in My hands, I would never have revealed Myself.

128

ای صاحبان بغضا قسم بآفتاب فلک بقا که اگر امر بدست این عبد بود هرگز خود را معروف نمینمودم چه که اسم مذکورم ننگ دارد از ذکر این السن غیر طاهرهٴ کاذبه و در هر حین که ساکن شده و صمت اختیار نمودم روح القدس از یمینم ناطق شده و روح الأعظم قدّام وجهم و روح الأمین فوق رأسم و روح البهآء در صدرم ندا فرموده و حال اگر بسمع لطیف استماع شود از جمیع اعضا و احشا و عروق و اظفار ندآء اللّه را استماع نمائید حتّی از شعراتم میشنوید بأنّه لا اله الّا هو و انّ هذا الجمال لبهائه لمن فی السّموات و الأرضین

Ey ṣāḥebān-e baghżā, qasam be-āftāb-e falak-e baqā ke agar amr be-dast-e īn ʿabd būd hargez khod rā maʿrūf nemīnamūdam, che ke esm-e madhkūram nang dārad az dhekr-e īn alson-e gheyr-e ṭāhere-ye kādhebe. Va dar har ḥīn ke sāken shode va ṣamt ekhtiyār namūdam Rūḥ al-Qudus az yamīnam nāṭeq shode va Rūḥ al-Aʿẓam qoddām-e vajham va Rūḥ al-Amīn fowq-e raʾsam va Rūḥ al-Bahāʾ dar ṣadram nedā farmūde. Va ḥāl agar be-samʿ-e laṭīf estemāʿ shavad az jamīʿ-e aʿżā va aḥshā va ʿorūq va aẓfār nedā-ye Allāh rā estemāʿ namāyīd, ḥattā az shaʿarātam mīshenavīd bi-annahu lā ilāha illā Huwa wa-inna hādhā al-jamāla la-bahāʾuhu li-man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn.

O bearers of hatred! I swear by the Sun of the heaven of eternity that, had the matter been in the hands of this servant, I would never have made Myself known, for My name is ashamed to be mentioned by these impure, lying tongues. Whenever I have remained still and chosen silence, the Holy Spirit has spoken at My right hand, the Most Great Spirit before My face, the Faithful Spirit above My head, and the Spirit of Glory within My breast.
