And now, if you listen with a discerning ear, you will hear the call of God from all My limbs, My inmost parts, My veins, and My nails. Even from My hairs you will hear that there is no God but Him, and that this Beauty is indeed His glory for all who are in the heavens and on the earth.

129

و لو کان هذا ذنبی تاللّه هذا لیس من عندی بل من لدن من ارسلنی و بعثنی بالحقّ و جعلنی سراجاً للعالمین ای قوم فواللّه رایحهٴ صدق از کذب بسی معلوم و واضح است مپسندید بر نفس حقّ آنچه بر خود نمی‌پسندید آخر قدری تأمّل نمائید مقصود این غلام در این آخر ایّام در این سجن کبری چه بوده و چه خواهد بود فتأمّلوا یا ملأ الغافلین

Wa-law kāna hādhā dhanbī, ta-Allāhi hādhā laysa min ʿindī bal min ladun man arsalanī wa-baʿathanī bi-al-ḥaqqi wa-jaʿalanī sirājan li-al-ʿālamīn. Ey qawm, fa-wa-Allāh rāyeḥe-ye ṣedq az kedhb basī maʿlūm va vāżeḥ ast. Mapasandīd bar nafs-e Ḥaqq ānche bar khod nemīpasandīd. Ākher qadrī taʾammol namāyīd, maqṣūd-e īn gholām dar īn ākher-e ayyām dar īn sejn-e kobrā che būde va che khāhad būd. Fa-taʾammalū yā malaʾa al-ghāfilīn.

And if this is My sin, by God, it is not of My own doing, but comes from the One who sent Me, raised Me up in truth, and made Me a lamp for the worlds. O people! By God, the fragrance of truthfulness is readily and clearly distinguished from falsehood. Do not wish for the True One Himself what you do not wish for yourselves. Reflect a little, after all: what has been, and what will be, the purpose of this Youth in these latter days in this Most Great Prison? Reflect, O assembly of the heedless!

130

یا قوم فاستحیوا عن اللّه و لا تشکّوا فی امره و لا تسأل الدّلیل عن الشّمس و اشراقها لأنّ دلیلها هو ضیائها و انوارها و انّک لا تکن مریباً فی ظهورها لأنّها اشرقت و لا مردّ لها بل فاسأل اللّه بأن یفتح بصرک لتدرک انوارها الّتی احاطت الکونین قل تاللّه قد رقم قلم القدس من رحیق المسک علی جبینی البیضآء بخطّ ابهی

Yā qawm, fa-staḥyū ʿan Allāhi wa-lā tashukkū fī amrihi wa-lā tasʾal al-dalīla ʿan al-shamsi wa-ishrāqihā li-anna dalīlahā huwa ḍiyāʾuhā wa-anwāruhā wa-innaka lā takun murīban fī ẓuhūrihā li-annahā ashraqat wa-lā maradda lahā bal fa-sʾal Allāha bi-an yaftaḥa baṣaraka li-tudrika anwārahā allatī aḥāṭat al-kawnayn. Qul ta-Allāhi qad raqama qalamu al-qudsi min raḥīqi al-miski ʿalā jabīnī al-bayḍāʾi bi-khaṭṭin abhā.

O people! Feel shame before God and do not doubt His Cause. Do not ask for proof of the sun and its shining, for its proof is its radiance and its light. Do not doubt its appearance, for it has risen and cannot be turned back. Rather, ask God to open your sight so that you may perceive its lights, which have encompassed both worlds. Say: By God, the Pen of Holiness has inscribed upon My radiant brow, with the pure essence of musk, in a most glorious script:

131

ان یا ملأ الأرض و السّمآء انّ هذا لهو المحبوب الّذی ما شهدت عین الابداع مثله و لا عین الاختراع شبهه و انّه لهو الّذی قرّت بجماله عین اللّه الملک العزیز الجمیل حدیث قبل است که صفحه‌ئی از توریة در دست یکی از اصحاب رسول اللّه بود حضرت فرمود چه در دست داری عرض نمود توریة فرمود بگذار آن را اگر میبود صاحب آن اطاعت مینمود مرا حال ملاحظه کن کتاب الهی که امر کلّ از نبیّ و حروفات و مرایا و ابواب و ارکان باو محقّق و ثابت شده اخذ آن و قرائت آن ممنوع شود جایز ولکن تبدیل یکی از مرایا علی زعمکم که بوجود حروفاتی محقّق شده که آن حروفات بکتاب ثابت و محقّق شده‌اند جایز نه فویل لکم تقولون ما لا تشعرون و تحسبون انّکم مهتدون کما یظنّون ملل القبل و بذلک یفرحون تاللّه لا عاصم لأحد من امر اللّه الّا بأن ینقطع عن کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض و یتوجّه الی اللّه المهیمن القیّوم نظر را مطهّر ساخته تا جمیع اشیاء را الیوم در صقع واحد مشاهده کنید و انوار شمس تقدیس را از افق قمیص بچشم و بصر ظاهر و باطن مشاهده نمائید

An yā malaʾa al-arḍi wa-al-samāʾ, inna hādhā la-huwa al-maḥbūbu alladhī mā shahidat ʿaynu al-ibdāʿi mithlahu wa-lā ʿaynu al-ikhtirāʿi shibhahu wa-innahu la-huwa alladhī qarrat bi-jamālihi ʿaynu Allāhi al-maliki al-ʿazīzi al-jamīl. Ḥadīth-e qabl ast ke ṣafḥeʾī az Towrāt dar dast-e yekī az aṣḥāb-e Rasūl Allāh būd. Ḥażrat farmūd che dar dast dārī? ʿArż namūd Towrāt. Farmūd begoẕār ān rā; agar mībūd ṣāḥeb-e ān eṭāʿat mīnamūd marā. Ḥāl molāḥeẓe kon, ketāb-e elāhī ke amr-e koll az nabī va ḥorūfāt va marāyā va abvāb va arkān be-ū moḥaqqaq va thābet shode, akhdh-e ān va qerāʾat-e ān mamnūʿ shavad jāyez, va-lāken tabdīl-e yekī az marāyā ʿalā zaʿmekom ke be-vojūd-e ḥorūfātī moḥaqqaq shode ke ān ḥorūfāt be-ketāb thābet va moḥaqqaq shode-and jāyez na. Fa-waylun lakum taqūlūna mā lā tashʿurūna wa-taḥsabūna annakum muhtadūna kamā yaẓunnūna milalu al-qabli wa-bi-dhālika yafraḥūn. Ta-Allāhi lā ʿāṣima li-aḥadin min amri Allāhi illā bi-an yanqaṭiʿa ʿan kulli man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍi wa-yatawajjaha ilā Allāhi al-muhaymini al-qayyūm. Naẓar rā moṭahhar sākhte tā jamīʿ-e ashyā rā al-yowm dar ṣoqʿ-e vāḥed moshāhede konīd va anvār-e shams-e taqdīs rā az ofoq-e qamīṣ be-chashm va baṣar-e ẓāher va bāṭen moshāhede namāyīd.

“O assembly of earth and heaven! This is indeed the Beloved, whose like the eye of creation has never beheld, nor has the eye of origination seen His equal. He is indeed the One in whose beauty the eye of God, the King, the Almighty, the Beautiful, has found delight.” There is an earlier tradition that one of the companions of the Messenger of God held a page of the Torah in his hand. He asked, “What do you have in your hand?” The companion replied, “The Torah.” He said, “Put it down. If its author were here, he would obey Me.” Now consider: you deem it permissible to forbid taking up and reading the Book of God, through which the authority of all—Prophet, Letters, Mirrors, Gates, and Pillars—has been established and confirmed. Yet you deem it impermissible to change one of the Mirrors, whose standing, by your own account, was established through the existence of Letters whose own standing was confirmed and established through the Book. Woe to you! You say what you do not understand and suppose that you are rightly guided, just as the religious communities of the past suppose, and in this they rejoice. By God, no one has any protection from the command of God unless they detach themselves from everyone in the heavens and on earth and turn toward God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Purify your vision so that today you may behold all things on a single plane and, with both your outward and inward eyes and sight, behold the lights of the Sun of holiness shining from the horizon of the robe.

132

و از جمیع این براهین گذشته در میرزا اسداللّه که نقطهٴ اولی جلّ ذکره باو خطاب فرموده ان یا مظهر الأحدیّة حال انصاف دهید کسی که محلّ ظهور سلطان احدیّه باشد بقول اللّه چگونه ابوالشّرور مینامید و اگر بگوئید این شأن را مرآت از او نفی نمود بر فرض جواز آن حال اگر نفس نقطه قمیص قبول را از مرآتی از مرایا انتزاع فرماید چه اعتراض بر آن جمال قدم وارد و اگر بگوئید از کجا محقّق شده که این نقطهٴ مشهوده و کلمهٴ جامعه در ادّعای خود صادق باشد میگوئیم بهمان حجّت و برهان که از ظهور قبلم کلّما ظهر من عنده و نزّل من لدنه را مسلّم داشته‌اید حال بهمان حجّت و برهان ناظر شوید و بخواهید ان رأیتم لا تکفروا باللّه الّذی خلقکم بأمره ان انتم من المنصفین و هم‌چنین به اسداللّه میفرماید ان یا حرف الثّالث المؤمن بمن یظهره اللّه جلّ اجلاله

Va az jamīʿ-e īn barāhīn goẕashte, dar Mīrzā Asad Allāh ke Noqṭe-ye Ūlā jalla dhikruhu be-ū kheṭāb farmūde, an yā maẓhara al-aḥadiyya, ḥāl enṣāf dehīd: kasī ke maḥall-e ẓohūr-e solṭān-e aḥadiyye bāshad be-qowl-e Allāh chegūne Abu al-Shorūr mīnāmīd? Va agar begūyīd īn shaʾn rā merʾāt az ū nafy namūd, bar farż-e javāz-e ān, ḥāl agar nafs-e Noqṭe qamīṣ-e qabūl rā az merʾātī az marāyā entezāʿ farmāyad che eʿterāż bar ān Jamāl-e Qedam vāred? Va agar begūyīd az kojā moḥaqqaq shode ke īn Noqṭe-ye mashhūde va Kaleme-ye Jāmeʿe dar eddeʿā-ye khod ṣādeq bāshad, mīgūyīm be-hamān ḥojjat va borhān ke az ẓohūr-e qablam kulla mā ẓahara min ʿindihi wa-nuzzila min ladunhu rā mosallam dāshte-īd, ḥāl be-hamān ḥojjat va borhān nāẓer shavīd va bekhāhīd. In raʾaytum lā takfurū bi-Allāhi alladhī khalaqakum bi-amrihi in antum min al-munṣifīn. Va ham-chenīn be Asad Allāh mīfarmāyad, an yā ḥarfa al-thālithi al-muʾmina bi-man yuẓhiruhu Allāh, jalla ijlāluhu.

Apart from all these proofs, consider Mírzá Asadu’lláh, whom the Primal Point—exalted be His mention—addressed as “O Manifestation of Oneness!” Now judge fairly: how can you call someone who, according to the word of God, is the place where the Sovereign of Oneness is manifested, “the Father of Evils”? If you say that the Mirror deprived him of this station, then, assuming that this is permissible, what objection can be raised against that Ancient Beauty if the Point Himself now strips one of the Mirrors of the robe of acceptance? And if you ask how it has been established that this visible Point and all-embracing Word is truthful in His claim, We say: through the very same proof and evidence by which you have accepted everything that appeared from Me and was sent down by Me in My previous revelation. Now look for and seek that same proof and evidence. If you see it, do not disbelieve in God, who created you by His command, if you are fair-minded. He likewise says to Asadu’lláh: “O Letter of the Third, who believes in Him whom God will make manifest—exalted be His majesty!”

133

و هم‌چنین در رسالهٴ جفریّه که مخصوص او از سماء هویّه نازل شده در صدر رساله مکتوب و هذه صورته ما نزّل لحضرة الأسد و الفرد الأحد المستشرق بالنّور الصّمد اسم اللّه الدّیّان للّه الواحد المعتمد و بعد میفرماید جلّ ذکره ان یا اسم الدّیّان هذا علم مکنون مخزون قد اودعناک و اتیناک عزّاً من عند اللّه اذ عین فؤادک لطیف تعرف قدره و تعزّ بهائه و بعد میفرماید عزّ قدره ان یا اسم الأجلّ لا تنظر الی ذلک الخلق الّا بمثل اغنام یذهبه راعیه کیف یشآء و من‌دون آنچه ذکر شده کلمات قدس صمدانیّه که در توصیف او نازل در کتاب موجود فانظروا الیه و این بنده نظر باختصار ذکر ننموده ای اکمهٴ وجود بصر بگشا

Va ham-chenīn dar Resāle-ye Jafriyye ke makhṣūṣ-e ū az samā-ye hoviyye nāzel shode, dar ṣadr-e resāle maktūb, wa-hādhihi ṣūratuhu: mā nuzzila li-ḥaḍrati al-asadi wa-al-fardi al-aḥadi al-mustashriqi bi-al-nūri al-ṣamadi ismi Allāhi al-Dayyāni li-llāhi al-wāḥidi al-muʿtamad. Va baʿd mīfarmāyad jalla dhikruhu, an yā isma al-Dayyān, hādhā ʿilmun maknūnun makhzūnun qad awdaʿnāka wa-ātaynāka ʿizzan min ʿindi Allāhi idh ʿaynu fuʾādika laṭīfun taʿrifu qadrahu wa-tuʿizzu bahāʾahu. Va baʿd mīfarmāyad ʿazza qadruhu, an yā isma al-ajall, lā tanẓur ilā dhālika al-khalqi illā bi-mithli aghnāmin yudhhibuhu rāʿīhi kayfa yashāʾ. Va men-dūn-e ānche dhekr shode kalemāt-e qods-e ṣamadāniyye ke dar towṣīf-e ū nāzel dar ketāb mowjūd, fa-nẓurū ilayhi. Va īn bande naẓar be-ekhteṣār dhekr nanamūde. Ey akmah-e vojūd, baṣar bogshā.

Likewise, in the Treatise of Jafr, which was sent down especially for him from the heaven of the divine Essence, the following is written at the beginning of the treatise: “What has been sent down for His Honor the Lion, the Single, the One, illumined by the everlasting Light, the Name of God, the Judge, for God, the One, the Relied-Upon.” He then says—exalted be His mention: “O Name of the Judge! This is a hidden, treasured knowledge that We have entrusted to you, and We have bestowed upon you an honor from God, for the eye of your heart is discerning: you know its worth and cherish its splendor.” He then says—exalted be His station: “O most exalted Name! Regard these people only as sheep that their shepherd drives wherever he wills.” Besides what has been mentioned, words of everlasting holiness revealed in his praise are found in the Book; consult it. This servant has not quoted them for the sake of brevity. O you who are blind from birth in the realm of existence, open your eyes!

134

و ملاحظه بوهم خود نما که همان فعلی را که خود مرتکبی و بآن عامل حال از آن متعجّب و متحیّر مانده چنانچه دیّان را دنی میگوئی و فرد الأحد که از اعظم اسماء الهی بوده ابوالشّرور نامیده و مع‌ذلک اعتراض بر سلطان یفعل ما یشآء نموده که چگونه میشود حلو مرّ شود و یا مرآت حجر گردد با اینکه اسداللّه انکار حقّ ننمود و حین ورود مدینة‌اللّه بین یدی العرش حاضر و بآنچه اهل بیان در آن یوم بآن مقرّ بوده‌اند اقرار نموده و مع‌ذلک ورد علیه ما ورد بلکه اکتفا باو وحده ننموده بر جمعی حکم قتل جاری نموده کتاب مستیقظ موجود ملاحظه نمائید

Va molāḥeẓe be-vahm-e khod namā ke hamān feʿlī rā ke khod mortakebī va be-ān ʿāmel ḥāl az ān motaʿajjeb va motaḥayyer mānde, chenānche Dayyān rā danī mīgūʾī va Fard al-Aḥad ke az aʿẓam-e asmā-ye elāhī būde Abu al-Shorūr nāmīde va maʿa-dhālek eʿterāż bar Solṭān-e yafʿalu mā yashāʾ namūde ke chegūne mīshavad ḥolv morr shavad va yā merʾāt ḥajar gardad. Bā īnke Asad Allāh enkār-e Ḥaqq nanamūd va ḥīn-e vorūd-e Madīnat Allāh bayn-e yaday-e ʿarsh ḥāżer va be-ānche ahl-e Bayān dar ān yowm be-ān moqerr būde-and eqrār namūde va maʿa-dhālek warada ʿalayhi mā warad. Balke ektefā be-ū vaḥdeh nanamūde bar jamʿī ḥokm-e qatl jārī namūde. Ketāb-e Mostayqeẓ mowjūd, molāḥeẓe namāyīd.

Consider your own delusion: you now stand astonished and bewildered at the very act that you yourself commit and practice. You call Dayyán “base” and have named the Single, the One—one of the greatest names of God—“the Father of Evils.” Yet you object to the Sovereign who does whatever He wills, asking how the sweet can become bitter or a mirror turn to stone. Asadu’lláh, however, did not deny the True One. On arriving in the City of God, he entered the presence of the Throne and acknowledged what the people of the Bayán acknowledged on that day. Nevertheless, there befell him what befell him. Nor did you content yourself with him alone: you pronounced a death sentence against a number of people. The book Mustayqiẓ is available; consult it.

135

قسم بآفتاب معانی که در آن کتاب بر کلّ مظاهر احدیّه فتوای قتل داده شده با آنکه حکم قتل بالمرّه از بیان و اهل آن مرتفع شده بنصّ منزل بیان یک دو افترا بآن بیچاره زده‌اند و حکم قتل جاری نموده‌اند من غیر اذن اللّه و ربّ مقتول شعر منه خیر من الف قاتلیه چنانچه حال بر جمال احدیّه ظلم باین واضحی و مبرهنی وارد و بقتلش قیام نموده‌اند مع‌ذلک باطراف نوشته و چه ظلمها که بجوهر عدل و منبع و معدن آن نسبت داده که شاید غلّ و بغضا در صدور بعضی از متوهّمین القا نماید ولکن غافل از آنکه و للّه تحت ظلال اسمه البصیر عباد یشقّنّ الشّعر بالشّعر و لن یمنع ابصارهم حجبات العالمین

Qasam be-āftāb-e maʿānī ke dar ān ketāb bar koll-e maẓāher-e aḥadiyye fatvā-ye qatl dāde shode, bā ānke ḥokm-e qatl be-al-marre az Bayān va ahl-e ān mortafeʿ shode be-naṣṣ-e Monzel-e Bayān. Yek do efterā be-ān bīchāre zade-and va ḥokm-e qatl jārī namūde-and min ghayri idhni Allāh. Wa-rubba maqtūlin shaʿrun minhu khayrun min alfi qātilīhi. Chenānche ḥāl bar Jamāl-e Aḥadiyye ẓolm be-īn vāżeḥī va mobarhanī vāred va be-qatlash qiyām namūde-and, maʿa-dhālek be-aṭrāf neveshte va che ẓolmhā ke be-Jowhar-e ʿAdl va manbaʿ va maʿdan-e ān nesbat dāde ke shāyad ghell va baghżā dar ṣodūr-e baʿżī az motavahhemīn elqā namāyad, va-lāken ghāfel az ānke wa-li-llāhi taḥta ẓilāli ismihi al-baṣīri ʿibādun yashaqqanna al-shaʿra bi-al-shaʿri wa-lan yamnaʿa abṣārahum ḥujubātu al-ʿālamīn.

I swear by the Sun of inner meanings that in that book a sentence of death has been issued against all the manifestations of Oneness, even though the death penalty has been entirely removed from the Bayán and its people by the explicit text of the Revealer of the Bayán. They have leveled one or two false accusations against that hapless man and pronounced a death sentence without God’s permission. How many a slain person has a single hair worth more than a thousand of his killers! Thus, even now, they have inflicted such evident and manifest injustice upon the Beauty of Oneness and have risen to kill Him. Yet they have written far and wide, attributing so many injustices to the very Essence of justice, its Source and Wellspring, hoping perhaps to instill malice and hatred in the hearts of some who are prey to delusions. But they are unaware that God has servants beneath the shadow of His name, the All-Seeing, who split a hair with a hair, and whose sight the veils of all the worlds will never obstruct.

136

و هم‌چنین به سیّد ابرهیم میفرمایند عزّ ذکره ان یا خلیلی فی الصّحف ان یا ذکری فی الکتب من بعد الصّحف ان یا اسمی فی البیان الی آخر ما نزّل این بیان الهی که در ذکر او از قلم قدس صمدانی جاری شده و حال به ابوالدّواهی مشهور شده با اینکه خود افتخار مینمایند که بذکر اللّه فی العالمین در کتب الهی ذکر شده‌اند و نفسی که بخلیل در صحف الهیّه و بذکر اللّه در کتب منزله و باسم اللّه در بیان متّسم شده به ابوالدّواهی تعبیر مینمایند و در دونش که اعتراض از نفس مشیّة اللّه و عظمته نموده تغییر جایز نمیدانند قدرت الهی را مثل قدرت خود فرض گرفته‌اند و قلم اعلی را معطّل دانسته‌اند

Va ham-chenīn be Seyyed Ebrāhīm mīfarmāyand ʿazza dhikruhu, an yā khalīlī fī al-ṣuḥufi an yā dhikrī fī al-kutubi min baʿdi al-ṣuḥufi an yā ismī fī al-Bayān, ilā ākhiri mā nuzzil. Īn bayān-e elāhī ke dar dhekr-e ū az qalam-e qods-e ṣamadānī jārī shode va ḥāl be Abu al-Davāhī mashhūr shode, bā īnke khod eftekhār mīnamāyand ke be-Dhekr Allāh fī al-ʿālamīn dar kotob-e elāhī dhekr shode-and. Va nafsī ke be-Khalīl dar ṣoḥof-e elāhiyye va be-Dhekr Allāh dar kotob-e monzale va be-Esm Allāh dar Bayān mottasem shode be-Abu al-Davāhī taʿbīr mīnamāyand, va dar dūnash ke eʿterāż az nafs-e Mashiyyat Allāh va ʿaẓamat-e ū namūde taghyīr jāyez nemīdānand. Qodrat-e elāhī rā methl-e qodrat-e khod farż gerefte-and va Qalam-e Aʿlā rā moʿaṭṭal dāneste-and.

Likewise, He says to Siyyid Ibráhím—exalted be His mention: “O My Friend in the Scriptures! O My Remembrance in the Books after the Scriptures! O My Name in the Bayán!”—and so on to the end of what was revealed. Such is the divine utterance that flowed from the Pen of everlasting holiness in his mention; yet he has now become known as “the Father of Calamities,” even though they themselves take pride in having been mentioned in the divine Books as “the Remembrance of God among the worlds.” They call someone designated as the Friend in the divine Scriptures, the Remembrance of God in the revealed Books, and the Name of God in the Bayán “the Father of Calamities.” Yet in the case of one beneath him, who has objected to the very Will of God and His greatness, they consider change impermissible. They have supposed divine power to be like their own power and have regarded the Most Exalted Pen as idle.

137

قسم بمظلومیّتم که قلم قدرت کلّ حین در محو و اثبات مشغول و لا یعقل ذلک الّا المنقطعون کذلک یمحو الرّحمن ما یشآء و یثبت و عنده امّ البیان و عجب از این نفوس که باین اسماء افتخار مینمایند و از حقّ معرض گشته‌اند بلی این اذکار و اوصاف در هر نفسی موجود مادامی که از حصن امر اللّه خارج نشده‌اند والّا لیس لهم قدر عند اللّه علی قدر سواد عین نملة میّتة و از این گذشته کلّ اشیاء ذکر اللّه فی العالمین بوده و خواهند بود چه که کلّ اشیاء بکینونتها اسم اللّه بوده و اسم او تعالی شأنه ذکر او بوده بین عباد و لم‌یزل چنین بوده و لایزال چنین خواهد بود

Qasam be-maẓlūmiyyatam ke qalam-e qodrat koll-e ḥīn dar maḥv va ethbāt mashghūl, wa-lā yaʿqilu dhālika illā al-munqaṭiʿūn. Kadhālika yamḥū al-Raḥmānu mā yashāʾu wa-yuthbitu wa-ʿindahu Ummu al-Bayān. Va ʿajab az īn nofūs ke be-īn asmā eftekhār mīnamāyand va az Ḥaqq moʿreż gashte-and. Balī īn adhkār va owṣāf dar har nafsī mowjūd mā-dāmī ke az ḥeṣn-e Amr Allāh khārej nashode-and, va-illā laysa lahum qadrun ʿinda Allāhi ʿalā qadri sawādi ʿayni namlatin mayyita. Va az īn goẕashte koll-e ashyā Dhekr Allāh fī al-ʿālamīn būde va khāhand būd, che ke koll-e ashyā bi-kaynūnatihā Esm Allāh būde va esm-e ū taʿālā shaʾnuhu dhekr-e ū būde bayn-e ʿebād, va lam-yazal chenīn būde va lā-yazāl chenīn khāhad būd.

I swear by the wrongs I have suffered that the Pen of power is at every moment engaged in effacing and confirming, and none understands this except those who are detached. Thus the All-Merciful effaces whatever He wills and confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Bayán. How astonishing are these people who take pride in these names yet have turned away from the True One! Yes, these designations and attributes remain in each soul so long as they have not left the stronghold of the Cause of God. Otherwise, they have no worth before God, not even as much as the black of a dead ant’s eye. Beyond this, all things have been and will be the Remembrance of God among the worlds, for all things, by their very being, are the Name of God, and His name—exalted be His glory—is His remembrance among His servants. So it has ever been, and so it will ever remain.

138

فوالّذی تفرّد بالعزّ و البهآء که اگر نمیبود که نظر اللّه خلق را نابالغ مشاهده نموده هرآینه در هر ذرّه از ذرّات وجود ابواب علمی میگشودم که جمیع خلق خود را از عرفانش عاجز و قاصر مشاهده نمایند ولکن چون اغیار موجود اسرار مستور به کذلک قدّر من لدن مقتدر قدیر قل یا ملأ البیان انتم خلقتم للقائی بعد استغنائی عنکم و وعدتم بنفسی و عرفانها بعد تقدیسی عن عرفانکم و بشّرتم بجمالی بعد استعلائی عنکم و عمّا خلق بین السّموات و الأرضین مع‌ذلک باوهن اسماء الیوم تشبّث نموده از سلطان اسماء دور و غافل مانده‌اید اگر بکلمات ناظرید معادل بیان از سماء رحمن نازل و بشأنی ظاهر که احدی را مجال اعراض نه مگر مشرکین که مرض قلبی آن نفوس را از عرفان و ادراک منع نموده

Fa-wa-lladhī tafarrada bi-l-ʿizzi wa-l-bahāʾ ke agar namībūd ke naẓar-i Allāh khalq rā nābāligh mushāhade namūde har-āyine dar har dharre az dharrāt-i vujūd abvāb-i ʿilmī mīgushūdam ke jamīʿ-i khalq khud rā az ʿirfānash ʿājiz va qāṣir mushāhade namāyand va-līkin chūn aghyār mawjūd asrār mastūr beh kadhālika quddira min ladun muqtadirin qadīr qul yā malaʾa l-bayān antum khuliqtum li-liqāʾī baʿda istighnāʾī ʿankum wa-wuʿidtum bi-nafsī wa-ʿirfānihā baʿda taqdīsī ʿan ʿirfānikum wa-bushshirtum bi-jamālī baʿda istiʿlāʾī ʿankum wa-ʿammā khuliqa bayna l-samāwāti wa-l-araḍīn maʿa-dhālik bi-awhan-i asmāʾ al-yawm tashabbuth namūde az sulṭān-i asmāʾ dūr va ghāfil mānde-īd agar bi-kalimāt nāẓirīd muʿādil-i bayān az samāʾ-i raḥmān nāzil va bi-shaʾnī ẓāhir ke aḥadī rā majāl-i iʿrāḍ na magar mushrikīn ke maraḍ-i qalbī ān nufūs rā az ʿirfān va idrāk manʿ namūde.

I swear by Him who is peerless in might and glory: were it not that the gaze of God has found humanity immature, I would open within every atom of existence doors to knowledge before which all people would find themselves powerless and incapable of comprehension. But since strangers are present, it is better that the mysteries remain concealed. Thus has it been decreed by One who is all-powerful and almighty. Say: “O people of the Bayán! You were created to meet Me, though I have no need of you; you were promised My own Self and its recognition, though I am sanctified above your recognition; and you were given the glad tidings of My beauty, though I am exalted above you and whatever has been created between the heavens and the earths.” Yet today you have clung to the feeblest of names and remained far from, and heedless of, the Sovereign of names. If you look to the words, the equivalent of the Bayán has descended from the heaven of the All-Merciful and has appeared in such a manner that no one has any grounds for turning away, except those who associate partners with God, whose sickness of heart has prevented them from recognition and understanding.

139

از این گذشته کلمات نفوسی که الیوم حول امر اللّه طایفند با کلمات من اتّخذتموه من دون اللّه لأنفسکم ولیّاً میزان نمائید تا بر عظمت امر مطّلع شوید که لعلّ بر جمال قدم بمجرّد وهم ضرّ وارد نیاورید قسم بحقّ که اهل هر ملّتی از ملل قبل اگر در احتجاب خود از مظاهر عزّ باقیه بمعاذیر نالایقه متعذّر شوند شاید ولکن از برای اهل بیان هیچ حجّت و عذری باقی نه چه که سلطان احدیّه ذکر ظهور بعد را باصرح بیان و اوضح تبیان فرموده‌اند بشأنی که کلّ بیان و ما نزّل فیه را بقول او منوط فرموده چنانچه از قبل از قلم قدم تحریر یافت فطوبی للعارفین

Az īn gudashte kalimāt-i nufūsī ke al-yawm ḥawl-i amr-i Allāh ṭāʾifand bā kalimāt-i man ittakhadhtumūhu min dūni llāhi li-anfusikum waliyyan mīzān namāyīd tā bar ʿaẓamat-i amr muṭṭaliʿ shavīd ke laʿall bar jamāl-i qidam bi-mujarrad-i vahm ḍurr vārid nayāvarīd qasam bi-ḥaqq ke ahl-i har millatī az milal-i qabl agar dar iḥtijāb-i khud az maẓāhir-i ʿizz-i bāqiye bi-maʿādhīr-i nālāyiqe mutaʿadhdhir shavand shāyad va-līkin az barā-yi ahl-i bayān hīch ḥujjat va ʿudhrī bāqī na che ke sulṭān-i aḥadiyye dhikr-i ẓuhūr-i baʿd rā bi-aṣraḥ-i bayān va awḍaḥ-i tibyān farmūde-and bi-shaʾnī ke kull-i bayān va mā nuzzila fīhi rā bi-qawl-i ū manūṭ farmūde chunānche az qabl az qalam-i qidam taḥrīr yāft fa-ṭūbā li-l-ʿārifīn.

Beyond this, weigh the words of those who today circle around the Cause of God against the words of the one whom you have taken as your guardian instead of God, so that you may become aware of the greatness of the Cause and perhaps refrain from harming the Ancient Beauty on the basis of mere conjecture. I swear by the True One: if the followers of any former religion should offer unworthy excuses for remaining veiled from the Manifestations of everlasting glory, that might be possible; but for the people of the Bayán no argument or excuse remains. For the Sovereign of oneness has spoken of the next Revelation in the most explicit language and the clearest exposition, making the entire Bayán and all that was revealed in it dependent on His word, as was previously written by the Pen of eternity. Blessed, then, are those who recognize.

140

و از جمله در ابطال حقّ و اثبات باطل معرض باللّه باین کلمات تمسّک جسته و چون لایق نبود که کلماتش بعینه ذکر شود لذا ما حرّک علیها قلم اللّه و مضمون آن این است که از قلم عزّ صادر میشود محبوب شما صاحب بصر بوده یا نه اگر نفی شود حکم بصر از منظر اکبر هذا ظلم علی اللّه و اگر آن سلطان قدم صاحب بصر و علم بوده چگونه میشود نفسی را وصف فرماید و باسماء حسنی ذکر نماید از مقام خود تنزّل کند و از معرضین محسوب گردد

Va az jumle dar ibṭāl-i ḥaqq va ithbāt-i bāṭil muʿriḍ bi-llāh bi-īn kalimāt tamassuk juste va chūn lāyiq nabūd ke kalimātash bi-ʿaynih dhikr shavad lidhā mā ḥurrika ʿalayhā qalamu llāh va maḍmūn-i ān īn ast ke az qalam-i ʿizz ṣādir mīshavad maḥbūb-i shumā ṣāḥib-i baṣar būde yā na agar nafy shavad ḥukm-i baṣar az manẓar-i akbar hādhā ẓulmun ʿalā llāh va agar ān sulṭān-i qidam ṣāḥib-i baṣar va ʿilm būde chigūne mīshavad nafsī rā vaṣf farmāyad va bi-asmāʾ-i ḥusnā dhikr namāyad az maqām-i khud tanazzul kunad va az muʿriḍīn maḥsūb gardad.

Among other things, in seeking to invalidate the truth and establish falsehood, the one who has turned away from God has resorted to these words. Since it was not fitting to quote his words exactly, the Pen of God was not moved to record them. Their substance, as it now issues from the Pen of glory, is this: “Did your Beloved possess sight or not? If sight is denied to the Most Great Countenance, this is an injustice against God. But if that Sovereign of eternity possessed sight and knowledge, how can someone whom He praises and mentions by the most beautiful names fall from his station and be counted among those who turn away?”

141

اوّلاً اینکه قائل این قول حقّ جلّ ذکره را یفعل ما یشآء ندانسته و قدرت محیطهٴ الهیّه را انکار نموده و چنین نفسی ابعد عباد بوده و خواهد بود بنصّ نقطهٴ بیان چنانچه از قبل مذکور شد قل اللّهمّ انّک انت الهان الالهین لتؤتینّ الألوهیّة من تشآء و لتنزعنّ الألوهیّة عمّن تشآء الی انّک علی کلّ شیء قدیرا قل اللّهمّ انّک انت ربّاب السّموات و الأرض لتؤتینّ الرّبوبیّة من تشآء و لتنزعنّ الرّبوبیّة عمّن تشآء الی آخر ما نزّل

Avvalan īnke qāʾil-i īn qawl Ḥaqq jalla dhikruhu rā yafʿalu mā yashāʾ nadāniste va qudrat-i muḥīṭe-yi ilāhiyye rā inkār namūde va chunīn nafsī abʿad-i ʿibād būde va khwāhad būd bi-naṣṣ-i nuqṭe-yi bayān chunānche az qabl madhkūr shud qul allāhumma innaka anta ilāhānu l-ilāhīn la-tuʾtiyanna l-ulūhiyyata man tashāʾ wa-la-tanziʿanna l-ulūhiyyata ʿamman tashāʾ ilā innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīran qul allāhumma innaka anta rabbābu l-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ la-tuʾtiyanna l-rubūbiyyata man tashāʾ wa-la-tanziʿanna l-rubūbiyyata ʿamman tashāʾ ilā ākhiri mā nuzzil.

First, the speaker of these words has failed to recognize that the True One—exalted be His mention—does whatever He wills, and has denied the all-encompassing power of God. Such a person has been and will remain the most remote of servants, according to the explicit text of the Point of the Bayán, as previously cited: “Say: O God, You are indeed the God of gods. You will surely bestow divinity on whomever You will, and You will surely strip divinity from whomever You will,” continuing to “You are powerful over all things.” “Say: O God, You are indeed the supreme Lord of the heavens and the earth. You will surely bestow lordship on whomever You will, and You will surely strip lordship from whomever You will,” and so on to the end of what was revealed.

142

حال میگوئیم در این کلمهٴ جامعه که از ساذج فطرت سلطان احدیّه جاری شده چه میگوئی اگر حقّ جلّ و عزّ را صادق دانسته سلطان مقتدری که قادر است باینکه الوهیّت و ربوبیّت را که اعظم مقامات بوده عطا فرماید بهر نفسی که اراده فرماید و هم‌چنین اخذ نماید از هر نفسی که بخواهد البتّه قادر بوده بر آنکه خلعت وصف را از نفسی انتزاع فرماید این ذکری است که کلّیّه فرموده‌اند تخصیص باحدی نداشته و ندارد

Ḥāl mīgūʾīm dar īn kalime-yi jāmiʿe ke az sādhij-i fiṭrat-i sulṭān-i aḥadiyye jārī shude che mīgūʾī agar Ḥaqq jalla va ʿazza rā ṣādiq dāniste sulṭān-i muqtadirī ke qādir ast bi-īnke ulūhiyyat va rubūbiyyat rā ke aʿẓam-i maqāmāt būde ʿaṭā farmāyad bi-har nafsī ke irāde farmāyad va ham-chunīn akhdh namāyad az har nafsī ke bikhwāhad albatte qādir būde bar ānke khilʿat-i vaṣf rā az nafsī intizāʿ farmāyad īn dhikrī ast ke kulliyye farmūde-and takhṣīṣ bi-aḥadī nadāshte va nadārad.

Now We ask: what do you say about this all-embracing utterance that has flowed from the pure, innate nature of the Sovereign of oneness? If you acknowledge the truthfulness of the True One—glorified and exalted be He—then an all-powerful Sovereign who can bestow divinity and lordship, the greatest of stations, on any soul He wills, and likewise take them from any soul He wishes, is certainly able to strip a soul of the robe of praise. This is a statement He has made in universal terms; it has never been restricted to any particular person.

143

و اگر بتخصیص وصف ناظری و ید اللّه را مغلول دانسته و قدرت محیطه را انکار مینمائی پس چه میگوئی در میرزا اسداللّه که بنصّ صریح در بارهٴ او میفرمایند ان یا حرف الثّالث المؤمن بمن یظهره اللّه و این بسی واضح است که حرف ثالث من یظهره اللّه جلّ اجلاله بصدهزار رتبه از حروفات بیان و مرایای او عنداللّه مقدّم بوده چه که خود نقطهٴ بیان روح ما سواه فداه میفرمایند نطفهٴ یکسالهٴ زمان من یظهره اللّه اقوی است از کلّ من فی البیان

Va agar bi-takhṣīṣ-i vaṣf nāẓirī va yadu llāh rā maghlūl dāniste va qudrat-i muḥīṭe rā inkār mīnamāʾī pas che mīgūʾī dar Mīrzā Asaduʾllāh ke bi-naṣṣ-i ṣarīḥ dar bāre-yi ū mīfarmāyand in yā ḥarfa l-thālithi l-muʾminu bi-man yuẓhiruhu llāh va īn basī vāḍiḥ ast ke ḥarf-i thālith-i man yuẓhiruhu llāh jalla ijlāluhu bi-ṣad-hazār rutbe az ḥurūfāt-i bayān va marāyā-yi ū ʿinda llāh muqaddam būde che ke khud-i nuqṭe-yi bayān rūḥ-i mā sivāhu fidāh mīfarmāyand nuṭfe-yi yaksāle-yi zamān-i man yuẓhiruhu llāh aqvā ast az kull-i man fī l-bayān.

But if you focus on the specific bestowal of praise, regard the hand of God as fettered, and deny His all-encompassing power, what do you say about Mírzá Asadu’lláh, concerning whom He explicitly says: “O Letter of the Third, who believes in Him whom God will make manifest!” It is abundantly clear that the Third Letter of Him whom God will make manifest—exalted be His majesty—outranks the Letters of the Bayán and its Mirrors by a hundred thousand degrees in the sight of God. For the Point of the Bayán Himself—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—says: “A one-year-old embryo of the time of Him whom God will make manifest is mightier than all who are in the Bayán.”

144

حال انصاف ده نقطهٴ بیان صاحب بصیرت بوده یا نه اگر او را صادق و صاحب بصر میدانی چرا نفسی را که باین علوّ و امتناع و سموّ و ارتفاع در اصل کتاب ذکر فرموده‌اند ابوالشّرور نامیدی و بر قتلش امر نمودی ان یا ذی عین واحدة شهدت عیوب النّاس و غفلت عمّا فی نفسک

Ḥāl inṣāf dih nuqṭe-yi bayān ṣāḥib-i baṣīrat būde yā na agar ū rā ṣādiq va ṣāḥib-i baṣar mīdānī chirā nafsī rā ke bi-īn ʿuluvv va imtināʿ va sumuvv va irtifāʿ dar aṣl-i kitāb dhikr farmūde-and Abuʾl-Shurūr nāmīdī va bar qatlash amr namūdī in yā dhī ʿaynin wāḥidatin shahidta ʿuyūba l-nāsi wa-ghafalta ʿammā fī nafsik.

Now judge fairly: did the Point of the Bayán possess insight or not? If you consider Him truthful and possessed of sight, why did you call a person whom He mentioned in the very Book with such loftiness, inaccessibility, sublimity, and exaltation “the Father of Evils,” and order his killing? O you with but one eye! You have seen the faults of others and remained heedless of what is within yourself.

145

اگر بگوئی از حقّ اعراض نمود لذا این حکم بر او جاری شد بر فرض تسلیم میگوئیم حرف ثالث من یظهره اللّه که ابهی و اعلای از خلق بیان عنداللّه بوده بنصّ قلم امر اگر جایز است معرض و کافر و مشرک شود پس چرا جایز نمیدانی که مرآتی از مرایای لایحصی از حقّ اعراض نماید فبهت الّذی کفر

Agar bigūʾī az Ḥaqq iʿrāḍ namūd lidhā īn ḥukm bar ū jārī shud bar farḍ-i taslīm mīgūʾīm ḥarf-i thālith-i man yuẓhiruhu llāh ke abhā va aʿlā-yi az khalq-i bayān ʿinda llāh būde bi-naṣṣ-i qalam-i amr agar jāʾiz ast muʿriḍ va kāfir va mushrik shavad pas chirā jāʾiz namīdānī ke mirʾātī az marāyā-yi lā yuḥṣā az Ḥaqq iʿrāḍ namāyad fa-buhita lladhī kafar.

If you say, “He turned away from the True One, and therefore this judgment was passed upon him,” We reply, granting this for the sake of argument: if the Third Letter of Him whom God will make manifest, who, according to the explicit text of the Pen of the Cause, was more glorious and exalted in the sight of God than the people of the Bayán, can become one who turns away, an unbeliever, and one who associates partners with God, why do you not admit that one Mirror among countless Mirrors can turn away from the True One? Thus was the one who disbelieved confounded.

146

فواللّه احدی بر اصل این امر مطّلع نه و لو یطّلعون لیعرفون

Fa-wa-llāh aḥadī bar aṣl-i īn amr muṭṭaliʿ na wa-law yaṭṭaliʿūna la-yaʿrifūn.

By God, no one is aware of the true nature of this Cause; if they became aware, they would surely recognize.

147

و در توقیع وحید اکبر ورقاء بقا بابدع نغمات تغنّی فرموده فیا روحا لمن یسمع و یکون فی آیات اللّه لمن المتفکّرین بیانه عزّ بیانه فوالّذی فلق الحبّة و برأ النّسمة لو ایقنت بأنّک یوم ظهوره لا تؤمن به لأرفعت عنک حکم الایمان فی ذلک الظّهور لأنّک ما خلقت الّا له و لو علمت انّ احداً من النّصاری یؤمن به لجعلته قرّة عینای و احکمت علیه بالایمان فی ذلک الظّهور من دون ان اشهد علیه من شیء انتهی

Va dar tawqīʿ-i Vaḥīd-i Akbar varqā-yi baqā bi-abdaʿ-i naghamāt taghannī farmūde fa-yā rawḥan li-man yasmaʿu wa-yakūnu fī āyāti llāhi la-mina l-mutafakkirīn bayānuhu ʿazza bayānuhu fa-wa-lladhī falaqa l-ḥabbata wa-baraʾa l-nasamata law ayqantu bi-annaka yawma ẓuhūrihi lā tuʾminu bihi la-arfaʿtu ʿanka ḥukma l-īmāni fī dhālika l-ẓuhūr li-annaka mā khuliqta illā lahu wa-law ʿalimtu anna aḥadan mina l-naṣārā yuʾminu bihi la-jaʿaltuhu qurrata ʿaynāya wa-aḥkamtu ʿalayhi bi-l-īmāni fī dhālika l-ẓuhūr min dūni an ashhada ʿalayhi min shayʾ intahā.

In the Tablet to Vaḥíd-i Akbar, the Dove of eternity has sung in the most wondrous melodies. What joy for one who listens and is among those who ponder the verses of God! His words—exalted be His utterance—are: “I swear by Him who split the seed and created the soul: if I were certain that on the day of His appearance you would not believe in Him, I would remove from you the designation of faith in that Revelation, for you were created for Him alone. And if I knew that one of the Christians would believe in Him, I would make him the solace of My eyes and pronounce him a believer in that Revelation, without witnessing anything from him.” Here ends the quotation.

148

میفرماید قسم بمقتدری که شکافت حبّهٴ قلوب را و خلق فرمود انسان را که اگر موقن بودم که تو در ظهور بعد ایمان نمیآوری بآن مشرق آفتاب حقیقت هرآینه مرتفع مینمودم از تو حکم ایمان را در این ظهور چه که تو خلق نشده مگر از برای عرفان آن شمس سماء ایقان و هرگاه بدانم یکی از نصاری موفّق میشود بعرفان آن جمال رحمن و ایمان باو هرآینه میگردانیدم او را قرّۀ چشمهای خود و حکم مینمودم بر او در این ظهور بایمان از دون اینکه ملحوظ شود از او امری

Mīfarmāyad qasam bi-muqtadirī ke shikāft ḥabbe-yi qulūb rā va khalq farmūd insān rā ke agar mūqin būdam ke tu dar ẓuhūr-i baʿd īmān namīāvarī bi-ān mashriq-i āftāb-i ḥaqīqat har-āyine murtafiʿ mīnamūdam az tu ḥukm-i īmān rā dar īn ẓuhūr che ke tu khalq nashude magar az barā-yi ʿirfān-i ān shams-i samāʾ-i īqān va har-gāh bidānam yakī az naṣārā muwaffaq mīshavad bi-ʿirfān-i ān jamāl-i raḥmān va īmān bi-ū har-āyine mīgardānīdam ū rā qurrat-i chashmhā-yi khud va ḥukm mīnamūdam bar ū dar īn ẓuhūr bi-īmān az dūn-i īnke malḥūẓ shavad az ū amrī.

He says: “I swear by the All-Powerful One who split the seed of hearts and created humanity: if I were certain that in the next Revelation you would not believe in that Dawning-Place of the Sun of Truth, I would remove from you the designation of faith in this Revelation, for you were created solely to recognize that Sun of the heaven of certitude. And if I should know that one of the Christians would attain recognition of that Beauty of the All-Merciful and faith in Him, I would assuredly make him the solace of My eyes and pronounce him a believer in this Revelation, without any deed of his being taken into account.”

149

حال ای اهل بصر ملاحظه نمائید که امر اللّه چه مقدار الطف و ارقّ بوده و رحمت منبسطهٴ الهیّه چگونه کلّ وجود را احاطه فرموده که در بارهٴ نفسی از نصاری که الیوم کافر و مشرک است بمجرّد ایمان در ظهور بعد آن سدرهٴ الهی او را بالطف و ارقّ اعضای مبارک خود نسبت داده و منسوب ساخته‌اند و مع‌ذلک این همج ارض در چه رتبه واقف و ناظرند فسحقاً لکم یا ملأ الغافلین

Ḥāl ay ahl-i baṣar mulāḥiẓe namāyīd ke amr-i Allāh che miqdār alṭaf va araqq būde va raḥmat-i munbasiṭe-yi ilāhiyye chigūne kull-i vujūd rā iḥāṭe farmūde ke dar bāre-yi nafsī az naṣārā ke al-yawm kāfir va mushrik ast bi-mujarrad-i īmān dar ẓuhūr-i baʿd ān sidre-yi ilāhī ū rā bi-alṭaf va araqq-i aʿḍā-yi mubārak-i khud nisbat dāde va mansūb sākhte-and va maʿa-dhālik īn hamaj-i arḍ dar che rutbe vāqif va nāẓirand fa-suḥqan lakum yā malaʾa l-ghāfilīn.

Now, O people of insight, consider how gracious and tender the Cause of God is, and how God’s all-embracing mercy encompasses the whole of existence: solely on account of faith in the next Revelation, that divine Lote-Tree has associated a Christian who today is an unbeliever and one who associates partners with God with the most delicate and tender of His blessed bodily members, and has linked him to them. Yet at what a level these rabble of the earth remain, and from what a standpoint they look! Away with you, O company of the heedless!

150

فوالّذی جعل الیوم دلیله نفسه و سلطانه ما یجری من قلمه المنیر که اگر کلّ من فی البیان الیوم معرض شوند و یک نفر از نصاری مؤمن هرآینه اسماء کلّ از لوح محفوظ محو خواهد شد و اسم نصاری ثابت یمحو اللّه ما یشآء و یثبت و عنده امّ الکتاب

Fa-wa-lladhī jaʿala l-yawma dalīlahu nafsahu wa-sulṭānahu mā yajrī min qalamihi l-munīr ke agar kull-i man fī l-bayān al-yawm muʿriḍ shavand va yak nafar az naṣārā muʾmin har-āyine asmāʾ-i kull az lawḥ-i maḥfūẓ maḥv khwāhad shud va ism-i naṣārā thābit yamḥū llāhu mā yashāʾu wa-yuthbitu wa-ʿindahu ummu l-kitāb.

I swear by Him who today has made His own Self His proof and what flows from His luminous Pen His authority: if all who are in the Bayán should turn away today and one Christian become a believer, the names of all would assuredly be effaced from the Preserved Tablet, and the name of the Christian confirmed. God effaces whatever He wills and confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.

151

و از جمیع گذشته آیا حکایت بلعام که در کتب الهی مسطور است نشنیده‌اند که با آنکه یکی از اوصیای انبیاء قبل بوده و جمیع اهل اقطار عالم خدمتش را فرض میشمردند و طاعتش را طاعة اللّه میدانستند و اشتهار اسمش جمیع دیار را احاطه نموده بود و چون جمال کلیم از افق عزّ تسلیم ظاهر شد بمعارضهٴ آن جمال احدیّه قیام نمود و هم‌چنین یهودای اسخریوطی که از حروف اثنی‌عشر انجیل بود حضرت روح را بید یهود تسلیم نمود

Va az jamīʿ gudashte āyā ḥikāyat-i Balʿām ke dar kutub-i ilāhī masṭūr ast nashanīde-and ke bā ānke yakī az awṣiyā-yi anbiyā-yi qabl būde va jamīʿ-i ahl-i aqṭār-i ʿālam khidmatash rā farḍ mīshumurdand va ṭāʿatash rā ṭāʿata llāh mīdānistand va ishtihār-i ismash jamīʿ-i diyār rā iḥāṭe namūde būd va chūn jamāl-i Kalīm az ufuq-i ʿizz-i taslīm ẓāhir shud bi-muʿāriḍe-yi ān jamāl-i aḥadiyye qiyām namūd va ham-chunīn Yahūdā-yi Iskharīyūṭī ke az ḥurūf-i ithnā-ʿashar-i injīl būd Ḥaḍrat-i Rūḥ rā bi-yad-i yahūd taslīm namūd.

Beyond all this, have they not heard the account of Balaam recorded in the divine Books? Although he was one of the appointed successors of the former Prophets, and all the peoples throughout the world considered service to him obligatory and obedience to him obedience to God, and the fame of his name had spread through every land, when the beauty of Moses appeared from the horizon of glorious submission, he arose to oppose that Beauty of oneness. Likewise, Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve Letters of the Gospel, delivered the Spirit into the hands of the Jews.

152

زینهار از افتتان و امتحان الهی آسوده نشوید و در کلّ حین پناه بخداوند متعال برده که شاید الیوم از صراط واضح منحرف نشوید و نلغزید فطوبی للثّابتین چه که امتحان برای کلّ بوده و خواهد بود و احدی از کمندش خارج نه الّا من شآء ربّک اگر نسیم عدلش مرور نماید صدهزار جوهر نور را در ظلمت نفس و هوی مشاهده نمائی و اگر نسیم فضلش هبوب فرماید صدهزار هیاکل فانیه را بمقرّ عرش باقیه ملاحظه کنی

Zīnhār az iftitān va imtiḥān-i ilāhī āsūde nashavīd va dar kull-i ḥīn panāh bi-Khudāvand-i mutaʿāl burde ke shāyad al-yawm az ṣirāṭ-i vāḍiḥ munḥarif nashavīd va nalaghzīd fa-ṭūbā li-l-thābitīn che ke imtiḥān barā-yi kull būde va khwāhad būd va aḥadī az kamandash khārij na illā man shāʾa rabbuk agar nasīm-i ʿadlash murūr namāyad ṣad-hazār jawhar-i nūr rā dar ẓulmat-i nafs va havā mushāhade namāʾī va agar nasīm-i faḍlash hubūb farmāyad ṣad-hazār hayākil-i fāniye rā bi-maqarr-i ʿarsh-i bāqiye mulāḥiẓe kunī.

Beware lest you feel secure from divine trials and tests. At every moment seek refuge in God, the Most Exalted, so that perhaps today you may neither stray from the clear path nor stumble. Blessed are the steadfast! For testing has been and will remain the lot of all, and no one is beyond its snare except those whom your Lord wills. Should the breeze of His justice pass by, you would see a hundred thousand essences of light in the darkness of self and desire; and should the breeze of His grace blow, you would behold a hundred thousand mortal forms at the seat of the everlasting throne.

153

فواللّه یا قوم مطّلع نیستید و بمجرّد وهم حرکت مینمائید بشنوید نصایح بدیعهٴ الهیّه را و در امر اللّه تجرّی ننمائید و خود را بعذاب لاینتهی معذّب مسازید از بحر اعظم موّاج بسراب بقیعه خود را مشغول نکنید و از شمس عزّ باقی بظلّ فانی قانع مشوید بیان حقّ را از لسان رحمن بشنوید

Fa-wa-llāh yā qawm muṭṭaliʿ nīstīd va bi-mujarrad-i vahm ḥarakat mīnamāʾīd bishnavīd naṣāyiḥ-i badīʿe-yi ilāhiyye rā va dar amr-i Allāh tajarrī nanamāʾīd va khud rā bi-ʿadhāb-i lā yantahī muʿadhdhab masāzīd az baḥr-i aʿẓam-i mavvāj bi-sarāb-i baqīʿe khud rā mashghūl nakunīd va az shams-i ʿizz-i bāqī bi-ẓill-i fānī qāniʿ mashavīd bayān-i Ḥaqq rā az lisān-i Raḥmān bishnavīd.

By God, O people, you are unaware and act on mere conjecture. Listen to the wondrous counsels of God, do not act presumptuously in the Cause of God, and do not subject yourselves to unending torment. Do not turn from the surging Most Great Ocean to occupy yourselves with a mirage on a barren plain, and do not forsake the Sun of everlasting glory to content yourselves with a fleeting shadow. Hear the utterance of the True One from the tongue of the All-Merciful.

154

احدی الیوم بر بیان و ما کنز فیه مطّلع نه و علمه عندنا لو انتم من العارفین از سلطان مسمّی که ملکوت اسماء بقول او خلق شده بقمیص اسم محتجب نشوید چه که جمیع اسماء بمنزلهٴ قمایصند یلبسها علی من یشآء فضلاً من عنده و ینزعها عمّن یشآء عدلاً من لدنه و لا یسأل عمّا یفعل و انّه لهو المقتدر القدیر

Aḥadī al-yawm bar Bayān va mā kuniza fīhi moṭṭaleʿ na, va ʿilmuhu ʿindanā law antum mina al-ʿārifīn. Az Solṭān-e mosammā ke malakūt-e asmāʾ be-qawl-e ū khalq shode be-qamīṣ-e esm moḥtajeb nashavīd, che ke jamīʿ-e asmāʾ be-manzale-ye qamāyeṣ-and; yalbasuhā ʿalā man yashāʾ faḍlan min ʿindihi wa yanziʿuhā ʿamman yashāʾ ʿadlan min ladunhi wa lā yusʾalu ʿammā yafʿalu wa innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr.

No one today is aware of the Bayán and what is treasured within it. Its knowledge is with Us, if you are among those who understand. Do not let the garment of a name veil you from the Sovereign who bears the names, through whose word the kingdom of names was created. For all names are like garments: He clothes whomever He wills in them as a grace from Him, and strips them from whomever He wills in His justice. He is not questioned about what He does, and He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

155

و الیوم اکثری از اهل بیان عبدهٴ اسماء بین یدی اللّه مذکور بوده و خواهند بود چنانچه اگر بنقطهٴ اولی بنفسه لنفسه عارف شده بودند فواللّه اقلّ من آن در این ظهور قدس صمدانی و تجلّی عزّ رحمانی توقّف نمینمودند

Va al-yawm aktharī az ahl-e Bayān ʿabade-ye asmāʾ bayna yaday Allāh madhkūr būde va khāhand būd, chenānche agar be-Noqṭe-ye Ūlā bi-nafsihi li-nafsihi ʿāref shode būdand, fa-wa-Allāh aqall-e men ān dar īn ẓohūr-e qods-e ṣamadānī va tajallī-ye ʿezz-e raḥmānī tavaqqof nemīnamūdand.

Today most of the people of the Bayán have been, and will remain, designated in the presence of God as worshippers of names. For had they recognized the Primal Point through His own Self and for His own sake, then, by God, they would not have hesitated for less than an instant before this Revelation of eternal holiness and this effulgence of merciful glory.

156

پس معلوم شد که عارف بنفس او جلّ و عزّ نبوده‌اند بلکه بقمیص اسمی او تعالی شأنه عارف شده‌اند چنانچه ایّامی نگذشت و بنفسه لنفسه ظاهر شده و او را نشناخته‌اند و بر او وارد آورده‌اند آنچه را که قلم حیا میکند از ذکرش

Pas maʿlūm shod ke ʿāref be-nafs-e ū jalla wa ʿazza nabūde-and, balke be-qamīṣ-e esmī-ye ū taʿālā shaʾnuhu ʿāref shode-and, chenānche ayyāmī nagodhasht va bi-nafsihi li-nafsihi ẓāher shode va ū rā nashenākhte-and va bar ū vāred āvorde-and ānche rā ke qalam ḥayā mīkonad az dhekrash.

It is thus clear that they had not recognized His own Self, glorious and mighty is He, but had recognized the garment of His name, exalted is His station. For only a few days passed before He appeared through His own Self and for His own sake, yet they failed to recognize Him and inflicted on Him what the Pen is ashamed to mention.

157

و این عدم عرفان نشده مگر آنکه تبدیل قمیص فرموده یعنی اسم اعلی باسم ابهی تبدیل شد و احدی عارف بآن نشده الّا الّذینهم انقطعوا عن کلّ من فی الملک و صعدوا الی اللّه بکلّهم الی ان دخلوا مقرّ عزّ کریم اولئک اولیائی تحت ظلال عنایتی و

Va īn ʿadam-e ʿerfān nashode magar ānke tabdīl-e qamīṣ farmūde, yaʿnī esm-e Aʿlā be-esm-e Abhā tabdīl shod va aḥadī ʿāref be-ān nashode illā alladhīna hum inqaṭaʿū ʿan kulli man fī al-mulk wa ṣaʿidū ilā Allāh bi-kullihim ilā an dakhalū maqarra ʿizzin karīm. Ulāʾika awliyāʾī taḥta ẓilāli ʿināyatī wa

This failure to recognize Him came about only because He changed His garment: that is, the name Most Exalted was changed to the name All-Glorious. No one recognized Him except those who detached themselves from everyone in the realm of creation and ascended to God with their whole being, until they entered an abode of noble glory. These are My loved ones beneath the shade of My loving care, and

158

ینزل علیهم سکینة من عندی و هم علی سرر الاستقلال هم مستقرّون اولئک حفظهم اللّه عن رمی الشّبهات و هم علی وساید القدس متّکئون و الی طرفی ناظرون علیهم فی کلّ حین بهائی ثمّ رحمتی و عنایتی ثمّ فضلی و افضالی و کذلک اختصّهم اللّه لنفسی و جعلهم من المؤمنین

Yanzilu ʿalayhim sakīnatun min ʿindī wa hum ʿalā sururi al-istiqlāl hum mustaqirrūn. Ulāʾika ḥafiẓahumu Allāhu ʿan ramyi al-shubuhāt wa hum ʿalā wasāʾidi al-quds muttakiʾūn wa ilā ṭarfī nāẓirūn. ʿAlayhim fī kulli ḥīnin bahāʾī thumma raḥmatī wa ʿināyatī thumma faḍlī wa ifḍālī wa kadhālika ikhtaṣṣahumu Allāhu li-nafsī wa jaʿalahum mina al-muʾminīn.

Tranquility descends upon them from Me, and they rest upon the couches of independence. These are the ones God has protected from the onslaught of doubts. They recline upon the cushions of holiness and gaze toward Me. Upon them at every moment be My glory, My mercy and loving care, My grace and bounty. Thus has God chosen them for My own Self and numbered them among the believers.

159

ای عباد سعی نموده که شاید از بدایع فضل ربّ الأرباب در ظلّ قباب آفتاب قدس عنایت وارد شوید و از حرارت نفس و هوی آسوده و محفوظ مانید اینست نصایح قلم امر فمن سمع فلنفسه و من اعرض فلها و انّه لمقدّس عن العالمین

Ey ʿebād, saʿy namūde ke shāyad az badāyeʿ-e faḍl-e Rabb al-Arbāb dar ẓell-e qebāb-e āftāb-e qods-e ʿenāyat vāred shavīd va az ḥarārat-e nafs va havā āsūde va maḥfūẓ mānīd. Īnast naṣāyeḥ-e qalam-e amr; fa-man samiʿa fa-li-nafsihi wa man aʿraḍa fa-lahā wa innahu la-muqaddasun ʿani al-ʿālamīn.

O servants, strive, so that through the wondrous grace of the Lord of Lords you may enter beneath the shade of the canopies of the holy Sun of loving care, and remain sheltered and protected from the heat of self and desire. These are the counsels of the Pen of the Cause. Whoever listens does so for his own sake, and whoever turns away does so to his own detriment. He is indeed sanctified above all the worlds.

160

و ایکاش که اهل بیان در بیان فارسی که از قلم رحمانی نازل نظر مینمودند که شاید در این ظهور قدس صمدانی خود را از سلسبیل عنایت ربّانی و تسنیم مکرمت سبحانی محروم نمینمودند و بشأنی شبهات بر قلوب غیر طاهره وارد شده که لن یعرف ایّاً من ایّ و اگر قلبی از کوثر بی‌زوال سلطان لایزال از شبهه مطهّر شود فی الحین بشبههٴ دیگر بیالاید سبحان‌اللّه با اینکه اهل بیان خود مقرّ و معترفند که نبوّت برسول اللّه ختم شده و سنهٴ ستّین اوّل ظهور اللّه است مع‌ذلک و مع اینکه حقّ حال بنفسه و کینونته مشهود و از افق انّنی انا حیّ فی الأفق الأبهی ظاهر و طالع مجدّداً ذکر وصایت و امثال آن مینمایند و ببقیّهٴ وهم ما ترک من ملل الفرقان اراده نموده‌اند انوار شمس یقین را که در سماء قدس بی‌زوال ذو الجلال مشرق شده ستر نمایند نیکو است ذکر این دو فرد در این مقام

Va ey kāsh ke ahl-e Bayān dar Bayān-e Fārsī ke az qalam-e raḥmānī nāzel naẓar mīnamūdand ke shāyad dar īn ẓohūr-e qods-e ṣamadānī khod rā az salsabīl-e ʿenāyat-e rabbānī va tasnīm-e makramat-e sobḥānī maḥrūm nemīnamūdand. Va be-shaʾnī shobohāt bar qolūb-e gheyr-e ṭāhere vāred shode ke lan yuʿrafa ayyan min ayy, va agar qalbī az kawthar-e bī-zavāl-e Solṭān-e lā-yazāl az shobhe moṭahhar shavad fī al-ḥīn be-shobhe-ye dīgar bīālāyad. Sobḥān Allāh, bā īnke ahl-e Bayān khod moqerr va moʿtaref-and ke nobovvat be-Rasūl Allāh khatm shode va sane-ye settīn avval-e ẓohūr Allāh ast, maʿa dhālek va maʿa īnke Ḥaqq ḥāl bi-nafsihi va kaynūnatihi mashhūd va az ofoq-e innanī anā ḥayyun fī al-ufuq al-Abhā ẓāher va ṭāleʿ, mojaddadan dhekr-e veṣāyat va amthāl-e ān mīnamāyand va be-baqiyye-ye vahm-e mā taraka min milal al-Furqān erāde namūde-and anvār-e shams-e yaqīn rā ke dar samā-ye qods-e bī-zavāl-e Dhu al-Jalāl moshreq shode satr namāyand. Nīkū ast dhekr-e īn do fard dar īn maqām.

If only the people of the Bayán would study the Persian Bayán, revealed by the Pen of the All-Merciful, so that they might not deprive themselves, in this Revelation of eternal holiness, of the Salsabíl of divine loving care and the Tasním of heavenly generosity. Doubts have so beset impure hearts that one thing cannot be distinguished from another; and if a heart is cleansed of doubt by the unfailing Kawthar of the everlasting Sovereign, it is immediately defiled by another doubt. Glory be to God! Although the people of the Bayán themselves acknowledge and confess that prophethood ended with the Messenger of God and that the year sixty marks the beginning of the Revelation of God, and although the True One is now visible in His own Self and Being, manifest and radiant from the horizon of “Indeed, I am living in the All-Glorious Horizon,” they nevertheless once again speak of successorship and the like. With the remnants of delusion left by the communities of the Qur’an, they have sought to veil the rays of the Sun of certitude that has risen in the heaven of the unfading holiness of the Lord of Majesty. It is fitting to cite these two couplets here.

161

ای ضیآء الحقّ حسام الدّین و دل ای دل و جان از قدوم تو خجل قصد این دارند این گل‌پاره‌ها که از حسد پوشند خورشید تو را

Ey Ḍiyāʾ al-Ḥaqq Ḥosām al-Dīn va del, ey del o jān az qodūm-e to khejel, qaṣd-e īn dārand īn gel-pāreh-hā ke az ḥasad pūshand khorshīd-e to rā.

O Radiance of Truth, Sword of Religion and of the heart, O you before whose coming heart and soul are abashed! These clods of earth intend, out of envy, to conceal your sun.

162

بگذارید این اقوال لایغنیه را و باصل امر و ما حقّق به الأسمآء ناظر شوید ظهور قبلم میفرماید اگر ناس ضعیف ملاحظه نمیشدند هرآینه ذکر مشیّت نمیفرمودم حال تقدیس امر و ارتفاع ما اراد اللّه لکم را مشاهده نمائید و قدر و رتبهٴ خود را ملاحظه کنید که حال بادلّهٴ پست‌ترین عباد از اهل فرقان تمسّک جسته و مستدلّ شده‌اند فوا حسرتا علیکم یا ملأ الغافلین

Begd hārīd īn aqvāl-e lā-yughniye rā va be-aṣl-e amr va mā ḥuqqiqa bihi al-asmāʾ nāẓer shavīd. Ẓohūr-e qablam mīfarmāyad agar nās ḍaʿīf molāḥeẓe nemīshodand har-āyene dhekr-e mashiyyat nemīfarmūdam. Ḥāl taqdīs-e amr va ertefāʿ-e mā arāda Allāhu lakum rā moshāhede namāyīd va qadr va rotbe-ye khod rā molāḥeẓe konīd ke ḥāl be-adelle-ye past-tarīn-e ʿebād az ahl-e Forqān tamassok joste va mostadell shode-and. Fa-wā ḥasratā ʿalaykum yā malaʾ al-ghāfilīn.

Set aside these fruitless sayings and turn your gaze to the source of the Cause and that through which the names were established. My previous Manifestation says, “Had people not been regarded as weak, I would assuredly not have mentioned the Will.” Now behold the sanctity of the Cause and the loftiness of what God has intended for you, and consider your own worth and rank: they have now resorted to the arguments of the lowliest servants among the people of the Qur’an and made these their proofs. Alas for you, O company of the heedless!

163

باری ایّام ظهور است و حقّ چون شمس فی وسط السّمآء ظاهر و زخرفی از دنیا در ساحت قدسش موجود نه که محتاج بوصیّ باشد آن را قسمت نماید و اگر میگوئید در امرش محتاج بوصیّ است هذا بغی منکم علی اللّه المهیمن القیّوم چه که امر طایف حول نفسش بوده و خواهد بود و لن یفارق منه ابداً ایّاکم ان تجعلوا للّه وزیراً او نظیراً او ضدّاً او ندّاً او وصیّاً او قریناً او مثالاً و در بیان این اسامی و ما حدّدتم به انفسکم جمیع را محو فرموده‌اند

Bārī ayyām-e ẓohūr ast va Ḥaqq chon shams fī wasaṭ al-samāʾ ẓāher va zokhrofī az donyā dar sāḥat-e qodsash mawjūd na ke moḥtāj be-vaṣī bāshad ān rā qesmat namāyad. Va agar mīgūyīd dar amrash moḥtāj be-vaṣī ast, hādhā baghyun minkum ʿalā Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm, che ke amr ṭāyef-e ḥawl-e nafsash būde va khāhad būd va lan yufāriqa minhu abadan. Iyyākum an tajʿalū li-llāhi wazīran aw naẓīran aw ḍiddan aw niddan aw waṣiyyan aw qarīnan aw mithālan. Va dar Bayān īn asāmī va mā ḥaddadtum bihi anfusakum jamīʿ rā maḥv farmūde-and.

In short, these are the days of Revelation, and the True One is manifest like the sun in the midst of heaven. There are no worldly riches in His holy court that He should need an executor to divide them. And if you say that He needs a successor in His Cause, this is an outrage on your part against God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. For the Cause has always revolved, and will always revolve, around His own Self, and will never be separated from Him. Beware of assigning to God a minister, a peer, an adversary, a rival, a successor, a companion, or a likeness. In the Bayán He has effaced all these names and everything by which you have confined yourselves.

164

اینست که ذکر مرایا در بیان من قبل الرّحمن نازل شده و آن هم محدود نبوده و نخواهد بود امیدواریم که از رشحات سماء تقدیس امطار قدسیّه بر قلوب غبرهٴ مکدّره مبذول شود که شاید از اشارات طاهر شده بمنظر ملیک اسماء و صفات توجّه نمایند فواللّه یا قوم مقصود از ذکر این براهین متقنه و ادلّهٴ محکمه و کلمات غیر متشابهه اثبات نفسم نبوده چه که هر نفسی که بأقلّ عمّا یحصی ببصر معنوی فایز شده البتّه انوار شمس ابهی را که در کلّ شیء علی هیئة انّه لا اله الّا انا العزیز الحکیم تجلّی فرموده مشاهده مینماید

Īnast ke dhekr-e marāyā dar Bayān min qibal al-Raḥmān nāzel shode va ān ham maḥdūd nabūde va nakhāhad būd. Omīdvārīm ke az rashaḥāt-e samā-ye taqdīs amṭār-e qodsiyye bar qolūb-e ghabere-ye mokaddare mabdhūl shavad ke shāyad az eshārāt ṭāher shode be-manẓar-e Malīk-e asmāʾ va ṣefāt tavajjoh namāyand. Fa-wa-Allāh yā qawm, maqṣūd az dhekr-e īn barāhīn-e motqane va adelle-ye moḥkame va kalemāt-e gheyr-e motashābehe ethbāt-e nafsam nabūde, che ke har nafsī ke be-aqall-e ʿammā yuḥṣā be-baṣar-e maʿnavī fāyez shode albatte anvār-e shams-e Abhā rā ke dar kull-e shayʾ ʿalā hayʾati innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥakīm tajallī farmūde moshāhede mīnamāyad.

Thus it is that mention of mirrors has been revealed in the Bayán by the All-Merciful, and this too has not been, and will not be, restricted. We hope that, from the showers of the heaven of sanctity, holy rains may be bestowed upon dusty, clouded hearts, so that they may be cleansed of allusions and turn toward the countenance of the Sovereign of names and attributes. By God, O people, My purpose in setting forth these conclusive proofs, these firm arguments, and these unambiguous words has not been to establish My own claim. For anyone endowed with even an immeasurably small degree of spiritual vision will assuredly behold the rays of the All-Glorious Sun, which has shone forth in all things in the form of “Indeed, there is no God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Wise.”

165

بلکه مقصودی من یأتی فی المستغاث تاللّه اذاً یبکی قلمی و اناملی ثمّ عینی و قلبی و کبدی و عروقی و دمی و عظمی و جلدی بما یرد علیه من هؤلآء الّذینهم کفروا باللّه و حاربوا بنفسه و جادلوا بآیاته و انکروا فضله و افتوا علیه بعد الّذی ظهر بکلّ الآیات و الحجج و العلامات

Balke maqṣūdam man yaʾtī fī al-Mustaghāth. Ta-Allāh idhan yabkī qalamī wa anāmilī thumma ʿaynī wa qalbī wa kabidī wa ʿurūqī wa damī wa ʿaẓmī wa jildī bi-mā yaridu ʿalayhi min hāʾulāʾ alladhīna hum kafarū bi-Allāh wa ḥārabū bi-nafsihi wa jādalū bi-āyātihi wa ankarū faḍlahu wa aftaw ʿalayhi baʿda alladhī ẓahara bi-kulli al-āyāt wa al-ḥujaj wa al-ʿalāmāt.

Rather, My purpose concerns Him who will come in the Mustagháth. By God, at this My pen and My fingers weep, as do My eye, My heart, My liver, My veins, My blood, My bones, and My skin, over what will befall Him at the hands of those who have disbelieved in God, fought against His own Self, disputed His verses, denied His grace, and pronounced judgment against Him after He appeared with every verse, proof, and sign.

166

فواللّه فعلتم ما لا فعل احد من ملل القبل و ارتکبتم ما شقّ عنه هیکل العظمة ردآء الصّبر ولکن انتم تمشون علی وجه الأرض کمن لا ذنب له فأفّ لکم یا ملأ المشرکین

Fa-wa-Allāh faʿaltum mā lā faʿala aḥadun min milal al-qabl wa irtakabtum mā shaqqa ʿanhu Haykal al-ʿAẓama ridāʾ al-ṣabr wa lākin antum tamshūna ʿalā wajh al-arḍ ka-man lā dhanba lahu fa-uffin lakum yā malaʾ al-mushrikīn.

By God, you have done what no one among the communities of the past has done, and committed that for which the Temple of Grandeur has torn the robe of patience. Yet you walk upon the earth like those who have committed no sin. Shame on you, O company of those who associate partners with God!

167

تاللّه یا قوم انّ فی الکذب روایح و کذلک فی الصّدق لو انتم تطهّرون قلوبکم و اشمامکم و تستنشقوا لتجدنّ رایحة اللّه المهیمن القیّوم قلم متحیّر است که چه ذکر نماید و حال امر بمقامی رسیده که ساذج روحی که اگر محلّ خطاب ابهی کلمات عالمین واقع شود خود را محزون مشاهده مینماید باید باستماع ادنی کلمات مشغول شود

Ta-Allāh yā qawm inna fī al-kadhib rawāʾiḥ wa kadhālika fī al-ṣidq law antum tuṭahhirūna qulūbakum wa ashmāmakum wa tastanshiqū la-tajidunna rāʾiḥat Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Qalam motaḥayyer ast ke che dhekr namāyad va ḥāl amr be-maqāmī resīde ke sādhej-e rūḥī ke agar maḥall-e kheṭāb-e abhā kalemāt-e ʿālamīn vāqeʿ shavad khod rā maḥzūn moshāhede mīnamāyad bāyad be-estemāʿ-e adnā kalemāt mashghūl shavad.

By God, O people, falsehood has its odors, and truth likewise. If you would purify your hearts and your sense of smell and breathe deeply, you would surely perceive the fragrance of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. The Pen is bewildered as to what to mention. Matters have now reached such a point that the pure essence of spirit, which would find itself saddened even to be addressed by the most glorious words in all the worlds, must occupy itself with listening to the lowliest words:

168

که چگونه میشود ذئب راعی اغنام شود بگو ای فقیر بی‌بصر اوّلاً راعی را نشناخته و ثانیاً سالها ذیاب راعی شما بوده چنانچه بعد از ظهور نیّر الهی از افق سماء معنوی ادراک نموده‌اید که متابعت قومی مینمودید که صدهزار مرتبه ذئب از آن نفوس عنداللّه ارجح بوده چه که بفتوای آن ذیاب مظهر ربّ الأرباب بتمام ظلم شهید شد لعنة اللّه علیهم و علی اتباعهم

Ke chegūne mīshavad dheʾb rāʿī-ye aghnām shavad. Begū ey faqīr-e bī-baṣar, avvalan rāʿī rā nashenākhte va thāniyan sālhā dheʾāb rāʿī-ye shomā būde, chenānche baʿd az ẓohūr-e nayyer-e elāhī az ofoq-e samā-ye maʿnavī edrāk namūde-īd ke motābeʿat-e qawmī mīnamūdīd ke ṣad-hezār martabe dheʾb az ān nofūs ʿinda Allāh arjaḥ būde, che ke be-fatvā-ye ān dheʾāb Maẓhar-e Rabb al-Arbāb be-tamām-e ẓolm shahīd shod. Laʿnat Allāh ʿalayhim wa ʿalā atbāʿihim.

“How can a wolf become the shepherd of the sheep?” Say: O sightless, impoverished one! First, you have not recognized the Shepherd; and second, for years wolves have been your shepherds. For after the divine Luminary rose above the horizon of the spiritual heaven, you realized that you had been following a people to whom, in God’s sight, a wolf was a hundred thousand times preferable. For it was through the ruling of those wolves that the Manifestation of the Lord of Lords was martyred with utter cruelty. God’s curse be upon them and upon their followers.

169

و اگر بگوئی قبل از ظهور متابعت آن قوم مجری و عنداللّه مقبول بود و بعد از ظهور و توقّف این قوم در امر الهی از نار محسوب شده‌اند حال هم در این ظهور قدس صمدانی همان حکم را جاری کن بشنوید نصح الهی را و قلب را از اشارات کلمات اهل حجبات مطهّر سازید بگو ای بندگان هوی قدمی بسوی خدا بردارید و از ارض ظنّ بهوای یقین طیران نمائید

Va agar begūʾī qabl az ẓohūr motābeʿat-e ān qawm mojrā va ʿinda Allāh maqbūl būd va baʿd az ẓohūr va tavaqqof-e īn qawm dar amr-e elāhī az nār maḥsūb shode-and, ḥāl ham dar īn ẓohūr-e qods-e ṣamadānī hamān ḥokm rā jārī kon. Beshnavīd noṣḥ-e elāhī rā va qalb rā az eshārāt-e kalemāt-e ahl-e ḥojobāt moṭahhar sāzīd. Begū ey bandegān-e havā, qadamī be-sū-ye Khodā bardārīd va az arḍ-e ẓann be-havā-ye yaqīn ṭayarān namāyīd.

And if you say that before the Revelation following those people was the accepted practice and was acceptable to God, and that after the Revelation, because they hesitated in the Cause of God, they were numbered among the people of the fire, then apply the same judgment now in this Revelation of eternal holiness. Listen to the counsel of God and purify your hearts of the allusions in the words of those who are veiled. Say: O servants of desire, take a step toward God and soar from the land of conjecture into the air of certitude.

170

ان یا قلم القدم دع حینئذ ما اردت ان تذکره لعباد اللّه ثمّ اذکر اخیک الّذی حارب بنفسک و جادل بآیات اللّه لیکون ذکری للعالمین لعلّ یفتح بذلک ابصار الّذین ارادوا الوجه فی العشیّ و الاشراق و ما زلّت اقدامهم فی هذا الیوم الّذی فیه التفّت السّاق بالسّاق

An yā Qalam al-Qidam daʿ ḥīnaʾidhin mā aradta an tadhkurahu li-ʿibād Allāh thumma udhkur akhīka alladhī ḥāraba bi-nafsika wa jādala bi-āyāt Allāh li-yakūna dhikrī li-al-ʿālamīn laʿalla yaftaḥu bi-dhālika abṣār alladhīna arādū al-wajh fī al-ʿashiyy wa al-ishrāq wa mā zallat aqdāmuhum fī hādhā al-yawm alladhī fīhi iltaffati al-sāqu bi-al-sāq.

O Pen of Eternity, leave aside for now what you intended to mention to the servants of God. Speak instead of your brother, who fought against your own Self and disputed the verses of God, that My account may be for all the worlds. Perhaps through it the eyes of those who have sought the Face at evening and at dawn may be opened, whose feet have not slipped on this Day when leg is entwined with leg.

171

فوالّذی نفسی بیده که بیست سنه در تعلیم و تأدیب و تربیت و حفظش سعی بلیغ و جهد منیع مبذول شد که ذکرش ممکن نه تا آنکه هجرت واقع و باین ارض وارد شدیم چندی گذشت سیّد محمّد اصفهانی از بیت ‌اللّه و حصن حبّه خارج و بمقرّ دیگر مستقرّ و اخوی فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو در صدد قطع سدرهٴ ربّانیّه برآمده الی ان اظهر اللّه خافیة نفسه و اشتهر مکره بین المهاجرین و ارتفع الضّجیج عن کلّ اناث و ذکور و صغیر و کبیر

Fa-wa-alladhī nafsī bi-yadihi ke bīst sane dar taʿlīm va taʾdīb va tarbiyat va ḥefẓash saʿy-e balīgh va jahd-e manīʿ mabdhūl shod ke dhekrash momken na, tā ānke hejrat vāqeʿ va be-īn arḍ vāred shodīm. Chandī godhasht, Seyyed Moḥammad-e Eṣfahānī az Bayt Allāh va ḥeṣn-e ḥobbash khārej va be-maqarr-e dīgar mostaqarr va akhavī fa-wa-Allāh alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa dar ṣadad-e qaṭʿ-e sedre-ye rabbāniyye bar-āmade, ilā an aẓhara Allāhu khāfiyata nafsihi wa ishtahara makruhu bayna al-muhājirīn wa irtafaʿa al-ḍajīj ʿan kulli ināthin wa dhukūrin wa ṣaghīrin wa kabīr.

By Him in whose hand is My soul, for twenty years such strenuous efforts and such immense exertions were devoted to his instruction, discipline, upbringing, and protection that they cannot be recounted, until the departure took place and We arrived in this land. Some time passed. Siyyid Muḥammad-i-Iṣfahání left the House of God and the fortress of His love and settled elsewhere. And My brother—by God, besides whom there is no other god—set about cutting down the divine Lote-Tree, until God laid bare what was hidden within him, his scheming became known among the emigrants, and an outcry arose from every woman and man, young and old.

172

و این عبد بالمرّه از جمیع گذشته خارج شده که شاید حرارت حسد بیفسرد و نار بغضا ساکن شود و در بیت وحده ساکن شده و ابواب خروج و دخول بر کلّ مسدود نمودم و اهل حرم جمیع از استماع این امر منکر در نوحه و ندبه مشغول فواللّه لن یقدر احد ان یذکر ما ورد علینا و لن یستطیع ان یسمعه احد من المحبّین

Va īn ʿabd bi-al-marre az jamīʿ godhashte khārej shode ke shāyad ḥarārat-e ḥasad beyafsorad va nār-e baghḍā sāken shavad, va dar bayt vaḥdahu sāken shode va abvāb-e khorūj va dokhūl bar koll masdūd namūdam. Va ahl-e ḥaram jamīʿ az estemāʿ-e īn amr-e monkar dar nawḥe va nodbe mashghūl. Fa-wa-Allāh lan yaqdira aḥadun an yadhkura mā warada ʿalaynā wa lan yastaṭīʿa an yasmaʿahu aḥadun mina al-muḥibbīn.

This servant relinquished everything and withdrew, so that perhaps the heat of envy might cool and the fire of hatred subside. I took up residence alone in a house and closed the doors to everyone coming or going. All the members of the household, on hearing of this heinous affair, were occupied with lamentation and weeping. By God, no one will ever be able to recount what befell Us, nor will any of Our loved ones be able to bear hearing it.

173

و در حین خروج سه نفر برای خدمت معیّن شد دو نفر مخصوص اخوی مذکور و کلیم و یک نفس برای خود و هم‌چنین دراهم معدوده که از دولت علیّه میرسید مابین کلّ قسمت شده و بعد کلّ متفرّق شده در اماکن متعدّده ساکن و این عبد در بیت وحده جالس مغلق الباب و مرخی الحجاب و ابداً بنفسی از احباب و غیره معاشرت ننموده بالمرّه باب لقا مسدود و جمال بقا مستور

Va dar ḥīn-i khurūj sih nafar barā-yi khidmat muʿayyan shud, du nafar makhṣūṣ-i akhavī-yi madhkūr va Kalīm va yak nafs barā-yi khud, va hamchunīn darāhim-i maʿdūdih kih az dawlat-i ʿaliyyih mīrasīd mābayn-i kull qismat shudih, va baʿd kull mutafarriq shudih dar amākin-i mutaʿaddidih sākin, va īn ʿabd dar bayt vaḥdahū jālis, mughlaq al-bāb va murkhā al-ḥijāb, va abadan bi-nafsī az aḥbāb va ghayrih muʿāshirat nanamūdih, bi’l-marrih bāb-i liqā masdūd va jamāl-i baqā mastūr.

At the time of departure, three people were appointed to serve: two specifically for the aforementioned brother and Kalīm, and one for Myself. Likewise, the small sum received from the imperial government was divided among everyone. Then all dispersed and settled in various places, while this servant sat alone in the house, with the door closed and the curtain drawn. I personally associated with none of the friends or anyone else. The door of access was completely closed, and the Beauty of Eternity was concealed.

174

و بعد از ستر جمال قدم سیّد محمّد باخوی پیوست و بغض اللّه سبب و علّت اتّحاد این دو شد و بخدعه و مکر مشغول شدند چنانچه نفسی را بدراهم فریب داده که ببلاد رود و آنچه ارتکاب نموده‌اند بسدرهٴ امر نسبت دهد دیگر تفصیل بسیار ولکن اشتغال باین اذکار را جایز نمیدانم البتّه شنیده‌اید بقدر ضرورت اظهار میشود که مباد ناس از کلمات کذبهٴ فانیه از صراط امریّه بلغزند

Va baʿd az satr-i jamāl-i qidam, Siyyid Muḥammad bi-akhavī payvast va bughḍ-i Allāh sabab va ʿillat-i ittiḥād-i īn du shud va bi-khudʿih va makr mashghūl shudand, chunānchih nafsī rā bi-darāhim farīb dādih kih bi-bilād ravad va ānchih irtikāb namūdih-and bi-sidrih-yi amr nisbat dihad. Dīgar tafṣīl bisyār, valākin ishtighāl bi-īn adhkār rā jāʾiz namīdānam. Albattih shinīdih-īd. Bi-qadr-i ḍarūrat iẓhār mīshavad kih mabād nās az kalimāt-i kadhabih-yi fāniyih az ṣirāṭ-i amriyyih bilaghzand.

After the Ancient Beauty withdrew into concealment, Siyyid Muḥammad joined My brother, and hatred of God became the cause and reason for their union. They occupied themselves with deceit and intrigue, even bribing someone with money to travel to the provinces and attribute to the Lote-Tree of the Cause what they themselves had committed. There is much more to recount, but I do not consider it fitting to occupy Myself with these matters. You have surely heard. Only as much as is necessary is disclosed, lest people be led by the words of these perishable liars to stray from the path of the Cause.

175

تا آنکه نفس مأمور نادم شده نزد بعضی رفته تفصیل امور را مذکور نمود و چون مراسلاتی که با او همراه نموده مشاهده نمودند جمیع را تحیّر دست داده چه که آنچه عامل شده بحقّ راجع نموده‌اند و هم‌چنین رساله در ردّ اللّه نوشته که باطراف برده انتشار دهند فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو بمثل صبیان بل ادنی تکلّم نموده لو انتم تعرفون و آنچه را بزعم خود در ردّ اللّه نوشته‌اند کلّ مثبت این امر ابدع بوده لو کان النّاس ببصر اللّه فی کلماتهم ینظرون

Tā ānkih nafs-i maʾmūr nādim shudih nazd-i baʿḍī raftih tafṣīl-i umūr rā madhkūr namūd, va chūn murāsalātī kih bā ū hamrāh namūdih mushāhidih namūdand jamīʿ rā taḥayyur dast dādih, chih kih ānchih ʿāmil shudih bi-Ḥaqq rājiʿ namūdih-and. Va hamchunīn risālih dar radd-i Allāh nivishtih kih bi-aṭrāf burdih intishār dihand. Fa-wa-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, bi-mithl-i ṣibyān bal adnā takallum namūdih, law antum taʿrifūn. Va ānchih rā bi-zaʿm-i khud dar radd-i Allāh nivishtih-and kull muthbit-i īn amr-i abdaʿ būdih, law kāna al-nāsu bi-baṣari Allāhi fī kalimātihim yanẓurūn.

Eventually, the person they had commissioned became remorseful, went to certain people, and related the details of these affairs. When they saw the correspondence he had been given to carry, they were all seized with astonishment, for everything those men had done they had attributed to the True One. They had also written a treatise refuting God, to be taken to various regions and circulated. By God, besides whom there is no other god, they have spoken like children—indeed, worse—if only you understood. Everything they imagined they had written in refutation of God has, in fact, affirmed this wondrous Cause, if only people would examine their words with the eye of God.

176

و دیگر چه مقدار مفتریات بملیک اسماء و صفات نسبت داده‌اند و آنچه دون خیر بوده باصل شجرهٴ ربوبیّه راجع نموده انّما اشکو بثّی و حزنی الی اللّه اذاً یتکلّم لسان اللّه و یقول

Va dīgar chih miqdār muftariyāt bi-Malīk-i asmā va ṣifāt nisbat dādih-and, va ānchih dūn-i khayr būdih bi-aṣl-i shajari h-yi rubūbiyyih rājiʿ namūdih. Innamā ashkū baththī wa-ḥuznī ilā Allāh. Idhan yatakallamu lisānu Allāhi wa-yaqūl.

How many other fabrications they have attributed to the Sovereign of names and attributes! Whatever was not good they have ascribed to the very root of the Tree of Lordship. “I complain of my anguish and sorrow only to God.” Then the Tongue of God speaks and says:

177

هل من مآء صافی یطهّر حولی عن هؤلآء المعرضین و هل من سیف لسان یفتح بالبیان و یدفع عن فنائی شرّ المشرکین و هل من ذی استقامة ینصرنی فی هذه الأیّام الّتی احاطتنی المنکرین و هل من ذی انقطاع یعرفنی بعینی و ینقطع عن العالمین و هل من ذی بصر لینظر فی امری و ما ورد علیّ من جنود الشّیاطین و هل من ذی قلب رقیق طاهر لیبکی ببکائی و بما ورد علیّ من هؤلآء المستکبرین و هل من ذی علم یصدّ سیوف الرّدّ و البغضآء عن وجه اللّه الملک العزیز الجمیل

Hal min māʾin ṣāfin yuṭahhiru ḥawlī ʿan hāʾulāʾi al-muʿriḍīn, wa-hal min sayfi lisānin yaftaḥu bi’l-bayāni wa-yadfaʿu ʿan fināʾī sharra al-mushrikīn, wa-hal min dhī istiqāmatin yanṣurunī fī hādhihi al-ayyāmi allatī aḥāṭatnī al-munkirīn, wa-hal min dhī inqiṭāʿin yaʿrifunī bi-ʿaynī wa-yanqaṭiʿu ʿan al-ʿālamīn, wa-hal min dhī baṣarin li-yanẓura fī amrī wa-mā warada ʿalayya min junūdi al-shayāṭīn, wa-hal min dhī qalbin raqīqin ṭāhirin li-yabkiya bi-bukāʾī wa-bi-mā warada ʿalayya min hāʾulāʾi al-mustakbirīn, wa-hal min dhī ʿilmin yaṣuddu suyūfa al-raddi wa’l-baghḍāʾi ʿan wajhi Allāhi al-Maliki al-ʿAzīzi al-Jamīl.

“Is there any pure water to cleanse My surroundings of these people who turn away? Is there any sword of the tongue to conquer through utterance and ward off from My court the evil of those who associate partners with God? Is there anyone steadfast to help Me in these days when the deniers have surrounded Me? Is there anyone detached to know Me through My own eye and sever himself from all the worlds? Is there anyone with vision to examine My Cause and what has befallen Me from the hosts of devils? Is there anyone with a tender, pure heart to weep at My weeping and at what these arrogant ones have inflicted upon Me? Is there anyone with knowledge to turn the swords of rejection and hatred away from the face of God, the King, the Almighty, the Beautiful?”

178

ان یا قلم الأعلی قل تاللّه الحقّ انّی ما استنصرت من احد حین الّذی حارب معی کلّ الملل و کان اللّه علی ذلک شهید و علیم و کلّما استنصر من احد و نأمر به العباد هذا لم یکن الّا لبلوغهم الی ذروة الفضل و من دون ذلک انّ اللّه لغنیّ حمید

In yā Qalama al-Aʿlā, qul ta-llāhi al-Ḥaqq, innī mā istanṣartu min aḥadin ḥīna alladhī ḥāraba maʿī kullu al-milal, wa-kāna Allāhu ʿalā dhālika shahīd wa-ʿalīm. Wa-kullamā istanṣara min aḥadin wa-naʾmuru bihi al-ʿibād, hādhā lam yakun illā li-bulūghihim ilā dhirwati al-faḍl, wa-min dūni dhālika inna Allāha la-ghaniyyun ḥamīd.

O Most Exalted Pen! Say: “By God, the True One, I sought help from no one when all the nations made war upon Me, and God is a witness to this and knows it well. Whenever He seeks help from anyone, and We enjoin this upon Our servants, it is solely that they may attain the summit of grace. Apart from this, God is indeed Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

179

باری رسائل متعدّده در ردّ سلطان احدیّه نوشته‌اند تاللّه بطل بذلک اعمالهم و ضلّ سعیهم فی الدّنیا و الآخرة و هم لا یشعرون و آنچه را سبب و علّت اعراض ناس دانسته‌اند باین عبد نسبت داده‌اند از جمله نسبت دنیا و این بر کلّ ذی شعور واضح بوده که این عبد در مابین معرضین چون شمس واضح و لایح بود و قسم بجمال قدم که در هیچ صبحی امید نبود که لیل ادراک شود و هم‌چنین هیچ لیلی گمان مشاهدهٴ فجر نه چه که مشرکین بکمال جدّ در قطع سدرهٴ ربّ العالمین بوده تا آنکه شمس قدرت ید اللّه فوق ایدیهم از افق جیب عظمت اشراق فرمود و مشرکین مغلوب و جمال انّه لهو الغالب علی کلّ شیء بر عرش قدرت و اقتدار مستوی و باعزاز تمام از عراق حرکت نمود

Bārī rasāʾil-i mutaʿaddidih dar radd-i Sulṭān-i aḥadiyyih nivishtih-and. Ta-llāhi baṭala bi-dhālika aʿmāluhum wa-ḍalla saʿyuhum fī al-dunyā wa’l-ākhirati wa-hum lā yashʿurūn. Va ānchih rā sabab va ʿillat-i iʿrāḍ-i nās dānistih-and bi-īn ʿabd nisbat dādih-and, az jumlih nisbat-i dunyā. Va īn bar kull-i dhī shuʿūr vāḍiḥ būdih kih īn ʿabd dar mābayn-i muʿriḍīn chūn shams vāḍiḥ va lāʾiḥ būd, va qasam bi-jamāl-i qidam kih dar hīch ṣubḥī umīd nabūd kih layl idrāk shavad va hamchunīn hīch laylī gumān-i mushāhidih-yi fajr nah, chih kih mushrikīn bi-kamāl-i jidd dar qaṭʿ-i sidrih-yi Rabb-i ʿālamīn būdih, tā ānkih shams-i qudrat-i Yadu Allāhi fawqa aydīhim az ufuq-i jayb-i ʿaẓamat ishrāq farmūd va mushrikīn maghlūb va jamāl-i Innahu la-huwa al-ghālibu ʿalā kulli shayʾ bar ʿarsh-i qudrat va iqtidār mustavī va bi-iʿzāz-i tamām az ʿIrāq ḥarakat namūd.

In short, they have written numerous treatises refuting the Sovereign of Oneness. By God, through this their deeds have come to nothing and their efforts have gone astray in this world and the next, yet they do not perceive it. They have attributed to this servant whatever they thought would cause people to turn away, including worldliness. Yet it was clear to every discerning person that this servant was as manifest and radiant as the sun amid those who turned away. I swear by the Ancient Beauty that no morning held any hope of living to see the night, nor did any night bring any expectation of witnessing the dawn, for those who associate partners with God were striving with all their might to cut down the Lote-Tree of the Lord of the worlds. At last the sun of the power of “The hand of God is above their hands” shone from the horizon of the bosom of grandeur, and those who associate partners with God were vanquished. The Beauty of “He is indeed supreme over all things” was established upon the throne of power and might and departed from Iraq with the utmost honor.

180

و این معلوم بوده که اراده آن بود که وحده عازم اسلامبول شوم چون جمعی جزع و فزع لایحصی نمودند ببعضی اذن خروج داده شد و بعضی هم من غیر اذن حرکت نمودند تا آنکه وارد ارض مشهور شدیم و ابداً بدولت علیّه مطلبی اظهار نشد و هر نفسی که بین یدی حاضر شد ملاقات واقع والّا فلا چنانچه جمیع استماع نموده و در نفس مدینۀ کبیر هم شنیده‌اند که ارادهٴ الهی چه بوده تا آنکه چند نفر مستضعفین حفظاً لأنفسهم و نسائهم مضطرب شده و جزع نمودند لذا ترحّماً لأنفسهم حکم بدا نازل

Va īn maʿlūm būdih kih irādih ān būd kih vaḥdahū ʿāzim-i Islāmbūl shavam. Chūn jamʿī jazaʿ va fazaʿ-i lā yuḥṣā namūdand bi-baʿḍī idhn-i khurūj dādih shud va baʿḍī ham min ghayr-i idhn ḥarakat namūdand, tā ānkih vārid-i arḍ-i mashhūr shudīm. Va abadan bi-dawlat-i ʿaliyyih maṭlabī iẓhār nashud, va har nafsī kih bayna yaday ḥāḍir shud mulāqāt vāqiʿ va-illā fa-lā, chunānchih jamīʿ istimāʿ namūdih va dar nafs-i Madīnih-yi Kabīr ham shinīdih-and kih irādih-yi ilāhī chih būdih, tā ānkih chand nafar mustaḍʿafīn ḥifẓan li-anfusihim wa-nisāʾihim muḍṭarib shudih va jazaʿ namūdand. Lidhā taraḥḥuman li-anfusihim ḥukm-i badā nāzil.

It was known that My intention was to set out alone for Istanbul. When a number of people raised immeasurable cries of grief and distress, some were given permission to leave, while others set out without permission, until We arrived in the well-known land. No request whatsoever was made to the imperial government. Whoever came into My presence was received; otherwise, no meeting took place. Everyone has heard this, and in the Great City itself they also heard what the divine intention had been, until a few weak souls became anxious for their own safety and that of their wives and began to lament. Thus, out of compassion for them, a decree changing the former decree was revealed.

181

حال کدام یک از این امور متعلّق بدنیا بوده باری قیاس بنفس نموده‌اند کذلک صفت لهم السنتهم الکذبة یقولون ما لا یشعرون واللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو قلم حیا مینماید از آنچه عامل شده‌اند ذکر نماید و اگر ذی بصری یافت شود از رسائل حضرات که از قلم جهل و بغضا ظاهر شده مقام و شأن معرضین مشهود گردد

Ḥāl kudām yak az īn umūr mutaʿalliq bi-dunyā būdih? Bārī qiyās bi-nafs namūdih-and. Kadhālika ṣafat lahum alsinatuhum al-kadhibah, yaqūlūna mā lā yashʿurūn. Wa-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, qalam ḥayā mīnamāyad az ānchih ʿāmil shudih-and dhikr namāyad, va agar dhī baṣarī yāft shavad az rasāʾil-i ḥaḍarāt kih az qalam-i jahl va baghḍā ẓāhir shudih maqām va shaʾn-i muʿriḍīn mashhūd gardad.

Now, which of these matters had anything to do with the world? They have, in short, judged Me by themselves. Thus have their lying tongues described matters to them; they say what they do not comprehend. By God, besides whom there is no other god, the Pen is ashamed to mention what they have done.
