If anyone with discernment could be found, the standing and character of those who turn away would become apparent from these gentlemen’s treatises, which have issued from the pen of ignorance and hatred.

182

دو سنهٴ قبل شعری جناب آقا محمّد علی و جناب سلمان سؤال نموده اخوی جواب نوشته بعد سیّد محمّد اصفهانی بین یدی حاضر و مذکور داشت میرزا علی ملتفت معنی شعر نشده‌اند و مصلحت نیست این مکتوب به سلمان داده شود این بنده سکوت نمود بعد با حاجی میرزا احمد نزد اخوی در بیت کلیم ذکر نمودند اخوی بعد از کلمات لایغنیه بالأخره متعذّر شد که شاید سائل اصل شعر را غلط نوشته باشد

Du sanih-yi qabl shiʿrī Janāb-i Āqā Muḥammad ʿAlī va Janāb-i Salmān suʾāl namūdih, akhavī javāb nivishtih. Baʿd Siyyid Muḥammad-i Iṣfahānī bayna yaday ḥāḍir va madhkūr dāsht Mīrzā ʿAlī multafit-i maʿnī-yi shiʿr nashudih-and va maṣlaḥat nīst īn maktūb bi-Salmān dādih shavad. Īn bandih sukūt namūd. Baʿd bā Ḥājī Mīrzā Aḥmad nazd-i akhavī dar bayt-i Kalīm dhikr namūdand. Akhavī baʿd az kalimāt-i lā yughniyih bi’l-ākharah mutaʿadhdhir shud kih shāyad sāʾil aṣl-i shiʿr rā ghalaṭ nivishtih bāshad.

Two years ago, Āqā Muḥammad ʿAlī and Salmān asked about a verse of poetry, and My brother wrote a reply. Siyyid Muḥammad-i-Iṣfahānī then came into My presence and said, “Mīrzā ʿAlī has not understood the meaning of the verse, and it is not advisable to give this letter to Salmān.” This servant remained silent. Later, together with Ḥājī Mīrzā Aḥmad, he raised the matter with My brother in Kalīm’s house. After some unhelpful remarks, My brother finally offered the excuse that perhaps the questioner had copied the original verse incorrectly.

183

بعد شعر را ملاحظه نمودند صحیح نوشته بود و آن نوشته نزد سلمان موجود است و جمیع ملاحظه نموده‌اند ابداً نفسی شاعر نشده چه که کلّ بحجبات وهمیّه محتجبند حال ملاحظه نمائید تا مقدار معرضین معلوم شود و مع‌ذلک بمنبع و مصدر علم ربّانیّه اعتراض مینمایند فوالّذی قامت ملکوت التّقدیر علی فنآء بابه که کلّ آنچه از قلم جاری نموده‌اند بهمین نحو بوده و خواهد بود ولکن عمت الأبصار احجاب الوهم و الهوی و لذا لا یلتفتون الّا الّذین جعل اللّه ابصارهم مطهّراً عن الأحجاب و هم ببصر الحدید فی کلّ شیء ینظرون

Baʿd shiʿr rā mulāḥiẓih namūdand, ṣaḥīḥ nivishtih būd, va ān nivishtih nazd-i Salmān mawjūd ast va jamīʿ mulāḥiẓih namūdih-and. Abadan nafsī shāʿir nashudih, chih kih kull bi-ḥujubāt-i vahmiyyih muḥtajiband. Ḥāl mulāḥiẓih namāyīd tā miqdār-i muʿriḍīn maʿlūm shavad, va maʿa-dhālik bi-manbaʿ va maṣdar-i ʿilm-i rabbāniyyih iʿtirāḍ mīnamāyand. Fa-wa-alladhī qāmat malakūtu al-taqdīri ʿalā fināʾi bābih, kih kull-i ānchih az qalam jārī namūdih-and bi-hamīn naḥv būdih va khvāhad būd. Va-lākin ʿamat al-abṣāra aḥjābu al-wahmi wa’l-hawā, va lidhā lā yaltafitūna illā alladhīna jaʿala Allāhu abṣārahum muṭahharan ʿan al-aḥjāb, wa-hum bi-baṣari al-ḥadīdi fī kulli shayʾin yanẓurūn.

They then examined the verse: it had been copied correctly. That document is still in Salmān’s possession, and everyone has seen it. Yet no one has taken any notice, for all are veiled by imaginary notions. Now consider this, so that the worth of those who turn away may become known. Despite this, they object to the fountainhead and source of divine knowledge. By Him at whose threshold the kingdom of destiny stands, everything they have set down with their pens has been, and will be, of this same kind. But the veils of delusion and desire have blinded their eyes, and thus none take heed except those whose sight God has purified of veils; they look upon all things with keen vision.

184

ای عباد ملاحظه نمائید که ضرّ بمقامی رسیده که قلم اعلی باین کلمات مشغول شده چه که ناس ضعیف و نابالغ مشاهده میشوند که مباد از کلمات جعلیّهٴ معرضین از جمال مبین غافل شوند والّا اگر فی‌الجمله شعور و بصر ملاحظه میشد ابداً ذکر معرضین و ما ظهر منهم تحریر نمیشد چه که الیوم کلّ مکلّفند که در نفس امر و ما یظهر من عنده ناظر شوند و من صعد الی ذلک المقام یشهد بأنّه هو الظّاهر الباهر المشرق المضیء فی وسط السّمآء یحکم ما یشآء و لا یسأل فیما اراد و انّه لهو المقتدر المختار

Ay ʿibād, mulāḥiẓih namāyīd kih ḍurr bi-maqāmī rasīdih kih Qalam-i Aʿlā bi-īn kalimāt mashghūl shudih, chih kih nās ḍaʿīf va nābāligh mushāhidih mīshavand, kih mabād az kalimāt-i jaʿliyyih-yi muʿriḍīn az Jamāl-i Mubīn ghāfil shavand. Va-illā agar fī’l-jumlih shuʿūr va baṣar mulāḥiẓih mīshud abadan dhikr-i muʿriḍīn va mā ẓahara minhum taḥrīr namīshud, chih kih al-yawm kull mukallafand kih dar nafs-i amr va mā yaẓharu min ʿindih nāẓir shavand. Wa-man ṣaʿida ilā dhālika al-maqāmi yashhadu bi-annahu huwa al-Ẓāhiru al-Bāhiru al-Mushriqu al-Muḍīʾu fī wasaṭi al-samāʾ, yaḥkumu mā yashāʾu wa-lā yusʾalu fīmā arāda wa-innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadiru al-Mukhtār.

O servants! Consider how grievous the harm has become, that the Most Exalted Pen has occupied itself with these words. People are seen to be weak and immature, and it is feared that the fabricated words of those who turn away may cause them to become heedless of the Manifest Beauty. Otherwise, had even a little understanding and discernment been observed, no mention of those who turn away or of what has proceeded from them would ever have been written. For today everyone is obliged to look to the Cause itself and to what appears from its Source. Whoever ascends to that station will testify that He is the Manifest, the Resplendent, the Radiant, the Luminous in the midst of heaven. He ordains whatever He wills and is not questioned concerning what He desires. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.

185

و از جمله نسبت ظلم باین مظلوم داده‌اند حال در همین فقره تفکّر نمائید و انصاف دهید جمیع اهل بیان باین عبد ملاقات نموده و بچشم ظاهر دیده هرگز بضرّ نفسی راضی شده لا فوربّ العرش لو انتم تنصفون و قد کان نفس الرّحمن فی فم الثّعبان عشرین من السّنین و مع ذلک ابداً اظهار نشد و حال هم اگر این مکاتیب مجعوله دیده نمیشد ابداً اظهار نمیرفت و یشهد بذلک کلّ من یعرفنی و کان علی بصیرة منیر

Va az jumlih nisbat-i ẓulm bi-īn maẓlūm dādih-and. Ḥāl dar hamīn fiqrih tafakkur namāyīd va inṣāf di hīd. Jamīʿ-i ahl-i Bayān bi-īn ʿabd mulāqāt namūdih va bi-chashm-i ẓāhir dīdih, hargiz bi-ḍurr-i nafsī rāḍī shudih? Lā fa-wa-Rabbi al-ʿarshi law antum tunṣifūn. Wa-qad kāna nafsu al-Raḥmāni fī fami al-thuʿbāni ʿishrīna mina al-sinīn, va maʿa dhālik abadan iẓhār nashud, va ḥāl ham agar īn makātīb-i majʿūlih dīdih namīshud abadan iẓhār namīraft. Wa-yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu man yaʿrifunī wa-kāna ʿalā baṣīratin munīr.

Among other things, they have charged this wronged One with oppression. Now reflect on this very point and judge fairly. All the people of the Bayān have met this servant and seen Him with their own eyes. Has He ever consented to anyone being harmed? No, by the Lord of the throne, if you judge fairly! The very person of the All-Merciful was in the serpent’s mouth for twenty years, yet this was never disclosed. Even now, had these fabricated letters not been seen, it would never have been disclosed. Everyone who knows Me and possesses clear insight bears witness to this.

186

بیست سنه اخوی نزد این عبد بود و احدی از او مطّلع نه و مع قدرت بر او و اطّلاع ما فی سرّه و قلبه کمال شفقت در حقّش معمول شد و یشهد بذلک کلّ الأشیآء ان انتم تسمعون ولکن چون ناس را مقلّد و بی‌بصر یافته‌اند لذا باینگونه کلمات اراده نموده‌اند این فئه را از بحر البحور منع نمایند

Bīst sanih akhavī nazd-i īn ʿabd būd va aḥadī az ū muṭṭaliʿ nah, va maʿa qudrat bar ū va iṭṭilāʿ-i mā fī sirrihi wa-qalbih kamāl-i shafaqat dar ḥaqqash maʿmūl shud. Wa-yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu al-ashyāʾi in antum tasmaʿūn. Va-lākin chūn nās rā muqallid va bī-baṣar yāftih-and lidhā bi-īngūnih kalimāt irādih namūdih-and īn fiʾih rā az baḥr-i buḥūr manʿ namāyand.

For twenty years My brother was with this servant, and no one knew of him. Although I had power over him and knew what lay concealed within him and in his heart, he was treated with the utmost compassion. All things bear witness to this, if you would listen. But since they have found people to be blind followers without discernment, they have sought, through words of this kind, to keep this community from the Ocean of oceans.

187

و بر جمیع اهل بیان و غیره واضح و مبرهن که این عبد باحدی معاشرت در این ارض ننموده و هم‌چنین در ورود مدینهٴ کبیر الّا من حضر بین یدینا و ما حرّک لسانی الّا علی ما یصعدهم الی جبروت الأمر مع‌ذلک نوشته‌اند که نزد اهل سنّت ما را رافضی نامیده‌اند فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو که خود این نفوس معرضه نزد اعجام نسبت دون ایمان بسدرهٴ رحمن داده‌اند و عند اهل سنّت و جماعت نسبت رفض حال نفسی خالصاً للّه بیاید صدق و کذب را معلوم نماید و میزان حقّ و باطل را بصدق و کذب همین قول قرار میدهیم اذاً ینادی لسان القدم من عرشه الأعظم و یقول لعن اللّه اوّل ظالم ظلم نقطة الأولی فی ظهوره الأخری و کفر بآیاته و حارب بنفسه و جادل بسلطانه و اشرک بذاته و الحد کلماته و اعرض عن جماله و کان من المشرکین فی الواح اللّه من قلم القدس مکتوبا

Va bar jamīʿ-i ahl-i Bayān va ghayrih vāḍiḥ va mubarhan kih īn ʿabd bi-aḥadī muʿāshirat dar īn arḍ nanamūdih, va hamchunīn dar vurūd-i Madīnih-yi Kabīr, illā man ḥaḍara bayna yadaynā, wa-mā ḥarraka lisānī illā ʿalā mā yuṣʿiduhum ilā jabarūti al-amr. Maʿa-dhālik nivishtih-and kih nazd-i ahl-i sunnat mā rā rāfiḍī nāmīdih-and. Fa-wa-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, kih khud-i īn nufūs-i muʿriḍih nazd-i aʿjām nisbat-i dūn-i īmān bi-sidrih-yi Raḥmān dādih-and va ʿinda ahl-i sunnat va jamāʿat nisbat-i rafḍ. Ḥāl nafsī khāliṣan li-llāh biyāyad ṣidq va kidhb rā maʿlūm namāyad, va mīzān-i ḥaqq va bāṭil rā bi-ṣidq va kidhb-i hamīn qawl qarār mīdahīm. Idhan yunādī lisānu al-qidami min ʿarshihi al-aʿẓami wa-yaqūl: laʿana Allāhu awwala ẓālimin ẓalama Nuqṭata al-Ūlā fī ẓuhūrihi al-ukhrā wa-kafara bi-āyātihi wa-ḥāraba bi-nafsihi wa-jādala bi-sulṭānihi wa-ashraka bi-dhātihi wa-alḥada kalimātihi wa-aʿraḍa ʿan jamālihi wa-kāna mina al-mushrikīna fī alwāḥi Allāhi min qalami al-qudsi maktūbā.

It is clear and evident to all the people of the Bayān and to others that this servant has associated with no one in this land, nor upon arriving in the Great City, except those who came into Our presence. My tongue moved only to speak what would raise them to the dominion of the Cause. Nevertheless, they have written, “He has called us Rāfiḍīs before the Sunnis.” By God, besides whom there is no other god, these very people who turn away have themselves accused the Lote-Tree of the All-Merciful of unbelief before the Persians and of Rāfiḍism before the Sunni community. Let someone now come, solely for God’s sake, and ascertain what is true and what is false. We make the truth or falsehood of this very statement the criterion of truth and error. Then the Tongue of Eternity calls out from His most great throne and says: “May God curse the first oppressor who wronged the Primal Point in His latter manifestation, denied His verses, made war upon His person, disputed His sovereignty, associated partners with His Essence, impugned His words, turned away from His beauty, and was numbered among those who associate partners with God, as inscribed by the Pen of holiness in the Tablets of God.”

188

فواللّه در هر وقتی از اوقات که در ارض طاء و یا عراق و مواضع دیگر حرفی در اخذ این طایفه مذکور میشد اخوی خود از عراق باطراف میرفتند چنانچه اکثری شنیده و میدانند و این عبد وحده مابین اعدا بوده تا آنکه از قدرت ربّانی امر مرتفع شد و جمیع از نفوس خود مطمئن شده از خلف ستر بیرون آمده اوّل کاری که بآن مشغول شدند قطع سدرهٴ امر بوده و چون خود را خائب و خاسر مشاهده نمودند عمّا ارادوا بعد باطراف نوشته و ارادهٴ خود را بارادة اللّه و مشیّته نسبت داده با اینکه این عبد حکم قتل را که مابین این فئه شهرت تام داشت مرتفع نمود و در اکثر الواح من قلم اللّه جاری شده و البتّه بنظر بعضی رسیده

Fa-wa-llāh dar har vaqtī az awqāt ke dar arḍ-i Ṭāʾ va yā ʿIrāq va mavāḍiʿ-i dīgar ḥarfī dar akhdh-i īn ṭāyife madhkūr mīshud akhavī khud az ʿIrāq bi-aṭrāf mīraftand chunānchi aktharī shinīde va mīdānand va īn ʿabd vaḥdahu mābayn-i aʿdā būde tā ānke az qudrat-i rabbānī amr murtafiʿ shud va jamīʿ az nufūs-i khud muṭmaʾinn shude az khalf-i sitr bīrūn āmade avval kārī ke bi-ān mashghūl shudand qaṭʿ-i sidri-yi amr būde va chun khud rā khāʾib va khāsir mushāhide nimūdand ʿammā arādū baʿd bi-aṭrāf nivishte va irādi-yi khud rā bi-irādati Allāh wa mashīʾatihi nisbat dāde bā īnke īn ʿabd ḥukm-i qatl rā ke mābayn-i īn fiʾe shuhrat-i tāmm dāsht murtafiʿ nimūd va dar akthar-i alvāḥ min qalami Allāh jārī shude va albatte bi-naẓar-i baʿḍī risīde

By God, whenever there was any talk in the Land of Ṭāʾ, in Iraq, or elsewhere of arresting this community, My brother himself would leave Iraq for other places, as most have heard and know. This servant remained alone among the enemies until, through divine power, the Cause was exalted. Once all felt secure for their own lives, they emerged from behind concealment, and the first task they undertook was to cut down the Lote-Tree of the Cause. When they saw themselves disappointed and defeated in what they had intended, they then wrote to various places, attributing their own intention to the will and purpose of God. Yet this servant abolished the injunction to kill, which had been widely known among this community. This has flowed from the Pen of God in most of the Tablets, and has certainly come to the attention of some.

189

از جمله سؤال شده که مقصود از نصری که در آیات بدیعهٴ الهیّه نازل شده چیست و ما نزّل عن جهة العرش فی جوابه این است که سواد آن بعینه ذکر میشود و هو هذا

Az jumle suʾāl shude ke maqṣūd az naṣrī ke dar āyāt-i badīʿi-yi ilāhiyye nāzil shude chīst va mā nuzzila ʿan jihati al-ʿarsh fī jawābihi īn ast ke savād-i ān bi-ʿaynihi dhikr mīshavad wa huwa hādhā

Among other things, a question was asked about what is meant by the assistance mentioned in the wondrous divine verses. What was sent down from the Throne in answer to it is reproduced here word for word, as follows:

190

مقصود از نصرتی که در الواح منیعه ذکر شده معلوم احبّآء اللّه بوده که حقّ جلّ ذکره مقدّس است از دنیا و آنچه در او است و مقصود از نصر این نبوده که احدی بنفسی محاربه و یا مجادله نماید سلطان جلال جمیع ارض از برّ و بحر آن را بید ملوک گذاشته و ایشانند مظاهر قدرت الهی علی قدر مراتبهم و اگر در ظلّ حقّ وارد شوند از حقّ محسوب و من دون ذلک انّ ربّک لعلیم خبیر

Maqṣūd az nuṣratī ke dar alvāḥ-i manīʿe dhikr shude maʿlūm-i aḥibbāʾ-i Allāh būde ke Ḥaqq jalla dhikruhu muqaddas ast az dunyā va ānche dar ū ast va maqṣūd az naṣr īn nabūde ke aḥadī bi-nafsī muḥāribe va yā mujādile namāyad Sulṭān-i Jalāl jamīʿ-i arḍ az barr va baḥr-i ān rā bi-yad-i mulūk gudhāshte va īshānand maẓāhir-i qudrat-i ilāhī ʿalā qadri marātibihim va agar dar ẓill-i Ḥaqq vārid shavand az Ḥaqq maḥsūb wa min dūni dhālika inna rabbaka la-ʿalīmun khabīr

“The friends of God know what is meant by the assistance mentioned in the exalted Tablets: God, exalted be His mention, is sanctified above the world and all that is in it. Assistance has not meant that anyone should wage war or contend with another. The Sovereign of Glory has placed the whole earth, both land and sea, in the hands of kings, and they are the manifestations of divine power according to their respective ranks. If they enter beneath the shadow of God, they are accounted as belonging to Him; otherwise, your Lord is indeed all-knowing, all-informed.

191

و آنچه حقّ جلّ ذکره از برای خود خواسته قلوب عباد او است که کنایز وحی صمدانیّه و خزاین حبّ الهیّه‌اند و لم‌یزل ارادهٴ سلطان لایزال این بوده که قلوب را از اشارات دنیا و ما فیها و علیها طاهر نماید تا قابل شوند از برای انوار تجلّیات ملیک اسماء و صفات

Va ānche Ḥaqq jalla dhikruhu az barā-yi khud khāste qulūb-i ʿibād-i ū ast ke kanāyiz-i vaḥy-i ṣamadāniyye va khazāyin-i ḥubb-i ilāhiyye-and va lam-yazal irādi-yi Sulṭān-i lā-yazāl īn būde ke qulūb rā az ishārāt-i dunyā va mā fīhā va ʿalayhā ṭāhir namāyad tā qābil shavand az barā-yi anvār-i tajalliyāt-i Malīk-i asmāʾ va ṣifāt

What God, exalted be His mention, has desired for Himself is the hearts of His servants, which are the treasuries of divine revelation and the repositories of divine love. It has always been the will of the everlasting Sovereign to purify hearts from the allusions of the world and all that is in it and upon it, so that they may become receptive to the lights of the revelations of the King of names and attributes.

192

پس باید در مدینهٴ قلب بیگانه راه نیابد تا دوست بمقرّ خود شتابد یعنی تجلّی جمالش نه ذات و نفس او چه که لازال مقدّس از صعود و نزول بوده و خواهد بود پس نصرت امر اللّه الیوم اعتراض باحدی و مجادله بنفسی و محاربه مع شیئی نبوده و نخواهد بود بلکه محبوب آن است که مداین قلوب بسیف لسان و حکمت بیان مفتوح شود نه بسیف حدید

Pas bāyad dar madīni-yi qalb bīgāne rāh nayābad tā Dūst bi-maqarr-i khud shitābad yaʿnī tajallī-yi jamālash na dhāt va nafs-i ū chi ke lā-zāl muqaddas az ṣuʿūd va nuzūl būde va khāhad būd pas nuṣrat-i amr-i Allāh al-yawm iʿtirāḍ bi-aḥadī va mujādile bi-nafsī va muḥāribe maʿa shayʾī nabūde va nakhāhad būd balke maḥbūb ān ast ke madāyin-i qulūb bi-sayf-i lisān va ḥikmat-i bayān maftūḥ shavad na bi-sayf-i ḥadīd

Thus no stranger must find a way into the city of the heart, so that the Friend may hasten to His own abode—that is, the revelation of His beauty, not His Essence and His very Self, for He has always been and will forever remain sanctified above ascent and descent. Assisting the Cause of God today has therefore never consisted, nor will it ever consist, in opposing anyone, disputing with anyone, or waging war against anything. Rather, what is desired is that the cities of hearts be conquered with the sword of the tongue and the wisdom of utterance, not with a sword of iron.

193

پس هر نفسی که ارادهٴ نصر الهی نماید باید اوّل بسیف معانی و بیان مدینهٴ قلب خود را تصرّف نماید و از جمیع ما سوی اللّه او را مطهّر سازد و بعد بمداین قلوب توجّه کند این است نصرت امر اللّه که الیوم از مشرق اصبع ملیک اسماء اشراق فرموده ابداً فساد محبوب نبوده و نیست و آنچه از قبل شده من غیر اذن اللّه بوده

Pas har nafsī ke irādi-yi naṣr-i ilāhī namāyad bāyad avval bi-sayf-i maʿānī va bayān madīni-yi qalb-i khud rā taṣarruf namāyad va az jamīʿ-i mā sivā Allāh ū rā muṭahhar sāzad va baʿd bi-madāyin-i qulūb tavajjuh kunad īn ast nuṣrat-i amr-i Allāh ke al-yawm az mashriq-i iṣbaʿ-i Malīk-i asmāʾ ishrāq farmūde abadan fasād maḥbūb nabūde va nīst va ānche az qabl shude min ghayri idhni Allāh būde

Thus whoever wishes to assist God must first conquer the city of his own heart with the sword of inner meanings and utterance, purify it from all besides God, and then turn toward the cities of hearts. This is the assistance to the Cause of God that has shone forth today from the dawning-place of the finger of the King of names. Disorder has never been, and is not, acceptable, and whatever occurred in the past was without God’s permission.

194

باری الیوم باید احبّای الهی بشأنی در مابین عباد ظاهر شوند که جمیع را بافعال خود برضوان ذو الجلال هدایت نمایند قسم بآفتاب صبح عزّ تقدیس که ابداً حقّ و احبّای او که منسوب باویند ناظر بارض و اموال فانیه در او نبوده و نخواهند بود چه اگر مقصود تصرّف در ارض بود البتّه قادر و مقتدر بوده و بکلمه‌ئی جمیع عالم را تصرّف میفرمود

Bārī al-yawm bāyad aḥibbā-yi ilāhī bi-shaʾnī dar mābayn-i ʿibād ẓāhir shavand ke jamīʿ rā bi-afʿāl-i khud bi-Riḍvān-i Dhu al-Jalāl hidāyat namāyand qasam bi-āftāb-i ṣubḥ-i ʿizz-i taqdīs ke abadan Ḥaqq va aḥibbā-yi ū ke mansūb bi-ūyand nāẓir bi-arḍ va amvāl-i fāniye dar ū nabūde va nakhāhand būd chi agar maqṣūd taṣarruf dar arḍ būd albatte qādir va muqtadir būde va bi-kalimiʾī jamīʿ-i ʿālam rā taṣarruf mīfarmūd

In short, today the friends of God must appear among His servants in such a manner that, through their deeds, they guide everyone to the Paradise of the Lord of Glory. I swear by the sun of the morning of sanctified glory that neither God nor His friends, who are associated with Him, have ever set their sights, or will ever set them, on the earth and its perishable possessions. For had the purpose been to take possession of the earth, He was assuredly powerful and mighty, and would have taken possession of the entire world with a single word.

195

ولکن سلطنت بسلاطین عنایت فرموده و حکمت بمتفرّسین و عرفان بعارفین و حبّ قلوب عباد خود را مخصوص خود مقرّر داشته و بدون آن ناظر نبوده و نخواهد بود و اینهم نظر بعنایت کبری است که شاید نفوس فانیه از شئونات ترابیّه طاهر و مقدّس شوند و بمقام باقیه که رضوان عزّ احدیّه است وارد گردند

Va-lākin salṭanat bi-salāṭīn ʿināyat farmūde va ḥikmat bi-mutafarrisīn va ʿirfān bi-ʿārifīn va ḥubb-i qulūb-i ʿibād-i khud rā makhṣūṣ-i khud muqarrar dāshte va bi-dūn-i ān nāẓir nabūde va nakhāhad būd va īn ham naẓar bi-ʿināyat-i kubrā ast ke shāyad nufūs-i fāniye az shuʾūnāt-i turābiyye ṭāhir va muqaddas shavand va bi-maqām-i bāqiye ke Riḍvān-i ʿizz-i aḥadiyye ast vārid gardand

But He has bestowed sovereignty upon kings, wisdom upon the discerning, and spiritual knowledge upon those who recognize Him. He has reserved for Himself the love of His servants’ hearts, and has never sought, nor will He ever seek, anything else. This, too, is out of His supreme grace, that perhaps mortal souls may be cleansed and sanctified from earthly concerns and enter the abiding station, which is the Paradise of the glory of divine unity.

196

والّا آن سلطان قدم بنفسه لنفسه مستغنی از کلّ بوده نه از حبّ ممکنات نفعی باو راجع و نه از ضرّشان ضرّی باو واقع کلّ از امکنهٴ ترابیّه ظاهر و باو راجع خواهند شد و آن جمال قدم متوحّداً متفرّداً بر مقرّ خود که مقدّس از مکان و زمان و ذکر و اشاره و دلاله و وصف و علوّ و دنوّ بوده مستقرّ و لا یعلم ذلک الّا کلّ ذی فطن بصیر انتهی

Va-illā ān Sulṭān-i Qidam bi-nafsihi li-nafsihi mustaghnī az kull būde na az ḥubb-i mumkināt nafʿī bi-ū rājiʿ va na az ḍurrishān ḍurrī bi-ū vāqiʿ kull az amkini-yi turābiyye ẓāhir va bi-ū rājiʿ khāhand shud va ān Jamāl-i Qidam mutavaḥḥidan mutafarridan bar maqarr-i khud ke muqaddas az makān va zamān va dhikr va ishāre va dilāle va vaṣf va ʿuluvv va dunuvv būde mustaqarr wa lā yaʿlamu dhālika illā kullu dhī fiṭanin baṣīr intahā

Otherwise, that Sovereign of Eternity is, in Himself and for Himself, independent of all. No benefit accrues to Him from the love of created beings, nor does any harm befall Him from their harm. All emerge from earthly places and will return to Him, while that Beauty of Eternity remains, alone and unique, established upon His own seat, which is sanctified above place and time, mention and allusion, indication and description, height and nearness. None knows this except those endowed with discernment and insight.” End.

197

مع‌ذلک آنچه را خود عامل و فاعل بوده‌اند بحقّ تعالی شأنه نسبت داده‌اند مع آنکه بر کلّ واضح است که حقّ یفعل ما یشآء بوده و بر هر چه حکم فرماید قادر و لیس لأحد ان یعترض علیه و مع‌ذلک فوالّذی نفسی بیده که اگر راضی بضرّ نفسی بوده و یشهد بذلک قلم اللّه ان انتم تشهدون و از جمله در مکاتیب خود ذکر نموده‌اند که این عبد درس خوانده و این کلمات منزله از علم اکتسابی حاصل شده چنانچه در احیان هر ظهور اینگونه کلمات نالایقه مذکور شده چنانچه نسبت بظهور قبلم همین نسبت را داده‌اند و من قبله به محمّد رسول اللّه انّما یعلّمه بشر لسان الّذی یلحدون الیه اعجمیّ و هذا لسان عربیّ مبین حال نفسی در کلّ ایران و عراق تفحّص نماید تا صدق و کذب معلوم شود فویل لهم و بما هم به یتکلّمون

Maʿa dhālik ānche rā khud ʿāmil va fāʿil būde-and bi-Ḥaqq taʿālā shaʾnuhu nisbat dāde-and maʿa ānke bar kull vāḍiḥ ast ke Ḥaqq yafʿalu mā yashāʾ būde va bar har che ḥukm farmāyad qādir wa laysa li-aḥadin an yaʿtariḍa ʿalayhi va maʿa dhālik fa-wa-alladhī nafsī bi-yadihi ke agar rāḍī bi-ḍurr-i nafsī būde wa yashhadu bi-dhālika qalamu Allāh in antum tashhadūn va az jumle dar makātīb-i khud dhikr nimūde-and ke īn ʿabd dars khānde va īn kalimāt-i munzale az ʿilm-i iktisābī ḥāṣil shude chunānchi dar aḥyān-i har ẓuhūr īngūne kalimāt-i nālāyiqe madhkūr shude chunānchi nisbat bi-ẓuhūr-i qablam hamīn nisbat rā dāde-and va min qablihi bi-Muḥammad Rasūl-i Allāh innamā yuʿallimuhu bashar lisānu alladhī yulḥidūna ilayhi aʿjamiyyun wa hādhā lisānun ʿarabiyyun mubīn ḥāl nafsī dar kull-i Īrān va ʿIrāq tafaḥḥuṣ namāyad tā ṣidq va kidhb maʿlūm shavad fa-waylun lahum wa bi-mā hum bihi yatakallamūn

Nevertheless, they have attributed to God, exalted be His station, deeds of which they themselves were the agents and perpetrators. Yet it is clear to all that God does whatever He wills and has power to carry out whatever He decrees, and no one has the right to object to Him. Even so, I swear by Him in whose hand is My soul that I have never consented to harm anyone, and the Pen of God bears witness to this, if you would bear witness. Among other things, they have stated in their letters that this servant has studied and that these revealed words are the product of acquired learning. Such unworthy statements have been made at the time of every revelation. They made this very allegation concerning My previous Manifestation, and before Him concerning Muḥammad, the Messenger of God: “A human being merely teaches Him.” “The tongue of the one to whom they allude is foreign, while this is a clear Arabic tongue.” Now let someone make inquiries throughout Iran and Iraq, so that truth and falsehood may become known. Woe to them for what they say!

198

ای بی‌خردان منبع این علوم ذات قدم بوده و معین این حکم نفس اللّه الأعظم لو انتم من المستشعرین و اگر بسمع فطرت استماع نمائید آنچه را در حین ظهور نقطه جلّ و عزّ علما و جهّال عصر اعتراضاً علی اللّه بآن تکلّم مینمودند حال هم همان کلمات را استماع مینمائید فواللّه یا قوم انّی لأکون متحیّراً فی امری و ما ورد علیّ فیا لیت ما ولدت من امّی و ان ولدت ما رضعت و ما صرت کبیراً ولکن ظهر ما ظهر و نزّلت جنود الوحی و قضی الأمر من لدی اللّه الواحد القهّار یا قوم اسمعوا قولی ثمّ اخرقوا الأحجاب ولو یکون مرایا السّموات و الأرضین ایّاکم ان لا یمنعکم شیء عن نفحات تلک الأیّام تاللّه لن یعادلها کنایز الابداع و لا خزاین الاختراع و کان اللّه علی ذلک شهید و علیم

Ay bī-khiradān manbaʿ-i īn ʿulūm Dhāt-i Qidam būde va maʿīn-i īn ḥikam Nafs-i Allāh al-Aʿẓam law antum mina al-mustashʿirīn va agar bi-samʿ-i fiṭrat istimāʿ namāyīd ānche rā dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr-i Nuqṭe jalla va ʿazza ʿulamā va juhhāl-i ʿaṣr iʿtirāḍan ʿalā Allāh bi-ān takallum mīnimūdand ḥāl ham hamān kalimāt rā istimāʿ mīnamāyīd fa-wa-llāhi yā qawm innī la-akūnu mutaḥayyiran fī amrī wa mā warada ʿalayya fa-yā layta mā wulidtu min ummī wa in wulidtu mā raḍiʿtu wa mā ṣirtu kabīran wa-lākin ẓahara mā ẓahara wa nuzzilat junūdu al-waḥy wa quḍiya al-amru min ladā Allāhi al-Wāḥidi al-Qahhār yā qawmi ismaʿū qawlī thumma ikhriqū al-aḥjāb wa-law yakūnu marāyā al-samāwāti wa al-araḍīn iyyākum an lā yamnaʿakum shayʾun ʿan nafaḥāti tilka al-ayyām ta-llāhi lan yuʿādilahā kanāyizu al-ibdāʿ wa lā khazāyinu al-ikhtirāʿ wa kāna Allāhu ʿalā dhālika shahīd wa ʿalīm

You who lack understanding! The source of this knowledge is the eternal Essence, and the wellspring of these words of wisdom is the most great Self of God, if only you perceived. If you listen with the ear of your innate nature, you will hear now the very same words that the learned and the ignorant of the age uttered in opposition to God at the appearance of the Point, exalted and glorified be He. By God, O people, I am bewildered by My plight and by what has befallen Me. If only My mother had not given birth to Me; or, if I had been born, had I never been nursed or grown to adulthood! But what has appeared has appeared, the hosts of revelation have been sent down, and the matter has been decreed by God, the One, the All-Subduing. O people, listen to My words, then tear through the veils, even if they should be the mirrors of the heavens and the earths. Beware lest anything keep you from the breezes of those days. By God, neither the treasures of creation nor the repositories of origination can equal them. God is witness to this and knows it well.

199

قسم بآفتاب فلک باقی که اگر امر بدست این عبد بود یک آیه مابین این قوم تلاوت نمیشد چه که ناس بالمرّه از فطرت اصلیّهٴ الهیّه منحرف شده‌اند ولکنّ اللّه قضی ما اراد و امضی ما شآء لا رادّ لمشیّته و لا مردّ لقضائه و انّه بکلّ شیء حکیم و اگر نه این بود که اهل این مملکت مضطرب ملاحظه میشد هرآینه اذن داده میشد که کلّ بین یدی اللّه حاضر شوند لیشهدوا ما لا شهد احد من العالمین

Qasam bi-āftāb-i falak-i bāqī ke agar amr bi-dast-i īn ʿabd būd yak āye mābayn-i īn qawm tilāvat namīshud chi ke nās bi-al-marre az fiṭrat-i aṣliyye-yi ilāhiyye munḥarif shude-and wa-lākinna Allāha qaḍā mā arāda wa amḍā mā shāʾ lā rādda li-mashīʾatihi wa lā maradda li-qaḍāʾihi wa innahu bi-kulli shayʾin ḥakīm va agar na īn būd ke ahl-i īn mamlakat muḍṭarib mulāḥiẓe mīshud har-āyine idhn dāde mīshud ke kull bayna yaday Allāh ḥāḍir shavand li-yashhadū mā lā shahida aḥadun mina al-ʿālamīn

I swear by the sun of the everlasting heaven that, had the matter been in this servant’s hands, not a single verse would have been recited among this people, for humanity has wholly departed from its original, divinely bestowed nature. But God has decreed what He desired and carried out what He willed. None can repel His will or reverse His decree, and He is wise in all things. Were it not that the people of this country were seen to be disturbed, permission would certainly have been given for everyone to appear in the presence of God, so that they might witness what no one in all the worlds has witnessed.

200

و از جمله نوشته که مقام شمسیّت در ظلّ مرآت واقع میشود و این رتبه فوق مقامات است و هم‌چنین از این مرآت شموس مشرق سبحان‌اللّه چه مقدار ناس را جاهل فرض نموده مع آنکه بسی واضح و مشهود است که خلق مرآت و وجود آن بجهت آن بوده که حکایت از اشباح و امثال نماید و بر هر ذی ‌بصری واضح است که ظهور عکوس امثال و اشباح هم در او لنفسه بنفسه تحقّق نداشته و ندارد و این فقره بر هر اکمهی ظاهر است تا چه رسد بذی بصر مع‌ذلک باین عباراتی که فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو هیچ جاهلی بآن تکلّم نمینماید در رسائل خود نوشته و اراده نموده باین کلمات ناس را از موجد و محقّق اسماء و صفات محروم نماید و این نیست مگر آنکه عباد را در بحور وهم و هوی مستغرق دیده و گمان نموده که آنچه مذکور دارد مسلّماً مقبول است والّا باین کلمات که کذب آن اظهر از شمس در وسط السّمآء است مشغول نمیشد

Va az jumle nivishte ke maqām-i shamsiyyat dar ẓill-i mirʾāt vāqiʿ mīshavad va īn rutbe fawq-i maqāmāt ast va ham-chunīn az īn mirʾāt shumūs mushriq subḥāna Allāh che miqdār nās rā jāhil farḍ nimūde maʿa ānke basī vāḍiḥ va mashhūd ast ke khalq-i mirʾāt va vujūd-i ān bi-jihat-i ān būde ke ḥikāyat az ashbāḥ va amthāl namāyad va bar har dhī baṣarī vāḍiḥ ast ke ẓuhūr-i ʿukūs-i amthāl va ashbāḥ ham dar ū li-nafsihi bi-nafsihi taḥaqquq nadāshte va nadārad va īn fiqre bar har akmahī ẓāhir ast tā che rasad bi-dhī baṣar maʿa dhālik bi-īn ʿibārātī ke fa-wa-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa hīch jāhilī bi-ān takallum namīnamāyad dar rasāʾil-i khud nivishte va irāde nimūde bi-īn kalimāt nās rā az Mūjid va Muḥaqqiq-i asmāʾ va ṣifāt maḥrūm namāyad va īn nīst magar ānke ʿibād rā dar buḥūr-i vahm va havā mustaghriq dīde va gumān nimūde ke ānche madhkūr dārad musallaman maqbūl ast va-illā bi-īn kalimāt ke kidhb-i ān aẓhar az shams dar vasaṭ-i al-samāʾ ast mashghūl namīshud

Among other things, he has written that the station of being a sun falls under the shadow of the mirror, that this rank is above all stations, and that suns likewise shine forth from this mirror. Glorified be God! How ignorant he has assumed people to be! Yet it is perfectly clear and evident that the mirror was created and exists in order to reflect forms and likenesses. It is clear to everyone with sight that even the appearance within it of the reflections of likenesses and forms has never come about, nor does it come about, through the mirror itself and for its own sake. This point is evident to anyone born blind, let alone to someone with sight. Nevertheless, he has written in his epistles such statements as, by God, besides whom there is no other god, no ignorant person would utter. Through these words he has intended to deprive people of the One who brings names and attributes into existence and gives them reality. This is only because he has seen God’s servants submerged in the seas of delusion and desire, and has supposed that whatever he says will assuredly be accepted. Otherwise, he would not have occupied himself with these words, whose falsehood is more evident than the sun in the midst of heaven.

201

و متمسّک باین شده که نقطهٴ بیان روح ما سواه فداه خود را در یک مقام مرآت اللّه نامیده و لذا مرآتیّت فوق رتبهٴ شمسیّت است فوالّذی انطقنی بالحقّ و اشرقنی عن افق القدس علی العالمین که اگر نفسی در این یک فقره تفکّر نماید بر جمیع مطالب این همج رعاع مطّلع میشود اوّلاً اینکه آن ذات قدم بکلّ اسماء خود را موسوم فرموده‌اند و بکلّ صفات موصوف چه از اعلی مراتب اسماء و چه از ادنی مراتب آن چنانچه در ابتدای احسن‌القصص میفرمایند قوله جلّ کبریائه الحمد للّه الّذی انزل الکتاب علی عبده لیکون للعالمین سراجاً وهّاجاً حال میتواند کسی قائل شود که رتبهٴ سراج فوق شمس بوده لا واللّه نمیگوید این سخنان را مگر نفسی که بر هوی تکلّم نماید و بخواهد در قلوب صافیهٴ منیره شبهه القا نماید فبئس ما هم یفعلون

Va mutamassik bi-īn shude ke Nuqṭi-yi Bayān rūḥ-i mā sivāhu fidāhu khud rā dar yak maqām Mirʾāt-i Allāh nāmīde va li-dhā mirʾātiyyat fawq-i rutbi-yi shamsiyyat ast fa-wa-alladhī anṭaqanī bi-al-ḥaqqi wa ashraqanī ʿan ufuqi al-qudsi ʿalā al-ʿālamīn ke agar nafsī dar īn yak fiqre tafakkur namāyad bar jamīʿ-i maṭālib-i īn hamaj-i raʿāʿ muṭṭaliʿ mīshavad avvalan īnke ān Dhāt-i Qidam bi-kull-i asmāʾ khud rā mawsūm farmūde-and va bi-kull-i ṣifāt mawṣūf che az aʿlā marātib-i asmāʾ va che az adnā marātib-i ān chunānchi dar ibtidā-yi Aḥsan al-Qaṣaṣ mīfarmāyand qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī anzala al-kitāba ʿalā ʿabdihi li-yakūna li-al-ʿālamīna sirājan wahhājan ḥāl mītavānad kasī qāʾil shavad ke rutbi-yi sirāj fawq-i shams būde lā wa-llāh namīgūyad īn sukhanān rā magar nafsī ke bar havā takallum namāyad va bikhāhad dar qulūb-i ṣāfiye-yi munīre shubhe ilqā namāyad fa-biʾsa mā hum yafʿalūn

He has also seized upon the fact that the Point of the Bayān—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—called Himself the Mirror of God in one passage, and has therefore claimed that the station of being a mirror is above that of being a sun. By Him who has caused Me to speak the truth and made Me shine from the horizon of holiness upon all the worlds, if anyone reflects on this one point, he will understand all the claims of this rabble. First, that eternal Essence has designated Himself by every name and described Himself by every attribute, from the highest degrees of names to the lowest. Thus, at the beginning of the Aḥsan al-Qaṣaṣ, He says—these are His words, exalted be His majesty—“Praise be to God, who has sent down the Book to His servant, that He may be a brightly shining lamp to all the worlds.” Can anyone now claim that the rank of a lamp is above that of the sun? No, by God! No one utters such words except someone who speaks from desire and wishes to cast doubt into pure and radiant hearts. How evil is what they do!

202

باری بیقین دانسته که در آن ساحت قدس جمیع اسماء در صقع واحدند چه که آن کینونت قدم در حینی که میفرماید انا ربّ الأرباب و انا الأرض و التّراب در آن منظر اکبر این هر دو در یک رتبه بوده و خواهند بود و این بیان ارقّ الطف اصفی را قلوب مکدّره ادراک نخواهند نمود چنانچه آن جمال قدم میفرماید قوله عزّ ذکره قل تنزّلت حتّی قلت انّنی انا ذرّ و دون ذرّ مثل ما انّنی انا قلت ربّ و مربّب کلّ ذی ربّ لأستغفرنّ اللّه عن کلتیهما و انّی الی اللّه ربّی لمن الرّاجعین انتهی

Bārī bi-yaqīn dāniste ke dar ān sāḥat-i quds jamīʿ-i asmāʾ dar ṣuqʿ-i vāḥidand, chi ke ān kaynūnat-i qidam dar ḥīnī ke mīfarmāyad anā rabbu al-arbāb va anā al-arḍu wa-al-turāb, dar ān manẓar-i akbar īn har du dar yik rutbe būde va khvāhand būd. Va īn bayān-i araqq-i alṭaf-i aṣfā rā qulūb-i mukaddare idrāk nakhvāhand namūd. Chinānchi ān Jamāl-i Qidam mīfarmāyad, qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu: qul tanazzaltu ḥattā qultu innanī anā dharrun wa-dūna dharrin mithla mā innanī anā qultu rabbun wa-murabbibu kulli dhī rabbin. La-astaghfiranna Allāha ʿan kiltayhimā wa-innī ilā Allāhi rabbī la-mina al-rājiʿīn. Intahā.

In any case, know with certainty that in that court of holiness all names occupy a single plane. For when that eternal Being says, “I am the Lord of lords” and “I am the earth and the dust,” both have held, and will continue to hold, the same rank in that most great vista. Clouded hearts will not comprehend this most subtle, delicate, and pure utterance. Thus the Ancient Beauty says—exalted be His mention—“Say: I descended until I said, ‘I am a mote, and less than a mote,’ just as I said, ‘I am the Lord and the nurturer of all that has a lord.’ I will surely ask God’s forgiveness for both, and I am indeed among those who return to God, my Lord.” Thus ends the quotation.

203

حال ای سالکان بوادی جهل و ضلال که کأس زقوم نوشیده‌اید و سلسبیل قدس مختوم دانسته‌اید در نار هوی محترق شده‌اید و از اهل رفرف اعلی خود را شمرده‌اید زهی حسرت که یک آن در حکمت بالغهٴ رحمن تفکّر ننموده‌اید و در یک حین در امر مالک یوم الدّین ببصر منیر توجّه ننموده‌اید کلمات رحمن را که بکمال انبساط و احاطه من‌دون حدود نازل شده بحجبات نفس خود چنان محجوب نموده‌اید که السن عالمین از ذکرش عاجزند

Ḥāl ay sālikān bi-vādī-yi jahl va ḍalāl ke kaʾs-i zaqqūm nūshīde-īd va salsabīl-i quds makhtūm dāniste-īd, dar nār-i havā muḥtariq shude-īd va az ahl-i rafraf-i aʿlā khud rā shumurde-īd. Zihī ḥasrat ke yik ān dar ḥikmat-i bālighe-yi Raḥmān tafakkur nanamūde-īd va dar yik ḥīn dar amr-i Mālik-i Yawm al-Dīn bi-baṣar-i munīr tavajjuh nanamūde-īd. Kalimāt-i Raḥmān rā ke bi-kamāl-i inbisāṭ va iḥāṭe min-dūn-i ḥudūd nāzil shude bi-ḥujubāt-i nafs-i khud chinān maḥjūb namūde-īd ke alsun-i ʿālamīn az dhikrash ʿājizand.

Now, you who journey in the valley of ignorance and error, you have drunk the cup of zaqqūm and deemed the Salsabīl of holiness sealed. You have burned in the fire of desire and counted yourselves among the inhabitants of the highest pavilion. What a pity that not for one moment have you reflected on the consummate wisdom of the All-Merciful, nor for a single instant turned with illumined sight toward the Cause of the Master of the Day of Judgment. You have so veiled with the veils of your own selves the words of the All-Merciful, revealed in perfect breadth and all-encompassing scope, without limits, that the tongues of all the worlds are powerless to describe it.

204

حال در این فقره ملاحظه نمائید که از قلم قدس الهی جاری شده میفرماید تنزّل فرمودم تا بمقامی که میفرمایم منم ذرّه و دون ذرّه مثل آنکه فرمودم منم ربّ و مربّب کلّ ربوب بلکه استغفار میکنم از این هر دو ذکر حال ملاحظه نمائید که آن جمال قدم خود را بکلّ اسماء نامیده‌اند مع‌ذلک میتوان گفت که ذرّه فوق شمس است و یا تراب فوق ربّ الأرباب فأنصفوا ان انتم من المنصفین

Ḥāl dar īn fiqre mulāḥiẓe namāyīd ke az Qalam-i Quds-i Ilāhī jārī shude. Mīfarmāyad: tanazzul farmūdam tā bi-maqāmī ke mīfarmāyam manam dharre va dūn-i dharre, mithl-i ānke farmūdam manam rabb va murabbib-i kull-i rubūb, balke istighfār mīkunam az īn har du dhikr. Ḥāl mulāḥiẓe namāyīd ke ān Jamāl-i Qidam khud rā bi-kull-i asmāʾ nāmīde-and. Maʿa-dhālik mītavān guft ke dharre fawq-i shams ast va yā turāb fawq-i Rabb al-Arbāb? Fa-anṣifū in antum mina al-munṣifīn.

Now consider this passage that has flowed from the holy Pen of God. He says, “I descended to the station where I say, ‘I am a mote, and less than a mote,’ just as I said, ‘I am the Lord and the nurturer of all lords.’ Rather, I ask forgiveness for both these statements.” Now consider how that Ancient Beauty has called Himself by every name. Can it nevertheless be said that the mote is above the sun, or the dust above the Lord of lords? Be fair, if you are among the fair-minded.

205

فوالّذی جعلنی مظهر ذاته ثمّ کینونته و عزّه و بهائه که اگر در این کلمات مبارکهٴ الهیّه تفکّر نمائید ابواب علوم ما لا نهایه بر وجه قلوب مفتوح شود بشأنی که دیگر مضطرب نشوید از اینکه فلان را باسمآء اللّه نامیده یا بذات اللّه و مرآت اللّه چه که جمیع اسماء در آن ساحت مساوی و لا فرق بینها و کلّ این اسماء طائف حول مظهر نفس قدم بوده و خواهد بود مثل اینکه در این حین اگر جمال قدم شجری را بکلّ اسمآء حسنی و صفات علیا موسوم فرماید انّه لیقدر و لیس لأحد ان یعترض علیه لأنّه هو المختار و ما سواه فی قبضة الاقتدار لا اله الّا هو العزیز الجبّار

Fa-wa-alladhī jaʿalanī maẓhara dhātihi thumma kaynūnatihi wa-ʿizzihi wa-bahāʾihi, ke agar dar īn kalimāt-i mubārake-yi ilāhiyye tafakkur namāyīd abvāb-i ʿulūm-i mā lā nihāye bar vajh-i qulūb maftūḥ shavad, bi-shaʾnī ke dīgar muḍṭarib nashavīd az īnke fulān rā bi-asmāʾ-i Allāh nāmīde yā bi-Dhāt-i Allāh va Mirʾāt-i Allāh. Chi ke jamīʿ-i asmāʾ dar ān sāḥat musāvī va lā farqa baynahā, va kull-i īn asmāʾ ṭāʾif-i ḥawl-i Maẓhar-i Nafs-i Qidam būde va khvāhad būd. Mithl-i īnke dar īn ḥīn agar Jamāl-i Qidam shajarī rā bi-kull-i asmāʾ-i ḥusnā va ṣifāt-i ʿulyā mawsūm farmāyad, innahu la-yaqdiru wa-laysa li-aḥadin an yaʿtariḍa ʿalayhi li-annahu huwa al-Mukhtāru wa-mā siwāhu fī qabḍati al-iqtidār. Lā ilāha illā huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-Jabbār.

By Him who has made Me the Manifestation of His Essence, His Being, His might, and His glory! If you reflect on these blessed divine words, the gates of limitless knowledge will open before your hearts, so that you will no longer be troubled because someone has been called by the names of God, or called the Essence of God and the Mirror of God. For all names are equal in that court, with no distinction between them, and all these names have revolved, and will continue to revolve, around the Manifestation of the eternal Self. For example, if at this moment the Ancient Beauty should designate a tree by all the most beautiful names and most exalted attributes, He assuredly has the power to do so, and no one has the right to object to Him, for He is the One who chooses, and all besides Him is within the grasp of His power. There is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All-Compelling.

206

و دیگر آنکه کلّ خلق را مرایاء لطیفه نامیده‌اند و میفرمایند اگر مسّ کند آن مرایا را جذبات حبّ الهی جذب میفرماید و اگر مسّ نماید دون حبّ نازل میشود بر عین آن مرایا غباری که حایل میشود مابین آن مرآت و بین عرفان امر پروردگار قادر علیم بقوله جلّ و عزّ انّ الخلق مرایا لطیفة ان یمسّها حبّ یجذب و ان یمسّها دون حبّ ینزل عینها غبار یحولنّ بینه و بین امر ربّه انتهی اذاً تفکّروا یا ملأ الغافلین

Va dīgar ānke kull-i khalq rā marāyā-yi laṭīfe nāmīde-and va mīfarmāyand agar mass kunad ān marāyā rā jadhabāt-i ḥubb-i ilāhī jadhb mīfarmāyad, va agar mass namāyad dūn-i ḥubb nāzil mīshavad bar ʿayn-i ān marāyā ghubārī ke ḥāyil mīshavad mābayn-i ān mirʾāt va bayn-i ʿirfān-i amr-i Parvardigār-i Qādir-i ʿAlīm. Bi-qawlihi jalla va ʿazza: inna al-khalqa marāyā laṭīfatun in yamassahā ḥubbun yajdhibu wa-in yamassahā dūnu ḥubbin yanzilu ʿaynahā ghubārun yaḥūlanna baynahu wa-bayna amri rabbihi. Intahā. Idhan tafakkarū yā malaʾa al-ghāfilīn.

Furthermore, He has called all creation delicate mirrors, and says that if the attractions of divine love touch those mirrors, they draw them onward; but if anything other than love touches them, dust settles upon the very surface of those mirrors, coming between the mirror and recognition of the Cause of the almighty, all-knowing Lord. In His words—glorious and mighty is He—“Creation consists of delicate mirrors: if love touches them, it attracts; and if anything other than love touches them, dust settles upon their surface, surely coming between one and the Cause of his Lord.” Thus ends the quotation. Reflect, then, you heedless ones.

207

و این بیان را نقطهٴ بیان جلّت عظمته عموماً فرموده‌اند و اگر بتخصیص ناظری بجناب آقا سیّد جواد خطاب میفرمایند قوله عزّ و جلّ که توئی آن مرآت اوّلیّه که لم‌یزل از حقّ حکایت نموده و لایزال حکایت خواهی نمود و هم‌چنین او را علّت اوّلیّه فرموده‌اند فواللّه که این رتبه فوق کلّ اسماء است چه از ذات اللّه و کینونة اللّه و ذکر اللّه و مرآت اللّه چه که از قبل هر نفسی که این رتبه را در حقّ رسول اللّه قائل شده حکم بکفرش نموده‌اند زیرا که علّت اوّلیّه خود حقّ را دانسته‌اند

Va īn bayān rā Nuqṭe-yi Bayān, jallat ʿaẓamatuhu, ʿumūman farmūde-and, va agar bi-takhṣīṣ nāẓirī bi-janāb-i Āqā Siyyid Javād khiṭāb mīfarmāyand, qawluhu ʿazza va jalla: ke tuʾī ān mirʾāt-i avvaliyye ke lam-yazal az Ḥaqq ḥikāyat namūde va lā-yazāl ḥikāyat khvāhī namūd. Va ham-chinīn ū rā ʿillat-i avvaliyye farmūde-and. Fa-wa-Allāh ke īn rutbe fawq-i kull-i asmāʾ ast, chi az Dhāt-i Allāh va Kaynūnat-i Allāh va Dhikr-i Allāh va Mirʾāt-i Allāh. Chi ke az qabl har nafsī ke īn rutbe rā dar ḥaqq-i Rasūl-i Allāh qāʾil shude ḥukm bi-kufrash namūde-and, zīrā ke ʿillat-i avvaliyye khud-i Ḥaqq rā dāniste-and.

The Point of the Bayān—exalted be His grandeur—made this statement in general terms. If, however, you are looking for a particular instance, He addresses Āqā Siyyid Javād in these words—mighty and glorious is He—“You are that Primal Mirror who has always reflected God and will forever reflect Him.” He has also called him the Primal Cause. By God, this rank is above all names, whether the Essence of God, the Being of God, the Remembrance of God, or the Mirror of God. For in the past, anyone who ascribed this rank to the Messenger of God was judged an unbeliever, since the Primal Cause was held to be God Himself.

208

و هم‌چنین در بارهٴ او نازل قوله جلّ ذکره انّا جعلناک نبیّاً علی العالمین حال با جمیع این مراتب و وصف که فوق آن در بیان ذکر نشده اگر العیاذ باللّه از حقّ اعراض نماید جمیع اقرب من آن از او مرتفع خواهد شد و اگر ببصر منیر ملاحظه نمائید کلّ اشیاء را در بیان بکلّ اسماء حسنی نامیده‌اند ولکن لا یعقلها الّا المخلصون و این کلمات ذکر میشود که همچه ندانند که اوصاف منزله در بیان مخصوص نفسی دون نفسی بوده بلکه در کلّ ثابت مادامی که در ظلّ حقّ مستقرّ باشند و بعد از خروج کلّ محروم و ممنوع

Va ham-chinīn dar bāre-yi ū nāzil, qawluhu jalla dhikruhu: innā jaʿalnāka nabiyyan ʿalā al-ʿālamīn. Ḥāl bā jamīʿ-i īn marātib va vaṣf ke fawq-i ān dar Bayān dhikr nashude, agar al-ʿiyādhu bi-Allāh az Ḥaqq iʿrāḍ namāyad jamīʿ aqrab min ān az ū murtafiʿ khvāhad shud. Va agar bi-baṣar-i munīr mulāḥiẓe namāyīd kull-i ashyāʾ rā dar Bayān bi-kull-i asmāʾ-i ḥusnā nāmīde-and, wa-lākin lā yaʿqiluhā illā al-mukhliṣūn. Va īn kalimāt dhikr mīshavad ke hamche nadānand ke awṣāf-i munzale dar Bayān makhṣūṣ-i nafsī dūn-i nafsī būde, balke dar kull thābit mādāmī ke dar ẓill-i Ḥaqq mustaqarr bāshand, va baʿd az khurūj kull maḥrūm va mamnūʿ.

Likewise, these words were revealed concerning him—glorious be His mention—“We have made you a prophet over all the worlds.” Now, despite all these ranks and this description, above which nothing has been mentioned in the Bayān, should he—God forbid—turn away from God, all would be stripped from him in less than an instant. If you consider with illumined sight, He has called all things in the Bayān by all the most beautiful names, but none comprehend this except the sincere. These words are mentioned so that no one should suppose that the descriptions revealed in the Bayān were exclusive to one person rather than another. Rather, they hold true of all, as long as they remain beneath the shadow of God; once they leave it, all are deprived and debarred.

209

و هم‌چنین در رتبهٴ جناب قدّوس روح العالمین فداه میفرمایند عزّ ذکره که بعدد هشت واحد از مرآت اللّه بر مقعد خود بوده و از شدّت نار محبّت او کسی قدرت بر قرب بهم نرسانده انتهی حال ملاحظه نمائید که هشت واحد از مرآت اللّه را در نفس مبارکشان ذکر فرموده‌اند فتفکّروا یا اولی الأفکار و در این بیان کنایز علمیّه مستور است و این عبد مذکور نداشت خوفاً من نمرود الظّلم و فرعون الجهل

Va ham-chinīn dar rutbe-yi janāb-i Quddūs, rūḥu al-ʿālamīna fidāhu, mīfarmāyand, ʿazza dhikruhu: ke bi-ʿadad-i hasht vāḥid az Mirʾāt-i Allāh bar maqʿad-i khud būde va az shiddat-i nār-i maḥabbat-i ū kasī qudrat bar qurb bi-ham narasānde. Intahā. Ḥāl mulāḥiẓe namāyīd ke hasht vāḥid az Mirʾāt-i Allāh rā dar nafs-i mubārakishān dhikr farmūde-and. Fa-tafakkarū yā ulī al-afkār. Va dar īn bayān kanāyiz-i ʿilmiyye mastūr ast va īn ʿabd madhkūr nadāsht khawfan min Nimrūdi al-ẓulmi wa-Firʿawni al-jahl.

Likewise, concerning the rank of Quddūs—may the soul of all the worlds be sacrificed for him—He says, exalted be His mention, “On his seat he was equal in number to eight vāḥids of the Mirror of God, and such was the intensity of the fire of his love that no one gained the power to draw near.” Thus ends the quotation. Now consider how He has mentioned eight vāḥids of the Mirror of God in his blessed person. Reflect, you people of insight. Treasures of knowledge lie hidden in this utterance, but this servant has not mentioned them, for fear of the Nimrod of oppression and the Pharaoh of ignorance.

210

و هم‌چنین در جمیع مقامات از قلم عزّ نازل که مرآت بنفسه لنفسه تحقّقی نداشته الّا بتقابلها بالشّمس و شمس را لم‌یزل و لایزال واحد فرموده‌اند و احدی را باین اسم موسوم نفرموده جز ذات قدم را در هر ظهوری مع‌ذلک نوشته مقام شمسیّت تحت رتبهٴ مرآتیّت است و شموس از مرآت مشرق میشوند فواللّه یا قوم ما انطق عن الهوی که اگر در همین قول تفکّر نمائید بیقین شهادت میدهید که این اقوال از جهل صرف و بغضای بحت ظاهر شده

Va ham-chinīn dar jamīʿ-i maqāmāt az Qalam-i ʿIzz nāzil ke mirʾāt bi-nafsihi li-nafsihi taḥaqquqī nadāshte illā bi-taqābulihā bi-al-shams, va shams rā lam-yazal va lā-yazāl vāḥid farmūde-and va aḥadī rā bi-īn ism mawsūm nafarmūde juz Dhāt-i Qidam rā dar har ẓuhūrī. Maʿa-dhālik nivishte maqām-i shamsiyyat taḥt-i rutbe-yi mirʾātiyyat ast va shumūs az mirʾāt mushriq mīshavand. Fa-wa-Allāh yā qawm mā anṭiqu ʿani al-hawā, ke agar dar hamīn qawl tafakkur namāyīd bi-yaqīn shahādat mīdahīd ke īn aqvāl az jahl-i ṣirf va baghḍā-yi baḥt ẓāhir shude.

Likewise, in every instance it has been revealed by the Pen of Glory that the mirror has no reality in and for itself except through facing the sun. He has declared the sun to have always been, and forever to remain, one, and has designated no one by this name except the eternal Essence in every Revelation. Nevertheless, he has written that the station of being a sun is beneath the rank of being a mirror, and that suns rise from the mirror. By God, O people, I do not speak from desire! If you reflect on this statement alone, you will assuredly testify that these assertions have arisen from sheer ignorance and unalloyed hatred.

211

اقسمکم یا قوم باللّه الّذی خلقکم و سوّاکم که در اوّل بیان فارسی ملاحظه نمائید که میفرمایند قوله عزّ ذکره اگر مرآت بگوید در من شمس است در نزد شمس ظاهر است که شبح او است که او میگوید انتهی مع‌ذلک نوشته که مرآت فوق شمس است و شموس در ظلّ مرآتند اگر مراد از این شموسی که ذکر نموده شموس حقیقت مقصود است فتعالی عن ذلک چه که بیک تجلّی از تجلّیات شمس حقیقت صدهزار مرآت اقلّ من حین مبعوث شوند

Uqsimukum yā qawm bi-Allāhi alladhī khalaqakum wa-sawwākum ke dar avval-i Bayān-i Fārsī mulāḥiẓe namāyīd ke mīfarmāyand, qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu: agar mirʾāt bigūyad dar man shams ast dar nazd-i shams ẓāhir ast ke shabaḥ-i ū ast ke ū mīgūyad. Intahā. Maʿa-dhālik nivishte ke mirʾāt fawq-i shams ast va shumūs dar ẓill-i mirʾātand. Agar murād az īn shumūsī ke dhikr namūde shumūs-i ḥaqīqat maqṣūd ast, fa-taʿālā ʿan dhālik, chi ke bi-yik tajallī az tajalliyāt-i Shams-i Ḥaqīqat ṣad-hizār mirʾāt aqall min ḥīn mabʿūth shavand.

I adjure you, O people, by God who created and fashioned you, to consider the beginning of the Persian Bayān, where He says—exalted be His mention—“If the mirror says, ‘The sun is within me,’ it is evident to the sun that it is its image of which the mirror speaks.” Thus ends the quotation. Nevertheless, he has written that the mirror is above the sun and that the suns are beneath the mirror’s shadow. If by these suns he has mentioned he means the Suns of Truth, exalted is He above that! For through a single effulgence among the effulgences of the Sun of Truth, a hundred thousand mirrors are raised up in less than an instant.

212

و من دون ذلک انّ المرآة خلقت لانطباع تجلّی من تجلّیات الشّمس علیها ان کانت صافیة و من دون ذلک یحکم علیه حکم الحجر چه که بر هر ذی بصری مشهود است که مرایا از برای اخذ عکوس اشیاء خلق شده‌اند چنانچه ذکر شده و اگر مقصود شموس اسماء و دون آن بوده این مخصوص بنفسی نه چه که در کلّ این شموس موجود و یظهر منه فی حین الّذی قدّر اللّه له و من فتح عین فؤاده یشهد فی کلّ ذرّ شمساً ثمّ فی هذه الشّمس شمساً ثمّ فی شمس الشّمس شمساً بحیث لا نهایة لها ولکن حکمة اللّه ذکر این مقام ننموده لئلّا یزلّ اقدام العارفین

Va min dūni dhālika inna al-mirʾāta khuliqat li-inṭibāʿi tajallin min tajalliyāti al-shamsi ʿalayhā in kānat ṣāfiyatan wa-min dūni dhālika yuḥkamu ʿalayhi ḥukmu al-ḥajar, chi ke bar har dhī baṣarī mashhūd ast ke marāyā az barā-yi akhdh-i ʿukūs-i ashyāʾ khalq shude-and chinānchi dhikr shude. Va agar maqṣūd shumūs-i asmāʾ va dūn-i ān būde īn makhṣūṣ bi-nafsī na, chi ke dar kull īn shumūs mawjūd va yaẓharu minhu fī ḥīni alladhī qaddara Allāhu lahu. Wa-man fataḥa ʿayna fuʾādihi yashhadu fī kulli dharrin shamsan thumma fī hādhihi al-shamsi shamsan thumma fī shamsi al-shamsi shamsan bi-ḥaythu lā nihāyata lahā. Va-lākin ḥikmat-i Allāh dhikr-i īn maqām nanamūde li-allā yazilla aqdāmu al-ʿārifīn.

Besides this, the mirror was created so that an effulgence among the sun’s effulgences might be imprinted upon it, if it is clear; otherwise it is judged to be a stone. For it is evident to everyone with sight that mirrors were created to receive the reflections of things, as has been mentioned. If, however, he meant the suns of names and anything below them, this is not exclusive to any one person, for these suns exist in all and appear from each at the time God has ordained for them. Whoever opens the eye of his heart beholds a sun in every mote, then a sun within this sun, then a sun within the sun of that sun, without end. Yet the wisdom of God has left this station unmentioned, lest the feet of those endowed with spiritual knowledge should slip.

213

فیا للّه یا قوم من هذا الظّلم الّذی ورد علی جمال القدم من الّذی یفتخر ان یقوم بین یدیه فلمّا اشتهر اسمه کفر باللّه المهیمن القیّوم و چون ظهور قبلم عالم بود بر اینکه مرآت در ظهور بعد دعوی شمسی مینماید لذا این حکم از قلم عزّ صدور یافت

Fa-yā li-Allāh yā qawm min hādhā al-ẓulmi alladhī warada ʿalā Jamāli al-Qidami mina alladhī yaftakhiru an yaqūma bayna yadayhi fa-lammā ishtahara ismuhu kafara bi-Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm. Va chūn Ẓuhūr-i Qablam ʿālim būd bar īnke mirʾāt dar ẓuhūr-i baʿd daʿvā-yi shamsī mīnamāyad lidhā īn ḥukm az Qalam-i ʿIzz ṣudūr yāft.

For God’s sake, O people, consider this injustice inflicted upon the Ancient Beauty by one who prides himself on standing in His presence! Yet when his name became well known, he disbelieved in God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. And since My previous Manifestation knew that the mirror would claim to be the sun in the following Revelation, this pronouncement issued from the Pen of Glory.

214

و بشأنی در بحر کبر و غرور مستغرق شده که بکلمات قبلم در علوّ شأن خود تمسّک جسته و بر منبع و معدن و مظهر و موجد و منزل آن معرض شده فبعداً للقوم الظّالمین و هم‌چنین خود را شجرهٴ عظمت نامیده فواللّه جمیع این کلمات نظر بآن است که ناس را احمق یافته

Va bi-shaʾnī dar baḥr-i kibr va ghurūr mustaghraq shude ke bi-kalimāt-i Qablam dar ʿuluvv-i shaʾn-i khud tamassuk juste va bar manbaʿ va maʿdin va maẓhar va mūjid va munzil-i ān muʿriḍ shude. Fa-buʿdan li-al-qawmi al-ẓālimīn. Va ham-chinīn khud rā Shajare-yi ʿAẓamat nāmīde. Fa-wa-Allāh jamīʿ-i īn kalimāt naẓar bi-ān ast ke nās rā aḥmaq yāfte.

He has become so submerged in the ocean of pride and arrogance that he has seized upon My former words concerning the loftiness of his station, yet turned away from their source, their wellspring, their manifestation, their originator, and the One who revealed them. Away, then, with the people of wrongdoing! He has likewise called himself the Tree of Grandeur. By God, all these words are due to his having found the people foolish.

215

و اگر از شجره عنداللّه محسوب شود من شجرة الّتی ینبغی لها ان تقطع و تلقی فی النّار الّا بأن یتوب الی اللّه و یستغفر عمّا فعل و یکون من التّائبین و بر جمیع واضح است چه از مهاجرین این ارض و چه هر فطن بصیری که ببصر اللّه در امور ناظرند که این کلمات غروریّه از لسان مجعولهٴ کذبهٴ شرکیّه جاری نشده مگر آنکه چون این شمس بدیع ابدع اعلی را از افق فجر بقا طالع و بنغمهٴ انّنی انا حیّ فی افق الأبهی مابین ارض و سماء ناطق دیده لذا تعجیل نموده و من حیث لا یشعر باین کلمات تکلّم کرده که شأنی فوق شأن اللّه از برای خود ثابت نماید

Va agar az shajare ʿinda Allāh maḥsūb shavad min shajaratin allatī yanbaghī lahā an tuqṭaʿa wa-tulqā fī al-nāri illā bi-an yatūba ilā Allāhi wa-yastaghfira ʿammā faʿala wa-yakūna mina al-tāʾibīn. Va bar jamīʿ vāḍiḥ ast chi az muhājirīn-i īn arḍ va chi har faṭin-i baṣīrī ke bi-baṣar-i Allāh dar umūr nāẓirand ke īn kalimāt-i ghurūriyye az lisān-i majʿūle-yi kadhabe-yi shirkiyye jārī nashude magar ānke chūn īn Shams-i Badīʿ-i Abdaʿ-i Aʿlā rā az ufuq-i fajr-i baqā ṭāliʿ va bi-naghme-yi innanī anā ḥayyun fī ufuqi al-Abhā mābayn-i arḍ va samāʾ nāṭiq dīde lidhā taʿjīl namūde va min ḥaythu lā yashʿur bi-īn kalimāt takallum karde ke shaʾnī fawq-i shaʾn-i Allāh az barā-yi khud thābit namāyad.

And if he is reckoned a tree in God’s sight, he is among the trees that should be cut down and cast into the fire, unless he repents to God, seeks forgiveness for what he has done, and becomes one of the repentant. It is clear to everyone—both those who have migrated to this land and every discerning person who considers affairs with the eye of God—that these arrogant words have flowed from that false, lying, idolatrous tongue only because he has seen this wondrous, most marvelous, most exalted Sun rising from the horizon of the dawn of eternity and proclaiming between earth and heaven the melody, “I am indeed alive in the all-glorious horizon.” He has therefore made haste and, without realizing it, uttered these words to establish for himself a station above the station of God.

216

و هذا لن یمکن ابداً لأنّ ما دونه مخلوق بأمره و منجعل بارادته و متحرّک باذنه و ما بعده الّا عبده و رعیّته و خلقه و بریّته و عباده هل یکون فوق شأن اللّه شأن لیثبته احد لنفسه و انّه قام بنفسه لنفسه فی علوّ نفسه مقام الّذی لا له فوق و لا تحت و لا یمین و لا یسار و لا امام و لا خلف و انّه قد خلق الجهات لا من جهة بمشیّته و الأشیآء لا من مثال بارادته و انّه لخالق کلّ شأن و منزل کلّ امر و یستحقّ لدونه بأن یفتخر بنفسه و انّه لا یفتخر بأحد من الموجودات و انّه لهو المقدّس المنزّه المقتدر المطاع

Wa-hādhā lan yumkina abadan li-anna mā dūnahu makhlūqun bi-amrihi wa-munjaʿalun bi-irādatihi wa-mutaḥarrikun bi-idhnihi wa-mā baʿdahu illā ʿabduhu wa-raʿiyyatuhu wa-khalquhu wa-bariyyatuhu wa-ʿibāduhu. Hal yakūnu fawqa shaʾni Allāhi shaʾnun li-yuthbitahu aḥadun li-nafsihi? Wa-innahu qāma bi-nafsihi li-nafsihi fī ʿuluwwi nafsihi maqāma alladhī lā lahu fawqun wa-lā taḥtun wa-lā yamīnun wa-lā yasārun wa-lā amāmun wa-lā khalf. Wa-innahu qad khalaqa al-jihāta lā min jihatin bi-mashīʾatihi wa-al-ashyāʾa lā min mithālin bi-irādatihi. Wa-innahu la-khāliqu kulli shaʾnin wa-munzilu kulli amrin wa-yastaḥiqqu li-dūnihi bi-an yaftakhira bi-nafsihi wa-innahu lā yaftakhiru bi-aḥadin mina al-mawjūdāti wa-innahu la-huwa al-Muqaddasu al-Munazzahu al-Muqtadiru al-Muṭāʿ.

This can never be possible, for everything other than Him is created by His command, brought into being by His will, and set in motion by His permission. All that comes after Him is but His servant, His subject, His creation, His creature, and His servants. Is there any station above the station of God that anyone might claim for himself? He stands by Himself, for Himself, in the loftiness of His own Self, in a station that has no above or below, no right or left, no front or back. By His will He created the directions, not from any direction, and by His purpose He created all things, not from any pattern. He is indeed the Creator of every station and the Revealer of every command. It befits those other than Him to glory in His own Self, while He glories in none of the beings in existence. He is indeed the Holy, the Transcendent, the All-Powerful, the One who is obeyed.

217

ای قوم بشنوید ندایم را و بر جمالم وارد نیاورید آنچه را که در کلّ الواح ممنوع شده‌اید تاللّه این است ید قدرت منبسطهٴ الهیّه که احاطه فرموده کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض را و این است لسان حقیقت ربّانیّه که بر اعلی سدرهٴ عزّ احدیّه تغنّی میفرماید و اینست قلم قدم که در ایّام و لیالی بحور اسرار و معارف الهی از او جاری و ساری است و اینست مخزن لآلی حکم بالغه و معدن علوم الهیّه و لم‌یزل و لایزال در افاضه بوده و خواهد بود زینهار که خود را از رشحات فضلش محروم منمائید و متابعت هر نفس بی‌بصری را واجب مشمرید

Ey qawm, beshnavīd nedāyam rā va bar jamālam vāred nayāvarīd ānche rā ke dar koll-e alvāḥ mamnūʿ shode-īd. Ta-llāh, īn ast yad-e qodrat-e monbaseṭe-ye elāhiyye ke eḥāṭe farmūde koll-e man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ rā va īn ast lesān-e ḥaqīqat-e rabbāniyye ke bar aʿlā sedre-ye ʿezz-e aḥadiyye taghannī mīfarmāyad va īnast qalam-e qedam ke dar ayyām va layālī boḥūr-e asrār va maʿāref-e elāhī az ū jārī va sārī ast va īnast makhzan-e laʾālī-ye ḥekam-e bāleghe va maʿdan-e ʿolūm-e elāhiyye va lam-yazal va lā-yazāl dar efāḍe būde va khwāhad būd. Zīnhār ke khwod rā az rashaḥāt-e faḍlash maḥrūm manamāyīd va motābaʿat-e har nafs-e bī-baṣarī rā vājeb mashmorīd.

O people, hear My call, and do not inflict upon My Beauty what you have been forbidden to do in all the Tablets. By God, this is the outstretched hand of divine power that has encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth. This is the tongue of divine truth that sings upon the loftiest Tree of the glory of oneness. This is the Pen of Eternity from which oceans of divine mysteries and knowledge flow and stream by day and by night. This is the treasury of the pearls of consummate wisdom and the mine of divine knowledge, which has always bestowed its bounty and will continue to do so forever. Beware lest you deprive yourselves of the sprinklings of its grace, and do not consider it obligatory to follow every sightless soul.

218

و هم‌چنین در رسالهٴ خود مذکور داشته که بمحض دانستن چند کلام و عبارت فهمی این دعویها نموده و مقصودش از این کلمات مزخرفه این هیکل قدس صمدانی بوده فوالّذی تفرّد بالقدرة و الاقتدار که در کلّ لیالی و ایّام مثل آنکه معلّمین اطفال را حروف هجائیّه تعلیم مینمایند بهمان قسم در تعلیمش جهد منیع مبذول شد فیا لیت قومی یعلمون ما صغر حدّه و حقر شأنه و کثر غروره و کبر قوله و این بر هر ذی بصری واضح و مبرهن است احتیاج بذکر تفصیل نداشته و ندارد

Va hamchenīn dar resāle-ye khwod madhkūr dāshte ke be-maḥḍ-e dānestan-e chand kalām va ʿebārat-fahmī īn daʿvīhā namūde va maqṣūdash az īn kalemāt-e mozakhrafe īn haykal-e qods-e ṣamadānī būde. Fa-wa-alladhī tafarrada bi-al-qudrati wa-al-iqtidār ke dar koll-e layālī va ayyām mesl-e ānke moʿallemīn aṭfāl rā ḥorūf-e hejāʾiyye taʿlīm mīnamāyand be-hamān qesm dar taʿlīmash jahd-e manīʿ mabdhūl shod. Fa-yā layta qawmī yaʿlamūna mā ṣaghura ḥadduhu wa-ḥaqura shaʾnuhu wa-kathura ghurūruhu wa-kabura qawluhu. Va īn bar har dhī-baṣarī vāḍeḥ va mobarhan ast eḥtiyāj be-dhekr-e tafṣīl nadāshte va nadārad.

He has likewise stated in his treatise that merely by knowing a few words and understanding some phrases, He has made these claims. By these absurd words he meant this sacred, eternal Temple. By Him who is peerless in power and might, throughout the nights and days, just as teachers teach children the letters of the alphabet, strenuous efforts were devoted to teaching him. If only My people knew how limited his capacity, how lowly his station, how abundant his conceit, and how grandiose his speech! This is clear and evident to every discerning person and has never required, nor does it now require, a detailed account.

219

و از جمله نسبت داده که این عبد نسبت بنقطهٴ اولی بخلاف ادب تکلّم نموده و حال اینکه این عبد ناطق است در مابین سموات و ارض بأنّنی انا نفسه و ذاته و روحه و هیکله و بهائه مع‌ذلک چگونه میشود بآن جوهر اعلی و ساذج ابهی روح من فی ممالک البقآء فداه بغیر رضآء اللّه تکلّم نمایم باری بعینه مثل ملأ فرقان که در اوّل فجر ظهور نسبت میدادند که این طایفه به رسول اللّه حبّ ندارند که شاید باین مزخرفات عباد را از عرفان نفس اللّه فی یوم المعاد محروم نمایند چنانچه نموده و مینمایند الا لعنة اللّه علی المفترین

Va az jomle nesbat dāde ke īn ʿabd nesbat be-Noqṭe-ye Ūlā be-khelāf-e adab takallom namūde va ḥāl īnke īn ʿabd nāṭeq ast dar mābayn-e samāvāt va arḍ bi-annanī anā nafsuhu wa-dhātuhu wa-rūḥuhu wa-haykaluhu wa-bahāʾuhu. Maʿa-dhālek chegūne mīshavad be-ān jawhar-e aʿlā va sādhaj-e abhā rūḥu man fī mamāliki al-baqāʾ fidāhu be-ghayr-e reḍā-ye Allāh takallom namāyam? Bārī be-ʿayneh mesl-e malaʾ-e Forqān ke dar avval-e fajr-e ẓohūr nesbat mīdādand ke īn ṭāyefe be-Rasūl Allāh ḥobb nadārand ke shāyad be-īn mozakhrafāt ʿebād rā az ʿerfān-e nafs-e Allāh fī yawm al-maʿād maḥrūm namāyand chenānche namūde va mīnamāyand. Alā laʿnatu Allāhi ʿalā al-muftarīn.

Among other things, he has alleged that this servant has spoken disrespectfully of the Primal Point, whereas this servant proclaims between the heavens and the earth, “I am indeed His very Self, His Essence, His Spirit, His Temple, and His Glory.” How, then, could I speak of that most exalted Essence and most glorious Reality—may the spirit of everyone in the realms of eternity be sacrificed for Him—in a manner contrary to God’s good pleasure? In short, this is exactly like the people of the Qur’an who, at the first dawn of the Revelation, alleged that this community had no love for the Messenger of God, hoping through such absurdities to deprive God’s servants of recognizing His own Self on the Day of Return, as they have done and continue to do. Indeed, God’s curse be upon those who fabricate falsehoods.

220

با اینکه جمیع عالم را آثار بدیعه احاطه نموده و جمیع اهل بیان بر این شاهد و گواهند و معادل ما نزّل فی البیان از این ظهور بدیع نازل و از اهل بیان نفسی نه که اثر اللّه نزدش موجود نباشد و من دون ذلک آنچه در این ارض موجود کتّاب از تحریرش عاجز مانده‌اند چنانچه اکثری بی‌سواد مانده مع‌ذلک نوشته بمجرّد عبارت فهمی و چهار کلمه این دعویها نموده‌اند حال شما انصاف دهید قولی که کذبش مثل شمس در وسط السّمآء مشرق و لایح و واضح است مع‌ذلک بچه جرئت و جسارت تکلّم نموده

Bā īnke jamīʿ-e ʿālam rā āthār-e badīʿe eḥāṭe namūde va jamīʿ-e ahl-e Bayān bar īn shāhed va govāhand va moʿādel-e mā nuzzila fī al-Bayān az īn ẓohūr-e badīʿ nāzel va az ahl-e Bayān nafsī na ke athar-e Allāh nazdash mawjūd nabāshad va min dūn-e dhālek ānche dar īn arḍ mawjūd kottāb az taḥrīrash ʿājez mānde-and chenānche aktharī bī-savād mānde maʿa-dhālek neveshte be-mojarrad-e ʿebārat-fahmī va chahār kaleme īn daʿvīhā namūde-and. Ḥāl shomā enṣāf dehīd qawlī ke kedhbash mesl-e shams dar vasaṭ-e al-samāʾ moshreq va lāyeḥ va vāḍeḥ ast maʿa-dhālek be-che jorʾat va jasārat takallom namūde.

Although wondrous writings have encompassed the whole world, and all the people of the Bayán bear witness and testify to this; although the equivalent of what was revealed in the Bayán has descended from this wondrous Revelation, and there is not one among the people of the Bayán who does not possess a writing of God; and although, beyond this, the scribes have been unable to transcribe what exists in this land, so that most of it remains uncopied—nevertheless, he has written that merely through understanding phrases and knowing a few words, He has made these claims. Now judge fairly: with what audacity and impudence he has uttered a statement whose falsehood is as manifest, apparent, and clear as the sun in the midst of heaven!

221

اگرچه فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو که این عبد ابداً اراده نداشته که آنچه از سماء مشیّت بدعاً نازل میشود ببلاد اشتهار یابد چه که انظر مطهّره بسیار قلیل مشاهده می‌شود که قابل ملاحظهٴ آثار اللّه باشند لذا لازال مستور میداشتم و چه مقدار آیات اللّه که در عراق نازل و جمیع در شطّ محو شد و حال معادل صدهزار بیت در این ارض موجود و هنوز سواد نشده تا چه رسد بجلد چه که این امور که معلّق بخودنمائی بوده لازال این عبد از او مقدّس بوده و خواهد بود

Agarche fa-wa-Allāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa ke īn ʿabd abadan erāde nadāshte ke ānche az samā-ye mashiyyat badʿan nāzel mīshavad be-belād eshtehār yābad che ke anẓor-e moṭahhare besyār qalīl moshāhede mīshavad ke qābel-e molāḥaẓe-ye āthār-e Allāh bāshand. Ledhā lā-zāl mastūr mīdāshtam va che meqdār āyāt-e Allāh ke dar ʿErāq nāzel va jamīʿ dar shaṭṭ maḥv shod va ḥāl moʿādel-e ṣad-hezār bayt dar īn arḍ mawjūd va hanūz savād nashode tā che rasad be-jeld che ke īn omūr ke moʿallaq be-khwodnamāʾī būde lā-zāl īn ʿabd az ū moqaddas būde va khwāhad būd.

Yet, by God, besides whom there is no god, this servant has never intended that what is newly revealed from the heaven of the divine will should become widely known throughout the lands, for very few purified eyes are to be found that are worthy of beholding the writings of God. Therefore I have always kept them concealed. How many verses of God were revealed in Iraq, all of which were effaced in the river! And now the equivalent of a hundred thousand verses exists in this land, not yet transcribed, let alone bound into volumes. For this servant has always been, and will always remain, sanctified from such matters as pertain to self-display.

222

و چند مرتبه بعضی خواسته‌اند که آنچه موجود است مجلّدات نموده باطراف ارسال دارند و هنوز اذن داده نشده چه که هیچیک از مظاهر الهیّه بنفسه مباشر اینگونه امور نشده‌اند چنانچه نقطهٴ اولی روح ما سواه فداه خود بنفسه اعتنا باین امور نفرموده و فرموده‌اند که بعد باحسن نظم منظّم شود و میفرمایند عزّ ذکره فطوبی لمن ینظر الی نظم بهآءاللّه و یشکر ربّه فانّه یظهر و لا مردّ له من عند اللّه فی البیان انتهی و هم‌چنین از قبل رسول ‌اللّه که بعد از ارتقاء آن ذات قدم قرآن جلد شد و من قبله انجیل

Va chand martabe baʿḍī khwāste-and ke ānche mawjūd ast mojalladāt namūde be-aṭrāf ersāl dārand va hanūz edhn dāde nashode che ke hīch-yek az maẓāher-e elāhiyye be-nafseh mobāsher-e īngūne omūr nashode-and chenānche Noqṭe-ye Ūlā rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh khwod be-nafseh eʿtenā be-īn omūr nafarmūde va farmūde-and ke baʿd be-aḥsan-e naẓm monaẓẓam shavad va mīfarmāyand ʿazza dhikruhu fa-ṭūbā li-man yanẓuru ilā naẓmi Bahāʾ Allāhi wa-yashkuru rabbahu fa-innahu yaẓharu wa-lā maradda lahu min ʿindi Allāhi fī al-Bayān intahā. Va hamchenīn az qabl Rasūl Allāh ke baʿd az erteqā-ye ān dhāt-e qedam Qorʾān jeld shod va min qablihi Enjīl.

Several times, some have wished to bind what exists into volumes and send them abroad, but permission has not yet been given, for none of the Manifestations of God has personally undertaken such matters. Thus the Primal Point—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—did not Himself attend to these matters, but said that they should later be arranged in the finest order. He says—exalted be His mention—“Blessed is the one who beholds the order of Bahá’u’lláh and gives thanks to his Lord, for He will assuredly appear, and there is no averting Him, as ordained by God in the Bayán.” Here ends the quotation. Likewise, in the past, with the Messenger of God: the Qur’an was bound into a volume after that eternal Being’s ascension, and before Him, the Gospel.

223

و با آنکه آیات عزّ قدس شرق و غرب عالم را احاطه نموده باین کلمات تشبّث جسته‌اند و بچهار کلمه تعبیر نموده‌اند چنانچه اعمال حجّ در سنهٴ قبل متعدّد از قلم عزّ صدور یافت و مع‌ذلک ارسال نشد مگر یک سوره که به سورهٴ حجّ معروف است هرگز این عبد در اشتهار اینگونه امور اوقات صرف ننموده و نخواهد نمود شأن نزول شأن حقّ است و انتشار شأن خلق و انّه لناشر امره بید النّاشرات من ملائکة المقرّبین لابدّ از خلف سرادق عصمت ربّانی عبادی روحانی ظاهر شوند و آثار اللّه را جمع نمایند و باحسن نظم منظّم سازند و هذا حتم لا ریب فیه

Va bā ānke āyāt-e ʿezz-e qods sharq va gharb-e ʿālam rā eḥāṭe namūde be-īn kalemāt tashabboth joste-and va be-chahār kaleme taʿbīr namūde-and chenānche aʿmāl-e ḥajj dar sane-ye qabl motaʿadded az qalam-e ʿezz ṣodūr yāft va maʿa-dhālek ersāl nashod magar yek sūre ke be-Sūre-ye Ḥajj maʿrūf ast. Hargez īn ʿabd dar eshtehār-e īngūne omūr awqāt ṣarf nanamūde va nakhwāhad namūd. Shaʾn-e nozūl shaʾn-e Ḥaqq ast va enteshār shaʾn-e khalq wa-innahu la-nāshiru amrihi bi-yadi al-nāshirāti min malāʾikati al-muqarrabīn. Lā-bodd az khalf-e sorādeq-e ʿeṣmat-e rabbānī ʿebādī rūḥānī ẓāher shavand va āthār-e Allāh rā jamʿ namāyand va be-aḥsan-e naẓm monaẓẓam sāzand wa-hādhā ḥatmun lā rayba fīh.

Although the verses of holy glory have encompassed the east and west of the world, they have seized upon these words and described them as a mere handful of words. Thus, in the past year, several sets of pilgrimage rites issued from the Pen of Glory, yet none was sent out except one surah, known as the Surah of Pilgrimage. This servant has never spent time publicizing such matters, nor will He ever do so. Revelation is the province of God, and dissemination is the province of His creatures. He will indeed spread His Cause through the hands of those angels brought near to Him who disseminate it. Spiritual servants will assuredly emerge from behind the tabernacle of divine protection, gather the writings of God, and arrange them in the finest order. This is an irrevocable decree, beyond all doubt.

224

و دیگر آنکه بعضی عبارات نوشته‌اند و نسبت بنقطهٴ بیان روح ما سواه فداه داده‌اند هذا کذب صراح و حینئذ یبرأ نقطة البیان منهم و من کلماتهم و کان اللّه یشهد بذلک ان انتم لا تشهدون

Va dīgar ānke baʿḍī ʿebārāt neveshte-and va nesbat be-Noqṭe-ye Bayān rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh dāde-and. Hādhā kid hbun ṣurāḥun wa-ḥīnaʾidhin yabraʾu Nuqṭatu al-Bayāni minhum wa-min kalimātihim wa-kāna Allāhu yashhadu bi-dhālika in antum lā tashhadūn.

Furthermore, they have written certain statements and attributed them to the Point of the Bayán—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him. This is a blatant lie. The Point of the Bayán therefore disavows them and their words, and God bears witness to this, even if you do not.

225

و چه مقدار باسماء افتخار مینمایند واللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو که شبه این نفوس در ابداع دیده نشده شب و روز اوقات صرف نموده که کلمه‌ئی در کتاب اللّه بیابند و بخود تفسیر نمایند و این عبد در حین تفریق از اخوی یک جعبه از خطوط و دوائر و هیاکل که بخطّ نقطهٴ اولی بوده نزد اخوی فرستادم و پیغام نمودم که چون تو بسیار مایلی که بعد از اعراض از حقّ بآثار آن افتخار نمائی لذا نزد تو ارسال شد که این هیاکل را بجهت بعضی از اهل دیار مختلفه ارسال داری و اظهار شأن نمائی و یا آنکه هر نفسی نزدت حاضر میشود انتشار دهی چنانچه الیوم بهمان عمل مشغولی و بلکه بعضی کلمات مجعولهٴ خود را بآن کلمات منضم ساخته لعلّ یزلّ بها اقدام العارفین

Va che meqdār be-asmāʾ eftekhār mīnamāyand. Wa-Allāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa ke shebh-e īn nofūs dar ebdāʿ dīde nashode. Shab va rūz awqāt ṣarf namūde ke kaleme-ī dar ketāb-e Allāh beyāband va be-khwod tafsīr namāyand va īn ʿabd dar ḥīn-e tafrīq az akhavī yek jaʿbe az khoṭūṭ va davāʾer va hayākel ke be-khaṭṭ-e Noqṭe-ye Ūlā būde nazd-e akhavī ferestādam va payghām namūdam ke chūn to besyār māyelī ke baʿd az eʿrāḍ az Ḥaqq be-āthār-e ān eftekhār namāʾī ledhā nazd-e to ersāl shod ke īn hayākel rā be-jehat-e baʿḍī az ahl-e deyār-e mokhtalefe ersāl dārī va eẓhār-e shaʾn namāʾī va yā ānke har nafsī nazdat ḥāḍer mīshavad enteshār dehī chenānche al-yawm be-hamān ʿamal mashghūlī va balke baʿḍī kalemāt-e majʿūle-ye khwod rā be-ān kalemāt monḍamm sākhte laʿalla yazilla bihā aqdāmu al-ʿārifīn.

How greatly they pride themselves on names! By God, besides whom there is no god, the like of these souls has never been seen in all creation. They spend their days and nights seeking a word in the Book of God that they might interpret as referring to themselves. When I, this servant, parted from My brother, I sent him a box of calligraphic writings, circles, and temples in the handwriting of the Primal Point, with this message: “Since you are so eager, after turning away from the Truth, to pride yourself on His writings, these have been sent to you so that you may send these temples to some of the people in different lands and display your station, or distribute them to whoever comes into your presence, as indeed you are occupied in doing today. You have even added some of your own fabricated words to those words, in the hope that through them the feet of those who have attained recognition might slip.”

226

باری ای عباد از این مراتب چشم بردارید و دل را مقدّس نمائید چه که الیوم فضلی ظاهر شده که در یک یوم و لیل اگر کاتب از عهده برآید معادل بیان فارسی از سماء قدس ربّانی نازل میشود و کذلک بشأن الآیات علی لسان عربیّ بدیع فاحضروا بین یدی العرش لتشهدوا بعیونکم و لا تقاسوا کلمات اللّه بکلمات دونه و تکوننّ علی بصیرة منیر

Bārī ey ʿebād az īn marāteb chashm bardārīd va del rā moqaddas namāʾīd che ke al-yawm faḍlī ẓāher shode ke dar yek yawm va layl agar kāteb az ʿohde bar-āyad moʿādel-e Bayān-e Fārsī az samā-ye qods-e rabbānī nāzel mīshavad wa-kadhālika bi-shaʾni al-āyāti ʿalā lisānin ʿarabiyyin badīʿ. Fa-iḥḍurū bayna yaday al-ʿarshi li-tashhadū bi-ʿuyūnikum wa-lā taqāsū kalimāti Allāhi bi-kalimāti dūnihi wa-takūnanna ʿalā baṣīratin munīr.

In short, O servants, turn your eyes away from these matters and sanctify your hearts, for today such grace has appeared that in a single day and night, if a scribe can keep pace, the equivalent of the Persian Bayán descends from the heaven of divine holiness. The same is true of verses in a wondrous Arabic tongue. Come, then, before the Throne, that you may witness with your own eyes. Do not measure the words of God against the words of anyone besides Him, and possess an illumined insight.

227

یا قوم فاشهدوا بما شهد اللّه و لا تلتفتوا الی دونه و لا تکوننّ من المریبین شهد اللّه انّه لا اله الّا هو و انّ نقطة الأولی عبده و بهائه کذلک نزّل من قبل من قلم اللّه العلیّ العظیم

Yā qawmi fa-ishhadū bi-mā shahida Allāhu wa-lā taltafitū ilā dūnihi wa-lā takūnanna mina al-murībīn. Shahida Allāhu annahu lā ilāha illā huwa wa-anna Nuqṭata al-Ūlā ʿabduhu wa-bahāʾuhu kadhālika nuzzila min qablu min qalami Allāhi al-ʿAliyyi al-ʿAẓīm.

O people, bear witness to that to which God has borne witness, do not turn toward anyone besides Him, and do not be among the doubters. God bears witness that there is no god but Him, and that the Primal Point is His servant and His glory. Thus was it revealed before by the Pen of God, the Most High, the Most Great.

228

و اگر بمعنی همین یک آیه بتمامه فایز میشدید ابداً از صراط اعظم الهی محتجب نمیگشتید چنانچه الیوم اکثری از اهل بیان شهادت میدهند و چون باین اسم مبارک میرسند اذاً تسودّ وجوههم و تضطرب قلوبهم و تزلّ اقدامهم و یکوننّ من المتوقّفین

Va agar be-maʿnī-ye hamīn yek āye be-tamāmeh fāyez mīshodīd abadan az ṣerāṭ-e aʿẓam-e elāhī moḥtajeb nemīgashtīd chenānche al-yawm aktharī az ahl-e Bayān shahādat mīdehand va chūn be-īn esm-e mobārak mīresand idhan taswaddu wujūhuhum wa-taḍṭaribu qulūbuhum wa-tazillu aqdāmuhum wa-yakūnanna mina al-mutawaqqifīn.

Had you grasped the full meaning of this one verse, you would never have been veiled from the most great path of God. Yet today most of the people of the Bayán bear witness, but when they reach this blessed Name, their faces darken, their hearts are troubled, their feet slip, and they become those who hesitate.

229

تاللّه الحقّ هیچ عملی نزد حقّ مقبول نه مگر باقرار باین اسم مبارک مطهّر فطوبی للذّاکرین و للرّاسخین

Ta-Allāhi al-Ḥaqq hīch ʿamalī nazd-e Ḥaqq maqbūl na magar be-eqrār be-īn esm-e mobārak-e moṭahhar fa-ṭūbā li-al-dhākirīna wa-li-al-rāsikhīn.

By God, the True One, no deed is accepted before God without acknowledgment of this blessed, sanctified Name. Blessed, then, are those who remember and those who stand firm.

230

و دیگر آنکه در رسائل افتخار نموده که جناب طاهره و عظیم باو مذعن شده‌اند اگرچه این عبد افتخار باین گونه امور را مفقود صرف و معدوم بحت میشمرم و این نه از غرور و استکبار است چه که این عبد در خود شأنی ندیده و نخواهد دید ولکن نظر باظهار شأن اللّه ذکر شده چه که کینونات حروفات باصلها و اسرها بقولی مبعوث بوده و خواهند بود

Va dīgar ānke dar rasāʾel eftekhār namūde ke Janāb-e Ṭāhere va ʿAẓīm be-ū modhʿen shode-and agarche īn ʿabd eftekhār be-īn gūne omūr rā mafqūd-e ṣerf va maʿdūm-e baḥt mīshmoram va īn na az ghorūr va estekbār ast che ke īn ʿabd dar khwod shaʾnī nadīde va nakhwāhad dīd va-lāken naẓar be-eẓhār-e shaʾn-e Allāh dhekr shode che ke kaynūnāt-e ḥorūfāt be-aṣlehā va asrehā be-qawlī mabʿūth būde va khwāhand būd.

Furthermore, he has boasted in his treatises that Ṭáhirih and ʿAẓím acknowledged him. Yet I, this servant, regard pride in such matters as sheer nothingness and utter nonexistence. This is not out of conceit or arrogance, for this servant has never seen, nor will ever see, any station in Himself. Rather, this has been mentioned to manifest the station of God, for the very beings of the Letters, in their origin and entirety, have been, and will be, called into being by a single utterance.

231

حقّ را لایق نه در اثبات ظهورش بغیر نفسه و ما یظهر من عنده استدلال فرماید چه که کلّ دلیل بانتسابه الیه محکم بوده و خواهد بود و کلّ سبیل بنسبته الیه مستقیم ولکن چون ناس ضعیف مشاهده میشوند و غیر بالغ لذا این عبد ذکر مینمایم که آنچه از کلمات الهی که مخصوص این امر نازل شده خارج از احصای این نفوس بوده و خواهد بود
