Ḥaqq rā lāyeq na dar ethbāt-e ẓohūrash be-gheyr-e nafsihi va mā yaẓharu min ʿindihi estedlāl farmāyad, che ke koll-e dalīl be-entesābash elayh moḥkam būde va khwāhad būd va koll-e sabīl be-nesbatash elayh mostaqīm. Va lāken chon nās ḍaʿīf moshāhede mīshavand va gheyr-e bālegh, ledhā īn ʿabd dhekr mīnamāyam ke ānche az kalemāt-e elāhī ke makhṣūṣ-e īn amr nāzel shode khārej az eḥṣā-ye īn nofūs būde va khwāhad būd.

It is not fitting for the True One to establish His manifestation by adducing anything other than Himself and what proceeds from Him, for every proof has been and will remain sound through its connection to Him, and every path is straight through its relation to Him. Yet since people are seen to be weak and immature, I, this servant, mention that the divine words revealed specifically concerning this Cause have been, and will remain, beyond the reckoning of these souls.

232

و اگر ناس ببصر اللّه ناظر باشند همین یک بیان نقطهٴ بیان جلّ ثنائه جمیع را کافی است که میفرمایند انّنی انا حیّ فی افق الأبهی چنانچه الیوم از افق ابهی ظاهر و لایح و مشرقند و حینئذ یسمع و یری کلّ ما یقول و یرتکب به الخلایق اجمعین و من دون ذلک

Va agar nās be-baṣar-e Allāh nāẓer bāshand, hamīn yek bayān-e Noqṭe-ye Bayān, jalla thanāʾuhu, jamīʿ rā kāfī ast ke mīfarmāyand: innanī anā ḥayyun fī ufuqi al-Abhā. Chenānche al-yowm az ofoq-e Abhā ẓāher va lāyeḥ va moshreqand, va ḥīnaʾidhin yasmaʿu wa yarā kulla mā yaqūlu wa yartakibu bihi al-khalāʾiqu ajmaʿīn, va men dūn-e dhālek.

If people were to look with the eye of God, this single utterance of the Point of the Bayān—exalted be His praise—would suffice them all: “Indeed, I am alive in the horizon of the All-Glorious.” Thus today He is manifest, radiant, and shining from the horizon of the All-Glorious, and He now hears and sees everything that all created beings say and do. Besides this,

233

شهادتی که در الواح ذکر فرموده‌اند و جمیع را بقرائت آن امر نموده‌اند دلیل واضح لمن کان ناظراً بعین اللّه ربّه قوله تعالی شهد اللّه انّه لا اله الّا هو و انّ نقطة الأولی عبده و بهائه و این آیات دلیلی است واضح و برهانی است قاطع ولکن لا یزید المتوهّمین الّا خساراً چه که متوهّمین جمیع آیات را بوهم تفسیر نموده‌اند و هم‌چنین میفرماید عزّ ذکره و انّی انا العرش البهآء بالحقّ الأکبر قد کنت فوق مطلع یاقوته السّیّال فوق الطّور

Shahādatī ke dar alvāḥ dhekr farmūde-and va jamīʿ rā be-qerāʾat-e ān amr namūde-and dalīl-e vāḍeḥ li-man kāna nāẓiran bi-ʿayni Allāhi rabbihi. Qawluhu taʿālā: shahida Allāhu annahu lā ilāha illā huwa wa anna Nuqṭata al-Ūlā ʿabduhu wa bahāʾuhu. Va īn āyāt dalīlī ast vāḍeḥ va borhānī ast qāṭeʿ, va lāken lā yazīdu al-mutawahhimīna illā khasāran, che ke motavahhemīn jamīʿ-e āyāt rā be-vahm tafsīr namūde-and. Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad, ʿazza dhikruhu: wa innī anā al-ʿarshu al-Bahāʾu bi-al-ḥaqqi al-akbar, qad kuntu fawqa maṭlaʿi yāqūtihi al-sayyāli fawqa al-Ṭūr.

The testimony He has mentioned in the Tablets, which He has commanded everyone to recite, is a clear proof for anyone who looks with the eye of God, his Lord. His words—exalted is He—are: “God bears witness that there is no god but Him, and that the Primal Point is His servant and His glory.” These verses are a clear proof and a decisive demonstration, yet they “increase the deluded in nothing but loss,” for the deluded have interpreted all the verses according to their own imaginings. He also says—exalted be His remembrance: “Indeed, I am the throne of glory in the greatest truth. I have been above the dawning-place of His flowing ruby, above the Mount.”

234

مقصود او در این آیهٴ منزلهٴ مبارکه اگر تفکّر رود بر علوّ ظهور ارفع امنع اقدس مطّلع می‌شوید و هم‌چنین میفرمایند قوله عزّ شأنه و لقد خلق اللّه فی حول ذلک الباب بحوراً من مآء الاکسیر محمّراً بالدّهن الوجود و حیواناً بالثّمرة المقصود و قدّر اللّه له سفناً من یاقوته الرّطبة الحمرآء و لا یرکب فیها الّا اهل البهآء باذن اللّه العلیّ و هو اللّه قد کان عزیزاً و حکیما

Maqṣūd-e ū dar īn āye-ye monzale-ye mobārake agar tafakkor ravad, bar ʿolovv-e ẓohūr-e arfaʿ-e amnaʿ-e aqdas moṭṭaleʿ mīshavīd. Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyand, qawluhu ʿazza shaʾnuhu: wa laqad khalaqa Allāhu fī ḥawli dhālika al-bābi buḥūran min māʾi al-iksīri muḥammaran bi-al-duhni al-wujūdi wa ḥayawānan bi-al-thamarati al-maqṣūdi, wa qaddara Allāhu lahu sufunan min yāqūtihi al-raṭbati al-ḥamrāʾi wa lā yarkabu fīhā illā ahlu al-Bahāʾi bi-idhni Allāhi al-ʿAliyyi wa huwa Allāhu qad kāna ʿazīzan wa ḥakīman.

If you reflect on His intent in this blessed, revealed verse, you will become aware of the loftiness of this most exalted, most inaccessible, most holy Revelation. He also says—exalted be His station: “God has indeed created around that Gate seas of the water of the elixir, reddened by the oil of existence and made living by the intended fruit. God has ordained for it ships of His moist crimson ruby, and none but the people of Bahāʾ embark in them, by the permission of God, the Most High. He is God, ever mighty and wise.”

235

حال سفن یاقوتهٴ رطبهٴ حمرا بر بحر کبریا جاری و ساری است ای اهل بها منقطع از ما سوی اللّه شده در فلک احدیّه و سفینهٴ عزّ باقیه درآئید و راکب شوید که هر نفسی که تمسّک جست باین فلک عنداللّه از اهل اثبات و نجات و علّیّین و رضوان مذکور و هر که تخلّف نمود از اهل نار و هلاک و سجّین و هاویه محسوب

Ḥāl sofon-e yāqūte-ye raṭbe-ye ḥamrā bar baḥr-e kebrīyā jārī va sārī ast. Ey ahl-e Bahā, monqaṭeʿ az mā sevā-ye Allāh shode dar folk-e aḥadīye va safīne-ye ʿezz-e bāqīye darāyīd va rākeb shavīd, ke har nafsī ke tamassok jost be-īn folk ʿendaʾllāh az ahl-e ethbāt va najāt va ʿellīyīn va reḍvān madhkūr, va har ke takhallof namūd az ahl-e nār va halāk va sejjīn va hāvīye maḥsūb.

Now the ships of moist crimson ruby sail and glide upon the ocean of majesty. O people of Bahā, detach yourselves from everything but God, enter the ark of oneness and the vessel of everlasting glory, and embark. For every soul who clings to this ark is reckoned before God among the people of affirmation and salvation, of the highest heaven and paradise; and whoever stays behind is counted among the people of fire and destruction, of the nethermost prison and the abyss.

236

زینهار دین را بدنیا مدهید و یوسف عزّ احدیّه را بآلآء دنیا و آخرت مبادله ننمائید عنقریب آنچه مشهود مفقود خواهید دید پس بکمال جهد و اجتهاد بظلّ ربّ الایجاد بشتابید که مکمن امنی جز ظلّش نبوده و نخواهد بود

Zīnhār dīn rā be-donyā madahīd va Yūsof-e ʿezz-e aḥadīye rā be-ālā-ye donyā va ākherat mobādele nanamāyīd. ʿAnqarīb ānche mashhūd mafqūd khwāhīd dīd. Pas be-kamāl-e jahd va ejtehād be-ẓell-e Rabb-e ījād beshetābīd, ke makman-e amnī joz ẓellash nabūde va nakhwāhad būd.

Take care not to exchange your faith for the world, nor trade the Joseph of the glory of oneness for the bounties of this world and the next. Before long, you will see all that is visible vanish. Hasten, then, with the utmost effort and endeavor to the shelter of the Lord of creation, for there has never been, nor will there ever be, a safe refuge other than His shelter.

237

و قوله عزّ کبریائه و امّا الغلام فهو من نار الشّجرة الخضرآء الموقدة من هذا العین الصّفرآء قد قتلناه فی هیکل المرئی لما قد قدّر اللّه فی الکتاب حظّاً من ابویه فخشینا ان یرهقهما خلال النّار فی جمال البهآء طغیاناً بلا علماً

Wa qawluhu ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu: wa ammā al-ghulāmu fa-huwa min nāri al-shajarati al-khaḍrāʾi al-mūqadati min hādhā al-ʿayni al-ṣafrāʾi, qad qatalnāhu fī haykali al-marʾiyyi li-mā qad qaddara Allāhu fī al-kitābi ḥaẓẓan min abawayhi, fa-khashīnā an yurhiqahumā khilāla al-nāri fī jamāli al-Bahāʾi ṭughyānan bi-lā ʿilman.

And His words—exalted be His majesty: “As for the youth, he is of the fire of the green tree, kindled from this yellow spring. We killed him in the visible temple because of what God had ordained in the Book as a portion from his parents, for We feared that, amid the fire, he would burden them with rebellion against the Beauty of Bahāʾ, without knowledge.”

238

حال بسی واضح است که کلّ بر این جمال اظهر انور ابهی طغیان نموده بشأنی که جز علم اللّه احدی محصی آن نه و کاش بطغیان و استکبار کفایت مینمودند بلکه در کلّ حین در انهدام بیت اللّه و حرمه مشغول بوده و خواهند بود و لن یسکن قلوبهم الّا بشرب دمی بعد الّذی خلقناهم و حفظناهم لاعلآء امری و نصرة جمالی

Ḥāl basī vāḍeḥ ast ke koll bar īn Jamāl-e aẓhar-e anvar-e Abhā ṭoghyān namūde be-shaʾnī ke joz ʿelm-e Allāh aḥadī moḥṣī-ye ān na. Va kāsh be-ṭoghyān va estekbār kefāyat mīnamūdand, balke dar koll-e ḥīn dar enhedām-e bayt-e Allāh va ḥaramash mashghūl būde va khwāhand būd. Wa lan yaskuna qulūbuhum illā bi-shurbi damī baʿda alladhī khalaqnāhum wa ḥafiẓnāhum li-iʿlāʾi amrī wa nuṣrati jamālī.

Now it is abundantly clear that all have rebelled against this most manifest, most luminous, all-glorious Beauty to a degree that no one can reckon except through the knowledge of God. If only they had been content with rebellion and arrogance! Rather, at every moment they have been, and will continue to be, occupied with destroying the house of God and His sanctuary. Their hearts will never be stilled except by drinking My blood, after We created and protected them for the exaltation of My Cause and the aid of My Beauty.

239

فلمّا اشدّ ظهرهم و وجدوا الاطمینان من انفسهم قاموا علی قتلی بطغیان عظیم فلمّا بلغت الی ذلک المقام نادی المناد عن خلف سرادق البقآء ان یا قلم الأعلی لا تجعل امرک محدوداً بذکر دون ذکر قل تاللّه قد نزّل البیان کلّه لأمری البدیع المنیع و لولاک ما نزّل حرف من البیان و لا صحایف عزّ کریم دع الموتی لأنّ الّذینهم ما آمنوا بک اموات غیر احیآء لا یسمعون و لا یعقلون ولو یلقی علیهم کلمات الأوّلین و الآخرین و الّذین احیاهم اللّه بک اولئک فی حبّک قرؤوا کلّ الکتب و لن یحتاجوا بشیء سواک لأنّ ظهورک بنفسه جعله اللّه حجّة علی العالمین

Fa-lammā ashadda ẓahrahum wa wajadū al-iṭmiʾnāna min anfusihim qāmū ʿalā qatlī bi-ṭughyānin ʿaẓīm. Fa-lammā balaghtu ilā dhālika al-maqāmi nādā al-munādi ʿan khalfi surādiqi al-baqāʾi an yā Qalama al-Aʿlā lā tajʿal amraka maḥdūdan bi-dhikrin dūna dhikr. Qul ta-Allāhi qad nuzzila al-Bayānu kulluhu li-amrī al-badīʿi al-manīʿi wa lawlāka mā nuzzila ḥarfun mina al-Bayāni wa lā ṣaḥāʾifu ʿizzin karīm. Daʿi al-mawtā li-anna alladhīnahum mā āmanū bika amwātun ghayru aḥyāʾin lā yasmaʿūna wa lā yaʿqilūna wa law yulqā ʿalayhim kalimātu al-awwalīna wa al-ākhirīn. Wa alladhīna aḥyāhumu Allāhu bika ulāʾika fī ḥubbika qaraʾū kulla al-kutubi wa lan yaḥtājū bi-shayʾin siwāka li-anna ẓuhūraka bi-nafsihi jaʿalahu Allāhu ḥujjatan ʿalā al-ʿālamīn.

When He had strengthened them and they felt assured of themselves, they rose up to kill Me in grievous rebellion. When I reached this point, the Herald called from behind the tabernacle of eternity: “O Most Exalted Pen, do not confine Your Cause to mentioning one thing rather than another. Say: By God, the entire Bayān was revealed for My wondrous, inaccessible Cause. But for You, not a letter of the Bayān would have been revealed, nor any scrolls of noble glory. Leave the dead, for those who have not believed in You are dead, not living. They neither hear nor understand, even if the words of the first and the last are recited to them. Those whom God has brought to life through You have, in their love for You, read all the Books, and they will never need anything but You, for God has made Your manifestation itself a proof to all the worlds.”

240

فلمّا سمعت النّدآء اکتفیت بما رقم من اصبع قدس منیر

Fa-lammā samiʿtu al-nidāʾa iktafaytu bi-mā ruqima min iṣbaʿi qudsin munīr.

When I heard the call, I contented Myself with what had been inscribed by a luminous finger of holiness.

241

باری آیات عزّ احدیّه در این اسم و ظهور زیاده از آن است که احصا توان نمود و مع‌ذلک این همج رعاع این اسم مبارک را بارض طاء تفسیر نموده‌اند چه که حضرت اعلی روح ما سواه فداه او را ارض بها نامیده

Bārī āyāt-e ʿezz-e aḥadīye dar īn esm va ẓohūr zeyāde az ān ast ke eḥṣā tavān namūd, va maʿa-dhālek īn hamaj-e raʿāʿ īn esm-e mobārak rā be-arḍ-e Ṭā tafsīr namūde-and, che ke Ḥaḍrat-e Aʿlā, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, ū rā arḍ-e Bahā nāmīde.

In short, the verses of the glory of oneness concerning this Name and Revelation are beyond counting. Yet these ignorant rabble have interpreted this blessed Name as referring to the land of Ṭā, because the Most Exalted One—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him—called it the land of Bahā.

242

و آنقدر شعور نداشته که ادراک نمایند که مقصود حضرت آن بوده که اخبار فرماید از ظهور جمال مقدّس در آن ارض ای ارض یمشی علیه البهآء و سکن فیها هذا الاسم المشرق المنیر چنانچه این اسم مبارک را در کلّ مراتب اسبق از کلّ اسماء ذکر فرموده‌اند و

Va ānqadr shoʿūr nadāshte ke edrāk namāyand ke maqṣūd-e Ḥaḍrat ān būde ke ekhbār farmāyad az ẓohūr-e Jamāl-e moqaddas dar ān arḍ, ay arḍun yamshī ʿalayhi al-Bahāʾu wa sakana fīhā hādhā al-ismu al-mushriqu al-munīr. Chenānche īn esm-e mobārak rā dar koll-e marāteb asbaq az koll-e asmā dhekr farmūde-and va

They have lacked even the understanding to perceive that His purpose was to foretell the appearance of the holy Beauty in that land—that is, a land upon which Bahāʾ walks and in which this radiant, luminous Name has dwelt. Thus He has mentioned this blessed Name as preceding all names in every degree, and

243

هم‌چنین در دعای قبل ملاحظه نمائید که اقدم اسماء این اسم مبارک ذکر شده بقوله اللّهمّ انّی اسألک من بهائک بأبهاه و هم‌چنین شهور که باسماء جدیده نامیده‌اند اوّل آن را باین اسم منسوب فرموده‌اند در هر شیء اگر ملاحظه نمائید احسن آن را باین اسم مذکور نموده‌اند

Hamchenīn dar doʿā-ye qabl molāḥeẓe namāyīd ke aqdam-e asmā īn esm-e mobārak dhekr shode be-qawlihi: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min bahāʾika bi-abhāhu. Va hamchenīn shohūr ke be-asmā-ye jadīde nāmīde-and, avval-e ān rā be-īn esm mansūb farmūde-and. Dar har shayʾ agar molāḥeẓe namāyīd, aḥsan-e ān rā be-īn esm madhkūr namūde-and.

likewise, consider the earlier prayer, in which this blessed Name is mentioned as the foremost of the names, in His words: “O God, I ask You by the most glorious of Your glory.” Likewise, among the months to which He has given new names, He has associated the first with this Name. Whatever you examine, He has designated its finest part by this Name.

244

و مع‌ذلک ملاحظه نمائید که بغضا بچه رتبه رسیده که این اسم مبارک را بارضی تفسیر نموده‌اند که ذرّة من ترابها خیر منهم و من ذواتهم و حقایقهم فأفّ لهم و بما فی صدورهم من نار الحسد و البغضآء و یحترقون بها فی کلّ حین و لا یشعرون

Va maʿa-dhālek molāḥeẓe namāyīd ke baghḍā be-che rotbe resīde ke īn esm-e mobārak rā be-arḍī tafsīr namūde-and ke dharratun min turābihā khayrun minhum wa min dhawātihim wa ḥaqāʾiqihim. Fa-uffin lahum wa bi-mā fī ṣudūrihim min nāri al-ḥasadi wa al-baghḍāʾi wa yaḥtariqūna bihā fī kulli ḥīnin wa lā yashʿurūn.

Yet consider how far their hatred has gone: they have interpreted this blessed Name as referring to a land, a speck of whose dust is better than they are, than their very selves and realities. Shame on them and on the fire of envy and hatred within their breasts! They burn in it at every moment, yet do not perceive it.

245

و دیگر جناب قدّوس جلّ ثنائه الواحی چند در ارض بدشت مرقوم فرموده و ارسال داشته و ابداً این عبد اظهار ننموده و از جمله در این امر بدیع اخبار فرموده‌اند تصریحاً من غیر تلویح قوله جلّ ثنائه و اذا اظهر الرّبّ سرّاً من افق البهآء فی ارض او ادنی فقد کان ذلک الطّلعة المتلامعة من نقطة البآء طرزیّاً و اذا قامت السّموات الجذبیّة بالسّطر بالسّرّ السّطریّة فذلک من امرنا لأهل العمآء قد کان طلیعاً و آن الواح مبارکه الآن موجود است و جمیع در ذکر این امر باصرح کلمات شاهد و گواه فوربّ العرش و العمآء که حیا مانع است از ذکر این کلمات چه که این عبد لازال اراده ننموده که بکلمات قبل شأنی از برای خود ثابت نماید لأنّ شأنی شأنه و انّه مشهود فی وسط سمآء الاستقلال و ما من ذی بصر الّا و قد یشهد و یری و للعمیآء لیس له من نصیب

Va dīgar Janāb-e Qoddūs, jalla thanāʾuhu, alvāḥī chand dar arḍ-e Badasht marqūm farmūde va ersāl dāshte va abadan īn ʿabd eẓhār nanamūde, va az jomle dar īn amr-e badīʿ ekhbār farmūde-and taṣrīḥan min ghayri talwīḥ. Qawluhu jalla thanāʾuhu: wa idhā aẓhara al-rabbu sirran min ufuqi al-Bahāʾi fī arḍi aw adnā fa-qad kāna dhālika al-ṭalʿatu al-mutalāmiʿatu min nuqṭati al-bāʾi ṭarziyyan, wa idhā qāmati al-samāwātu al-jadhbiyyatu bi-al-saṭri bi-al-sirri al-saṭriyyati fa-dhālika min amrinā li-ahli al-ʿamāʾi qad kāna ṭalīʿan. Va ān alvāḥ-e mobārake al-ān mowjūd ast va jamīʿ dar dhekr-e īn amr be-aṣraḥ-e kalemāt shāhed va govāh. Fa-wa-rabbi al-ʿarshi wa al-ʿamāʾi ke ḥayā māneʿ ast az dhekr-e īn kalemāt, che ke īn ʿabd lāzāl erāde nanamūde ke be-kalemāt-e qabl shaʾnī az barā-ye khwod thābet namāyad, li-anna shaʾnī shaʾnuhu wa innahu mashhūdun fī wasaṭi samāʾi al-istiqlāli wa mā min dhī baṣarin illā wa qad yashhadu wa yarā wa li-al-ʿamyāʾi laysa lahu min naṣīb.

Furthermore, his honor Quddūs—exalted be his praise—wrote and sent several Tablets in the land of Badasht, which this servant has never disclosed. Among other things, he foretold this wondrous Cause explicitly, without allusion. His words—exalted be his praise—are: “When the Lord manifests a secret from the horizon of Bahāʾ in the land of ‘or nearer,’ that resplendent Countenance from the point of the letter Bāʾ has indeed been an exemplar. And when the heavens of attraction are raised through the line, through the mystery of the line, that has indeed been a harbinger of Our Cause to the people of the cloud of unknowing.” Those blessed Tablets are now extant, and all bear witness and testify to this Cause in the most explicit words. By the Lord of the Throne and the cloud of unknowing, shame prevents Me from mentioning these words, for this servant has never wished to establish a station for Himself through earlier utterances. For My station is His station, and it is manifest in the midmost heaven of independence. There is no one endowed with sight who does not witness and behold it, while the blind have no share in it.

246

قل تاللّه شأنی شأنه و قدرتی قدرته و سلطانی سلطانه و ظهوره حجّتی و ما جری من قلمه برهانی کما انّ ظهوری حجّته و ما جری من قلمی برهانه ولکن نظر بحفظ عباد نابالغ تحریر میشود

Qul ta-Allāhi shaʾnī shaʾnuhu wa qudratī qudratuhu wa sulṭānī sulṭānuhu wa ẓuhūruhu ḥujjatī wa mā jarā min qalamihi burhānī, kamā anna ẓuhūrī ḥujjatuhu wa mā jarā min qalamī burhānuhu. Va lāken naẓar be-ḥefẓ-e ʿebād-e nābālegh taḥrīr mīshavad.

Say: By God, My station is His station, My power is His power, and My sovereignty is His sovereignty. His manifestation is My proof, and what has flowed from His Pen is My testimony, just as My manifestation is His proof, and what has flowed from My Pen is His testimony. Yet this is being written for the protection of immature servants.

247

و از جمله نقطهٴ جذبیّه جناب طاء علیها بهآء اللّه الأبهی مدّتها با این عبد بوده و آنی لقاء این غلام را بملک دنیا و آخرت مبادله نمینمود و ما ارادت ان تفارق عنّی اقلّ من آن ولکن قضی ما قضی و چه مقدار از آیات و اشعار که در این امر بدیع ذکر فرموده از جمله در وصف طلعت الهی غزلی گفته و یک فرد آن این است

Va az jomle Noqṭe-ye Jadhbīye, Janāb-e Ṭā, ʿalayhā bahāʾu Allāhi al-Abhā, moddat-hā bā īn ʿabd būde va ānī leqā-ye īn gholām rā be-molk-e donyā va ākherat mobādele namīnamūd, wa mā arādat an tufāriqa ʿannī aqalla min ān, va lāken quḍiya mā quḍiya. Va che meqdār az āyāt va ashʿār ke dar īn amr-e badīʿ dhekr farmūde. Az jomle dar vaṣf-e Ṭalʿat-e elāhī ghazalī gofte va yek fard-e ān īn ast.

Among them, too, was the Point of Attraction, her honor Ṭā—upon her be the glory of God, the All-Glorious—who was with this servant for a long time. She would not have exchanged a moment in the presence of this Youth for dominion over this world and the next, nor did she wish to part from Me for less than an instant. Yet what was decreed came to pass. How many verses and poems she uttered concerning this wondrous Cause! Among them, she composed a ghazal in praise of the divine Countenance, one couplet of which is this:

248

گر براندازد بها از رخ نقاب صدهزار همچون ازل آید پدید

Gar barandāzad Bahā az rokh neqāb ṣad-hezār hamchūn Azal āyad padīd.

Should Bahā cast the veil from His face, a hundred thousand like Azal would appear.

249

و هم‌چنین در دون این عبد هم بسیار وصف نموده و فوق جمیع این بیانات کتاب مکنون نقطهٴ اعلی روح ما سواه فداه که کلّ در این امر بدیع نازل شده و از انظار مستور گشته از خدا بخواهید تا بآن فایز شوید

Va hamchenīn dar dūn-e īn ʿabd ham besyār vaṣf namūde, va fowq-e jamīʿ-e īn bayānāt Ketāb-e Maknūn-e Noqṭe-ye Aʿlā, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, ke koll dar īn amr-e badīʿ nāzel shode va az anẓār mastūr gashte. Az Khodā bekhwāhīd tā be-ān fāyez shavīd.

She likewise offered much praise concerning others besides this servant. Above all these utterances stands the Hidden Book of the Most Exalted Point—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him—which was revealed entirely concerning this wondrous Cause and has been concealed from view. Ask God that you may attain it.

250

فوالّذی نفسی بیده که اگر مدّعی جمال الهی الیوم از این گونه دلایل در کتاب خود مذکور نمیداشت و تمسّک نمیجست که باین ادلّه سبب اضلال خلق شود هرگز این عبد باین ادلّه استدلال نمینمود باری ای عباد ندای علیّ اعلی را در ظهور اخرای او بشنوید و جمیع این دلایل را از قلب محو نمائید چه که اگر بکلمات و اشارات و صحف و کتب در این ظهور بدع ربّانی تمسّک جوئید ابداً بجوهر عرفان طلعت رحمن و سلطان امکان فایز نخواهید شد

Fa-wa-alladhī nafsī bi-yadihi ke agar moddaʿī-ye Jamāl-e elāhī al-yowm az īn gūne dalāyel dar ketāb-e khwod madhkūr namīdāsht va tamassok namījost ke be-īn adelle sabab-e eḍlāl-e khalq shavad, hargez īn ʿabd be-īn adelle estedlāl namīnamūd. Bārī ey ʿebād, nedā-ye ʿAlīy-e Aʿlā rā dar ẓohūr-e okhrā-ye ū beshnavīd va jamīʿ-e īn dalāyel rā az qalb maḥv namāyīd, che ke agar be-kalemāt va eshārāt va ṣoḥof va kotob dar īn ẓohūr-e bedʿ-e rabbānī tamassok jūyīd, abadan be-jowhar-e ʿerfān-e Ṭalʿat-e Raḥmān va Solṭān-e emkān fāyez nakhwāhīd shod.

By Him in whose hand is My soul, had the one laying claim to the divine Beauty not cited such proofs in his book today and clung to them, thereby making these arguments a means of leading people astray, this servant would never have adduced these proofs. In short, O servants, hear the call of the Most Exalted ʿAlī in His latter manifestation, and erase all these proofs from your hearts. For if you cling to words, allusions, scrolls, and books in this wondrous divine Revelation, you will never attain the essence of the recognition of the Countenance of the All-Merciful and the Sovereign of all existence.

251

بلکه ناظر باشید بهمان حجّتی که نفس نقطهٴ اولی جلّ و عزّ بآن اتیان فرمود و امر خود را ثابت نمود و هم‌چنین از قبل آن جمال قدم محمّداً رسول اللّه و من قبله ابن مریم و من قبله کلیم فوالّذی نفسی بیده که یک حرف از آیات اللّه اعزّ است نزد این عبد از کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض

Balke nāẓer bāshīd be-hamān ḥojjatī ke nafs-e Noqṭe-ye Ūlā jalla wa ʿazza be-ān etyān farmūd va amr-e khod rā thābet namūd va ham-chenīn az qabl ān Jamāl-e Qedam Muḥammadan Rasūl Allāh wa min qablihi Ibn Maryam wa min qablihi Kalīm. Fa-wa-lladhī nafsī bi-yadihi ke yek ḥarf az āyāt-e Allāh aʿazz ast nazd-e īn ʿabd az kull man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ.

Rather, look to that very proof which the Primal Point Himself—glorified and exalted be He—brought forth and by which He established His Cause, as did before Him that Ancient Beauty, Muḥammad, the Messenger of God, and before Him the Son of Mary, and before Him Moses. By Him in whose hand is My soul, a single letter of the verses of God is dearer to this servant than all who are in the heavens and on earth.

252

و اینکه ذکر شده که در حین ظهور ناظر بکلمات و اشارات و دلالات و اسماء و صفات نشوید این حکمی است که خود نقطهٴ اولی روح ما سواه فداه فرموده و مقصود آن جمال الهی آنکه مباد در حین ظهور اهل بیان بمثل اهل فرقان باحادیث و آیات تمسّک جویند و بمظهر و موجد و منزل آن اعتراض نمایند

Va īnke dhekr shode ke dar ḥīn-e ẓohūr nāẓer be-kalamāt va eshārāt va dalālāt va asmāʾ va ṣefāt nashavīd īn ḥokmī ast ke khod-e Noqṭe-ye Ūlā rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu farmūde va maqṣūd-e ān Jamāl-e Elāhī ānke mabād dar ḥīn-e ẓohūr ahl-e Bayān be-methl-e ahl-e Forqān be-aḥādīth va āyāt tamassok jūyand va be-maẓhar va mūjed va monzel-e ān eʿterāż namāyand.

As for the statement that, at the time of the Revelation, you should not look to words, allusions, indications, names, and attributes: this is a command given by the Primal Point Himself—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him. The intention of that divine Beauty was that, at the time of the Revelation, the people of the Bayān should not, like the people of the Qurʾān, cling to traditions and verses and object to the One who manifests them, brings them into being, and reveals them.

253

باری اگر قدری در این ظهور ابدع امنع تفکّر نمائید بر اسرار لایحصی مطّلع شوید و مشاهده نمائید که از اوّل ابداع تا حین چنین ظهوری ظاهر نشده اگرچه نظر بعدم استعداد عباد اسباب منع هم موجود لیفصل به الجوهر عن العرض و الرّوح عن الطّین

Bārī agar qadrī dar īn ẓohūr-e abdaʿ-e amnaʿ tafakkor namāyīd bar asrār-e lā yoḥṣā moṭṭaleʿ shavīd va moshāhede namāyīd ke az avval-e ebdāʿ tā ḥīn chenīn ẓohūrī ẓāher nashode agarche naẓar be-ʿadam-e esteʿdād-e ʿebād asbāb-e manʿ ham mowjūd li-yafṣila bihi al-jawhar ʿan al-ʿaraḍ wa-l-rūḥ ʿan al-ṭīn.

In short, if you reflect a little on this most wondrous, most exalted Revelation, you will become acquainted with countless mysteries and see that, from the beginning of creation until now, no such Revelation has appeared. Yet, in view of the servants’ lack of readiness, obstacles are also present, so that through this He may separate the substance from the accident and the spirit from the clay.

254

تاللّه الحقّ الیوم اگر ذرّه‌ئی از جوهر در صدهزار من سنگ مخلوط باشد و در خلف سبعة ابحر مستور هرآینه دست قدرت الهی او را ظاهر فرماید و آن ذرّهٴ جوهر را از او فصل نماید ای قوم نسمة اللّه در هبوب است و روح اللّه در اهتزاز و جذب اللّه از افق مشرق جمال رحمن طالع

Ta-llāh al-Ḥaqq, al-yawm agar dharre-ī az jowhar dar ṣad-hezār man sang makhlūṭ bāshad va dar khalf-e sabʿat abḥur mastūr har-āyene dast-e qodrat-e Elāhī ū rā ẓāher farmāyad va ān dharre-ye jowhar rā az ū faṣl namāyad. Ey qowm nasmat Allāh dar hobūb ast va rūḥ Allāh dar eht ezāz va jadhb Allāh az ofoq-e mashreq-e Jamāl-e Raḥmān ṭāleʿ.

By God, the True One! Today, if a particle of a gem were mixed with a hundred thousand maunds of stone and concealed beyond seven seas, the hand of divine power would assuredly bring it to light and separate that particle of the gem from the stone. O people, the breeze of God is blowing, the Spirit of God is stirring, and the attraction of God is dawning from the horizon of the dayspring of the Beauty of the All-Merciful.

255

سر از نوم نفس و هوی بردارید و مشاهده کنید که چه ظاهر شده در ابداع زینهار گوش بمزخرفات قوم مدهید چه که الیوم اگر سمع طاهر یافت شود میشنود از این طایفه آنچه از اهل فرقان می‌شنید و آنچه از اهل توریة و انجیل استماع مینمود و من‌دون اقوال بلکه همان افعال را بعینه ببصر ظاهر و باطن مشاهده مینماید

Sar az nowm-e nafs va havā bardārīd va moshāhede konīd ke che ẓāher shode dar ebdāʿ. Zīnhār gūsh be-mozakhrafāt-e qowm madahīd che ke al-yawm agar samʿ-e ṭāher yāft shavad mīshenavad az īn ṭāyefe ānche az ahl-e Forqān mīshenīd va ānche az ahl-e Towrāt va Enjīl estemāʿ mīnamūd va men-dūn-e aqvāl balke hamān afʿāl rā be-ʿayneh be-baṣar-e ẓāher va bāṭen moshāhede mīnamāyad.

Raise your heads from the sleep of self and desire, and behold what has appeared in creation. Beware of lending an ear to the people’s idle words, for today, if a pure ear is found, it will hear from this group what it used to hear from the people of the Qurʾān and what it heard from the people of the Torah and the Gospel. Indeed, beyond words, it will witness with both outward and inward sight the very same deeds.

256

چنانچه الیوم کسی که بنفس حقّ محاربه نموده و استکبر علی من خلقه در کلماتش مذکور داشته که اگر حقّ ظاهر شود چه از اهل بیان و چه غیر آن چه عبد و چه حرّ چه سیاه و چه سفید این عبد مطیع است حرفی ندارم حال ملاحظه نمائید که این سخن را در وقتی میگوید که در همان حین بمحاربه با جمال اللّه مشغول است و در کمال اعراض معرض حال شما تفکّر کنید و ملاحظه نمائید که حجّت حقّ چه بوده و علامت ظهور حقّ چه

Chenānche al-yawm kasī ke be-nafs-e Ḥaqq moḥārebe namūde wa istakbara ʿalā man khalaqahu dar kalamātash madhkūr dāshte ke agar Ḥaqq ẓāher shavad che az ahl-e Bayān va che gheyr-e ān che ʿabd va che ḥorr che sīyāh va che sefīd īn ʿabd moṭīʿ ast ḥarfī nadāram. Ḥāl molāḥeẓe namāyīd ke īn sokhan rā dar vaqtī mīgūyad ke dar hamān ḥīn be-moḥārebe bā Jamāl Allāh mashghūl ast va dar kamāl-e eʿrāż moʿreż. Ḥāl shomā tafakkor konīd va molāḥeẓe namāyīd ke ḥojjat-e Ḥaqq che būde va ʿalāmat-e ẓohūr-e Ḥaqq che.

Thus today, the one who has waged war against the True One Himself and arrogantly defied Him who created him has stated in his writings: “If the True One appears, whether from among the people of the Bayān or others, whether slave or free, black or white, this servant is obedient; I have no objection.” Now consider that he says this at the very time he is engaged in warfare against the Beauty of God and has turned away in utter rejection. Now reflect and consider what the proof of the True One has been and what the sign of His appearance is.

257

این ظهور باین مشهودی که انوارش عالم را احاطه نموده از آن معرض و بر قتلش ایستاده و بعد باین کلمات مشغول شده لأجل توهّم ناس مثل اوّل ظهور که علمای فرقان سبحه‌ها بر دست و در کمال خضوع و خشوع در معابد بعبادت مشغول و بشأنی اظهار زهد مینمودند که چون اسم حقّ مذکور میشد برمیخاستند و بکمال خضوع تواضع مینمودند و در همان حین تواضع و خضوع بر قتلش فتوی میدادند و حکم دون ایمان در حقّش جاری مینمودند و بزبان متکلّم که چگونه میشود ما معرض از حقّ باشیم و حال آنکه شبها آمل بوده‌ایم و روزها از حقّ سائلیم هر وقت ظاهر شود مطیعیم و منقاد

Īn ẓohūr be-īn mashhūdī ke anvārash ʿālam rā eḥāṭe namūde az ān moʿreż va bar qatl ash īstāde va baʿd be-īn kalamāt mashghūl shode li-ajl-e tavahhom-e nās methl-e avval-e ẓohūr ke ʿolamā-ye Forqān sobḥe-hā bar dast va dar kamāl-e khożūʿ va khoshūʿ dar maʿābed be-ʿebādat mashghūl va be-shaʾnī eẓhār-e zohd mīnamūdand ke chon esm-e Ḥaqq madhkūr mīshod barmīkhāstand va be-kamāl-e khożūʿ tavāżoʿ mīnamūdand va dar hamān ḥīn-e tavāżoʿ va khożūʿ bar qatl ash fatvā mīdādand va ḥokm-e dūn-e īmān dar ḥaqqash jārī mīnamūdand va be-zabān motakallem ke chegūne mīshavad mā moʿreż az Ḥaqq bāshīm va ḥāl ānke shab-hā āmel būde-īm va rūz-hā az Ḥaqq sāʾelīm har vaqt ẓāher shavad moṭīʿīm va monqād.

He turns away from this Revelation, so plainly manifest that its light has encompassed the world, and has risen to put Him to death; then he occupies himself with these words to delude the people. It was the same at the beginning of the Revelation, when the divines of the Qurʾān, prayer beads in hand, were occupied with worship in their temples in the utmost humility and reverence. They made such a display of piety that, whenever the name of the True One was mentioned, they would rise and bow with the utmost humility. Yet in that very state of humility and submission, they issued decrees for His death and pronounced Him an unbeliever, while saying: “How could we turn away from the True One, when by night we have awaited Him with hope and by day we beseech Him? Whenever He appears, we are obedient and submissive.”

258

حال معرض باللّه فواللّه الّذی لا اله الّا هو رأس مظهر نفس حقّ را بسکّین بغی و فحشا و سیف غلّ و بغضا قطع مینماید و در آن حین با گردن خاضع باین کلمه ناطق که حقّ هر وقت ظاهر شود من مطیعم

Ḥāl moʿreż bi-llāh fa-wa-llāh alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa raʾs-e maẓhar-e nafs-e Ḥaqq rā be-sekkīn-e baghy va faḥshā va seyf-e ghell va baghżā qaṭʿ mīnamāyad va dar ān ḥīn bā gardan-e khāżeʿ be-īn kalame nāṭeq ke Ḥaqq har vaqt ẓāher shavad man moṭīʿam.

Now the one who turns away from God—by God, besides whom there is no other god—severs the head of the Manifestation of the True One Himself with the knife of iniquity and indecency and the sword of malice and hatred, while at that very moment, with bowed head, he utters these words: “Whenever the True One appears, I am obedient.”

259

فواللّه یا قوم شما را نابالغ یافته که باینگونه هذیانات تکلّم مینماید و اینقدر شما را متوهّم یافته که حقّی که بجمیع ظهورات ظاهر شده فتوی بر قتلش داده و در کلّ حین بمحاربه با جمالش مشغول و مع‌ذلک باین اقوال تکلّم نموده حسرةً و اسفاً علیکم بما غفلتم عن الّذی کان اظهر من کلّ ظهور و اشتغلتم بالّذی فواللّه لو کنتم مطّلعاً علیه لفررتم منه الف منازل

Fa-wa-llāh yā qawm shomā rā nābālegh yāfte ke be-īngūne hadhayānāt takallom mīnamāyad va īnqadr shomā rā motavahhem yāfte ke Ḥaqqī ke be-jamīʿ-e ẓohūrāt ẓāher shode fatvā bar qatl ash dāde va dar koll-e ḥīn be-moḥārebe bā jamālash mashghūl va maʿa-dhālek be-īn aqvāl takallom namūde. Ḥasratan wa asafan ʿalaykum bi-mā ghafaltum ʿan alladhī kāna aẓhar min kull ẓuhūr wa ishtaghaltum bi-alladhī fa-wa-llāh law kuntum muṭṭaliʿan ʿalayhi la-farartum minhu alf manāzil.

By God, O people, he has found you immature, and so he speaks such nonsense. He has found you so deluded that he has decreed the death of the True One who has appeared with every manifestation, and is at all times engaged in warfare against His Beauty, yet still speaks these words. Alas, and woe to you, that you have remained heedless of Him who is more manifest than every manifestation and have occupied yourselves with one from whom—by God—if you knew him, you would flee a thousand stages.

260

و نسأل اللّه بأن یفصل بینی و بینه و یطهّر ارض الّتی اکون علیها عن رجس هؤلآء الفاسقین او یسکننی فی دیار اخری و انّه لذو فضل علی العباد و انّه لعلی کلّ شیء قدیر

Wa nasʾal Allāh bi-an yafṣila baynī wa baynahu wa yuṭahhira arḍ allatī akūnu ʿalayhā ʿan rijs hāʾulāʾ al-fāsiqīn aw yuskinanī fī diyār ukhrā wa innahu la-dhū faḍl ʿalā al-ʿibād wa innahu la-ʿalā kull shayʾ qadīr.

And We ask God to separate Me from him and to cleanse the land on which I dwell of the defilement of these transgressors, or to settle Me in another land. He is indeed bountiful to His servants, and He has power over all things.

261

بگو ای جاهل نفس محبوب ظاهر است و چون شمس لایح و تو بعرفان او الیوم فایز نشده بلکه او را با جمیع حجج و براهین که عالم را احاطه نموده از اهل ایمان نمیشمری مع‌ذلک بکلماتش تمسّک جسته اراده نموده که ریاستی برای نفس خود ثابت کنی تاللّه الحقّ اذاً یکذّبکم کلّ الأشیآء ولکن انتم لا تشعرون مثل شما عنداللّه مثل اهل فرقان است که بقول رسول ریاست خود را ثابت نموده‌اند و بر اعراش عزّت و حکم جالس و بنفس او وارد آورده‌اند آنچه را که هیچ بصری در ابداع ندیده و ادراک ننموده ای مست خمر نفس و هوی از سلطان معلوم چشم پوشیده و بموهوم خود تمسّک جسته همین ذلّت تو را کافی است که انکار نموده آیاتی را که بآن دینت ثابت شده و باو افتخار مینمائی و از برای خود شأن ثابت میکنی

Begū ey jāhel nafs-e Maḥbūb ẓāher ast va chon shams lāyeḥ va to be-ʿerfān-e ū al-yawm fāyez nashode balke ū rā bā jamīʿ-e ḥojaj va barāhīn ke ʿālam rā eḥāṭe namūde az ahl-e īmān nemīshomorī maʿa-dhālek be-kalamātash tamassok joste erāde namūde ke rīyāsatī barā-ye nafs-e khod thābet konī. Ta-llāh al-Ḥaqq idhan yukadhdhibukum kull al-ashyāʾ wa lākin antum lā tashʿurūn. Methl-e shomā ʿenda-llāh methl-e ahl-e Forqān ast ke be-qowl-e Rasūl rīyāsat-e khod rā thābet namūde-and va bar aʿrāsh-e ʿezzat va ḥokm jāles va be-nafs-e ū vāred āvarde-and ānche rā ke hīch baṣarī dar ebdāʿ nadīde va edrāk nanamūde. Ey mast-e khamr-e nafs va havā az Solṭān-e maʿlūm chashm pūshīde va be-mowhūm-e khod tamassok joste hamīn dhellat to rā kāfī ast ke enkār namūde āyātī rā ke be-ān dīnat thābet shode va be-ū eftekhār mīnamāʾī va az barā-ye khod shaʾn thābet mīkonī.

Say: O ignorant one, the Beloved Himself is manifest and shines like the sun, yet today you have not attained recognition of Him. Rather, despite all the proofs and testimonies that have encompassed the world, you do not count Him among the faithful. Nevertheless, you cling to His words, seeking to establish leadership for yourself. By God, the True One, all things then declare you false, but you do not perceive it. In God’s sight, you are like the people of the Qurʾān, who have established their leadership through the words of the Messenger and sit upon thrones of honor and authority, yet have inflicted on His very person what no eye in creation has ever seen or perceived. O you who are drunk with the wine of self and desire! You have turned your eyes from the manifest Sovereign and clung to your own imagined one. This abasement alone is enough for you: you have denied the verses by which your religion was established, in which you take pride, and through which you claim a station for yourself.

262

و مع‌ذلک شاعر نیستی اذاً لم یکن لک شأن عند اللّه الّا کشأن الّذینهم اعرضوا بعدما آمنوا و انکروا بعد الّذی اعترفوا ان انت من العارفین تاللّه الحقّ عرّ روح الأمین رأسه عن فعلک و انّک ما استشعرت بذلک و کنت من الغافلین و جلسن حوریّات الغرفات علی الرّماد من ظلمک و انّک تکون فی نفسک من الفرحین

Va maʿa-dhālek shāʿer nīstī. Idhan lam yakun laka shaʾn ʿinda Allāh illā ka-shaʾn alladhīna-hum aʿraḍū baʿdamā āmanū wa ankarū baʿda alladhī iʿtarafū in anta min al-ʿārifīn. Ta-llāh al-Ḥaqq ʿarra Rūḥ al-Amīn raʾsahu ʿan fiʿlika wa innaka mā istashʿarta bi-dhālika wa kunta min al-ghāfilīn wa jalasna ḥūriyyāt al-ghurafāt ʿalā al-ramād min ẓulmika wa innaka takūnu fī nafsika min al-fariḥīn.

Yet you remain unaware. Thus your station in God’s sight is no different from that of those who turned away after believing and denied after acknowledging, if you are among those who understand. By God, the True One, the Faithful Spirit has bared His head because of your deed, yet you have not perceived it and remain among the heedless. The maidens of the heavenly chambers have sat upon ashes because of your injustice, while within yourself you rejoice.

263

تاللّه الحقّ ینوح کلّ شیء فی نفسه و یبکی ولکن انّک غفلت و کنت من المعرضین و انت الّذی تذکر المحبوب بلسانک لتشتبه علی النّاس و تقتل محبوب الأوّلین و الآخرین لو یفتح اللّه بصرک لتشهد بأنّ بظلمک قد علّق المحبوب فی الهوآء و ترمیه فی کلّ حین برمی الحسد و البغضآء ثمّ بسهام الغلّ و العناد ثمّ برصاص الاعراض و کان اللّه علی ذلک لشهید و علیم

Ta-llāh al-Ḥaqq yanūḥu kull shayʾ fī nafsihi wa yabkī wa lākin innaka ghafalta wa kunta min al-muʿriḍīn wa anta alladhī tadhkuru al-Maḥbūb bi-lisānika li-tashtabiha ʿalā al-nās wa taqtulu Maḥbūb al-awwalīn wa-l-ākhirīn. Law yaftaḥ Allāh baṣaraka la-tashhada bi-anna bi-ẓulmika qad ʿulliqa al-Maḥbūb fī al-hawāʾ wa tarmīhi fī kull ḥīn bi-ramy al-ḥasad wa-l-baghḍāʾ thumma bi-sihām al-ghill wa-l-ʿinād thumma bi-raṣāṣ al-iʿrāḍ wa kāna Allāh ʿalā dhālika la-shahīd wa ʿalīm.

By God, the True One, everything laments and weeps within itself, but you have remained heedless and are among those who turn away. You are the one who mentions the Beloved with your tongue to mislead the people, while killing the Beloved of the first and the last. If God were to open your eyes, you would see that through your injustice the Beloved has been suspended in the air, and that at every moment you assail Him with the projectiles of envy and hatred, then with the arrows of malice and obstinacy, then with the bullets of rejection. God is indeed a witness to this and knows it.

264

اذاً ینوح محمّد فی الأفق الأعلی و یبکی الرّوح فی الرّفیق الأبهی ثمّ الکلیم عند سدرة المنتهی ثمّ عیون النّبیّین و المرسلین ای مست بادهٴ غرور اقلّ من حین بشعور آی در خود و افعال خود تفکّر نما

Idhan yanūḥu Muḥammad fī al-ufuq al-aʿlā wa yabkī al-Rūḥ fī al-rafīq al-abhā thumma al-Kalīm ʿinda Sidrat al-Muntahā thumma ʿuyūn al-nabiyyīn wa-l-mursalīn. Ey mast-e bāde-ye ghorūr aqall-e men ḥīn be-shoʿūr āy dar khod va afʿāl-e khod tafakkor namā.

Thus Muḥammad laments in the highest horizon, and the Spirit weeps in the all-glorious company, as does Moses beside the Lote Tree beyond which none may pass, and the eyes of the Prophets and Messengers shed tears. O you who are drunk with the wine of pride! Come to your senses for less than a moment; reflect on yourself and your deeds.

265

گیرم بر این گروه نابالغ امر اللّه را مشتبه نمودی و جمیع هم تو را من دون اللّه ساجد شدند چه نفعی برای تو حاصل لا فوربّ العالمین جز خسران دنیا و آخرت حاصلی نداشته و ندارد و اگر الیوم بر سریر یاقوت جالس شوی عنداللّه بر ارض هاویه ساکنی

Gīram bar īn gorūh-e nābālegh Amr Allāh rā moshtabeh namūdī va jamīʿ ham to rā min dūn Allāh sājed shodand che nafʿī barā-ye to ḥāṣel? Lā fa-wa-Rabb al-ʿālamīn joz khosrān-e donyā va ākherat ḥāṣelī nadāshte va nadārad va agar al-yawm bar sarīr-e yāqūt jāles shavī ʿenda-llāh bar arż-e Hāvīye sākenī.

Suppose you have obscured the Cause of God for this immature group, and all of them have bowed down to you instead of God. What benefit do you gain? No, by the Lord of the worlds! It has yielded and yields nothing but loss in this world and the next. Even if today you sit upon a throne of ruby, in God’s sight you dwell on the ground of the abyss.

266

فواللّه اگر بسمع فطرت استماع نمائی میشنوی که همان ارضی که بر او جالسی پناه میبرد بخدا از تو و میگوید ای غافل بچه حجّت و دلیل حقّ خود را ثابت مینمائی و حقّ من له الحقّ و به حقّق الحقّ را انکار میکنی فأفّ علیک و علی الّذینهم اتّخذوک لأنفسهم من دون اللّه حبیب بحقّ موقن نشدی دیگر چرا بر قتلش قیام نمودی

Fa-wa-llāh agar be-samʿ-e feṭrat estemāʿ namāʾī mīshenavī ke hamān arżī ke bar ū jālesī panāh mībarad be-Khodā az to va mīgūyad ey ghāfel be-che ḥojjat va dalīl ḥaqq-e khod rā thābet mīnamāʾī va ḥaqq-e man lahu al-ḥaqq wa bihi ḥuqqiqa al-ḥaqq rā enkār mīkonī? Fa-uff ʿalayka wa ʿalā alladhīna-hum ittakhadhūka li-anfusihim min dūn Allāh ḥabīb. Be-Ḥaqq mūqen nashodī dīgar cherā bar qatl ash qīyām namūdī?

By God, if you listen with the ear of your inborn nature, you will hear the very ground on which you sit seeking refuge in God from you and saying: “O heedless one, by what proof and evidence do you establish your own right while denying the right of Him to whom all right belongs and through whom truth has been established? Shame on you and on those who have taken you as their beloved instead of God!” You did not become certain of the True One; why, then, did you rise to put Him to death?

267

آخر بیست سنه در حفظ تو سعی نمود مع آنکه عالم بوده بما فی قلبک و اگر آنی اراده میفرمود موجود نبودی مع‌ذلک متنبّه نشدی و باطراف عالم فعل خود را بحقّ نسبت داده تاللّه نیست در این قلب مگر انوار تجلّیات فجر بقا و بر ضرّ نفسی راضی نه ان

Ākhar bīst sane dar ḥefẓ-e to saʿy namūd maʿ-e ānke ʿālem būde bi-mā fī qalbika va agar ānī erāde mīfarmūd mowjūd nabūdī maʿa-dhālek motanabbeh nashodī va be-aṭrāf-e ʿālam feʿl-e khod rā be-Ḥaqq nesbat dāde. Ta-llāh nīst dar īn qalb magar anvār-e tajallīyāt-e fajr-e baqā va bar żorr-e nafsī rāżī na [corrupted text]

After all, for twenty years He strove to protect you, although He knew what was in your heart. Had He so willed for an instant, you would not have existed. Yet you did not take heed, and throughout the world you have attributed your own deed to the True One. By God, nothing is in this heart but the lights of the effulgences of the dawn of eternity, and it is not willing that any soul should suffer harm [corrupted original text]

268

یا اخی اسمع ندآء هذا الّذی وقع من ظلمک فی هذا البئر الّذی لم یکن لها من قعر و کان قمیصه مرشوشاً بدم صادق من غلّک و فی قعر البئر ینادی و یقول یا اخی لا تفعل بأخیک کما فعل ابن آدم بأخیه یا اخی اتّق اللّه و لا تجادل بآیاتی و لا تحارب بنفسی و لا تقتل الّذی جعل صدره محلّاً لسیف الأعدآء لئلّا یرد علیک من ضرّ و کان ان یحفظک فی کلّ اللّیالی و الأیّام و فی کلّ بکور و اصیل

Yā akhī ismaʿ nidāʾ hādhā alladhī waqaʿa min ẓulmika fī hādhā al-biʾr alladhī lam yakun lahā min qaʿr wa kāna qamīṣuhu marshūshan bi-dam ṣādiq min ghillika wa fī qaʿr al-biʾr yunādī wa yaqūlu yā akhī lā tafʿal bi-akhīka ka-mā faʿala Ibn Ādam bi-akhīhi. Yā akhī ittaqi Allāh wa lā tujādil bi-āyātī wa lā tuḥārib bi-nafsī wa lā taqtul alladhī jaʿala ṣadrahu maḥallan li-sayf al-aʿdāʾ li-allā yarida ʿalayka min ḍurr wa kāna an yaḥfaẓaka fī kull al-layālī wa-l-ayyām wa fī kull bukūr wa aṣīl.

O My brother, hear the call of this One who, through your injustice, has fallen into this bottomless well, whose shirt has been spattered with true blood through your malice. From the depths of the well He calls out and says: “O My brother, do not do to your brother what the son of Adam did to his brother. O My brother, fear God. Do not dispute My verses, do not wage war against My person, and do not kill the One who made His breast a target for the swords of His enemies so that no harm might come to you, and who protected you through every night and day, every morning and evening.”

269

یا اخی تاللّه الحقّ ما انطق عن الهوی ان هذا الّا وحی یوحی علّمنی شدید الرّوح عند سدرة المنتهی تاللّه یا اخی ان هی من تلقآء نفسی بل من لدن عزیز حکیم کلّما اقبلت الیک لئلّا تحدث من فتنة یفتننّ بها العباد حفظاً لأمر ربّک تاللّه رمیت نحوی رمی الشّقاق و کلّما تقرّبت بک لعلّ تسکن بذلک نفسک قمت علیّ بالنّفاق و یشهد بذلک ارکانک ان انت من المنکرین

Yā akhī, ta-Allāhi al-Ḥaqqi mā anṭiqu ʿani al-hawā. In hādhā illā waḥyun yūḥā. ʿAllamanī shadīdu al-rūḥi ʿinda sidrati al-muntahā. Ta-Allāhi yā akhī, in hiya min tilqāʾi nafsī bal min ladun ʿazīzin ḥakīm. Kullamā aqbaltu ilayka li-allā tuḥditha min fitnatin yuftananna bihā al-ʿibādu ḥifẓan li-amri rabbika, ta-Allāhi ramayta naḥwī ramya al-shiqāq. Wa-kullamā taqarrabtu bika laʿalla taskuna bi-dhālika nafsuka qumta ʿalayya bi-al-nifāq. Wa-yashhadu bi-dhālika arkānuka in anta mina al-munkirīn.

O My brother, by God, the True One, I do not speak from desire. This is nothing but revelation revealed. One mighty in spirit taught Me at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary. By God, O My brother, it is not of My own devising, but comes from One who is Almighty, All-Wise. Whenever I turned toward you to prevent you from stirring up a turmoil by which the servants would be put to the test, and to safeguard the Cause of your Lord, by God, you hurled the shafts of discord at Me. And whenever I drew near to you so that your soul might thereby find peace, you rose against Me in hypocrisy. Your own limbs bear witness to this, if you should deny it.

270

تاللّه یا اخی کلّما کنت صامتاً عن بدایع ذکر ربّی روح القدس قامنی علی امره و روح الأعظم ایقظنی عن رقدی و انطقنی بالحقّ بین السّموات و الأرضین ان کان هذا ذنبی فلست انا اوّل من اذنب فقد ارتکب ذلک الّذینهم کانوا من قبلی ثمّ الّذی سمّی بعلیّ فی ملکوت الأسمآء ثمّ بمحمّد فی جبروت القصوی ثمّ بابنی فی الملإ الأعلی ثمّ بالکلیم فی هذا السّینآء المقدّس المبارک العزیز الرّفیع

Ta-Allāhi yā akhī, kullamā kuntu ṣāmitan ʿan badāʾiʿi dhikri rabbī, rūḥu al-qudusi qāmanī ʿalā amrihi wa-rūḥu al-aʿẓami ayqaẓanī ʿan raqdī wa-anṭaqanī bi-al-ḥaqqi bayna al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn. In kāna hādhā dhanbī fa-lastu anā awwala man adhnaba, fa-qad irtakaba dhālika alladhīnahum kānū min qablī, thumma alladhī summiya bi-ʿAliyyin fī malakūti al-asmāʾi thumma bi-Muḥammadin fī jabarūti al-quṣwā thumma bi-ibnī fī al-malaʾi al-aʿlā thumma bi-al-Kalīmi fī hādhā al-Sīnāʾi al-muqaddasi al-mubāraki al-ʿazīzi al-rafīʿ.

By God, O My brother, whenever I remained silent about the wonders of the remembrance of My Lord, the Holy Spirit raised Me up for His Cause, and the Most Great Spirit awakened Me from My slumber and made Me speak the truth between the heavens and the earths. If this is My sin, I am not the first to have sinned: those who came before Me committed it, as did the One who was named ʿAlī in the kingdom of names, then Muḥammad in the uttermost dominion, then My Son in the Concourse on High, then the One who conversed with God upon this holy, blessed, mighty, exalted Sinai.

271

یا اخی فانظر فی کتب النّبیّین و المرسلین ثمّ ما فی ایادیهم من حجج اللّه و برهانه و دلائله و آثاره و ظهوراته و آیاته ثمّ انصف فی اخیک و لا تکن من الّذینهم ظلموا نفس اللّه ثمّ استظلموا لیدخلوا الشّکّ و الرّیب فی قلوب المؤمنین

Yā akhī, fa-unẓur fī kutubi al-nabiyyīna wa-al-mursalīn, thumma mā fī ayādīhim min ḥujaji Allāhi wa-burhānihi wa-dalāʾilihi wa-āthārihi wa-ẓuhūrātihi wa-āyātihi, thumma anṣif fī akhīka wa-lā takun mina alladhīnahum ẓalamū nafsa Allāhi thumma istaẓlamū li-yudkhilū al-shakka wa-al-rayba fī qulūbi al-muʾminīn.

O My brother, look into the books of the Prophets and Messengers, and then into the proofs of God, His testimony, His evidences, His traces, His manifestations, and His signs that are in their hands. Then judge your brother fairly, and do not be among those who wronged the very Self of God and then claimed to have been wronged, so as to instill doubt and misgiving in the hearts of the believers.

272

تاللّه لمّا عرف اخیک بأنّک قمت علیه و لن تسکن نار الحسد فی صدرک خرج بنفسه و اهله وحده و دخل بیتاً اخری و غلق علی وجهه باب الدّخول و الخروج و کان فیه لمن السّاکنین و مع ذلک انّک یا اخی ما سکنت فی نفسک و کتبت ما کتبت و ارسلت ما ارسلت تاللّه انّ القلم یستحیی لیجری علی ما ذکرت و بما افتریت علی اخیک تاللّه بذلک ضیّعت حرمتی و حرمة اللّه بین العباد فسوف تشهد و تری و ان تکون حینئذ لمن الغافلین

Ta-Allāhi lammā ʿarafa akhūka bi-annaka qumta ʿalayhi wa-lan taskuna nāru al-ḥasadi fī ṣadrika kharaja bi-nafsihi wa-ahlihi waḥdahu wa-dakhala baytan ukhrā wa-ghalaqa ʿalā wajhihi bāba al-dukhūli wa-al-khurūji wa-kāna fīhi la-mina al-sākinīn. Wa-maʿa dhālika innaka yā akhī mā sakanta fī nafsika wa-katabta mā katabta wa-arsalta mā arsalta. Ta-Allāhi inna al-qalama yastaḥyī li-yajriya ʿalā mā dhakarta wa-bi-mā iftarayta ʿalā akhīka. Ta-Allāhi bi-dhālika ḍayyaʿta ḥurmatī wa-ḥurmata Allāhi bayna al-ʿibādi fa-sawfa tashhadu wa-tarā wa-in takūna ḥīnaʾidhin la-mina al-ghāfilīn.

By God, when your brother realized that you had risen against Him and that the fire of envy in your breast would not subside, He left on His own with His family, entered another house, shut its door against His own coming and going, and remained there. Yet even then, O My brother, you found no peace within yourself: you wrote what you wrote and sent what you sent. By God, the Pen is ashamed to set down what you have said and the accusations you have fabricated against your brother. By God, through this you have violated My honor and the honor of God among His servants. You will soon witness and see, even though you are now among the heedless.

273

اذاً قم عن رقد نفسک و هواک و قصّ شارب الحسد و قلّم اظفار البغضآء ثمّ تطیّب من طیب الوفآء ثمّ غسّل بمیاه القدس و ضع وجهک علی التّراب بخضوع و خشوع و انابة و رجوع

Idhan qum ʿan raqdi nafsika wa-hawāka wa-quṣṣ shāriba al-ḥasadi wa-qallim aẓfāra al-baghḍāʾi thumma taṭayyab min ṭībi al-wafāʾi thumma ghassil bi-miyāhi al-qudsi wa-ḍaʿ wajhaka ʿalā al-turābi bi-khuḍūʿin wa-khushūʿin wa-inābatin wa-rujūʿ.

Rise, then, from the slumber of self and desire, trim the mustache of envy, and clip the nails of hatred. Then perfume yourself with the fragrance of faithfulness, wash with the waters of holiness, and lay your face upon the dust in submission, humility, repentance, and return.

274

محبوب و قل ای ربّ انا الّذی فرّطت فی جنب اخی فی مذ اللّیالی و الأیّام و کنت غافلاً عن بدایع ذکرک الحکیم اذاً یا الهی فارفع الحجاب عن بصری لأعرف نفسک و اقوم بثنائک و انقطع عمّا سواک و اقبل الی وجهک الکریم ثمّ اجعلنی من عبادک الّذین جعلت لهم مقعد صدق عندک ثمّ ارزقنی من تسنیم عنایتک و کوثر افضالک

Maḥbūb. Wa-qul ay rabbi anā alladhī farraṭtu fī janbi akhī fī mudh al-layālī wa-al-ayyāmi wa-kuntu ghāfilan ʿan badāʾiʿi dhikrika al-ḥakīm. Idhan yā ilāhī fa-irfaʿ al-ḥijāba ʿan baṣarī li-aʿrifa nafsaka wa-aqūma bi-thanāʾika wa-anqaṭiʿa ʿammā siwāka wa-uqbila ilā wajhika al-karīm. Thumma ijʿalnī min ʿibādika alladhīna jaʿalta lahum maqʿada ṣidqin ʿindaka thumma urzuqnī min tasnīmi ʿināyatika wa-kawthari afḍālika.

Beloved. And say: “O Lord, I am the one who failed in my duty toward my brother throughout the nights and days and was heedless of the wonders of Your wise remembrance. Now, O my God, lift the veil from my sight, so that I may recognize Your Self, arise to praise You, detach myself from everything but You, and turn toward Your generous face. Then make me one of those servants of Yours for whom You have appointed a seat of truth in Your presence, and grant me sustenance from the heavenly spring of Your care and the river of Your bounty.

275

ثمّ الحقنی بعبادک المخلصین الّذین ما التفتوا بالدّنیا و لا بریاساتها و لا بما فیها و علیها و انقطعوا بأنفسهم و اموالهم فی سبیل بارئهم و کانوا من المنقطعین ای ربّ لا تدعنی بنفسی ثمّ خذ یدی بید قدرتک ثمّ انقذنی من غمرات النّفس و الهوی و لهیبها و اشتعالها ثمّ اجعل تلک النّار علیّ برداً و سلاماً و روحاً و ریحاناً ثمّ اکتبنی من عبادک المنقطعین

Thumma alḥiqnī bi-ʿibādika al-mukhliṣīna alladhīna mā iltafatū bi-al-dunyā wa-lā bi-riyāsātihā wa-lā bi-mā fīhā wa-ʿalayhā wa-inqaṭaʿū bi-anfusihim wa-amwālihim fī sabīli bāriʾihim wa-kānū mina al-munqaṭiʿīn. Ay rabbi lā tadaʿnī bi-nafsī thumma khudh yadī bi-yadi qudratika thumma anqidhني min ghamarāti al-nafsi wa-al-hawā wa-lahībihā wa-ishtiʿālihā thumma ijʿal tilka al-nāra ʿalayya bardan wa-salāman wa-rūḥan wa-rayḥānan thumma uktubnī min ʿibādika al-munqaṭiʿīn.

Then join me to Your sincere servants, who paid no heed to the world, its positions of authority, or anything within it or upon it, who detached themselves and their possessions in the path of their Maker and were among the detached. O Lord, do not leave me to myself. Take my hand in the hand of Your power, and rescue me from the engulfing depths of self and desire, their blaze and their burning. Then make that fire coolness and peace for me, and a spirit of life and sweet fragrance, and number me among Your detached servants.

276

ای ربّ وفّقنی لخدمتک و تبلیغ آیاتک ثمّ اجعلنی ناصراً لأمرک و حافظاً لدینک و ناطقاً بثنائک و معلناً بدایع افضالک و اکرامک و انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و انّک انت العزیز الکریم ای ربّ لا تخیّب من تمسّک بحبل عنایتک و لا تطرد من علّق سبّابة الرّجآء علی حبل جودک و افضالک

Ay rabbi waffiqnī li-khidmatika wa-tablīghi āyātika thumma ijʿalnī nāṣiran li-amrika wa-ḥāfiẓan li-dīnika wa-nāṭiqan bi-thanāʾika wa-muʿlinan badāʾiʿa afḍālika wa-ikrāmika wa-innaka anta al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾu wa-innaka anta al-ʿazīzu al-karīm. Ay rabbi lā tukhayyib man tamassaka bi-ḥabli ʿināyatika wa-lā taṭrud man ʿallaqa sabbābata al-rajāʾi ʿalā ḥabli jūdika wa-afḍālika.

O Lord, enable me to serve You and convey Your verses. Make me a helper of Your Cause, a guardian of Your religion, one who voices Your praise and proclaims the wonders of Your bounty and generosity. You indeed have power over whatever You will, and You are the Almighty, the Generous. O Lord, do not disappoint anyone who has grasped the cord of Your care, and do not drive away anyone who has hooked the finger of hope upon the cord of Your generosity and bounty.

277

ای ربّ لا تحتجبنی عن منبع رضاک ثمّ ارضنی بالاقرار بما رضیته و نزّلته عن غمام فضلک و سحاب عزّ مکرمتک و انت المعطی فی کلّ الأحوال و انّک انت الغفور الرّحیم ای ربّ لا تعرّ جسدی عن قمیص الانصاف و لا قلبی عن برد الاعتراف بنفسک الرّحمن الرّحیم

Ay rabbi lā taḥtajibnī ʿan manbaʿi riḍāka thumma arḍinī bi-al-iqrāri bi-mā raḍītahu wa-nazzaltahu ʿan ghamāmi faḍlika wa-saḥābi ʿizzi makrumatika wa-anta al-muʿṭī fī kulli al-aḥwāli wa-innaka anta al-ghafūru al-raḥīm. Ay rabbi lā tuʿarri jasadī ʿan qamīṣi al-inṣāfi wa-lā qalbī ʿan burdi al-iʿtirāfi bi-nafsika al-raḥmāni al-raḥīm.

O Lord, do not veil me from the wellspring of Your good pleasure. Make me content to acknowledge what You have approved and sent down from the clouds of Your grace and the clouds of Your glorious generosity. You are the Bestower in every circumstance, and You are the All-Forgiving, the Merciful. O Lord, do not strip my body of the shirt of fairness, or my heart of the robe of acknowledgment of Your Self, the All-Merciful, the Merciful.

278

ای ربّ فاجعل قدمی ثابتاً علی صراطک بحیث لا انکر ما دعوتنی به فی کلّ آیاتک و الواحک و زبرک و کتبک و اسفارک و صحایف قدسک المنیع ای ربّ فاجعلنی ناظراً الی شطر مواهبک و راجعاً الی بحر غفرانک فلا تعرّنی عن جمیل ثنائک و انّک انت القادر علی ما تشآء و انّک انت المقتدر علی ما ترید

Ay rabbi fa-ijʿal qadamī thābitan ʿalā ṣirāṭika bi-ḥaythu lā unkira mā daʿawtanī bihi fī kulli āyātika wa-alwāḥika wa-zuburika wa-kutubika wa-asfārika wa-ṣaḥāyifi qudsika al-manīʿ. Ay rabbi fa-ijʿalnī nāẓiran ilā shaṭri mawāhibika wa-rājiʿan ilā baḥri ghufrānika fa-lā tuʿarrinī ʿan jamīli thanāʾika wa-innaka anta al-qādiru ʿalā mā tashāʾu wa-innaka anta al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā turīd.

O Lord, make my foot firm upon Your path, so that I may not deny that to which You have summoned me in all Your verses, Your tablets, Your scriptures, Your books, Your volumes, and the pages of Your unassailable holiness. O Lord, make me look toward Your gifts and return to the ocean of Your forgiveness. Do not strip me of the beauty of praising You. You indeed have power over whatever You will, and You are mighty to do whatever You desire.

279

و ایّدنی بأن لا انکر ما حقّق به ایمانی و ثبت ذکری و رفع اسمی و بعث کینونتی و ذوّت حقیقتی و کنت من المؤمنین ای ربّ لا تحرم من وقف تلقآء مدین رحمتک و تشبّث بذیل احسانک و فضلک ای ربّ فاجعل لی کلمة من عندک لأکون متذکّراً بها فی العشیّ و الاشراق و فی کلّ حین

Wa-ayyidnī bi-an lā unkira mā ḥuqqiqa bihi īmānī wa-thabata dhikrī wa-rufiʿa ismī wa-buʿithat kaynūnatī wa-dhuwwitat ḥaqīqatī wa-kuntu mina al-muʾminīn. Ay rabbi lā taḥrim man waqafa tilqāʾa madīni raḥmatika wa-tashabbatha bi-dhayli iḥsānika wa-faḍlika. Ay rabbi fa-ijʿal lī kalimatan min ʿindika li-akūna mutadhakkiran bihā fī al-ʿashiyyi wa-al-ishrāqi wa-fī kulli ḥīn.

Strengthen me so that I may not deny that through which my faith was made real, my remembrance established, my name exalted, my being brought to life, and my reality brought into existence, and through which I became one of the believers. O Lord, do not deprive the one who has stood before the city of Your mercy and clung to the hem of Your kindness and grace. O Lord, appoint for me a word from Your presence, so that through it I may remain mindful in the evening, at daybreak, and at every moment.”

280

کذلک تنطقک لسان المظلوم فی قعر الجبّ لعلّ تتّخذ الی شطر الانصاف من سبیل اذاً یخاطب اللّه نسیم قدسه الّذی یهبّ عن شطر العرش و جعله رسولاً من عنده علی العالمین لأنّه لن یجد فی تلک الأیّام من رسول لیرسله الی العباد ببشارات امره و یجعلهم من الذّاکرین و المستبشرین لأنّه وقع فی سجن الّذی انقطعت عنه ایادی المریدین و ارجل القاصدین و من دون السّجن وقع فی بئر الحسد الّذی ما اطّلع بقعره الّا نفسه المحصی العلیم الخبیر کذلک قصّ اللّه من قصص الحقّ بلسانه الصّادق المتکلّم العلیم الأمین

Kadhālika tunṭiquka lisānu al-Maẓlūmi fī qaʿri al-jubbi laʿalla tattakhidha ilā shaṭri al-inṣāfi min sabīl. Idhan yukhāṭibu Allāhu nasīma qudsihi alladhī yahubbu ʿan shaṭri al-ʿarshi wa-jaʿalahu rasūlan min ʿindihi ʿalā al-ʿālamīna li-annahu lan yajida fī tilka al-ayyāmi min rasūlin li-yursilahu ilā al-ʿibādi bi-bishārāti amrihi wa-yajʿalahum mina al-dhākirīna wa-al-mustabshirīna li-annahu waqaʿa fī sijni alladhī inqaṭaʿat ʿanhu ayādī al-murīdīna wa-arjulu al-qāṣidīn. Wa-min dūni al-sijni waqaʿa fī biʾri al-ḥasadi alladhī mā iṭṭalaʿa bi-qaʿrihi illā nafsuhu al-muḥṣī al-ʿalīmu al-khabīr. Kadhālika qaṣṣa Allāhu min qaṣaṣi al-ḥaqqi bi-lisānihi al-ṣādiqi al-mutakallimi al-ʿalīmi al-amīn.

Thus does the tongue of the Wronged One in the depths of the pit give you words to speak, so that you may find a path toward fairness. God now addresses His holy breeze, which blows from the direction of the Throne, and has made it a messenger from His presence to the worlds, for in these days He will find no messenger to send to His servants with the glad tidings of His Cause and to make them among those who remember and rejoice. For He has fallen into a prison beyond the reach of the hands of His devotees and the feet of those who seek Him. Beyond this imprisonment, He has fallen into the well of envy, whose depths none knows but His own Self, the All-Reckoning, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Thus has God recounted a true account through His truthful, speaking, all-knowing, faithful Tongue.

281

ای نسیم صبا چون قاصدی ملاحظه نمیشود تو برایحهٴ قمیص بها از رضوان بقا بر مریدین از احبّایم مرور نما و ببیّنات روح و آیات ظهور جمیع را آگاه کن که شاید بعضی از نفوس از جمیع من علی الأرض و تعلّق بآن پاک و مقدّس شده بفردوس اعظم راجع شوند ولکن ای نسیم بانقطاع تمام مرور نما بشأنی که اگر ضرّ عالمین بر تو وارد شود صابر باشی و اگر نعمت آن بر تو نازل گردد توجّه ننمائی چه که اگر از جهات حسد و بغض و ردّ و قبول و سکون و اضطراب جمیع من علی الأرض مقدّس نشوی قادر بر این تبلیغ منیع و فایز بحمل اسرار ربّانی نگردی کذلک یأمرک لسان ربّک لتکون من العاملین

Ey nasīm-e ṣabā, chūn qāṣedī molāḥeẓe nemī-shavad to be-rāyeḥe-ye qamīṣ-e Bahā az Reżvān-e baqā bar morīdīn az aḥebbāyam morūr namā va be-bayyenāt-e rūḥ va āyāt-e ẓohūr jamīʿ rā āgāh kon ke shāyad baʿżī az nofūs az jamīʿ-e man ʿalā al-arḍ va taʿalloq be-ān pāk va moqaddas shode be-Ferdows-e Aʿẓam rājeʿ shavand. Valāken ey nasīm be-enqeṭāʿ-e tamām morūr namā be-shaʾnī ke agar żorr-e ʿālamīn bar to vāred shavad ṣāber bāshī va agar neʿmat-e ān bar to nāzel gardad tavajjoh nanamāʾī, che ke agar az jahāt-e ḥasad va boghż va radd va qabūl va sokūn va eżṭerāb-e jamīʿ-e man ʿalā al-arḍ moqaddas nashavī qāder bar īn tablīgh-e manīʿ va fāyez be-ḥaml-e asrār-e rabbānī nagardī. Kadhālika yaʾmuruka lisānu rabbika li-takūna mina al-ʿāmilīn.

O morning breeze, since no messenger is to be found, pass from the Riḍván of eternity, bearing the fragrance of the shirt of Bahá, among the devoted ones of My loved ones. Acquaint them all with the clear evidences of the spirit and the signs of revelation, so that perhaps some souls may become pure and sanctified from all who dwell on earth and from attachment to it, and return to the Most Great Paradise. But, O breeze, pass with complete detachment, so that if the harm of all the worlds should assail you, you would remain patient, and if their blessings should descend upon you, you would pay no heed. For unless you become sanctified from the envy and hatred, rejection and acceptance, calm and agitation of all who dwell on earth, you will neither be capable of this exalted proclamation nor attain the privilege of bearing divine mysteries. Thus does the tongue of your Lord command you, so that you may be among those who act.

282

بگو ای احباب و ای اولی الألباب آخر قدری نظر را از توجّه بدنیا و شئونات آن مقدّس نمائید و دیدهٴ بصیرت در امورات ظاهره و شئونات لامعه که از شطر عرش ابهی ظاهر و هویدا است ملاحظه نموده تفکّر نمائید که شاید در این ایّام که سکر غفلت جمیع اهل سموات و ارض را احاطه نموده خود را بمدینهٴ احدیّۀ ابدیّهٴ الهی کشانید و از بدایع رحمت بی‌زوالش محروم نمانید که مباد نعوذ باللّه از مقصود اوّلیّهٴ رحمانی محجوب گردید و از معرضین در کتاب ربّ الأرباب محسوب شوید من‌دون آنکه شاعر باشید فنعوذ باللّه عن ذلک یا اولی الألباب

Begū ey aḥbāb va ey olī al-albāb, ākhar qadrī naẓar rā az tavajjoh be-donyā va shoʾūnāt-e ān moqaddas namāʾīd va dīde-ye baṣīrat dar omūrāt-e ẓāhere va shoʾūnāt-e lāmeʿe ke az shaṭr-e ʿarsh-e Abhā ẓāher va hoveydā ast molāḥeẓe namūde tafakkor namāʾīd, ke shāyad dar īn ayyām ke sokr-e ghaflat jamīʿ-e ahl-e samavāt va arż rā eḥāṭe namūde khod rā be-madīne-ye aḥadīyye-ye abadīyye-ye elāhī keshānīd va az badāyeʿ-e raḥmat-e bī-zavālash maḥrūm namānīd, ke mabād naʿūdhu bi-Allāh az maqṣūd-e avvalīyye-ye raḥmānī maḥjūb gardīd va az moʿreżīn dar ketāb-e Rabb al-Arbāb maḥsūb shavīd men-dūn-e ānke shāʿer bāshīd. Fa-naʿūdhu bi-Allāhi ʿan dhālika yā ulī al-albāb.

Say: O loved ones, O people of understanding! At last, free your gaze to some degree from attention to the world and its affairs. With the eye of insight, consider and reflect upon the manifest events and radiant signs that have appeared and become evident from the direction of the All-Glorious Throne. Perhaps, in these days when the intoxication of heedlessness has overtaken all the inhabitants of heaven and earth, you may bring yourselves to the city of God’s eternal oneness and not remain deprived of the wonders of His unfailing mercy. Otherwise—God forbid—you may be veiled from the primary purpose of the All-Merciful and be reckoned in the Book of the Lord of Lords among those who turn away, without being aware of it. We seek refuge in God from this, O people of understanding!

283

جمیع انبیا و رسل ناس را بسبل عرفان جمال رحمن دعوت نموده‌اند چه که این مقام اعظم مقامات بوده و خواهد بود قدری ملاحظه نموده در ارسال رسل الهی که بچه سبب و جهت این هیاکل احدیّه از غیب بعرصهٴ شهود آمده‌اند و جمیع این بلایا و رزایا که شنیده‌اید جمیع را تحمّل فرموده‌اند شکّی نیست که مقصود جز دعوت عباد بعرفان جمال رحمن نبوده و نخواهد بود و اگر بگوئید مقصود اوامر و نواهی آن بوده شکّی نیست که این مقصود اوّلیّه نبوده و نخواهد بود چنانچه اگر کسی بعبادت اهل سموات و ارض قیام نماید و از عرفان الهی محروم باشد هرگز نفعی بعاملین آن نبخشیده و نخواهد بخشید و در جمیع کتب سماویّه این مطلب مشهود و واضح است و اگر نفسی عارف بحقّ باشد و جمیع اوامر الهیّه را ترک نماید امید نجات هست چنانچه نزد اولی البصر واضح و مبرهن است

Jamīʿ-e anbiyā va rosol nās rā be-sobol-e ʿerfān-e Jamāl-e Raḥmān daʿvat namūde-and, che ke īn maqām aʿẓam-e maqāmāt būde va khāhad būd. Qadrī molāḥeẓe namūde dar ersāl-e rosol-e elāhī ke be-che sabab va jahat īn hayākel-e aḥadīyye az gheyb be-ʿarṣe-ye shohūd āmade-and va jamīʿ-e īn balāyā va razāyā ke shenīde-īd jamīʿ rā taḥammol farmūde-and. Shakkī nīst ke maqṣūd joz daʿvat-e ʿebād be-ʿerfān-e Jamāl-e Raḥmān nabūde va nakhāhad būd. Va agar begūʾīd maqṣūd avāmer va navāhī-ye ān būde shakkī nīst ke īn maqṣūd-e avvalīyye nabūde va nakhāhad būd, chenānche agar kasī be-ʿebādat-e ahl-e samavāt va arż qiyām namāyad va az ʿerfān-e elāhī maḥrūm bāshad hargez nafʿī be-ʿāmelīn-e ān nabakhshīde va nakhāhad bakhshīd. Va dar jamīʿ-e kotob-e samāvīyye īn maṭlab mashhūd va vāżeḥ ast. Va agar nafsī ʿāref be-Ḥaqq bāshad va jamīʿ-e avāmer-e elāhīyye rā tark namāyad omīd-e najāt hast, chenānche nazd-e olī al-baṣar vāżeḥ va mobarhan ast.

All the Prophets and Messengers have summoned humanity to the paths of recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful, for this has been and will remain the greatest of all stations. Reflect a little on the sending of the divine Messengers: for what cause and purpose have these Temples of Oneness come from the unseen into the realm of the visible, and endured all the afflictions and calamities of which you have heard? There is no doubt that their purpose has been, and will remain, nothing but to summon the servants to recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful. If you say that the purpose was His commandments and prohibitions, there is no doubt that this has not been, and will not be, the primary purpose. For if someone were to perform the worship of all the inhabitants of heaven and earth yet remain deprived of the recognition of God, it would never have benefited, nor will it ever benefit, those who perform it. This matter is evident and clear in all the heavenly books. And if a soul recognizes the True One but abandons all the divine commandments, there is hope of salvation, as is clear and manifest to those endowed with insight.

284

پس مقصود اوّلیّه از خلق ابداع و ظهور اختراع و ارسال رسل و انزال کتب و حمل رسل مشقّتهای لایحصی را جمیع بعلّت عرفان جمال سبحان بوده پس حال اگر نفسی بجمیع اعمال مشغول شود و در تمام عمر بقیام و قعود و ذکر و فکر و مادون آن از اعمال مشغول گردد و از عرفان اللّه محروم ماند ابداً ثمری باو راجع نخواهد شد و عرفان اللّه هم لازال عرفان مظهر نفس او بوده در میانهٴ خلق او چنانچه در جمیع کتب خاصّه در بیان که در جمیع الواح آن این مطلب بلند اعلی و این لطیفهٴ اعزّ قصوی مذکور گشته و مبرهن آمده فطوبی للعارفین

Pas maqṣūd-e avvalīyye az khalq-e ebdāʿ va ẓohūr-e ekhterāʿ va ersāl-e rosol va enzāl-e kotob va ḥaml-e rosol mashaqqat-hā-ye lā yoḥṣā rā jamīʿ be-ʿellat-e ʿerfān-e Jamāl-e Sobḥān būde. Pas ḥāl agar nafsī be-jamīʿ-e aʿmāl mashghūl shavad va dar tamām-e ʿomr be-qiyām va qoʿūd va dhekr va fekr va mādūn-e ān az aʿmāl mashghūl gardad va az ʿerfān-e Allāh maḥrūm mānad abadan thamarī be-ū rājeʿ nakhāhad shod. Va ʿerfān-e Allāh ham lāzāl ʿerfān-e maẓhar-e nafs-e Ū būde dar miyāne-ye khalq-e Ū, chenānche dar jamīʿ-e kotob khāṣṣe dar Bayān ke dar jamīʿ-e alvāḥ-e ān īn maṭlab-e boland-e aʿlā va īn laṭīfe-ye aʿazz-e qoṣvā madhkūr gashte va mobarhan āmade. Fa-ṭūbā li-al-ʿārifīn.

Thus the primary purpose of bringing creation into being, of the appearance of originated things, of sending Messengers, of revealing books, and of the Messengers’ bearing countless hardships has, in every case, been recognition of the Beauty of the All-Glorious. Now, therefore, if a soul should engage in every deed and spend an entire lifetime in standing and sitting, remembrance and contemplation, and other such acts, yet remain deprived of the recognition of God, no fruit will ever accrue to that soul. And recognition of God has always meant recognition of the Manifestation of His own Self among His creatures, as set forth in all the books, especially in the Bayán, in all of whose tablets this lofty and most exalted theme, this most precious and sublime truth, has been stated and demonstrated. Blessed, then, are those who recognize.

285

و اگر ببصر اطهر ملاحظه شود مشهود میگردد که جمیع هیاکل احدیّه که جان و مال و ننگ و نام را در سبیل محبوب انفاق نموده‌اند در رتبهٴ اوّلیّه مقصودی نداشته‌اند جز آنکه عباد را بشریعهٴ عرفان کشانند حال ملاحظه در انبیا نمائید که چه قدر بلایای لایحصی حمل نموده‌اند که شاید ناس حجبات وهم را خرق نمایند و از کوثر یقین مشروب گردند

Va agar bi-baṣar-i aṭhar mulāḥiẓa shavad, mashhūd mīgardad ki jamīʿ-i hayākil-i aḥadiyya ki jān va māl va nang va nām rā dar sabīl-i maḥbūb infāq namūda-and, dar rutba-yi avvaliyya maqṣūdī nadāshta-and juz ānki ʿibād rā bi-sharīʿa-yi ʿirfān kishānand. Ḥāl mulāḥiẓa dar anbiyā namāyīd ki chi qadr balāyā-yi lāyuḥṣā ḥaml namūda-and ki shāyad nās ḥujubāt-i vahm rā kharq namāyand va az kawthar-i yaqīn mashrūb gardand.

If viewed with the purest sight, it becomes evident that all the Temples of Oneness who have sacrificed life and possessions, reputation and name in the path of the Beloved have had no primary purpose except to draw the servants to the waters of recognition. Now consider the Prophets: how many countless afflictions they have borne so that people might tear through the veils of illusion and drink from the river of certainty.

286

و چون حجبات غلیظیّهٴ وهمیّه در انظار بسیار بزرگ و مهیمن بود لذا هر رسول که از جانب حقّ ظاهر شد جمیع بر اعتراض بآن نفحهٴ ربّانیّه قیام نموده‌اند تا آنکه ارسال رسل منتهی بهادی سبل در سنهٴ ستّین شد ملاحظه شد که چه قدر ناس بوهمیّات انفس خود از شاطی قدس یقین دور مانده‌اند بشأنی که از خدا جز هوی و از یقین جز ظنّ مبین در مابینشان مذکور نه

Va chūn ḥujubāt-i ghalīẓiyya-yi vahmiyya dar anẓār bisyār buzurg va muhaymin būd, lidhā har rasūl ki az jānib-i Ḥaqq ẓāhir shud, jamīʿ bar iʿtirāḍ bi-ān nafḥa-yi rabbāniyya qiyām namūda-and, tā ānki irsāl-i rusul muntahī bi-Hādī-yi subul dar sana-yi sittīn shud. Mulāḥiẓa shud ki chi qadr nās bi-vahmiyyāt-i anfus-i khud az shāṭī-yi quds-i yaqīn dūr mānda-and, bi-shaʾnī ki az Khudā juz havā va az yaqīn juz ẓann-i mubīn dar mābaynishān madhkūr na.

Since the thick veils of illusion loomed so large and held such sway in people’s eyes, whenever a Messenger appeared from God, all rose in opposition to that divine Breeze, until the succession of Messengers culminated in the Guide of the paths in the year sixty. It became evident how far people had remained from the sacred shore of certainty through their own vain imaginings, to such a degree that among them nothing was spoken of as God but desire, and nothing as certainty but manifest conjecture.

287

و چون جمال علیّ اعلی امر بخرق احجاب فرمود جمیع بر اعراضش قیام نمودند تا آنکه معدودی قلیل باصل مقصود عارف شده جمیع حجبات وهمیّه و سبحات ظنونیّه را بنار سدرهٴ ربّانیّه محترق نموده بعرفان جمال رحمن فایز گشتند تاللّه الحقّ اگر نفسی در آنچه بر آن جمال مبارک وارد شده از اعراض علما و بلایای لایحصی تفکّر نماید در تمام عمر بناله و نوحه و ندبه مشغول گردد تا آنکه اهل کین آن جمال مبین را در هوا معلّق نمودند و برصاص شرک و بغضا آن سدرهٴ عزّ منتهی را قطع نمودند

Va chūn Jamāl-i ʿAlī-yi Aʿlā amr bi-kharq-i aḥjāb farmūd, jamīʿ bar iʿrāḍash qiyām namūdand, tā ānki maʿdūdī qalīl bi-aṣl-i maqṣūd ʿārif shuda, jamīʿ-i ḥujubāt-i vahmiyya va subuḥāt-i ẓunūniyya rā bi-nār-i sidra-yi rabbāniyya muḥtariq namūda, bi-ʿirfān-i Jamāl-i Raḥmān fāʾiz gashtand. Ta-Allāh al-Ḥaqq, agar nafsī dar ānchi bar ān Jamāl-i mubārak vārid shuda az iʿrāḍ-i ʿulamā va balāyā-yi lāyuḥṣā tafakkur namāyad, dar tamām-i ʿumr bi-nāla va nawḥa va nudba mashghūl gardad, tā ānki ahl-i kīn ān Jamāl-i mubīn rā dar havā muʿallaq namūdand va bi-raṣāṣ-i shirk va baghḍā ān sidra-yi ʿizz-i muntahā rā qaṭʿ namūdand.

When the most exalted Beauty of ʿAlī commanded that the veils be torn away, all rose to turn away from Him, until a small number recognized the essential purpose and, burning away all the veils of illusion and the splendors of conjecture with the fire of the divine Tree, attained recognition of the Beauty of the All-Merciful. By God, the True One! If anyone were to reflect on what befell that blessed Beauty—the rejection of the religious scholars and countless afflictions—that person would spend an entire lifetime lamenting, mourning, and weeping. At last, the people of malice suspended that manifest Beauty in the air and, with the bullets of idolatry and hatred, cut down that Tree of utmost glory.

288

و آن جمال مبارک در حینی که معلّق بهوا بود در سرّ سرّ بلسان ناطق مبین باین کلمات محکم متین تکلّم میفرمودند که ای اهل بیان قدری تفکّر در این خلق نمائید که جمیع خود را عارف بحقّ میدانند و سالک سبل یقین میشمرند و در کلّ احیان باذکار و کلمات رحمن مشغول شده‌اند بقسمی که یومی از ایّام اوامر ملیک علّام را ترک ننموده‌اند و اگر هم از نفسی ترک شده خود را نادم مشاهده نموده

Va ān Jamāl-i mubārak dar ḥīnī ki muʿallaq bi-havā būd, dar sirr-i sirr bi-lisān-i nāṭiq-i mubīn bi-īn kalimāt-i muḥkam-i matīn takallum mīfarmūdand ki ay ahl-i Bayān, qadrī tafakkur dar īn khalq namāyīd ki jamīʿ khud rā ʿārif bi-Ḥaqq mīdānand va sālik-i subul-i yaqīn mīshumrand va dar kull-i aḥyān bi-adhkār va kalimāt-i Raḥmān mashghūl shuda-and, bi-qismī ki yawmī az ayyām avāmir-i Malīk-i ʿAllām rā tark nanamūda-and va agar ham az nafsī tark shuda, khud rā nādim mushāhida namūda.

While that blessed Beauty was suspended in the air, in the innermost mystery He spoke these firm and weighty words with an eloquent and lucid tongue: “People of the Bayān, reflect a little on these people. They all consider themselves to have recognized God and count themselves among those who walk the paths of certainty. At all times they have occupied themselves with the remembrance and words of the All-Merciful, so much so that they have not neglected the commandments of the all-knowing King for a single day; and if anyone has neglected them, that person has felt remorse.

289

و مع‌ذلک جوهر رحمن و ساذج سبحان را که بعرفان او متمسّک بوده‌اند معلّق داشته و شهید مینمایند و ابداً عارف باو نگشته و خود را از جمیع فیوضات الهیّه و عنایات عزّ رحمانیّه محروم داشته‌اند در قعر نارند و خود را از اهل جنّت میشمرند و در بحر عذاب مستغرقند و خود را از احباب ربّ الأرباب میدانند و در منتهی بعد از حقّ خود را از اهل قرب فرض گرفته‌اند

Va maʿa-dhālik Jawhar-i Raḥmān va Sādhij-i Subḥān rā ki bi-ʿirfān-i ū mutamassik būda-and muʿallaq dāshta va shahīd mīnamāyand va abadan ʿārif bi-ū nagashta va khud rā az jamīʿ-i fuyūḍāt-i ilāhiyya va ʿināyāt-i ʿizz-i raḥmāniyya maḥrūm dāshta-and. Dar qaʿr-i nārand va khud rā az ahl-i jannat mīshumrand va dar baḥr-i ʿadhāb mustaghraqand va khud rā az aḥbāb-i Rabb al-Arbāb mīdānand va dar muntahā-yi buʿd az Ḥaqq khud rā az ahl-i qurb farḍ girifta-and.

Yet they have suspended and are putting to death the Essence of the All-Merciful, the pure Being of the All-Glorious, to whose recognition they have professed to hold fast. They have never recognized Him and have deprived themselves of all divine outpourings and the glorious favors of the All-Merciful. They are in the depths of the fire, yet count themselves among the people of paradise. They are submerged in the sea of torment, yet consider themselves among the beloved of the Lord of Lords. At the utmost distance from God, they imagine themselves among those who are near Him.

290

پس شما ای اهل بیان در کلّ حین توکّل بجمال ربّ العالمین نمائید و باو پناه برید که مبادا بر جمالم در ظهور اخرایم وارد آورید آنچه آن گروه در این حین وارد آورده‌اند

Pas shumā ay ahl-i Bayān dar kull-i ḥīn tavakkul bi-Jamāl-i Rabb al-ʿĀlamīn namāyīd va bi-ū panāh barīd ki mabādā bar Jamālam dar ẓuhūr-i ukhrāyam vārid āvarīd ānchi ān gurūh dar īn ḥīn vārid āvarda-and.

Therefore, people of the Bayān, place your trust at all times in the Beauty of the Lord of the worlds and seek refuge in Him, lest in My next Revelation you inflict upon My Beauty what those people have inflicted at this time.

291

ای اهل بیان فئهٴ فرقان حجّتی در دست نداشتند مگر فرقان که فارق بین حقّ و باطل بوده در آن ایّام و چون جمال عزّ رحمانیم از افق قدس سبحانیم طالع و مشرق شد بهمان حجّت و دلیل بل اعظم نفس خود را ظاهر فرمودم که شاید از حجّت قبل بحجّت بعد آگاه شده خود را از حرم تصدیق جمال یقین محروم نسازند و مع‌ذلک در کلّ ایّام آیات فرقان را تلاوت مینمایند و از این آیات بدیعه که حجّیّتش چون شمس مابین سماء ظاهر و لایح است ممنوع و محروم گشته‌اند

Ay ahl-i Bayān, fiʾa-yi Furqān ḥujjatī dar dast nadāshtand magar Furqān ki fāriq bayn-i ḥaqq va bāṭil būda dar ān ayyām. Va chūn Jamāl-i ʿizz-i raḥmāniyam az ufuq-i quds-i subḥāniyam ṭāliʿ va mushriq shud, bi-hamān ḥujjat va dalīl, bal aʿẓam, nafs-i khud rā ẓāhir farmūdam ki shāyad az ḥujjat-i qabl bi-ḥujjat-i baʿd āgāh shuda, khud rā az ḥaram-i taṣdīq-i Jamāl-i yaqīn maḥrūm nasāzand. Va maʿa-dhālik dar kull-i ayyām āyāt-i Furqān rā tilāvat mīnamāyand va az īn āyāt-i badīʿa ki ḥujjiyyatash chūn shams mābayn-i samā ẓāhir va lāʾiḥ ast mamnūʿ va maḥrūm gashta-and.

People of the Bayān, the people of the Qurʾān had no proof in hand except the Qurʾān, which distinguished truth from falsehood in those days. When My Beauty of merciful glory rose and shone from the horizon of My transcendent holiness, I manifested Myself with that same proof and testimony—indeed, with a greater one—so that through the earlier proof they might recognize the later proof and not deprive themselves of the sanctuary of acknowledgment of the Beauty of certainty. Yet they recite the verses of the Qurʾān every day while remaining shut out and deprived of these wondrous verses, whose authority as proof is as evident and radiant as the sun in the midst of heaven.

292

چنانچه در حین ظهور آیات عزّیّهٴ الهیّه جمعی مذکور نمودند که این آیات از کتب قبل سرقت شده و بعضی لسان غافلشان باین تکلّم نموده که این آیات از معدن نفس و هوی ظاهر کذلک اشهدناهم ان انتم من الشّاهدین تا آنکه امر بمقامی رسید در حینی که بذکرم توسّل میجستید جسدم را مجروح نمودید و در وقتی که بعرفانم افتخار مینمودید بر جمال معروفم رصاص کین انداختید

Chunānchi dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr-i āyāt-i ʿizziyya-yi ilāhiyya jamʿī madhkūr namūdand ki īn āyāt az kutub-i qabl sirqat shuda va baʿḍī lisān-i ghāfilishān bi-īn takallum namūda ki īn āyāt az maʿdan-i nafs va havā ẓāhir. Kadhālika ashhadnāhum in antum min al-shāhidīn. Tā ānki amr bi-maqāmī rasīd, dar ḥīnī ki bi-dhikram tavassul mījustīd jasadam rā majrūḥ namūdīd va dar vaqtī ki bi-ʿirfānam iftikhār mīnamūdīd bar Jamāl-i maʿrūfam raṣāṣ-i kīn andākhtīd.

Thus, when the glorious divine verses were revealed, some declared that these verses had been stolen from earlier books, while others said with heedless tongues that these verses arose from the source of self and desire. Thus We made them bear witness, if you are among those who witness. Matters reached such a point that, even as you sought recourse through My remembrance, you wounded My body, and while you prided yourselves on recognizing Me, you fired bullets of malice at My recognized Beauty.

293

اینست شأن دنیا و اهل آن تا آنکه روح لطیفم از آلایش انفس مشرکه فارغ شده بمقرّ عزّ ارفع اعلی و رفیق اقدس امنع ابهی طیران نمود و بعد از ارتقای روح مبارکم بافق ابهی بطرف عنایت و لحاظ مکرمت بمدّعیان محبّتم ناظرم که کدام بوصایایم عمل مینمایند و بامرم مطیعند

Īnast shaʾn-i dunyā va ahl-i ān, tā ānki rūḥ-i laṭīfam az ālāyish-i anfus-i mushrika fārigh shuda, bi-maqarr-i ʿizz-i arfaʿ-i aʿlā va Rafīq-i aqdas-i amnaʿ-i abhā ṭayarān namūd. Va baʿd az irtiqā-yi rūḥ-i mubārakam bi-ufuq-i abhā, bi-ṭarf-i ʿināyat va liḥāẓ-i makramat bi-muddaʿiyān-i maḥabbatam nāẓiram ki kudām bi-vaṣāyāyam ʿamal mīnamāyand va bi-amram muṭīʿand.

Such is the way of the world and its people. At last My gentle spirit was freed from the defilement of idolatrous souls and winged its way to the loftiest, most exalted seat of glory and the most holy, most unapproachable, all-glorious Companion. After My blessed spirit ascended to the all-glorious horizon, I look with the eye of favor and the gaze of loving-kindness upon those who claim to love Me, to see which of them act according to My counsels and obey My command.

294
