اذاً ینطق لسان القدم عن افق الأبهی و یقول یا ملأ البیان هذا جمالی قد ظهر بآیاتی ثمّ ظهوراتی لم کفرتم به و اعرضتم عنه اذاً یثبت بأنّکم ما آمنتم بنفسی کما ثبت فی حین ظهوری بأنّ ملأ الفرقان ما آمنوا بمحمّد مظهر نفسی کما ظهر فی ظهور محمّد بأنّ ملأ الانجیل ما آمنوا بابنی کما ظهر حین الّذی جآء الرّوح بأنّ امّة التّوریة ما آمنوا بالکلیم اذاً فارجعوا ثمّ انظروا الی ان ینتهی الأمر الی ظهور الأوّل و کذلک نلقی علیکم من اسرار ما کان لعلّ تکوننّ فی انفسکم لمن الشّاعرین

Idhan yanṭiqu lisān al-qidam ʿan ufuq al-Abhā wa-yaqūlu yā malaʾ al-Bayān, hādhā Jamālī qad ẓahara bi-āyātī thumma ẓuhūrātī, lima kafartum bihi wa-aʿraḍtum ʿanhu? Idhan yathbutu bi-annakum mā āmantum bi-nafsī kamā thabata fī ḥīn ẓuhūrī bi-anna malaʾ al-Furqān mā āmanū bi-Muḥammad maẓhar nafsī, kamā ẓahara fī ẓuhūr Muḥammad bi-anna malaʾ al-Injīl mā āmanū bi-Ibnī, kamā ẓahara ḥīna alladhī jāʾa al-Rūḥ bi-anna ummat al-Tawrāt mā āmanū bi-l-Kalīm. Idhan fa-rjiʿū thumma unẓurū ilā an yantahiya al-amru ilā ẓuhūr al-awwal. Wa-kadhālika nulqī ʿalaykum min asrār mā kāna laʿalla takūnunna fī anfusikum la-min al-shāʿirīn.

Then the Tongue of Eternity speaks from the all-glorious horizon and says: ‘People of the Bayān, this is My Beauty, who has appeared with My verses and My manifestations. Why have you disbelieved in Him and turned away from Him? It is thereby established that you have not believed in Me, just as at the time of My Revelation it was established that the people of the Qurʾān had not believed in Muḥammad, the Manifestation of My Self; just as in the Revelation of Muḥammad it became evident that the people of the Gospel had not believed in My Son; and just as, when the Spirit came, it became evident that the people of the Torah had not believed in Him who conversed with God. Go back, then, and consider, until the matter reaches the appearance of the first. Thus We impart to you some of the mysteries of what has been, so that within yourselves you may be among those who perceive.’

295

و از شهادتم ایّامی نگذشته که عنایت جدید از شطر قدس ابهی و مکرمت منیع از افق عزّ اعلی اشراق فرمود و ساذج قدم بجمال اعظم اکرم از رضوان غیب ظاهر شد بهمان حجّتی که من حجّت قرار دادم و بهمان برهان که عنداللّه مقبول بوده بلکه بجمیع شئونات احدیّت و ظهورات عزّ صمدیّت و بطونات غیب لایدرک و دلالات عزّ لایعرف ظاهر شده

Va az shahādatam ayyāmī nagudhashta ki ʿināyat-i jadīd az shaṭr-i quds-i abhā va makramat-i manīʿ az ufuq-i ʿizz-i aʿlā ishrāq farmūd va Sādhij-i Qidam bi-Jamāl-i aʿẓam-i akram az Riḍvān-i ghayb ẓāhir shud, bi-hamān ḥujjatī ki man ḥujjat qarār dādam va bi-hamān burhān ki ʿinda Allāh maqbūl būda, balki bi-jamīʿ-i shuʾūnāt-i aḥadiyyat va ẓuhūrāt-i ʿizz-i ṣamadiyyat va buṭūnāt-i ghayb-i lāyudrak va dalālāt-i ʿizz-i lāyuʿraf ẓāhir shuda.

Only a few days had passed since My martyrdom when a fresh favor shone from the region of all-glorious holiness and an exalted loving-kindness from the horizon of the highest glory. The pure Being of Eternity appeared from the paradise of the unseen in a most great and most bountiful Beauty, with the very proof that I had established as proof and the very testimony that had been acceptable before God. Indeed, He appeared with all the aspects of oneness, the manifestations of the glory of eternal self-sufficiency, the hidden depths of the unfathomable unseen, and the signs of unknowable glory.

296

مع‌ذلک شما ای ملأ بیان از کلّ جهات باسیاف غلّ و اشارات بر حول عرش اعظم جمع شده‌اید و در کلّ حین از سهام کین بر این جمال عزّ منیع وارد آورده‌اید قسم بجمالم اگر حال ملاحظه نمائید و بطرف حقیقت برفیق اعلی متوجّه شوید ملاحظه مینمائید که از جسدم بحور دم جاری و از ارکانم آثار اسیاف کین ظاهر

Maʿa-dhālik shumā ay malaʾ-i Bayān az kull-i jihāt bi-asyāf-i ghill va ishārāt bar ḥawl-i ʿarsh-i aʿẓam jamʿ shuda-īd va dar kull-i ḥīn az sihām-i kīn bar īn Jamāl-i ʿizz-i manīʿ vārid āvarda-īd. Qasam bi-Jamālam, agar ḥāl mulāḥiẓa namāyīd va bi-ṭarf-i ḥaqīqat bi-Rafīq-i Aʿlā mutavajjih shavīd, mulāḥiẓa mīnamāyīd ki az jasadam buḥūr-i dam jārī va az arkānam āthār-i asyāf-i kīn ẓāhir.

Yet you, people of the Bayān, have gathered from every direction around the most great Throne with the swords of rancor and insinuation, and at every moment you have struck this Beauty of exalted glory with the arrows of malice. I swear by My Beauty! If you look now and turn toward the truth, toward the most exalted Companion, you will see seas of blood flowing from My body and the marks of the swords of malice evident upon My limbs.

297

آخر تفکّر ننموده‌اید که بچه سبب نفسم را انفاق فرمودم و آن همه سیوف فحشا و رصاص بغضا بر او وارد آمد و این بسی واضح است که مقصودی جز عرفان مظهر نفسم نبوده و چون مظهر نفسم بتمام ظهور ظاهر شد اینگونه معمول داشته‌اید که مشهود شده

Ākhir tafakkur nanamūda-īd ki bi-chi sabab nafsam rā infāq farmūdam va ān hama suyūf-i faḥshā va raṣāṣ-i baghḍā bar ū vārid āmad? Va īn basī vāḍiḥ ast ki maqṣūdī juz ʿirfān-i Maẓhar-i nafsam nabūda va chūn Maẓhar-i nafsam bi-tamām-i ẓuhūr ẓāhir shud, īngūna maʿmūl dāshta-īd ki mashhūd shuda.

Have you not reflected, after all, on why I sacrificed Myself and why all those swords of wickedness and bullets of hatred struck Me? It is abundantly clear that My purpose was nothing but recognition of the Manifestation of My Self. Yet when the Manifestation of My Self appeared in the fullness of revelation, you treated Him in the manner that has been witnessed.

298

حال اگر در موقف حشر اکبر از شما سؤال شود و از آنچه بآن عامل شده‌اید استفسار رود در جواب ربّ الأرباب چه خواهید گفت لا واللّه ابداً قوّت تکلّم نخواهید داشت چه که ایّامی از غیبتم نگذشته و جمیع حجّیّت ظهور و امور وارده را بچشم خود مشاهده نموده‌اید و مع‌ذلک از جمالی که بقول او کلّ شئونات قبلیّه و بعدیّه محقّق شده غافل شده‌اید و بحجبات نفس و هوی از منظر اعلی محجوب مانده‌اید

Ḥāl agar dar mawqif-i ḥashr-i akbar az shumā suʾāl shavad va az ānchi bi-ān ʿāmil shuda-īd istifsār ravad, dar javāb-i Rabb al-Arbāb chi khāhīd guft? Lā wa-Allāh, abadan quvvat-i takallum nakhāhīd dāsht, chi ki ayyāmī az ghaybatam nagudhashta va jamīʿ-i ḥujjiyyat-i ẓuhūr va umūr-i vārida rā bi-chashm-i khud mushāhida namūda-īd va maʿa-dhālik az Jamālī ki bi-qawl-i ū kull-i shuʾūnāt-i qabliyya va baʿdiyya muḥaqqaq shuda ghāfil shuda-īd va bi-ḥujubāt-i nafs va havā az Manẓar-i Aʿlā maḥjūb mānda-īd.

Now, if you are questioned at the place of the greatest gathering and asked about what you have done, what will you say in answer to the Lord of Lords? No, by God! You will have no power to speak, for only a few days have passed since My absence, and you have witnessed with your own eyes the full proof of the Revelation and all that befell Me. Yet you have become heedless of the Beauty through whose word all things, past and future, have been brought into being, and have remained shut out from the most exalted Vision by the veils of self and desire.

299

ای قوم در تمام اوراق بیان کلّ را باین ظهور قدس صمدانی بشارت دادم و فرمودم که مباد در حین طلوع این نیّر عزّ اعظم بشیئی از آنچه خلق شده مابین سموات و ارض مشغول شوید و از جمال قدم محتجب مانید

Ay qawm, dar tamām-i awrāq-i Bayān kull rā bi-īn ẓuhūr-i quds-i ṣamadānī bishārat dādam va farmūdam ki mabād dar ḥīn-i ṭulūʿ-i īn nayyir-i ʿizz-i aʿẓam bi-shayʾī az ānchi khalq shuda mābayn-i samāvāt va arḍ mashghūl shavīd va az Jamāl-i Qidam muḥtajib mānīd.

People, throughout all the pages of the Bayān I gave everyone the glad tidings of this holy and eternal Revelation, and said that when this Luminary of supreme glory arose, you must not become occupied with anything created between the heavens and the earth and remain veiled from the Beauty of Eternity.

300

و هم‌چنین تصریحاً فرمودم که ایّاکم ای قوم اگر در حین ظهور بواحد بیان محتجب شوید و این معلوم بوده که واحد بیان اوّل خلق بیان عنداللّه محسوب و بر کلّ سبقت داده‌ام

Va hamchunīn taṣrīḥan farmūdam ki iyyākum ay qawm agar dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr bi-vāḥid-i Bayān muḥtajib shavīd va īn maʿlūm būda ki vāḥid-i Bayān avval-i khalq-i Bayān ʿinda Allāh maḥsūb va bar kull sabqat dāda-am.

I also expressly said: beware, people, lest at the time of the Revelation you be veiled by the Vāḥid of the Bayān. It was known that the Vāḥid of the Bayān is reckoned before God as the first of the creation of the Bayān, and that I have given it precedence over all.

301

و هم‌چنین بنصّ صریح فرموده‌ام که ایّاکم ای قوم اگر حین ظهور محتجب شوید بآنچه نازل شده در بیان و حال شما ای قوم بوصفی که در بیان نازل شده و نمیدانید که مقصود چیست و در بارهٴ کیست چه که ابداً نفسی از مقصودم مطّلع نبوده مع‌ذلک از موجد وصف و منزل و مظهر و محقّق آن که بقولی از او اینگونه هیاکل خلق شده و میشوند معرض شده‌اید و کاش باین اکتفا مینمودید بلکه بر قتلش فتوی داده‌اید واللّه در کلّ احیان مثل ثعبان این جوهر رحمن را اذیّت نموده‌اید مؤمن نشدید و بحقّ عارف نگشتید دیگر بر قتل و ضرّش چرا راضی شدید

Va hamchunīn bi-naṣṣ-i ṣarīḥ farmūda-am ki iyyākum ay qawm agar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr muḥtajib shavīd bi-ānchi nāzil shuda dar Bayān. Va ḥāl shumā ay qawm bi-vaṣfī ki dar Bayān nāzil shuda va namīdānīd ki maqṣūd chīst va dar bāra-yi kīst, chi ki abadan nafsī az maqṣūdam muṭṭaliʿ nabūda, maʿa-dhālik az mūjid-i vaṣf va munzil va muẓhir va muḥaqqiq-i ān ki bi-qawlī az ū īngūna hayākil khalq shuda va mīshavand muʿriḍ shuda-īd. Va kāsh bi-īn iktifā mīnamūdīd, balki bar qatlash fatvā dāda-īd. Va-Allāh dar kull-i aḥyān mithl-i thuʿbān īn Jawhar-i Raḥmān rā adhiyyat namūda-īd. Muʾmin nashudīd va bi-Ḥaqq ʿārif nagashtīd, dīgar bar qatl va ḍarrash chirā rāḍī shudīd?

I also stated in an explicit text: beware, people, lest at the time of the Revelation you be veiled by what has been revealed in the Bayān. Yet now, people, because of a description revealed in the Bayān—when you do not know what is intended or whom it concerns, for no one has ever been aware of My intention—you have turned away from the One who brought that description into being, revealed it, manifested it, and fulfilled it, through a single word from whom such temples have been and continue to be created. If only you had been content with this! Instead, you have issued a decree for His death. By God, at every moment you have tormented this Essence of the All-Merciful like a serpent. You did not believe and did not recognize God; why, then, did you consent to His death and injury?

302

قسم بجمالم که از کأس انصاف ننوشیده‌اید و از بحر رضایم نچشیده‌اید بیمین عدل قدم نگذارده‌اید و در کوی متبصّرین مرور ننموده‌اید ضلالت را نفس هدایت شمرده‌اید و صرف شرک را جوهر توحید دانسته‌اید

Qasam bi-Jamālam ki az kaʾs-i inṣāf nanūshīda-īd va az baḥr-i riḍāyam nachishīda-īd, bi-yamīn-i ʿadl qadam nagudhāshta-īd va dar kūy-i mutabaṣṣirīn murūr nanamūda-īd. Ḍalālat rā nafs-i hidāyat shumurda-īd va ṣirf-i shirk rā jawhar-i tawḥīd dānista-īd.

I swear by My Beauty that you have not drunk from the cup of fairness or tasted the ocean of My good pleasure. You have not set foot on the right side of justice or passed through the quarter of those endowed with insight. You have counted error as guidance itself and regarded sheer idolatry as the essence of divine unity.”

303

و جمیع شما بعین ظاهر دیده‌اید نفسی را که بیست سنه حفظ فرمود و الآن موجود است و با قدرت بر او و اطّلاع به ما فی سرّ او در کنف حفظ رحمانیّتش حفظ فرمود و مع‌ذلک بر قتلش قیام نمود و چون اراده و فعلش بین مهاجرین انتشار یافت لذا محض ستر اعمال شنیعهٴ خود و القای شبهه در قلوب متوهّمه بمفتریات مجعوله مشغول گشت و افعال و اعمال خود را بساذج قدم نسبت داده که شاید عباد را از یمین یقین بشمال وهم کشاند

Va jamīʿ-e shomā be-ʿayn-e ẓāher dīde-īd nafsī rā ke bīst sana ḥefẓ farmūd va al-ān mowjūd ast va bā qodrat bar ū va eṭṭelāʿ be mā fī sirri ū dar kanaf-e ḥefẓ-e raḥmāniyyatash ḥefẓ farmūd va maʿa-dhālek bar qatl-ash qiyām namūd va chūn erāda va feʿl-ash bayn-e mohājerīn enteshār yāft ledhā maḥż-e satr-e aʿmāl-e shanīʿa-ye khod va elqā-ye shobha dar qolūb-e motavahhema be-moftarayāt-e majʿūla mashghūl gasht va afʿāl va aʿmāl-e khod rā be-sādhaj-e qedam nesbat dāde ke shāyad ʿebād rā az yamīn-e yaqīn be-shomāl-e vahm kashānad.

All of you have seen with your own outward eyes the person whom He protected for twenty years and who is still alive. Though He had power over him and knew what lay hidden within him, He sheltered him within His merciful protection. Nevertheless, that person arose to kill Him. When his intention and deed became known among the emigrants, he occupied himself with fabricated accusations solely to conceal his own vile deeds and cast doubt into minds prone to imagining things. He attributed his own acts and deeds to the Essence of Eternity, hoping thereby to draw the servants from the right hand of certitude to the left hand of delusion.

304

و شما آنچه را ببصر دیده‌اید و ادراک نموده‌اید انکار نموده و بمفتریات مجعوله از طلعت احدیّه محتجب مانده‌اید قسم بجمال عزّ تقدیسم که آنچه در بارهٴ این جمال مبین نوشته‌اند حجّت است بر کلّ در کذب قائلین و اثبات این امر مبین چه که نسبتهائی ذکر نموده که کذبش اظهر از شمس است در وسط سماء چه که جمیع با این جمال عزّ اعلی معاشرت نموده‌اید و بقدر خود ادراک نموده

Va shomā ānche rā be-baṣar dīde-īd va edrāk namūde-īd enkār namūde va be-moftarayāt-e majʿūla az ṭalʿat-e aḥadiyya moḥtajeb mānde-īd. Qasam be-jamāl-e ʿezz-e taqdīsam ke ānche dar bāra-ye īn jamāl-e mobīn neveshte-and ḥojjat ast bar koll dar kedhb-e qāʾelīn va ethbāt-e īn amr-e mobīn che ke nesbat-hāʾī dhekr namūde ke kedhb-ash aẓhar az shams ast dar vasaṭ-e samāʾ che ke jamīʿ bā īn jamāl-e ʿezz-e aʿlā moʿāsherat namūde-īd va be-qadr-e khod edrāk namūde.

You have denied what you have seen with your own eyes and perceived, and through fabricated accusations you have remained veiled from the Countenance of Oneness. I swear by the beauty of My transcendent holiness that what they have written about this manifest Beauty is proof to all of the falsehood of those who utter it and confirmation of this manifest Cause. For they have made allegations whose falsehood is more evident than the sun in the midst of heaven, since you have all associated with this Beauty of most exalted glory and have perceived according to your own capacity.

305

و مع‌ذلک باین کلمات مجعوله از منزل آیات احدیّه معرض شده و سلّمنا که صادقند آیا حقّ را یفعل ما یشآء ندانسته‌اید و بأنّه یحکم ما یرید موقن نشده‌اید

Va maʿa-dhālek be-īn kalemāt-e majʿūla az monzel-e āyāt-e aḥadiyya moʿreż shode va sallamnā ke ṣādeq-and āyā Ḥaqq rā yafʿalu mā yashāʾ nadāneste-īd va bi-annahu yaḥkumu mā yurīd mūqen nashode-īd.

Nevertheless, because of these fabricated words you have turned away from the Revealer of the verses of Oneness. Even if we concede that they are true, have you not known that the True One does whatever He wills, and have you not become certain that He decrees whatever He desires?

306

از جمیع این مراتب گذشته این جمعی که در این سفر مع اللّه هجرت نموده و اکثری از امور را ببصر و فؤاد خود ادراک نموده‌اند و شهادت میدهند که حقّ جلّ شأنه بجمیع شئونات از کلّ ما سواه ممتاز بوده و خواهد بود مع‌ذلک این نفوس را کاذب دانسته‌اید و کسانی که اصلاً مطّلع بر امر نبوده و نخواهند بود و در مناهج وهم و ظنّ سالکند صادق دانسته و میدانید فأفّ لکم یا ملأ المتوهّمین

Az jamīʿ-e īn marāteb godhashte īn jamʿī ke dar īn safar maʿa Allāh hejrat namūde va aktharī az omūr rā be-baṣar va foʾād-e khod edrāk namūde-and va shahādat mīdehand ke Ḥaqq jalla shaʾnuhu be-jamīʿ-e shoʾūnāt az koll-e mā-sevāh momtāz būde va khvāhad būd maʿa-dhālek īn nofūs rā kādheb dāneste-īd va kasānī ke aṣlan moṭṭaleʿ bar amr nabūde va nakhvāhand būd va dar manāhej-e vahm va ẓann sālek-and ṣādeq dāneste va mīdānīd. Fa-uffin lakum yā malaʾa al-mutawahhimīn.

Apart from all these considerations, this company who have emigrated with God on this journey have perceived most of these matters with their own eyes and hearts, and testify that the True One—exalted be His glory—has been and will remain distinguished in every respect from all besides Him. Nevertheless, you have deemed these souls liars, while you have regarded, and still regard, as truthful those who have never been aware of the matter and never will be, and who walk the paths of delusion and conjecture. Shame on you, you company of the deluded!

307

قسم بجمالم که حجّت بالغهٴ الهی بر کلّ تمام شده و کلمهٴ تامّه‌اش از افق صدق مشرق گشته و الیوم پناهی جز پناهش نه و ظلّی جز ظلّش مشهود نه بشنوید ندای محبوب خود را و آنچه ببصر دیده‌اید متمسّک شوید و از عروهٴ وهم بگسلید

Qasam be-jamālam ke ḥojjat-e bālegha-ye elāhī bar koll tamām shode va kalema-ye tāmma-ash az ofoq-e ṣedq moshreq gashte va al-yowm panāhī joz panāh-ash na va ẓellī joz ẓell-ash mashhūd na. Beshnavīd nedā-ye maḥbūb-e khod rā va ānche be-baṣar dīde-īd motamassek shavīd va az ʿorva-ye vahm bogsalīd.

I swear by My Beauty that God’s conclusive proof has been fully established for all, and His perfect Word has dawned from the horizon of truth. Today there is no refuge but His refuge, and no sheltering shade is to be seen but His. Listen to the call of your Beloved, hold fast to what you have seen with your own eyes, and loose your hold on the handle of delusion.

308

و اگر ببصر حقیقت ملاحظه نمائید تاللّه اهل ملأ اعلی در نوحه و ندبه مشغولند و جمیع حوریّات غرفات در حنین و ناله اوراق سدرهٴ منتهی از ظلم این ظالمان پژمرده گشته تاللّه الحقّ اریاح رحمت رحمن از شطر امکان مقطوع و اشراقات انوار وجه سبحان از اهل اکوان ممنوع

Va agar be-baṣar-e ḥaqīqat molāḥeẓa namāʾīd ta-Allāh ahl-e malaʾ-e aʿlā dar nowḥa va nodba mashghūl-and va jamīʿ-e ḥūriyyāt-e ghorofāt dar ḥanīn va nāla. Owrāq-e sedra-ye montahā az ẓolm-e īn ẓālemān pazhmorda gashte. Ta-Allāh al-Ḥaqq aryāḥ-e raḥmat-e Raḥmān az shaṭr-e emkān maqṭūʿ va eshrāqāt-e anvār-e vajh-e Sobḥān az ahl-e akvān mamnūʿ.

If you look with the eye of truth, by God, the inhabitants of the Concourse on high are mourning and lamenting, and all the maidens of the heavenly chambers are sighing and wailing. The leaves of the Lote-Tree of the Utmost Boundary have withered through the oppression of these oppressors. By God, the True One, the breezes of the All-Merciful’s mercy have been cut off from the realm of contingent being, and the radiance of the lights of the All-Glorious Countenance has been withheld from the inhabitants of creation.

309

تاللّه الحقّ ظلمی نموده‌اید که کلّ اشیاء از حیات خود منقطع شده‌اند و الیوم خلقی باقی نه چه از اهل ملأ اعلی و چه از اهل مداین بقا و چه عاکفین لجّهٴ اسماء مگر آنکه کلّ لطایف سرور را بحزن تبدیل نموده‌اند و قمیص سود پوشیده‌اند و جمیع ملأ کرّوبیین و حقایق انبیا و مرسلین در غرفات عزّ تمکین بنوحه مشغول و شما ای غافلین ارض مسرورید و در ارض هاویه بکمال فرح سیر مینمائید

Ta-Allāh al-Ḥaqq ẓolmī namūde-īd ke koll-e ashyāʾ az ḥayāt-e khod monqaṭeʿ shode-and va al-yowm khalqī bāqī na che az ahl-e malaʾ-e aʿlā va che az ahl-e madāyen-e baqā va che ʿākefīn-e lojja-ye asmāʾ magar ānke koll-e laṭāyef-e sorūr rā be-ḥozn tabdīl namūde-and va qamīṣ-e sūd pūshīde-and va jamīʿ-e malaʾ-e karūbiyyīn va ḥaqāʾeq-e anbiyā va morsalīn dar ghorofāt-e ʿezz-e tamkīn be-nowḥa mashghūl va shomā ey ghāfelīn-e arż masrūrīd va dar arż-e hāviya be-kamāl-e faraḥ seyr mīnamāʾīd.

By God, the True One, you have committed such oppression that all things have been severed from their own life. Today no creature remains—whether among the inhabitants of the Concourse on high, the dwellers in the cities of eternity, or those abiding in the ocean of names—who has not exchanged all the delights of joy for sorrow and put on a garment of black. The entire company of the cherubim and the realities of the Prophets and Messengers are lamenting in the chambers of established glory, while you, heedless ones of the earth, are joyful and wander through the land of the abyss in utter delight.

310

جوهر دین را کشته‌اید و بگمان خود بر سرر دین و ایقان جالسید فواللّه یا قوم شبه این ظهور ظاهر نشده و چشم امکان ندیده بشنوید ندایم را و نباشید از احتیاط‌کنندگانی که در ملأ فرقان بودند بشأنی که احتیاط از دم بعوضه مینمودند و بر سفک دم اللّه فتوی میدادند

Jowhar-e dīn rā koshte-īd va be-gomān-e khod bar soror-e dīn va īqān jāles-īd. Fa-wa-Allāh yā qawm shebh-e īn ẓohūr ẓāher nashode va chashm-e emkān nadīde. Beshnavīd nedāyam rā va nabāshīd az eḥtiyāṭ-konandegānī ke dar malaʾ-e Forqān būdand be-shaʾnī ke eḥtiyāṭ az dam-e baʿūża mīnamūdand va bar safk-e dam-e Allāh fatvā mīdādand.

You have slain the essence of religion, yet imagine yourselves seated on the thrones of religion and certitude. By God, O people, nothing like this Revelation has ever appeared, nor has the eye of contingent being ever beheld its like. Hear My call, and do not be among those punctilious ones who were found among the people of the Qur’an: so scrupulous were they that they took precautions over the blood of a gnat, yet issued rulings authorizing the shedding of the blood of God.

311

بذکر مشغول بودند و چون آیات سلطان ذکر بر آن گروه القا میشد صیحه میزدند که این اذکار را بگذار و ما را از ذکر اللّه غافل مکن این بوده اعمال و افعال آن گروه که مشهود گشت و شما ای اهل بیان در این ایّام بجوهر آن اعمال مرتکب و عاملید و خود را از حقّ شمرده و میشمرید

Be-dhekr mashghūl būdand va chūn āyāt-e solṭān-e dhekr bar ān gorūh elqā mīshod ṣayḥa mīzadand ke īn adhkār rā bogdhār va mā rā az dhekr-e Allāh ghāfel makon. Īn būde aʿmāl va afʿāl-e ān gorūh ke mashhūd gasht va shomā ey ahl-e Bayān dar īn ayyām be-jowhar-e ān aʿmāl mortakeb va ʿāmel-īd va khod rā az Ḥaqq shomorde va mīshomorīd.

They were occupied with remembrance, yet when the verses of the Sovereign of Remembrance were recited to that company, they cried out, “Leave aside these remembrances, and do not distract us from the remembrance of God!” Such were the deeds and actions witnessed from that company. And you, people of the Bayān, are committing and carrying out the very essence of those deeds in these days, while you have reckoned, and still reckon, yourselves to be of the True One.

312

اذاً اشهد اللّه و ملائکته و انبیائه و رسله و الّذینهم یطوفنّ فی حول عرشه و کلّ ما خلق فی السّموات و الأرض بأنّی ما قصّرت فی تبلیغی ایّاکم و بلّغتکم رسالات اللّه حین ظهوری و حین ارتقائی و هذا الحین الّذی اظهرت نفسی عن افق الأبهی و القیت علیکم الحکمة و البیان و عرّفتکم جمال الرّحمن و اتممت الحجّة لکم و الدّلیل علیکم و البرهان فیکم و ما بقی من ذکر الّا و قد القیتکم

Idhan ush’hidu Allāha wa-malāʾikatahu wa-anbiyāʾahu wa-rusulahu wa-alladhīna hum yaṭūfunna fī ḥawli ʿarshihi wa-kulla mā khalaqa fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍi bi-annī mā qaṣṣartu fī tablīghī iyyākum wa-ballaghtukum risālāti Allāhi ḥīna ẓuhūrī wa-ḥīna irtiqāʾī wa-hādhā al-ḥīna alladhī aẓhartu nafsī ʿan ufuqi al-Abhā wa-alqaytu ʿalaykumu al-ḥikmata wa-al-bayāna wa-ʿarraftukum jamāla al-Raḥmāni wa-atmamtu al-ḥujjata lakum wa-al-dalīla ʿalaykum wa-al-burhāna fīkum wa-mā baqiya min dhikrin illā wa-qad alqaytukum.

Thus I call God to witness, and His angels, His Prophets, His Messengers, those who circle around His throne, and all that He has created in the heavens and on earth, that I have not fallen short in conveying My message to you. I have delivered to you the messages of God at the time of My manifestation, at the time of My ascent, and at this time when I have manifested Myself from the All-Glorious Horizon. I have imparted to you wisdom and utterance, made known to you the beauty of the All-Merciful, and completed the testimony for you, the evidence against you, and the proof among you. No admonition remains that I have not conveyed to you.

313

اذاً یا الهی انت تعلم بأنّی ما قصّرت فی امرک و بلّغت هؤلآء ما امرتنی به قبل خلق السّموات و الأرض و بیّنت لهم مناهج عدلک و اظهرت لهم مسالک رضائک

Idhan yā ilāhī anta taʿlamu bi-annī mā qaṣṣartu fī amrika wa-ballaghtu hāʾulāʾi mā amartanī bihi qabla khalqi al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍi wa-bayyantu lahum manāhija ʿadlika wa-aẓhartu lahum masālika riḍāʾika.

Thus, O my God, You know that I have not fallen short in Your Cause, and that I have conveyed to these people what You commanded Me before the creation of the heavens and the earth. I have explained to them the ways of Your justice and shown them the paths of Your good pleasure.

314

اذاً یا الهی فارحم علی هؤلآء و لا تجعلهم من الّذین اعرضوا عنّی و انکروا حقّی و جادلوا بآیاتی الی ان سفکوا دمی و تقطعوا جوارحی اذاً یا الهی ایّدهم علی امرک ثمّ انصرهم بنصرتک و لا تجعلهم محروماً عن هذه النّفحات الّتی هبّت عن هذا الرّضوان الّذی خلقته فی قطب الجنان و لا تمنعهم عن فوحات الّتی ارسلته عن افق اسمک الرّحمن

Idhan yā ilāhī fa-irḥam ʿalā hāʾulāʾi wa-lā tajʿalhum mina alladhīna aʿraḍū ʿannī wa-ankarū ḥaqqī wa-jādalū bi-āyātī ilā an safakū damī wa-taqaṭṭaʿū jawāriḥī. Idhan yā ilāhī ayyidhum ʿalā amrika thumma unṣurhum bi-nuṣratika wa-lā tajʿalhum maḥrūman ʿan hādhihi al-nafaḥāti allatī habbat ʿan hādhā al-riḍwāni alladhī khalaqtahu fī quṭbi al-jināni wa-lā tamnaʿhum ʿan fawaḥāti allatī arsaltahu ʿan ufuqi ismika al-Raḥmān.

Thus, O my God, have mercy on these people, and do not make them among those who turned away from Me, denied My right, and disputed My verses until they shed My blood and dismembered My limbs. O my God, strengthen them in Your Cause, then aid them with Your assistance. Do not deprive them of these breezes that have blown from this paradise which You have created at the heart of the gardens of heaven, and do not withhold from them the fragrances You have sent forth from the horizon of Your name, the All-Merciful.

315

اذاً فاحدث یا الهی فی صدورهم من نور کلماتک نار انجذابک لیقلبهم من قدرة المحضة الی یمین عرش رحمانیّتک ثمّ اشتعل یا الهی فی قلوبهم مشاعل عشقک و اشتیاقک لیحترق بها حجبات الّتی منعتهم عن ساحة قربک و لقائک

Idhan fa-aḥdith yā ilāhī fī ṣudūrihim min nūri kalimātika nāra injidhābika li-yaqlibahum min qudrati al-maḥḍati ilā yamīni ʿarshi raḥmāniyyatika thumma ishtaʿil yā ilāhī fī qulūbihim mashāʿila ʿishqika wa-ishtiyāqika li-yaḥtariqa bihā ḥujubāti allatī manaʿathum ʿan sāḥati qurbika wa-liqāʾika.

Thus, O my God, bring into being within their breasts, from the light of Your words, the fire of attraction to You, that through sheer power it may turn them toward the right hand of the throne of Your mercy. Then kindle within their hearts, O my God, the torches of love and longing for You, that through them the veils that have barred them from the court of Your nearness and Your presence may be burned away.

316

ثمّ خذ یا الهی ایادیهم بأیدی القدرة و الاقتدار ثمّ انقذهم عن غمرات الوهم و الهوی و بلّغهم الی مقرّ الّذی قدّسته عن اشارات کلّ ما خلق بین الأرض و السّمآء ثمّ الق علیهم کلمة الّتی بها تجذب افئدة العارفین الی سمآء عزّ الطافک و قلوب المقرّبین الی هوآء قدس افضالک

Thumma khudh yā ilāhī ayādiyahum bi-aydī al-qudrati wa-al-iqtidāri thumma anqidhhum ʿan ghamarāti al-wahmi wa-al-hawā wa-ballighhum ilā maqarri alladhī qaddastahu ʿan ishārāti kulli mā khuliqa bayna al-arḍi wa-al-samāʾi thumma alqi ʿalayhim kalimata allatī bihā tujdhabu afʾidatu al-ʿārifīna ilā samāʾi ʿizzi alṭāfika wa-qulūbu al-muqarrabīna ilā hawāʾi qudsi afḍālika.

Then take their hands, O my God, with the hands of power and might. Rescue them from the depths of delusion and desire, and bring them to the abode that You have sanctified beyond the allusions of all that has been created between earth and heaven. Then impart to them the word through which the hearts of those who know You are drawn to the heaven of the glory of Your loving-kindness, and the hearts of those brought near to You are drawn to the atmosphere of the holiness of Your favors.

317

ثمّ اجعلهم یا محبوبی من الّذین ما منعتهم کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض عن التّوجّه الی شطر عنایتک و الاستقرار علی امرک و الاعتراف بحضرتک و الایقان بلقائک و انّک انت الغفور الرّحیم المعطی العزیز الباذل النّاصر الکریم

Thumma ijʿalhum yā maḥbūbī mina alladhīna mā manaʿathum kullu man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍi ʿani al-tawajjuhi ilā shaṭri ʿināyatika wa-al-istiqrāri ʿalā amrika wa-al-iʿtirāfi bi-ḥaḍratika wa-al-īqāni bi-liqāʾika wa-innaka anta al-Ghafūru al-Raḥīmu al-Muʿṭī al-ʿAzīzu al-Bādhilu al-Nāṣiru al-Karīm.

Then make them, O my Beloved, among those whom all who are in the heavens and on earth have not prevented from turning toward Your loving care, remaining steadfast in Your Cause, acknowledging Your presence, and attaining certainty of meeting You. You are indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful, the Bestower, the Almighty, the Munificent, the Helper, the All-Bountiful.

Lawh-i-Ibn-i-Dhi’b (Epistle to the Son of the Wolf)
BH11924 (Unnamed)
